description.en: Agent skill for beautiful, verifiable architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams—self-contained HTML with motion and crisp export.

description.en: A one-of-a-kind resume builder that keeps your privacy in mind. Completely secure, customizable, portable, open-source and free forever. Try it out today!

description.en: :rocket: The Ultimate Image Uploader for Efficient Creators. Supports Obsidian, Typora, VS Code etc. and 60+ image hosting services  (S3, GitHub, Cloudflare R2, Imgur, Aliyun OSS...). Paste, upload, done.
description.zh: 通过 PicGo 已有配置（PicGo Cloud、GitHub、S3、腾讯云 COS、七牛，或任意已安装的上传插件）把本地图片和文件上传到图床，提供 `picgo_upload` 工具与 `/picgo` 命令。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件生态打造的现代化桌面端解决方案。万物皆「插件」，桌面本身也是「插件」。
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件生态提供现代化桌面端解决方案，助力插件的开发与管理。

description.en: Open-source LLM knowledge platform: turn raw documents into a queryable RAG, an autonomous reasoning agent, and a self-maintaining Wiki.

description.en: Hindsight, agent memory that learns: long-term project memory with auto recall and retain, knowledge pages, deep reflection, and per-repo memory banks.
description.zh: Hindsight 可学习的 Agent 记忆：自动召回与沉淀的长期项目记忆、知识页、深度反思与按仓库隔离的记忆库。

description.en: Self-evolving memory OS for LLM & AI Agents: ultra-persistent memory, hybrid-retrieval, and cross-task skill reuse, with 35.24% token savings and DeepSeek Harness support.
description.zh: 为AI代理提供持久化、自进化的记忆系统，支持混合检索与跨任务技能复用，显著节省令牌开销。

description.en: Remote control of a dsh web workspace from phone or PC: QR-code pairing through a token-gated channel, SSE real-time sync, and separate mobile and full desktop GUI modes.

description.en: Task board for the dsh web GUI: a sidebar multi-column kanban whose cards run in real DSH agent sessions and can also be scheduled with cron expressions, executed host-side even with the browser closed.
description.zh: 侧边栏多列任务看板：卡片交给真实 DSH 智能体会话执行，支持 cron 定时（Host 侧到点执行，关浏览器也生效）。

description.en: Git branch selector and Git graph for the dsh web GUI: switch branches and explore branch-lane and commit history from the conversation header.
description.zh: 输入框上方提供 Git 分支选择器，并把分支泳道与提交历史画成图谱，沿着时间线找到任意变更。

description.en: Skill center for the dsh web GUI: browse all loaded skills grouped by source, enable or disable model invocation, create new skills, and delete into a recoverable trash.
description.zh: 技能中心：按来源分级浏览已加载的全部 skill，启用/禁用模型调用、创建新技能、删除进可恢复回收站。

description.en: Archives, stores, and organizes entire sessions for later retrieval, ensuring conversation history is preserved and accessible.
description.zh: 归档并存储整个会话，便于日后检索，确保对话历史得以保存和访问。

description.en: Provides internationalization utilities for the DeepSeek Harness web plugin ecosystem, supporting translations across the workshop.
description.zh: 为插件生态提供国际化与翻译支持，方便多语言界面开发。

description.zh: 在界面中显示或管理当前会话标识。

description.zh: 为 DSH 网页客户端提供任务看板、Git 图、实时令牌统计等界面插件集合。

description.zh: 为DSH网页界面添加任务板、Git图、右侧面板、远程移动UI、宠物、实时Token统计和皮肤中心。

description.en: Adds a decorative companion element to the DSH web interface, providing playful interaction and visual appeal.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面添加装饰性陪伴元素，提供趣味互动与视觉点缀。

description.en: Renders a marketplace interface for discovering and installing community plugins.
description.zh: 渲染创意工坊界面，供用户发现并安装社区插件。

description.en: Introduces a virtual pet to the DSH web interface, offering playful interactions and visual engagement for users.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面中引入虚拟宠物，为用户提供趣味互动与视觉陪伴。

description.en: Enables remote shell access and command execution through the DSH web interface, facilitating system management.
description.zh: 通过 DSH 网页界面实现远程 Shell 访问与命令执行，便于系统管理。

description.en: Provides a tool for describing images via the DSH interface, enabling automated visual content analysis.
description.zh: 通过 DSH 界面提供图像描述工具，实现自动化视觉内容分析。

description.en: A web plugin ecosystem pack for DeepSeek Harness, aggregating various UI enhancements and tools via a creative workshop distribution channel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 聚合多种界面增强与工具插件的 Web 生态包，通过创意工坊分发。

description.en: Provides a settings panel for users to customize web UI preferences and options.
description.zh: 提供设置面板，让用户自定义 Web 界面偏好和选项。

description.en: Acts as a central hub for browsing and applying skins within the DSH web interface, simplifying theme management.
description.zh: 作为 DSH 网页界面的皮肤中心，集中浏览与应用主题，简化管理。

description.en: A `describe_image` vision tool for text-only models: images (local path, URL, attachment) go to a configurable OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint and only the returned text enters the session.
description.zh: 给纯文本模型补视觉：describe_image 把本地路径/URL/附件图片交给可配置的 OpenAI 兼容视觉端点，进会话的只有返回文本。

description.en: DSH Web UI plugin & skin collection: task board, git panel, etc.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 插件与皮肤合集：任务板、Git 面板等

description.en: One repository, three parts: a runtime injector for DSH plugin packages (inject, hot-reload, unload, promote a dev staging tool to the front, route self-heal, plus a settings-page plugin manager that lists, unloads and drags folders in to internalize), a task-aware reasoning-mode router agent preset (router-standard / router-spec / router-react), and a graded two-level task protocol whose six tools (commit_star, lock_stage, revise_do, edit_plan, mark_task, redteam_verdict) pin task state to disk. The injector implementation ships in-tree, so the install carries its own behaviour rather than a dependency list.
description.zh: 一个仓库三件套：DSH 插件包的运行时注入器（注入、热重载、卸载、开发侧挂区一键转正、路由自愈，外带设置页插件管理：列出、卸载、拖入文件夹内化）、任务感知的思维模式路由 agent 预设（router-standard / router-spec / router-react）、以及分级两级任务协议（commit_star / lock_stage / revise_do / edit_plan / mark_task / redteam_verdict 六个工具，任务状态落盘）。注入器实现直接在库内，安装的是它自己的行为而不是一份依赖清单。

description.en: Integrates a design studio into the AI workspace, enabling editable design creation and collaborative workflows.
description.zh: 在 AI 工作区中集成设计工作室，支持可编辑设计与协作流程。

description.en: Adds presentation creation capabilities to the AI workspace, allowing users to design and edit slides.
description.zh: 为 AI 工作区添加演示文稿制作功能，用户可设计与编辑幻灯片。

description.en: Integrates video editing tools into the AI workspace, supporting creation and modification of video content.
description.zh: 在 AI 工作区中集成视频编辑工具，支持创建与修改视频内容。

description.en: The plugin market inside DeepSeek Harness — browse, search, one-click install · DSH 可视化插件市场
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置页内浏览、搜索并安装社区插件，支持分类筛选、一键更新与停用，以及主题切换与配置备份。

description.en: Vision bridge for text-only models: paste an image, get structured JSON evidence (OCR, layout, semantics).
description.zh: 为纯文本模型架起视觉桥梁：粘贴图片，输出结构化 JSON 证据（OCR、版面、语义）。

description.en: Swaps the filesystem and bash providers for a mirage virtual workspace: file tools and shell commands run over mounted resources (RAM, S3, Redis, Slack, Gmail, Notion, Postgres) instead of the host disk, with per-mount read/write/exec modes, per-command sandbox routing (monty, pyodide, quickjs in process; docker, e2b, daytona remote), and installed CLIs (git, gh, slack, linear, ntn, gws, or one you register) as head words in the virtual terminal.
description.zh: 把文件系统与 bash 提供者换成 mirage 虚拟工作区：文件工具与 shell 命令作用于挂载的资源（RAM、S3、Redis、Slack、Gmail、Notion、Postgres）而非宿主磁盘，支持按挂载点设置读/写/执行模式、按命令选择沙箱（进程内 monty、pyodide、quickjs；远程 docker、e2b、daytona），并可在虚拟终端中安装 CLI（git、gh、slack、linear、ntn、gws，或自行注册的程序树）作为命令头词。

description.en: 开放的侧边栏底座，支持三方拓展注册新侧边栏页面。内置文件渲染编辑/终端/侧边对话/Git/子代理页面 ｜ Open sidebar foundation, supports third-party extensions to register new sidebar pages. Built-in file rendering/editing, terminal, side chat, Git, and sub-agent pages.
description.zh: 侧边栏完整工作台：内置文件渲染编辑、终端、Git 与子代理，支持三方插件注册新 Tab。

description.en: A memory management kit that helps agents remember, refine, and recall user information across sessions for personalized interactions.
description.zh: 为智能体提供跨会话记忆管理，帮助记住、优化并回忆用户信息，实现个性化交互。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to ReMe's local-first, self-evolving personal knowledge base: automatically captures completed main-agent conversations as user-owned Markdown memory, searches conversations and source material through reme_search with BM25, optional embeddings, and wikilink expansion, and schedules daily memory consolidation.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入 ReMe 本地优先、自进化的个人知识库：自动把已完成的主 Agent 对话沉淀为用户掌控的 Markdown 记忆，通过 reme_search 结合 BM25、可选向量检索和 wikilink 展开搜索对话与资料，并按日整理长期记忆。

description.en: Let AI agents use your real, logged-in browser without interrupting your work. CLI + extension for browser automation across any shell-capable AI agent.
description.zh: BrowserSkill 的 DeepSeek Harness 浏览器自动化桥接插件，通过原生浏览器工具控制可见的 Chrome 和 Edge Agent Window，支持可访问性与 VOM 页面观察、截图、隔离的多会话控制和 Web UI 实时观察浮层。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 皮肤集合 + Gallery 预览页（仿 Codex-Dream-Skin / DreamSkin.cc）。每个皮肤是符合官方标准（turtle-ui 式 setup）的独立可安装插件包。

description.zh: 供 DSH 与其他编程 Agent 共享的 Markdown 记忆，支持自动捕获、步骤前上下文注入、搜索召回，以及通过审阅面板实现 memory-to-skill 自进化。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）一只住在 DSH 界面右下角的小鲸鱼娘，帮你盯着DeepSeek账户余额。QQ弹弹，支持拖拽吸附、左吸附翻转、数字滚动动画，随界面自动启用，建议直接喊来你的dsh安装

description.zh: 为AI助手提供无限长期记忆，跨会话和任务保持上下文连贯。

description.en: Local first, desktop companion platform with animated pets, plugin SDK and coding-agent integrations.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的生命周期状态、错误与审批请求，桥接到本地运行的 OpenPets 桌面伙伴。

description.zh: 把腾讯云 CloudBase 后端接入 DeepSeek Harness——在对话里搭好并部署全栈应用，查询结果渲染为表格卡片（分页、排序、导出 CSV），部署后可预览真实域名，并提供 CloudBase MCP 工具集（`mcp__cloudbase__*`），登录走 device-code 流程。

description.en: TongFlow film-crew studio for image, voice, music and video production: the agent writes per-asset TongFlow workflow files (.tongflow.json) that run through TongFlow plugins, with an embedded workflow canvas, a shot/character/take project layout and a manga-drama template; sessions starting with @tongflow open the Studio view.
description.zh: 基于 TongFlow 的“片场”插件，用于图片、配音、音乐与视频制作：agent 为每个资产生成 TongFlow 工作流文件（.tongflow.json）并通过 TongFlow 插件执行，内嵌工作流画布，按镜头/角色/take 组织项目，附漫剧模板；以 @tongflow 开头的会话进入 Studio 界面。

description.en: AI 小说创作软件：把灵感、角色、世界观、大纲、章节写作、审稿和修稿组织成可控流程；提供 Windows/macOS 桌面版，支持本地和在线模型。AI Novel Writing Software: Organizes inspirations, characters, worldbuilding, outlines, chapter drafting, review, and revision into a controllable workflow. Features desktop apps for Windows/macOS, Ollama integration, and a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin preview.
description.zh: 安装专用 AI 小说创作预设与工作台：提供带修订号的本地项目资产、紧凑侧边工作台，以及需要原生审批的逐文件变更。

description.en: One-command install and free to use; paste an image to see and ask. Provides a nearly seamless multimodal experience for text-only models, supporting image Q&A, multi-image comparison, long-screenshot OCR, screenshot-to-UI restoration, element grounding, pixel diff, and more.
description.zh: 一键安装、免费使用；粘贴图片即可看图问答。为纯文本模型提供近乎无缝的多模态体验，支持图片问答、多图比较、长图 OCR、截图到前端 UI 还原、元素定位、像素对比等。

description.en: [dsh]为纯文本模型设计更强大的视觉工具箱：一行安装使用、粘贴图片直接识别、多张图片问答、截图到前端UI 还原等｜DeepSeek Harness-native integration for agent-vision-toolkit: image Q&A, long-screenshot OCR, UI restoration, grounding, pixel diff, Artifacts, and Web UI.
description.zh: 给纯文本AI装上眼睛，支持图片问答、长截图OCR、界面还原、视觉定位和像素级对比，让智能体看得懂屏幕。

description.en: Runs local security audits of AI API relays and LLM proxies from DeepSeek Harness, producing Markdown reports for prompt injection, model substitution signals, tool-call rewriting, error leakage, stream integrity, and profile-gated Web3 risks.
description.zh: 从 DeepSeek Harness 对 AI API 中转站和 LLM 代理运行本地安全审计，生成 Markdown 报告，覆盖提示词注入、模型替换信号、工具调用改写、错误泄漏、流完整性和按 profile 启用的 Web3 风险。

description.en: Reads the session files twenty-two other coding agents on this machine already wrote — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code Copilot Chat, opencode, OpenClaw, Hermes, Kimi, Cline, Zed and more — including sessions from before it was installed: six tools (deja_recall, deja_session, deja_blame, deja_fix, deja_how, deja_remember), a /deja command, and optional automatic recall added to the runtime context. Local BM25 index, no LLM, no embeddings, no network (dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-deja).
description.zh: 读取本机上其他二十二个编程智能体已经写下的会话文件——Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、VS Code Copilot Chat、opencode、OpenClaw、Hermes、Kimi、Cline、Zed 等，包括安装之前的历史：提供 deja_recall、deja_session、deja_blame、deja_fix、deja_how、deja_remember 六个工具与 /deja 命令，并可选地把召回结果加入运行时上下文。本地 BM25 索引，不用大模型，不用向量嵌入，不联网（dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-deja）。

description.en: The most comprehensive DeepSeek Harness plugin market — refreshed daily, sourced across the Internet, reviewed before publishing.
description.zh: 提供可视化插件市场，支持浏览、搜索和安装，每日更新精选内容。

description.en: dsh-Openwrite：OpenWrite 的 DeepSeek Harness 小说创作插件，含统一创作 Agent、90 个小说工具、原生工作台与标准审稿 DAG
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的小说创作工作台，提供创作预设、大纲与人物管理、正文批注、审稿流程和受管理的本地 Python 后端。

description.en: Packages the DeepSeek Harness desktop companion into an installable Electron app for macOS and Windows.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 桌面伴侣打包为 macOS 和 Windows 的可安装 Electron 应用。

description.en: Provides an experimental agent team profile for the DeepSeek Harness development environment.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 开发环境提供实验性的 agent 团队配置。

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 开发环境提供基于 web 的实验性 agent 团队配置。

description.en: Base package containing core UI components and runtime for the desktop companion.
description.zh: 桌面伴侣的基础包，包含核心界面组件与运行时。

description.en: Headless runtime package for running the desktop companion without a graphical interface.
description.zh: 无界面运行桌面伴侣的运行时包。

description.en: Provides a development kit for building and bundling DeepSeek Harness desktop companion applications.
description.zh: 提供用于构建和打包 DeepSeek Harness 桌面伴侣应用的开发套件。

description.en: Offers a minimal development toolkit for creating lightweight DeepSeek Harness desktop companion builds.
description.zh: 提供用于创建轻量级 DeepSeek Harness 桌面伴侣构建的最小开发工具包。

description.en: Web application bundle providing the full user interface for the desktop companion.
description.zh: 提供桌面伴侣完整用户界面的网页应用包。

description.en: Chrome sidebar extension that lets DeepSeek Harness operate your browser directly, no vision capabilities required. 一款 Chrome 侧边栏扩展程序，可让 DeepSeek Harness 直接操控您的浏览器，无需视觉能力。
description.zh: Chrome 侧边栏扩展，让 DSH 直接操控你的浏览器，无需视觉能力。

description.en: Bundles the DeepSeek Harness CLI with a desktop client for Windows, enabling one-click launch and usage.
description.zh: 打包 DeepSeek Harness 命令行工具，提供 Windows 桌面客户端，一键启动使用。

description.en: Connects different parts of the system, possibly automating workflows.
description.zh: 连接系统各部分，可能自动化工作流。

description.en: Provides a customizable navigation bar for the application.
description.zh: 提供可定制的应用导航栏。

description.en: Controls the reasoning effort level of the AI model.
description.zh: 控制AI模型的推理努力程度。

description.en: Manages chat sessions, including creation, switching, and deletion.
description.zh: 管理聊天会话，包括创建、切换和删除。

description.en: Lively Working-line extension for pi CLI and DSH
description.zh: Lively Working-line extension for pi CLI and DSH

description.en: DSH 桌面宠物：一行命令装好即用的透明动画小桌宠，支持多开、大小位置随心配置；还内置 DIY 素材链，能用 AI 视频自造专属宠物
description.zh: DSH Web UI 桌面宠物：25 个透明动画、屏幕漫游、点击反应与拖拽，附可复现的素材生成链。

description.en: Connects dsh to a local SandBase Harness runtime over stdio MCP for managing agents and sessions, streaming turns, inspecting artifacts and cancelling work.
description.zh: 通过 stdio MCP 将 dsh 连接到本地 SandBase Harness 运行时，用于管理代理与会话、流式执行任务、检查产物和取消工作。

description.en: 把 DSH 变成 2005 年门户网站｜Parody ads, fake games, and popups for the DSH Web UI
description.zh: 2005 年中文站点风格的整活广告插件：侧栏广告/信息流/角落弹窗 + 假关闭叉，素材全虚构。

description.en: Traceable, searchable cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness — conversation knowledge as typed graph nodes (TASK/SKILL/EVENT) and typed edges.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的可追溯、可检索跨会话记忆：把对话知识沉淀为带类型的图节点（任务/技能/事件）与关系边。

description.en: Facilitates integration between the DeepSeek Harness desktop app and its product, enabling feature bridging across packages.
description.zh: 桥接桌面应用与其产品功能，实现不同包之间的特性集成与协同。

description.en: Offers tools for creating and manipulating canvas-based visual content in the desktop workspace.
description.zh: 提供在桌面工作区创建和操作画布视觉内容的工具。

description.zh: 支持在桌面应用的不同会话或项目间继承模型配置。

description.zh: 提供处理 Office 文档的工具，支持创建和编辑文件。

description.en: Offers project management tools for organizing files, tasks, and resources in the desktop workspace.
description.zh: 提供项目管理工具，用于组织桌面工作区的文件、任务和资源。

description.en: Provides structured UI components for building consistent and organized interface elements.
description.zh: 提供结构化 UI 组件，用于构建一致且有序的界面元素。

description.en: Facilitates IPC communication for work product hosting between different app processes.
description.zh: 促进应用不同进程间的工作产品托管 IPC 通信。

description.en: Manages work references and citations across sessions in the desktop application.
description.zh: 管理桌面应用中跨会话的工作引用和引用来源。

description.en: LLM-supervised persistent memory for AI agents — graph-based recall, cross-session knowledge, single binary. Works with DeepSeek Harness, Claude Code, OpenClaw, and any agent runtime.
description.zh: LLM-supervised persistent memory for AI agents — graph-based recall, cross-session knowledge, single binary. Works with DeepSeek Harness, Claude Code, OpenClaw, and any agent runtime.

description.en: Applies a QQ 2006 retro visual theme to the client interface, evoking classic chat aesthetics.
description.zh: 为客户端界面应用QQ2006怀旧主题，唤起经典聊天风格。

description.en: Provides the AionUI panel for DeepSeek Harness desktop client, enhancing the user interface with a dedicated panel.
description.zh: 为桌面客户端提供AionUI面板，增强界面交互功能。

description.en: Displays real-time statistics and live metrics within the client interface for monitoring activity.
description.zh: 在客户端界面中展示实时统计和活动指标，便于监控。

description.en: Applies visual skins and themes to the desktop client, changing its appearance.
description.zh: 为桌面客户端应用视觉皮肤和主题，改变其外观。

description.en: Applies a QQ 98 retro visual theme to the client interface, offering a vintage look.
description.zh: 为客户端界面应用QQ98怀旧主题，提供复古外观。

description.en: Provides a theme skin styled after a securities trading interface for the desktop client.
description.zh: 为桌面客户端提供证券交易风格的界面皮肤。

description.en: The design skill for Claude Code, Cursor and any coding agent. Stop shipping AI-slop UI: turn it into shippable, tasteful frontend. Install: npx skills add superdesigndev/superdesign-skill. Powered by superdesign.dev
description.zh: 在 Superdesign 画布上做 UI 与营销图的设计技能：先读代码库拿上下文、抽取现有设计系统，再通过 Superdesign CLI 生成并迭代可分支的设计稿、流程页与可复用组件。

description.en: ccteam turns the coding agents you already run (Claude Code, Codex, Grok, DeepSeek Harness, Kimi, Pi) into one team — any session can spawn, dispatch, and collect work from any vendor on any machine, while you steer it all from Telegram, Lark, or a browser tab. 把你在用的编程 agent 编成一支团队,跨厂商跨机器派活,Telegram/飞书/网页统一指挥。
description.zh: 把 Claude Code/Codex/Grok/Kimi 编成团队，Telegram/飞书指挥

description.en: Distributed agent coordination platform where agents live, connect, coordinate, execute, and evolve together.
description.zh: 通过 WebSocket V2 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Avernet Bot 协作网络，支持自动注册、Agent 会话隔离、工具调用事件和多 Bot 路由工具。

description.en: Codex-style `@file` mentions: search workspace files in the composer and attach their contents to prompts.
description.zh: Codex 风格的 `@file` 文件引用，输入框里直接搜索并引用工作区文件。

description.en: Bundles an agentic AI sandbox matrix for orchestrated multi-environment workflows.
description.zh: 提供沙箱矩阵，用于编排多环境的自动化工作流。

description.en: 🥇 The strongest free web search plugin for DeepSeek Harness, and the search bridge for every model without native web access. Free, no signup, no API key. Ask the web or X, get structured JSON evidence. | 🥇 全网最强的 DeepSeek Harness 免费联网搜索插件，免费免注册免 API key。为不能联网的模型补上搜索，问网页或 X，拿回结构化 JSON 证据（搜索、抓取、引用）。
description.zh: 纯文本 agent 的联网搜索桥：搜索网页与 X，返回结构化 JSON 证据（search/fetch/引用）。

description.en: Failure-recovery memory: search and record failure-recovery lessons from real engineering sessions, with BM25 + semantic RAG retrieval and a lessons knowledge base.
description.zh: 失败恢复记忆库：从真实工程会话中搜索和记录失败恢复教训，支持 BM25 + 语义 RAG 检索和知识库管理。

description.en: 面向 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的渗透测试模式  @CloverSecLabs
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的授权渗透模式：以探索链路记录目标、线索、资产与漏洞，并在 Web 中可视化展示。

description.en: 基于dsh web实现的多种模式，目的是服务于redteam进行授权的安全研究，覆盖渗透测试、红队评估、代码审计等范围领域，请勿用于非法行为。（允许二开，赋予模块各位自己的业务逻辑，方法论只有自己熟练的才好用，好的方法论=好的生态）
description.zh: 面向授权安全研究的 DSH 合集：九个工作模式（redteam 总控、渗透测试、代码审计、二进制分析、攻防评估、免杀对抗、应急溯源、云安全攻防、CTF 解题）与十五个运行时插件，设置页管理台支持一键部署、安装、更新与卸载。

description.en: Interactive UI components rendered inline in replies: layout, charts, forms, quizzes, mermaid, 3D scenes, and an action event loop back to the model.
description.zh: 助手回复内渲染交互式 UI 组件：布局、图表、表单、测验、mermaid、3D 场景与回传事件循环。

description.en: Postiz Agents CLI - connect it to Claude / OpenClaw / etc, to schedule social media posts 🤖
description.zh: 把 Postiz 接到 Claude、OpenClaw 等 AI 助手，让它们帮你定时发布社交媒体内容。

description.en: Your thinking deserves a map: an infinite canvas where LLM conversations grow into an editable thought graph. Wires are the context.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中嵌入可编辑对话画布，通过连线选择画布请求的上下文，支持分支、合并与本地 Agent 会话导入。

description.en: Security guard for AI agents — blocks malicious skills, prevents data leaks, protects secrets. 24 detection rules, runtime action evaluation, trust registry.

description.zh: easyeda-agent

description.zh: 科研工作台，支持 LaTeX 编译、arXiv 管理、实验追踪、指标图表和 SSH 任务编排。

description.en: AnySearch web search provider and advanced search tools for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
description.zh: 基于 AnySearch 的实时网页与垂直搜索插件，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供搜索工具。

description.en: Local IMAP invoice download, OCR, archive, and Excel reimbursement summaries for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地 IMAP 发票下载、OCR 识别、归档与 Excel 报销汇总。

description.en: Cross-agent, local-first persistent memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), powered by Mnemon. It shares long-term memory across Mnemon-enabled agents and adds runtime memory, searchable project documents, semantic recall, knowledge graph, and a Sidebar UI.
description.zh: 由 Mnemon 驱动的 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）跨 Agent、本地优先的持久记忆插件。它可在支持 Mnemon 的 Agent 之间共享长期记忆，并提供运行时记忆、可检索项目档案、语义召回、知识图谱和 Sidebar UI。

description.en: 基于 Jingyun Studio + DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 打造的一站式 AI 商业化桌面客户端，一个将 AI 智能体 / 技能 / 工作流转化为可交易商品的完整商业化平台客户端。  井云为 DSH 注入了完整的商业闭环：登录注册 → 会员体系 → 订阅支付 → 云端资产 → 多端同步，让 AI 开发者 30 分钟内将自己的智能体封装为独立的商业产品。
description.zh: 基于 Jingyun Studio 与 DeepSeek Harness 打造的一站式 AI 商业化桌面客户端。

description.en: 是一层高自由度的玻璃质感主题，套在 DeepSeek Harness 网页端。顶栏、侧边栏、输入框、统计行、轨迹视图都成了磨砂玻璃片。玻璃模糊度、磨砂度、背景（流体或自定义壁纸，壁纸还能单独调模糊和磨砂）全都能在设置卡片里自由调节。关掉开关就回到原生界面，不改 DSH 任何一行源码。

description.zh: 自动捕获运行时上下文和项目文档，实现跨会话的持久化、可搜索记忆。

description.zh: 提供轻量级上下文管理，保持关键记忆活跃且不增加过多负担。

description.en: Give DeepSeek Harness a real office environment.  Univer Office Plugin brings spreadsheets, docs, slides, canvases, relational tables, and more into one runtime — with connected data, validation, versioned changes, and isolated worktrees for multi-agent collaboration.

description.en: HarmonyOS NEXT skill bundle for DeepSeek Harness with offline API references and DevEco, HDC, and emulator automation guidance.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 HarmonyOS NEXT 技能包、离线 API 参考及 DevEco、HDC 与模拟器自动化指南。

description.en: Open-source CLI, schemas, resolver, and DSH agent tools for DSH Plugin Hub
description.zh: 提供命令行工具、模式定义和解析器，辅助开发与分发 DSH 插件。

Reviews code changes by analyzing diffs and providing feedback.

description.en: Creates and edits slide presentations with AI assistance.

description.en: Desktop-native BigFish companion for DeepSeek Harness — real Agent status, always on top on Windows.

description.zh: 本地 SQLite 任务板，以原生覆盖页呈现：项目、任务、评论、关联、附件与工作流自动化，状态流转 backlog → todo → in_progress → in_review → done；提供 `taskboard_*` Agent 工具（Agent 只能提交到 in_review，验收需人工）、无头 JSON CLI 与打包 skill。

description.en: Desktop pet (QQ-pet style): floats in the corner, draggable, feedable, playable.
description.zh: 桌面宠物（QQ 宠物形态）：右下角悬浮、可拖拽/投喂/玩耍。

description.en: Community distribution: TUI, desktop, and Web UI as one bundle with layered installation.
description.zh: 社区发行版：TUI、桌面端与 Web UI 统一体验，分层安装、一步到位。

description.en: 把本机 Wallpaper Engine 的壁纸变成 DSH 网页界面的背景：Video 动态播放、Web 以 iframe 加载、Scene 壁纸提取主纹理作为静态帧；iOS 液态玻璃设置窗口（配色 / 玻璃颜色 / 透明度）、内容分级与类型过滤、自定义壁纸上传、紧凑 CD 架布局、黑胶唱片展示、隐藏 / 恢复、倍速 / 翻转与自动轮播。感谢 Jerry 维护 macOS 版。
description.zh: 前置要求：DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5-rc.1+（DSH Desktop ≥ 2.0.7）且 dsh-better-sidebar ≥ 0.19.0，安装或更新本插件前请先更新两者。把本机 Wallpaper Engine 的 Video/Web 壁纸实时播放到聊天界面后方，Scene 壁纸由内置渲染器输出完整场景帧，支持内容分级/类型过滤、自定义壁纸上传与 iOS 液态玻璃设置窗口。

description.en: Pixel-perfect clones of any webpage. Paste a URL, get a measured Vite + React replica.

description.en: WebView2-based DSH launcher
description.zh: 基于 WebView2 的 DSH 启动器

description.en: 让 Agent 的工作方式可组合、可审查、可持续改进，最终实现 Agent Self Evoling。 DeepSeek Harness Web plugin with composable task controls and isolated, human-reviewed self-evolution.
description.zh: 提供常规执行、第一性原理提示、独立对抗审查三种任务模式。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness（dsh）Windows 轻量启动器：双击即用，克制的原生体验 / Lightweight Windows launcher for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — double-click to run, native & restrained
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: control how long the dsh service (node) stays alive when using the dsh-launcher shell. Writes %LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-launcher\settings.json (serviceLifetime: 0 always-on, 1 tray-resident, 2 follow-window); the shell applies it on window close / tray exit. No runtime dependencies.

description.en: 一个基于 DeepSeek Harness 插件机制构建的多端远程访问方案，通过安全、低延迟、端到端加密的 P2P 优先网络，支持从 PC、Android 和 Web 随时访问并操作远程 Harness 和 CodeX。 (A multi-device remote access solution built on the DeepSeek Harness plugin system, enabling PC, Android, and Web clients to securely access and operate remote Harness and CodeX over a low-latency, end-to-end encrypted, P2P-first network.)
description.zh: 支持从桌面或安卓设备安全远程连接并操作 Harness。

description.en: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Claude Code 风格终端界面，支持 Windows、macOS 与 Linux，兼容透明终端、VS Code 主题和自定义配色。
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的终端工作区，支持导入本地 VS Code JSON／JSONC 主题、继承终端背景效果、鼠标文本选择、结构化工具与 Diff 视图、Session／Profile／插件管理，以及 Skill／MCP 浏览。

description.en: Token usage accounting for DeepSeek Harness, reconciled against New API and Sub2API relay-site billing
description.zh: Token 记账：对账 New API 与 Sub2API 中转站账单。

description.en: One-command skin plugin: 8 original themes, translucent wallpaper with opacity/blur, per-user accent, and shareable theme-pack import/export, favorites and surprise-me — purely native on DSH's token system.
description.zh: 一键换肤插件：8 套原创主题、背景壁纸（透明度/模糊）、强调色、主题包导入/导出+分享链接、收藏与随机，纯原生 token 系统接入。

description.en: Multi-device remote access for DeepSeek Harness: continue an active session from your phone, tablet, browser, or another computer over an end-to-end encrypted channel (Noise IK + adaptive relay/WebRTC transport), with device authorization, ApiProxy-only remote capabilities, and read-only file preview via dsh-file-viewer — no shell, remote desktop, or write access.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 多端远程访问：从手机、平板、浏览器或另一台电脑继续进行中的会话，端到端加密通道（Noise IK + 自适应 Relay/WebRTC 传输），设备授权管理；远程端仅开放 ApiProxy 能力，支持 dsh-file-viewer 只读文件预览，不提供 Shell、远程桌面或写入权限。

description.en: Free web search provider for DeepSeek Harness - DuckDuckGo backend, no API key needed
description.zh: DSH 免费搜索插件：7 个引擎（DuckDuckGo/Bing/SearXNG 免费 + Exa/Perplexity/DeepSeek 付费）、自动回退、设置页 UI（API key 输入 + 官网链接）、web_fetch、引擎测试工具。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 滑动变阻器皮肤

description.zh: 让 AI 帮你连数据库、写 SQL。

description.en: Bridge the Pi and DeepSeek Harness ecosystems: one Pi Host ABI runs unmodified Pi extensions as native DSH plugins. 打通 Pi 与 DSH 生态。
description.zh: 桥接 Pi 与 DSH 生态，使 Pi 扩展通过共享 ABI 作为原生 DSH 插件运行。

description.en: Bridges the Pi and DeepSeek Harness ecosystems, enabling unmodified Pi extensions to run as native DSH plugins.
description.zh: 打通 Pi 与 DeepSeek Harness 生态，让 Pi 扩展无需修改即可作为原生 DSH 插件运行。

description.en: Bridge the Pi and DeepSeek Harness ecosystems: one Pi Host ABI runs unmodified Pi extensions as native DSH plugins. 打通 Pi 与 DSH 生态。
description.zh: 让 Pi 生态的扩展无需修改就能直接跑在 DeepSeek Harness 上，轻松迁移插件、打通两个 AI 工具生态。

description.en: Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness kept as plain markdown, one fact per file, readable in any editor. The `MEMORY.md` index has a hard 200-line / 25 KB cap enforced by `ctx.tools.guard()`: a write that would grow an over-cap index is denied, while a rewrite that shrinks it always passes, so an oversized index can be compacted step by step. The plugin never writes memories on its own — what is kept is decided by you and the model. The same store is also used by Claude Code, Codex, Kiro and OpenClaw.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的长期记忆，以纯 markdown 保存：一条事实一个文件，任何编辑器都能打开。索引 `MEMORY.md` 有 200 行 / 25KB 的硬上限，由 `ctx.tools.guard()` 强制执行——让已超限的索引继续变大的写入会被拒绝，而缩小它的重写一律放行，于是过大的索引可以一步步压缩下来。插件不会自行写入记忆，记什么由你和模型决定。同一个记忆库也被 Claude Code、Codex、Kiro、OpenClaw 使用。

description.en: 88 installable open-source Agent Skills for research, social intelligence, marketing, and business workflows—compatible with Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 通过文件系统 Skill provider 将 88 个研究、社交情报、营销与商业 Agent Skills 挂载到 dsh。

description.en: AI-assisted local creator workbench for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把每条视频变成一个本地文件夹，从选题到发布一站式管理，AI 帮你搞定创作全流程。

description.en: Local Git-backed long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness with hybrid CJK/English retrieval, cited context, transactional sync, previews, and rollback.

description.en: Persistent multi-model squads configured in Settings and selected in the Composer, with per-member model/tool policies; the main Agent dynamically plans each send as a bounded DAG with bounded reviewer/repair loops, while Run Center tracks retries and per-member tokens from official Harness usage events.

description.en: Second-model AI auto-review for DeepSeek Harness approval requests: a read-only reviewer subagent returns structured allow/deny verdicts with reasons, fail-closed by default, fully auditable from the session log (approval/asked -> autoReview/verdict -> approval/decided).

description.zh: 将 DSH 对话导出为锤子便签风格 PNG，或在配置的账号工作区中新建和更新 Markdown 便签。

description.en: 推荐组件（非必须）：DeepSeek Harness 运行时注入器；已随 dsh-routing-suite 单仓库化保留，本仓库继续维护/发布。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 运行时注入模组，按官方 REPLACE 结构排程重载，插件升级不用手动折腾。

description.en: Provider balances, subscription quotas, and token-usage analytics for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI (dsh web).
description.zh: 在 dsh web 里一眼看清各家模型余额、订阅额度和 token 用量，花钱心里有数。

description.en: Token usage heatmap, per-model breakdowns, and DeepSeek account balance for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI (dsh web).
description.zh: Token 用量热力图 + 分模型明细 + DeepSeek 账户余额，全部在一个 Web 面板里看。

description.en: Safe automatic permissions for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 Workspace Write 与 Full access 之间增加 Auto 权限档：日常操作留在官方 workspace-write 沙箱内，由当前会话模型复核升权与破坏性调用，精确的越界访问按次放行一次，意图不明时询问，命中关键路径则拒绝。

description.en: Lowtide (as in low tide) runs task batches automatically in off-peak hours — a highly customizable task framework with four execution strategies, L1–L3 semi/full-auto adjudication, in-place task editing and preflight checks, built on the Cordis microkernel, one build for both desktop and web.
description.zh: lowtide（退潮）插件能够实现闲时自动批量跑任务——任务框架高度自定义，四种执行策略，L1–L3 半自动/全自动裁决，支持任务编辑与预检，Cordis 微内核集成，桌面网页端通用。

description.en: A DSH Web plugin for phone and tablet access with QR pairing, per-device authorization, revocation, and a Cloudflare Quick Tunnel.
description.zh: 通过二维码配对从移动设备远程访问DSH，支持安全登录和设备授权。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for Android — build, run, and interact with a live emulator or USB device stream inside a conversation, driven entirely through adb.
description.zh: 在对话中直接操控安卓模拟器或USB真机，通过adb实时查看屏幕、执行操作，让AI帮你调试和测试应用。

description.en: Dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code or Codex: native subagent progress, in-host worker sessions with per-tier presets, and a multimodal bridge for vision and image generation.
description.zh: 从 Claude Code / Codex 派发任务给 DSH Agent：原生子代理进度、按能力分层预设的宿主内工作会话，以及为纯文本 Harness 提供视觉与图像生成的多模态桥。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness skin market 皮肤市场 已收录200+DSH 皮肤 完善评分系统加人工审核，有便捷的社区收录入口；有在线页面方便在线浏览，也有插件方便管理本地皮肤
description.zh: 原生皮肤市场与生命周期管理器，发现社区皮肤、展示预览与兼容状态，并提供已验证的一键安装或手动安装入口。

description.en: Complete reverse-skill (87 SKILL.md) as a DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Cordis plugin — reverse engineering, authorized pentesting and security research skill pack.
description.zh: 完整 reverse-skill（85 个 SKILL.md）的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：逆向工程、授权渗透测试与安全研究的技能路由包。

description.en: 专门为 agent 打造的开源 agent 搜索工具，具备 200+的搜索源及多语言搜索能力，覆盖中文/英文/学术/代码/购物/金融/新闻/百科。
description.zh: 面向 agent 的统一搜索与证据核验：120+ 引擎多语言路由，垂直域与结构化模态卡，10 个 MCP 工具与 wide_research 编排，fetch 核验回填证据分的证据闭环。

description.en: Manage your own remote DSH host from the local GUI: SSH tunnels, mixed remote session list, one-click remote GUI, auto-healing tunnels.
description.zh: 本地 GUI 管理你自己服务器上的 DSH 分身：SSH 隧道、远程会话混排列表、一键远程 GUI、隧道掉线自动重连。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness preset that configures Git Bash support and a ready-to-use terminal environment.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：一键安装「极简模式 (Git Bash)」agent preset —— 把 DSH 自带极简模式中的 bash 调用映射到 Git for Windows 的 bash（MSYS），让 Windows 上的极简模式真正可用。

description.en: Agent-first web presentation workspace: turn briefs into editable slide decks and export native PPTX on demand.
Provides an adapter for integrating DSH with standard tooling.
description.zh: 提供适配器，用于集成DSH与标准工具。

description.en: Aqua: a highly customizable glassmorphism theme for the Web surface — adjustable blur, frost, fluid or wallpaper backdrop, unified corners, and motion
description.zh: Aqua: a highly customizable glassmorphism theme for the Web surface — adjustable blur, frost, fluid or wallpaper backdrop, unified corners, and motion

description.en: One-click backup, export, import and migration of a whole DSH config: settings, plugins, MCP, skills and workspaces. Secrets are excluded by default and, if you opt in, are AES-256-GCM encrypted rather than written in the clear; imports preview first and auto-backup with rollback, profiles hold multiple setups, and remote sync pushes portable config through a private Git repo with secrets excluded.
description.zh: 一键备份、导出、导入与迁移整套 DSH 配置：设置、插件、MCP、技能与工作区。密钥默认不导出；若选择包含，则以 AES-256-GCM 加密而非明文写出。导入先预览、自动备份并可回滚，profile 可保存多套配置，远程同步经私有 Git 仓库推送可移植配置且不含密钥。

description.en: DSH Web UI plugin: Skills settings section with hot enable/disable, delete and add（Web界面的skill管理工具）
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面增加技能管理区，支持热启停、删除和新增技能。

description.en: DSH Web UI plugin: Skills settings section with hot enable/disable, delete and add
description.zh: 技能管理面板：在设置页直接启用/停用、删除、添加 Skills，不用改配置文件。

description.en: Registers Ark Agent Plan, Coding Plan and postpaid model routes in the native DSH model picker.
description.zh: 在 DSH 原生模型选择器中注册方舟 Agent Plan、Coding Plan 与后付费模型路由。

description.en: Adds a Managed Agents settings tab and MCP tools to dispatch long-running agent tasks to Ark cloud Managed Agents.
description.zh: 新增 Managed Agents 设置页，并通过 MCP 工具向方舟云端 Managed Agents 派发长任务、取回轨迹与产物。

description.en: Long-term memory for DSH agents — durable, inspectable memories with recall, search, browse and knowledge-graph tools, import from ten other AI coding tools, and a settings page.
description.zh: 为 DSH Agent 提供长期记忆——可检索、可检视的持久记忆，带回忆、搜索、浏览与知识图谱工具，支持从十个其他 AI 编码工具导入记忆，并附设置页。

description.en: Adds a strip above the composer to recall sent-but-unread (steering) text messages before the model reads them.
description.zh: 在输入框上方提供「未读消息」条带，可在模型读取前撤回已发送但尚未被读取的文字消息。

description.en: Dynamic workflow for DSH (placeholder).
description.zh: 把 DSH 的一次性多 Agent 调度变成可保存、可观察、可恢复的工作流，跑起来更省心。

description.en: DSH 个人配置:Token 用量统计 / 成本估算 / 自定义指令 / 外观全局字号 / 桌面宠物(含会话状态概览),纯本地不联网。Personal center for DSH: usage stats, cost estimation, custom instructions, global font size & desktop pet with session overview — all local & offline.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 个人中心：跨会话用量统计、按模型成本估算、全局自定义指令、外观全局字号、数据驱动的桌面宠物（位图/矢量皮肤）与会话状态概览，纯本地离线运行。

description.en: UltraCode-style multi-agent orchestration: a generatable, savable, governable, observable, resumable workflow layer.
description.zh: 把 UltraCode 式多 Agent 调度带给 DSH：可生成、可保存、可治理、可观察、可恢复的 Workflow 层。

description.en: Rewind conversation and workspace state, powered by a persistent Change Ledger.
description.zh: 对话回退：基于持久 Change Ledger 回滚会话与工作区状态。

description.en: Multi-agent department framework for long-form complex tasks, fighting AI hallucination, validated on academic research. 共识管线：多智能体部门长线任务解决框架，对抗AI幻觉，以学术研究为验证场景。
description.zh: 以多智能体部门协作编排长线复杂任务，降低幻觉，适用于学术研究流程。

description.en: A Web UI plugin that presents model requests, responses, and tool calls as a navigable workflow for each DSH conversation.
Select text → annotate → send with your message; replies map back to each annotation.
description.zh: 选中文字→批注→随消息发送，回复按批注逐条对照。

description.en: Verifiable research-report engine for DeepSeek Harness: content-addressed evidence ledger (claim-snapshot binding, tamper-evident) plus versioned sealed reports with per-claim verification verdicts and a manifest-sealed directory.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的可核查研究报告引擎：通过内容寻址的证据台账和版本化封存报告使每条结论携带核查结论，由 manifest 哈希封存目录，检索编排复用 ctx.web 与 ctx.jobs 接口。

description.en: Multi-model council for DeepSeek Harness: independent answers, anonymous peer reviews, and an inspectable final decision.
description.zh: 让多个大模型各自作答、匿名互评，最终给出一个可追溯的共识结论，帮你做更靠谱的决策。

description.en: Industry and company research domain pack for DeepSeek Harness: methodology skills, industry chain mapping, public-source policy/news tracking, company research cards, and auditable research reports. Research only - not investment advice.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的确定性行业研究报告：公司与行业研究流程基于分阶段证据产出结构化、可核验的报告。

description.en: Profile-wide DSH governance and routing with a Web Control Center for responsibility and evidence inspection, plus compaction, scoped semantic memory, safety continuity, and verified delivery; compatible with DSH 0.1.5-rc.1.
description.zh: 面向整个 DSH profile 的治理与路由 bundle，提供用于职责与证据检查的 Web Control Center，以及压缩、本地作用域语义记忆、安全连续性与真实验收；兼容 DSH 0.1.5-rc.1。

description.en: A preset editor for DSH that adds one-click armor breaking functionality.
description.zh: DSH 预设编辑器插件, 支持一键破甲.

description.en: Offers a plugin marketplace with search, five-dimension scoring, and one-click installation for over 1500 DSH plugins.
description.zh: 提供插件市场，支持搜索、五维评分和 1500+ DSH 插件的一键安装。

description.en: 将 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 包含的模型自动接入 DeepSeek Harness，零配置使用。Bring the models in the WorkBuddy desktop app into DeepSeek Harness with zero configuration.
description.zh: 将 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 包含的模型自动接入 DeepSeek Harness，在 DSH 对话窗口里零配置使用。

description.en: DSH Web内目前最无感的消息撤回、重编辑插件，原版体验，兼容性强，功能简单可开关，设置丰富，现代化轻量ui框架。The most seamless message recall & re-edit plugin for DSH Web — native experience, strong compatibility, simple toggles, rich settings, modern lightweight UI. DSH Web で最もシームレスなメッセージ撤回・再編集プラグイン——ネイティブ体験、高い互換性、シンプルなトグル、充実した設定、モダンで軽量な UI。
description.zh: 在 dsh web 中内联编辑与撤回自己的消息——惰性、无痕，带版本翻页器与会话级草稿持久化。

description.en: Local-first A-share research workbench for DeepSeek Harness: market dashboards, watchlists, valuation, four investor agents, versioned reports, and continuous post-report chat.
description.zh: 本地优先的A股研究台，集成行情看板、自选股、估值分析、四个AI投研助手和持续对话，帮你把研究做成报告。

description.en: Automatically turn successful DeepSeek Harness sessions into reusable, reviewable Agent Skills.
description.zh: 将 DSH 会话中明确表达的经验整理为可审核的原生 Skill 草稿，并仅在用户确认后保存。

description.en: Write declarative allow, deny, and ask rules for tools
description.zh: Claude Code 风格的声明式权限规则：按序 allow/deny/ask 的 YAML 规则，在 tools/pre-execute 瀑布上匹配工具名、参数、工作区路径与 agent 身份，带完整会话日志审计、干跑模式与热重载。

description.en: Non-commercial day/night whale-girl skin for official Harness rc.7: current no-viewport-frame layout, paired crystal-workshop and moon-tide scenes, chibi companions, translucent ornaments, and lightweight ambience.
description.zh: 面向官方 Harness rc.7 的非商业鲸鱼娘昼夜皮肤：当前无整屏边框布局、白昼水晶工坊与夜晚月潮观测室双场景、Q 版侧栏伙伴、透明花边与轻量氛围。

description.en: Project-scoped cross-session memory: seven-layer SQLite store (soul/user/project/fact/lesson/rules/topic) on node:sqlite, cache-friendly first-message injection plus per-message keyword hits, memory_remember/search/find_similar/read/update/project tools, and idle-window consolidation ("dream") with peak-hour suppression. Prompt texts ship as per-language data files — the framework supports multilingual users.
description.zh: 项目级跨会话记忆：node:sqlite 七层存储（soul/user/project/fact/lesson/rules/topic），首条消息缓存友好注入 + 每条消息关键词命中，memory_remember/search/find_similar/read/update/project 工具，空闲窗口自动整理记忆（dream，峰时抑制）。prompt 文案按语言数据文件加载——框架支持多语言用户。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 社区内置插件市场（dsh-plugin）— 搜索插件、下载并安装 4000+ 人工精选社区插件，每日更新、完全免费。内置在 Harness「设置 → 插件中心」，无需离开应用即可浏览、搜索、安装各类 AI 插件。
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 社区内置插件市场（dsh-plugin）— 搜索插件、下载并安装 4000+ 人工精选社区插件，每日更新、完全免费。内置在 Harness「设置 → 插件中心」，无需离开应用即可浏览、搜索、安装各类 AI 插件。

description.en: Adds video lens capabilities for processing visual content in sessions.
description.zh: 添加视频镜头能力，处理会话中的视觉内容。

description.en: Governs AI agent tasks by aligning goals, planning, orchestrating, and verifying delivery while managing risks.
description.zh: 治理 AI agent 任务，对齐目标与事实，规划调度并验证交付。

description.en: Session strata for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: the transcript's scrollbar becomes a to-scale, colour-coded map of the whole run, with your own messages emphasised and clickable anchors.
description.zh: 滚动条槽位里的会话缩略图：按事件类型着色的等比色块、用户与失败锚点、滚到顶自动补载历史、悬停线索墙铺开全部发言，附近/中/全三档地图尺度切换。

description.en: Code-first generative UI for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 通过代码描述生成用户界面，实现代码优先的 UI 构建方式。

description.en: In-harness plugin market for the dsh web GUI: browse the awesome-dsh-plugin.com catalog and install/uninstall plugins into a profile from Settings → Plugins → Plugin Market.
description.zh: dsh Web GUI 内的社区插件市场：浏览 awesome-dsh-plugin.com 目录，从 设置 → 插件 → 插件市场 安装/卸载插件到 profile。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin — turns dsh web into a SillyTavern-style roleplay frontend: character cards, prompt presets, lorebooks, personas, BM25 long-term memory, world-state deltas, and rollback-able floor operations, all on the dsh agent runtime.
description.zh: 把 dsh web 变成酒馆式角色扮演前端，支持角色卡、世界书和长期记忆。

description.en: Template for deepseek-harness plugin development.
description.zh: Template for deepseek-harness plugin development.

description.en: Use openai-codex models and image generation via ChatGPT OAuth for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 通过 ChatGPT OAuth 将 OpenAI Codex 模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，并提供可选的搜索与图片工具。

description.en: 🧠 The memory that dreams — cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness. Offline & private, auto-consolidates in its sleep (autoDream), visualized in a memory panel.
description.zh: 会做梦的记忆 — DeepSeek Harness 跨会话记忆插件：跨会话记住你与项目、深夜 autoDream 自动巩固记忆、冲突记忆先冻结待你裁决、全程可回放审计。默认离线：SQLite 配人工可编辑的 Markdown 镜像，提供本地语义检索、实体图谱、交互式记忆库面板及外部 API 与 CLI。

description.en: DSH网络设置插件 \| DeepSeek Harness network diagnostics, proxy detection and repair for Windows/WSL/MacOS
description.zh: 可视化 DSH 进程在 Windows 或 WSL 上的网络链路（DNS/TCP/TLS/HTTP 分层探测），检测失效的代理配置，并提供带快照回滚的安全修复。

description.en: Delete one complete turn from a DeepSeek Harness session without deleting the session
description.zh: 允许从 DSH 会话中删除单个完整轮次，而不删除整个会话。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness bundle that packages the Superpowers development workflow as native DSH skills.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 版 Superpowers 技能包：移植自 obra/superpowers 的 TDD、调试、规划与协作技能，以 Cordis 插件安装并注册 14 个技能（零运行时依赖）。

description.en: Adds account login, API and custom Provider setup, model switching, image fallback for text-only models, and token/cost attribution to DeepSeek Harness 47f.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 47f 提供账号登录、API 与自定义 Provider 配置、模型切换、纯文本模型图片兜底，以及 Token 与费用归因。

description.en: Browser-local wallpaper and translucent-panel controls for DSH Web, with multiple images, fit and position choices, shading, blur, and panel opacity.
description.zh: DSH Web 的浏览器本地壁纸与半透明面板插件，支持多图切换、填充与位置选择、遮罩、模糊和面板透明度调节。

description.en: Get one notify API and eight channel adapters
description.zh: DSH 多渠道通知与手机控制插件：一个 `notify()` API 接入 27 个渠道，支持事件推送、手机审批与提问、手机任务接管（`/tasks` · `/use`）、图片入会话、六条入站控制通道、本机 Web 管理台、双语消息（`lang` 切换 zh/en）、多 agent 路由和零运行时依赖。

description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness control of the Tabbit Browser: auto-loads the tabbit-browser skill on install, detects official Tabbit and Tabbit Browser releases (>= 1.9.0), checks the tabbit-cli persistent runtime, diagnoses the per-platform DSH sandbox mode needed to call the CLI, and downloads the region-matched official installer via a background job when no qualifying version is present.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 能够控制 Tabbit 浏览器：安装即自动加载 tabbit-browser skill，检测国际版 Tabbit 与国内版 Tabbit Browser 正式版（>= 1.9.0），检查 tabbit-cli 常驻运行时，按平台诊断调用 CLI 所需的 DSH sandbox 模式，并在没有合格版本时通过后台任务下载与系统地区匹配的正式版安装包。

description.en: Officially connects QQ Bot to DeepSeek Harness, enabling chat-based interactions through the popular messaging platform.
description.zh: 让 QQ Bot 接入 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的官方插件

description.en: DSH Web UI plugin: auto-sends 「继续」 after non-human interruptions, with error classification, adaptive backoff, pause, idempotency/loop guards, resume templates, and stats—all configurable in settings UI | DSH 前端 UI 插件：非人为中断后自动发送「继续」，支持错误分类、自适应退避、暂停、幂等/循环保护、续跑模板与统计，均可在设置界面配置
description.zh: DSH Web 请求中断自动续跑：网络、超时或宿主崩溃等非人为失败后自动发送「继续」，支持错误分类、自适应退避、模板化继续文本与浏览器通知。

description.en: Local-first content production and operations workspace for DSH: manage ideas, scripts, media assets, schedules, goals, publishing status, and post-publication reviews.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的本地内容生产与运营工作台：管理灵感、脚本、媒体资产、档期、目标、发布状态和发布后复盘。

description.en: Bounded, layered, approval-gated, auditable cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness (capability seam: ctx.memory + SQLite provider + memory tool + frozen snapshot injection)
description.zh: 有界、分层、带审批门、可审计的跨会话记忆：`ctx.memory` 服务 + 零依赖 SQLite 存储 + `memory` 工具与冻结快照注入，并预演 dsh-memory-protocol v1——适配器注册表与可分发的一致性套件。

description.en: 🌊 Persistent dock & fully-customizable balance/usage panel for DeepSeek Harness — activity heatmap, dual-channel comparison, local-only & privacy-first
description.zh: 显示常驻停靠栏与可定制的余额/用量面板，含活动热力图与双通道对比。

description.en: Integrates GitHub functionality into DeepSeek Harness, likely enabling repository interactions and workflows.
description.zh: 将 GitHub 功能集成到 DeepSeek Harness，可能支持仓库交互与工作流。

description.en: Rebuilds the DeepSeek Harness web sidebar, workspace tree, search, and turn navigation in a Codex-style layout.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页端重构 Codex 风格侧栏、工作区会话树、全局搜索和轮次导航。

description.en: Liang Saint Slider as the DeepSeek Harness model + thinking-effort selector.
description.zh: 把滑动变祖器搬进 DeepSeek Harness，拖动滑块就能切换模型和思考强度。

description.en: DSH 自动化插件：让 Coding 任务按计划在全新 Agent Session 中运行，并由用户或 Agent 创建和管理定时任务。 / Run coding tasks in fresh Agent sessions and manage schedules from DSH Web or an Agent.
description.zh: 定时任务：让 Coding 任务按计划在全新 Agent Session 中运行，保留可审计历史。

description.en: 终末地官网风格的 DSH Web 主题：奶油纸底、墨黑文字、信号黄强调、全直角工业编辑风。
description.zh: 《明日方舟：终末地》工业编辑风主题：奶油纸底、墨黑文字、全局直角，两套强调色配色（谷地黄信号黄 / 武陵青青碧色）可在设置切换，另有可选的等高线地形背景、ENDFIELD 水印与启动加载屏。

description.en: A plugin management panel: one-click enable/disable for installed plugins plus a GitHub dsh-plugin marketplace with details and one-click installs.
description.zh: 插件管理面板：已安装插件一键启用/停用，内置 GitHub dsh-plugin 插件市场，支持详情查看与一键安装。

description.en: Mobile adaptation for the DSH Web UI: works well on narrow screens, fits wide screens too.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 移动端适配：窄屏好用，宽屏适用。

description.en: Recent conversations stay vivid. Older ones fade into summaries, not oblivion. StrataGate gives DeepSeek Harness six-layer, time-decaying memory, while lasting events and relationships settle into a knowledge graph. Bring your memories from other AIs with you—no need to start over.
description.zh: 近期对话保持清晰，久远记忆逐渐化为摘要，而不是消失。StrataGate 为 DeepSeek Harness 带来六层时间衰减记忆，并将长期事件与关系沉淀进知识图谱。还可以把其他 AI 中的已有记忆一起带过来，不必从头开始。

description.en: DSH Web UI 移动端适配：窄屏好用，宽屏适用
description.zh: 让 DSH 网页界面在手机上也好用，窄屏顺手，宽屏照样舒服。

description.en: Near-native image understanding for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 给纯文本模型接近原生的识图能力：图片消息自动走视觉模型转成文字描述再进上下文。

description.en: Visual conversation map for DeepSeek Harness — sessions as cards on a whiteboard: drag to arrange, double-click to chat, draw an edge to fork with injected context. ADHD-friendly spatial memory. · DSH 可视化对话地图
description.zh: 把每个会话变成白板上的卡片，拖拽排列、双击聊天、连线分支，用空间记忆替代工作记忆，专为 ADHD 友好设计。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的表情包插件——找得到、发得出、学得会，纯文本斗图、情绪主动发图、像 QQ/微信 一样发图、AI 自动学图、自定义表情包 、多种风格随意切换。
description.zh: 聊天表情包：纯文本斗图、情绪主动发图、像 QQ/微信 一样发图、AI 自动学图、自定义表情包。

description.en: Read-only security and compliance plugin for DeepSeek Harness: prompt-injection detection, Chinese-PII redaction, and a local configuration audit with redacted, reproducible reports.
description.zh: DSH 只读安全合规插件：提示注入检测、中文 PII 脱敏、本机配置安全审计，输出脱敏且可复现的报告。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness control center for official balance monitoring, per-session costs and tokens, third-party token totals, completion alerts, official recharge, flexible layouts, and agent-assisted session controls.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 监控、提醒、充值与会话控制中心：查看官方余额、本会话花费与 token、第三方 token 合计，提供完成提醒、官方充值、灵活布局及 Agent 辅助的会话控制。

description.en: Agent Research Copilot (ARC) is a set of skills and tools (CLI) for theoretical physics literature review, idea generation and performing calculations.
dsh-expression — DSH plugin (tools)
description.zh: 找得到、发得出 —— DSH 表情包插件：语义搜图，只发真实文件，走 companion QQ 通道

description.en: AI image generation for the DSH Web GUI: text-to-image and image-to-image through a configurable OpenAI-compatible endpoint (gpt-image-2 / gpt-image-1 / dall-e-3), with an api_url/api_key settings card and a sidebar split-pane generation studio.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web GUI 的 AI 生图插件：通过可配置的 OpenAI 兼容端点（gpt-image-2 / gpt-image-1 / dall-e-3）实现文生图与图生图，提供 api_url/api_key 设置卡片与侧边栏分栏生图工作台。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件管理面板：一键启用/停用插件 + GitHub dsh-plugin 插件市场+自定义插件索引/市场，带插件详情与一键安装，一键框架升级自动回滚,插件升级门控 | Plugin manager & marketplace for DeepSeek Harness
A plugin manager and GitHub dsh-plugin marketplace for the DSH Web UI.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 里直接管理插件，还能逛 GitHub 插件市场一键装新插件。

description.en: Prevents request context bloat in DeepSeek Harness: catalogs MCP tools and skills under ctx.capability, exposes them in exposed/progressive/blocked tiers, and invokes low-frequency ones on demand via meta_search/meta_invoke, with a visual settings tab.
description.zh: 解决海量 MCP 工具/技能塞满请求、挤占上下文的问题：统一编目能力（ctx.capability），以常驻/按需/禁用三档控制暴露与执行，低频能力按需经 meta_search/meta_invoke 检索执行，并附可视化「能力菜单」设置页。

description.en: Local-first cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): automatic capture, Event/Element cards, evidence-gated recall, source tracing. 本地跨会话长期记忆。
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供本地优先的跨会话长期记忆，自动记录事件并保留原始证据，支持溯源召回，让 AI 记住关键上下文。

description.en: Local image and MP4 video backgrounds for DSH Web: a sidebar Background panel, saved themes including a built-in window-frame preset, mute toggle, last-background restore, plus /bg, /bg-theme and /bg-clear commands.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 设置本地图片与 MP4 视频背景：侧栏「背景」面板、可保存主题（含内置「画窗」）、声音开关、恢复上次背景，以及 /bg、/bg-theme、/bg-clear 命令。

description.en: Desktop notifications for turn completions, with per-outcome controls and keyword rules.
description.zh: 回合完成桌面通知，按结果分控 + 关键词过滤。

description.en: A macOS-only native account-pool and provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: A macOS-only native account-pool and provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness.

description.en: 把 DSH Web 状态行换成 1063 条梗:打字机 + 炫彩渐变 + 弹幕 + 12 个主题词库包,设置页可视化编辑。
description.zh: 把 dsh 回合状态行换成 1059 条中英文案的轮播：打字机输出、流动彩虹渐变、弹幕、12 个可开关的主题词库包、实时占位符与标签页标题轮换。两个 star 包默认关闭；星标者包每位星标者一条文案，由工作流每周刷新。

description.en: Read-only session work-path observer: fold turns into stage, run, duration and tok/s summaries, then expand parallel branches, tool results and vendor-visible reasoning.
description.zh: 只读会话工作路径观察器：收起轮次看阶段数、执行数、耗时与 tok/s，展开看并行分支、工具结果与供应商可见推理。

description.en: Proactive associative memory for DSH: zero-prompt recall injected at a fixed boundary, three-layer auto-consolidation, skill crystallization, and Astra-style context management - handoff ledgers and a PLAN whiteboard that survive context-window switches, water-level sensing with an auto-detected model window. Local Markdown storage, model-agnostic, zero deps; lexical 0GB floor with optional semantic tiers.
description.zh: 主动联想记忆 + Astra 式上下文管理：自动唤回（固定边界注入，前缀缓存友好）/自动沉淀/技能固化/交接账本与 PLAN 白板跨窗口续命/水位感知（窗口自动适配当前模型）。本地 Markdown 存储，模型无关，零依赖；词法 0GB 兜底，可选语义档。

description.en: A DSH-first Rust/ratatui agent TUI with streamed tool calls, subagents, durable sessions, and a Cordis-extensible client UI.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Rust/ratatui Agent TUI，支持流式工具调用、子代理、持久会话和可扩展的 Cordis 客户端界面。

description.en: Provides a Codex-style user interface for chat interactions.
description.zh: 提供 Codex 风格的聊天交互界面。

description.en: DSH Codex UI — 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供 Codex 风格侧栏、工作区会话树、全局搜索和轮次导航 · A Codex-style sidebar, workspace session tree, global search, and turn navigation for DSH Web
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里还原 Codex 界面，侧边栏、工作区树和搜索都能用，操作更顺手。

description.en: Visual plugin marketplace for DeepSeek Harness — browse, search and install community plugins
description.zh: Visual plugin marketplace for DeepSeek Harness — browse, search and install community plugins

description.en: AI agent skills for Sealos — deploy any project, provision databases, object storage & more with one command. Works with Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex.
description.zh: 一条命令搞定项目部署、数据库和对象存储，让 AI 助手直接操作 Sealos 云平台。

description.en: Provides real-time quotes for selected A-share stocks in a collapsible window at the top-right of the DSH web interface.
description.zh: A股自选股实时行情盯盘插件 - DeepSeek Harness Web 右上角可折叠弹窗

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: in-place conversation rewind in the same session window (Claude Code /rewind semantics) + optional file restore
description.zh: 在会话窗口内原地回退对话，并可选择恢复文件到先前状态。

description.en: Execution maze for DSH sessions: the agent's real path — main advance, failed or dead-end detours, backtracks, request retries and subagent branches — drawn on one wall-clock timeline, with three tracks under each lane sharing that axis (tool-call density, token pulse, context pressure) and a deterministic analysis panel below it (tool result matrix, failure-recovery chains, duration distribution); watch it grow live in a session tab, or upload up to 5 session logs for a same-axis compare.
description.zh: 执行迷宫：把智能体真实的执行过程——主干推进、失败或扑空的支路、折返、请求重试与子代理分支——画在同一根墙钟时间轴上；泳道下方是与它共用时间轴的三条数据轨道（工具调用密度、Token 脉冲、上下文压力），再下方是确定性的执行分析面板（工具结果矩阵、失败恢复链、耗时分布）；可在会话页签里实时生长，也可上传最多 5 个 session log 做同轴对比。

description.en: Google Antigravity (agy CLI) models for DSH — streaming chat with Gemini/Claude/GPT-OSS subscriptions, native tool cards, thinking turns, and in-GUI Google OAuth login.
description.zh: 将 Google Antigravity (agy CLI) 接入 DSH：无 API Key 使用 Gemini/Claude/GPT-OSS 订阅模型，支持流式对话、原生工具卡片、思考轮次注记及 Web 界面 Google OAuth 扫码登录。

description.en: Shared real browser for DSH: a native Electron window the human can watch and take over, driven by the agent over CDP with 20 browser_* tools (open/snapshot/execute/fill/screenshot/download/auth), per-task session isolation, cookie persistence, CAPTCHA detection; self-hosts on plain dsh web without a desktop shell.
description.zh: 共享真实浏览器：用户可观看并随时接管的原生 Electron 窗口，agent 通过 CDP 驱动，内置 20 个 browser_* 工具（打开/快照/执行/填表/截图/下载/登录态）；任务级会话隔离、登录态持久化、人机验证识别，纯 `dsh web` 无需桌面外壳即可自托管。

description.en: A temporal context graph, a memory API, retrieval primitives, and a multiple-platform integration mesh — designed to be embedded into any host process.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenContext，提供跨会话持久记忆、提示词自动捕获与召回、会话摘要、结构化洞察和文档检索。

description.en: Trace Compare & Live Maze for DeepSeek Harness: visualize agent exploration (main path, detours, backtracks) from session logs or live sess…
description.zh: 执行轨迹可视化：主干、失败支路、折返点与子代理支路画在同一根墙钟时间轴上；支持上传 1–2 个 session log 同轴对比，或在会话页签实时看迷宫生长。

description.en: Fluid streaming rendering and smooth scrolling for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供流畅流式渲染和丝滑滚动。

description.en: OpenMAIC: classrooms, slides, interactive widgets, and Socratic teaching.
description.zh: OpenMAIC 教学：课堂、幻灯片、交互组件与苏格拉底式教学。

description.en: Inject deployment-configured system-prompt sections and reference exchanges into every conversation request via stream interception, with a web settings panel.
description.zh: 通过流拦截将部署级系统提示词段落与参考对话注入每次对话请求，附带 Web 设置面板。

description.en: Matt Pocock skills deck: installs with all 25 engineering and productivity skills bundled (mattpocock/skills v1.2.3, zero manual setup: triage, grilling, wayfinder, handoff) in a right-side details panel. GitHub issues fully supported; Markdown files in preview; GitLab not currently supported. Hope it helps you turn ideas into reality, faster.
description.zh: Matt Pocock 技能面板（DSH Deck）：安装即自带 25 个工程与效率技能（mattpocock/skills v1.2.3，triage、grilling、wayfinder、handoff 等），右侧面板直接调用，无需手动装技能。主力支持 GitHub issue；Markdown 本地文件为预览版；GitLab 暂不在支持范围。希望它能帮你把想法更快变成现实。

description.en: Enables LLM to use a cli environment.
description.zh: 让大模型直接操作你的命令行、文件、浏览器和远程机器，实现本地环境的一站式智能控制。

description.en: In-chat read-aloud for DeepSeek Harness: tap to read, pause and resume AI replies with natural Doubao TTS voices (BYOK), reading only the final answer with code, tables and diagrams filtered; local engine, plugin keeps no API key.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 对话内朗读：点一下即可朗读、暂停、继续 AI 回复，豆包 TTS 自然音色（BYOK），只读最终回答并过滤代码、表格与图形，本地引擎，插件零 Key。

description.en: Unified Harness TUI (ACP client). Self-Improvement TUI plugin of DeepSeek Harness. Everything Here Is Also A Plugin.

Drive a local or remote ComfyUI server from DeepSeek Harness: comfyui_run / comfyui_object_info / comfyui_workflow tools generate and edit images and videos, with a workflow library (graph extraction: per component / main flow / all), a load area with resolution auto-match, a live queue, SDXL and Wan 2.1 templates, a companion skill, and a same-origin media proxy.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 直接驱动本地或远程 ComfyUI：comfyui_run / comfyui_object_info / comfyui_workflow 工具生成与编辑图像、视频，附带工作流库（图工作流提取：按分量 / 主流程 / 整体）、加载区分辨率自动匹配、实时队列、SDXL 与 Wan 2.1 模板、配套 skill 与同源媒体代理。

description.en: 给 HR / 猎头的 AI 招聘工作流：岗位标准梳理、Boss直聘 + 猎聘双通道寻源初筛、市场人才盘点、简历评估、约面试、候选人台账与日报。可装成 Claude Code 插件或 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 插件——后者自带可直接上手操作的「招聘浏览器」面板；也能配合任意读 AGENTS.md 的 AI 编程助手使用。
description.zh: 给 HR 和猎头用的 AI 招聘副驾，从梳理岗位要求、双平台找人打招呼到约面试、记台账、写日报一条龙。

description.en: Compare multiple skills on the same task and pick the winner.
description.zh: 同一任务并行试跑多个技能，对比结果选出最优。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 自动审批门控：Flash 预判不可回补操作，安全自动批准、危险转人工（fail-safe）
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 自动审批门控：Flash 预判写入/命令是否不可回补，安全操作自动批准、危险操作转人工（fail-safe）。另含文件改动对比（unified diff）与一键撤销、按会话隔离的快照管理（v0.5.1：通过工具调用参数回溯精确保存快照，覆盖人工审批场景）。

description.en: Native Rapid-MLX provider for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — dsh reads model facts from the server instead of your settings.yaml.
description.zh: 提供原生 Rapid-MLX 模型提供方，使 DSH 直接从服务器读取模型信息。

description.en: A whale-girl desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: pat-to-raise growth, work-state poses per tool type, 494 dialogue lines, 30 achievements, a growth diary, drag physics, theme sync and an accessibility mode. Chat-keyword sensing and API-balance care ship off and are opt-in; an optional weather mood calls Open-Meteo only after you name a city. No telemetry.
description.zh: 元气鲸鱼娘桌宠：摸头养成、按工具类型联动的工作状态、494 条台词、30 项成就、成长日记、拖拽惯性、主题适配与无障碍模式。关键词感知与余额关心默认关闭、需手动开启；可选的天气心情只在你填了城市后才会请求 Open-Meteo。无遥测。

description.en: A web UI plugin manager for DeepSeek Harness that handles viewing, real-time toggling, install/uninstall, updates, health checks, and environment management.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 中一键管理 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件：查看、实时启停、安装/卸载、更新检测、健康检查（依赖/冲突/兼容性分析）、环境管理、插件市场。bundle 与非 bundle 插件全覆盖

description.en: kanghelyu/dsh-deepseek-flow 声明为 DeepSeek Harness 生态插件。
description.zh: kanghelyu/dsh-deepseek-flow 声明为 DeepSeek Harness 生态插件。

description.en: 自动分类、收录和验证 DeepSeek-Harness 社区插件的市场。 Automatically categorize, curate, and validate the DeepSeek-Harness community plugin marketplace.
description.zh: 自动分类、收录和验证DeepSeek Harness社区插件的市场，提供流畅的发现体验。

description.en: Secure remote access for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a login gate, MFA/TOTP, signed session cookies, optional admin/user/guest roles, in-browser workspace selection, and allowlisted remote file previews.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供安全远程访问：登录门禁、MFA/TOTP、签名会话 Cookie、可选的 admin/user/guest 角色、浏览器内工作区选择和按允许目录限制的远程文件预览。

description.en: Use your ChatGPT / Codex subscription with DeepSeek Harness via OAuth, with model access, usage quotas, search, and image generation — no API key or Codex CLI required.
description.zh: 通过 ChatGPT OAuth 在 DSH 中使用 Codex 模型，提供订阅联网搜索、额度与安全重置、图片工具、高速模式和模型感知上下文；无需 API Key 或 Codex CLI。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件：✨ 提示词一键增强 + 💬 语音识别（说完自动停·云端/本地双引擎）· 附 🔁 服务异常一键重启
description.zh: 一键提示词增强（5 模式·记忆链·模型链）+ 语音识别（云端 Qwen3-ASR / 本地 SenseVoice 离线，说完自动停），附服务异常一键重启。

description.en: DSH plugin: Claude-style Chinese risk control & conversation autonomy for DeepSeek Harness web
description.zh: DSH plugin: Claude-style Chinese risk control & conversation autonomy for DeepSeek Harness web

description.en: DSH plugin: Claude-style Chinese risk control & conversation autonomy for DeepSeek Harness web

Read-only runtime management panel for the official DSH MCP client: connection status, registered tools, errors, and reconnect counts through the /mcp command and a Settings tab, with sanitized display and enable/disable patch suggestions.
description.zh: 官方 MCP 客户端（dsh-mcp-client）的只读运行时管理面板：/mcp 命令与设置页 MCP 页签展示连接状态、已注册工具、错误与重连计数，脱敏展示并提供启停 patch 建议。

description.en: DSH plugin — free OpenCode Zen models for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Free LLM API, no API key needed. 在 DSH 中使用 OpenCode Zen 免费模型，无需 API key
description.zh: 将 OpenCode Zen 免费模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，无需 API Key。

description.en: A search tool that provides access to 65,600+ API documents from 20 Chinese open platforms, zero-configuration, supporting Skill and native DSH plugin.
description.zh: 搜索工具，提供20个中国开放平台的6.5万+API文档，零配置，支持Skill和原生DSH插件。

description.en: Self-evolving team memory as plain Markdown in git: a native Cordis plugin that registers 38 bare-name memory tools plus a prompt-signals section re-evaluated at every assembly, with RPE reinforcement, decay and sleep consolidation; shares one data repo with its Claude Code (MCP) and OpenClaw hosts; verified against DSH 0.1.0-rc.6.

description.en: Enhanced, persistent web search plugin for DeepSeek Harness (multi-engine search, SQLite+LRU cache, platform backends, Playwright rendering)

description.zh: 手机优先的 DSH 前端体验优化：输入框自动折叠、手机回车换行、侧边栏/顶部栏/设置页压缩、禁缩放回弹，以及审批/提问/任务完成通知（页面卡片、Web Push、webhook）；零 dsh 本体改动。

description.en: Bridges DeepSeek Harness to Feishu/Lark bots, enabling remote conversations with your coding assistant on both Pi and DSH platforms.
description.zh: 飞书/Lark 机器人桥接，同时支持 Pi 和 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）双平台，随时随地远程与你的编程助手对话

description.en: 把 dsh agent 接入微信、飞书等 20+ 聊天平台的聚合网关插件 | Aggregate IM gateway for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): connect your agents to WeChat, Feishu, Telegram, Discord & 20+ chat platforms
description.zh: 通过聚合 IM 网关，将 DSH agent 接入微信、飞书等 20+ 聊天平台。

description.en: Accessibility-first macOS computer use: fresh observations, stale-state rejection, scoped permissions, and safe input.
description.zh: macOS 电脑控制：Accessibility 观测、过期状态拒绝、作用域权限与安全输入。

description.en: Use the dsh web UI on your dev machine from an Android or iOS phone, connected peer-to-peer across networks via iroh; no server to set up, with a relay fallback that only carries ciphertext.
description.zh: 用 Android/iOS 手机远程使用电脑上的 dsh 完整网页界面,经 iroh 跨网点对点打洞直连,不用架任何服务器;打不通才退回 relay,relay 只见密文。

description.en: Academic writing guard (EN/ZH bilingual): removes AI-style defensive writing, protects scientific evidence (numbers, citations, claim strength, null findings, scope) during polishing, and calibrates writing toward a target journal (Journal Profile + Journal Fit). Deterministic local regex/statistics, zero network/LLM; writing_rules / writing_audit / writing_style_profile / writing_journal_profile with auto-audit on paper writes.
description.zh: 论文写作守卫（中英双语）：去掉 AI 式防御性写作，润色时守住科学证据（数字/引用/主张强度/零结果/scope），并按目标期刊校准写作风格（Journal Profile + Journal Fit）。纯本地正则/统计，零网络零 LLM；提供 writing_rules / writing_audit / writing_style_profile / writing_journal_profile，论文写入后自动审计。

description.en: Remote DeepSeek Harness with full server-side API access (`settings.*` / `credentials.*` / `host.listDirectory`). Token-gated reverse proxy, per-device sessions, phone invite QR, fence self-check, optional approval / CIDR / idle timeout / local TLS, WebSocket/SSE.
description.zh: 远程访问 DeepSeek Harness 且服务端 API 完整：转发时改写 Host/Origin，恢复其他方案必定 403 的 settings.* / credentials.* / host.listDirectory。令牌门、按设备会话、可选首访审批。

description.en: Automatically add emojis to AI replies.
description.zh: 为 AI 回复自动添加表情。

description.en: Quick sticky notes on the composer toolbar: jot ideas or TODOs, auto-saved as Markdown, one click to send into the chat.
description.zh: 编辑框工具栏便签，随手记点子和 TODO，自动保存为 Markdown，一键发送到对话。

description.en: dsh-scholar (literature)
description.zh: dsh-scholar（文献相关）

description.en: Provides a task board for visualizing and organizing multi-step tasks or workflows within the harness.
description.zh: deepseekharness 任务看板插件

description.en: Adds a blue whale pet that idles and eats on your DSH interface, adding playful charm to the workspace.
description.zh: 在你的deepseek-harness上养一只吃白饭的大蓝鲸

description.en: Design-fidelity QA for text-only models: a `deepseek_vision` tool borrows an eye from any OpenAI-compatible vision route, so the model can judge whether an implementation matches its mock — shipped with the benchmark behind that judgement (four fixtures, 23 injected defects, raw transcripts) and the questioning discipline it depends on.
description.zh: 给纯文本模型的设计稿保真判定：`deepseek_vision` 工具从任意 OpenAI 兼容视觉路由借来一只眼，让模型判断实现与设计稿是否一致——并附上支撑该判定的基准（4 组夹具、23 处注入缺陷、逐格原始输出）与其依赖的提问纪律。

description.en: Customize the "deep diving" thinking status label to anything you like.
description.zh: 把鲸鱼娘思考时的 "deep diving" 状态文案自定义成任意你想要的样子。

description.en: Review agent file changes in a Diff panel, add comments for follow-up edits, and undo edited or newly created files.
description.zh: 在 Diff 面板中审查 Agent 的文件改动、添加评论以继续修改，并撤销已编辑或新建的文件。

description.en: Adds a sidebar question-asking tab to DeepSeek Harness, enabling Codex-style side questions or Claude Code's /btw feature.
description.zh: 一个基于DSH-better-sidebar的侧边栏提问tab，实现类codex的侧边提问或claude code的/btw功能

description.en: Rewind a DeepSeek Harness conversation and its workspace together without touching Git; every rewind is a fork and /redo reverses it.
description.zh: 同步回退 DeepSeek Harness 的对话与工作区，不碰 Git；每次回退都是一个 fork，/redo 可撤销。

description.en: A Remielle(ZZZ) desktop pet for the dsh web GUI that switches animated sticker moods with the harness work state.
description.zh: 蕾米埃尔(绝区零)桌宠：随 DSH 工作状态切换动画表情。

description.en: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）远程 Web 启动 + 用户名/密码认证插件。 |  DeepSeek Harness Remote‑Web‑Launch Plugin with Username/Password Auth
description.zh: DSH远程Web启动插件，支持用户名密码认证。

description.en: The DSH plugin-development knowledge base as an on-demand agent skill: official constraints, task workflows, API reference and community gotchas, installed with the bundle so the agent can look things up while building a plugin.
description.zh: DSH 插件开发知识库，作为按需加载的 agent 技能随 bundle 安装：官方约束、任务工作流、API 参考与社区踩坑，写插件时让 DSH 自己查。

description.en: Live theme editor for DeepSeek Harness with curated palettes and typography controls.

Mobile remote-control suite: bundle plugin with native sidebar entry and admin drawer, self-healing bearer-token gateway over LAN/Tailscale, Android app (sessions/approvals/questions/goals), /fs/* file transfer (Range resume, 2GB upload), latency-based multi-server auto-switch, offline chat cache.
description.zh: 移动远程控制套件：原生侧边栏入口 + 管理抽屉的 bundle 插件，自带 Bearer 令牌网关自愈（局域网/Tailscale）；Android App 覆盖会话/审批/提问/goal；/fs/* 文件端点（Range 断点续传、2GB 上传）；多服务器测速自动切换；聊天记录离线缓存。

description.en: Provides an installation safety net with snapshots, rollback, guarded boot, and incident reports for plugin management.
description.zh: Install safety net for DeepSeek Harness: pre-install snapshots, one-click/automatic rollback, guarded boot, and incident reports that auto-trigger agent analysis. 中文: DeepSeek Harness 插件安装安全网（安装前自动快照、一键/自动回退、守护启动、事故报告自动触发 Agent 分析）。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness bundle that provides a controlled exit command for completed or canceled tasks.
Provides integration with the fnOS file system, allowing file operations directly from the assistant.
description.zh: 集成飞牛系统文件操作，便于助手直接存取文件。

description.en: Applies an aurora-themed color scheme with vibrant gradients and cosmic-inspired visual styling.
description.zh: 应用极光主题配色，带鲜艳渐变和星空灵感视觉风格。

description.en: Applies custom visual skins to transform the overall look and feel of the interface with different color schemes and styles.
description.zh: 应用自定义视觉皮肤，通过不同配色和风格改变界面整体外观。

description.en: Displays a comprehensive statistics panel with detailed metrics and performance data for the DeepSeek Harness interface.
description.zh: 在界面中展示全面的统计面板，提供详细的指标和性能数据。

description.en: Applies a trading-themed skin with market-oriented colors and financial dashboard aesthetics.
description.zh: 应用交易主题皮肤，采用市场导向配色和金融仪表盘美学。

description.en: Applies a Miku-themed skin featuring vocaloid-inspired colors and anime-styled visual design.
description.zh: 应用初音未来主题皮肤，采用声库角色配色和动漫风格视觉设计。

description.en: Applies a blue fantasy theme with mystical blue tones and imaginative visual elements.
description.zh: 应用蓝色奇幻主题，采用神秘蓝色调和富有想象力的视觉元素。

description.en: Applies a dragon heir theme with epic fantasy styling and dragon-inspired visual motifs.
description.zh: 应用龙裔主题，采用史诗奇幻风格和龙纹视觉元素。

description.en: Provides an AionUI panel component for the client interface, enhancing visual panels.
description.zh: 为客户端界面提供 AionUI 面板组件，增强视觉面板。

description.en: Renders an interactive git commit graph visualization, showing branch topology and history directly within the client interface.
description.zh: 在客户端界面中渲染交互式 Git 提交图谱，直观展示分支拓扑和历史。

description.en: Provides real-time live statistics updates in the user interface, displaying dynamic metrics and activity data as they occur.
description.zh: 在用户界面中实时更新统计信息，动态展示指标和活动数据。

description.en: Adds a virtual desktop pet companion that interacts with users, providing entertainment and playful engagement.
description.zh: 添加虚拟桌面宠物伙伴，与用户互动，带来娱乐和趣味体验。

description.en: Provides SSH connectivity tools, enabling secure remote terminal sessions and server management from within the application.
description.zh: 提供 SSH 连接工具，支持在应用内进行安全远程终端会话和服务器管理。

description.en: Displays a task board interface for visualizing and managing tasks in a kanban-style layout.
description.zh: 以看板式布局展示任务板界面，用于可视化和管理任务。

description.en: Shows a usage dashboard with charts and metrics tracking resource consumption and activity patterns.
description.zh: 展示使用情况仪表盘，用图表和指标跟踪资源消耗和活动模式。

description.en: Aggregates all web UI components into a single bundle for unified deployment and consistent interface enhancement.
description.zh: 将所有 Web UI 组件聚合为单一包，便于统一部署和一致的界面增强。

description.en: Provides a settings panel for configuring web UI preferences, appearance, and interface behavior.
description.zh: 提供设置面板，用于配置 Web UI 偏好、外观和界面行为。

description.en: Applies a Minecraft-themed skin with blocky, pixelated visuals and game-inspired color palette.
description.zh: 应用我的世界主题皮肤，采用方块像素视觉和游戏风格配色。

description.en: Provides a centralized hub for browsing, selecting, and managing available visual skins.
description.zh: 提供集中中心，用于浏览、选择和管理可用视觉皮肤。

description.en: Applies a THS-themed skin with specialized financial data styling and trading-oriented visuals.
description.zh: 应用 THS 主题皮肤，采用专业金融数据风格和交易导向视觉。

description.en: Applies a whale song theme with oceanic tones and serene, flowing visual design elements.
description.zh: 应用鲸歌主题，采用海洋色调和宁静流动的视觉设计元素。

description.en: Applies an XP-themed skin with retro Windows-style visuals and nostalgic interface styling.
description.zh: 应用 XP 主题皮肤，采用复古 Windows 风格视觉和怀旧界面风格。

description.en: Normify · DSH 插件：把项目架构写成归一化的分形模块树，三层校验（写时 / 校验 / 冻结回执）、30 个 normify_* 工具 + normify-gen 技能，一键渲染单文件交互式架构图；支持伴随式开发（change_open → brief → check → 实施 → refresh → change_close）。
description.zh: 把项目架构整理成归一化的分形模块树，三层校验加一键生成交互式架构图，还能伴随式开发。

description.en: A deepseek-harness plugin, making your agent evolve in customed git repository.
description.zh: 让智能体在自定义 Git 仓库中持续进化，自动迭代代码与配置，提升开发效率。

description.en: Trace Compare & Live Maze for DeepSeek Harness: visualize agent exploration (main path, detours, backtracks) from session logs or live sessions
Google Antigravity (agy) OAuth auth + model access plugin for DeepSeek Harness: multi-account pool, 429 rotation, device fingerprinting, CLI and web login.
description.zh: 提供 Google Antigravity OAuth 认证与模型访问，支持多账号池和请求轮换。

description.en: Deterministic research reports for Chinese public mutual funds built from public-source data (Tiantian Fund and Eastmoney), pure-function metrics (performance decomposition, holdings penetration, style attribution, manager profile), and versioned reports with a per-number snapshot traceability appendix.
description.zh: 中国公募基金确定性研究报告：采集天天基金/东方财富公开数据，纯函数计算业绩拆解、持仓穿透、风格归因与经理画像，输出带逐数字可溯源快照附录的版本化报告。

description.en: Claude Science-style research workbench: ReAct research-loop engine (research_* tools), versioned artifacts with provenance (artifact_* tools), and 10 science skills for genomics/pathogens/bioinformatics.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的 Claude Science 式科研工作台：ReAct 研究循环引擎（research_* 工具）、带溯源的版本化工件（artifact_* 工具）与面向基因组/病原体/生物信息的 10 个科研技能。

description.en: dsh plugin: quantitative tools for agents — market data (Binance public API), technical indicators (SMA/EMA/RSI/MACD/Bollinger/ATR) and MA-crossover backtest
description.zh: 为代理提供市场数据、技术指标和回测等量化交易工具。

description.en: Multi-agent math problem-solving & verification framework: brainstorm → solver iteration → multi-verifier debate → Verified knowledge base, with checkpoint resume and manual/auto intervention (also ships as an agent preset).
description.zh: 多代理数学问题求解与验证框架：头脑风暴 → 求解迭代 → 多验证器辩论 → 可信知识库沉淀，支持断点续跑与人工/自动干预（同时提供 agent preset 与可安装 bundle）。

description.en: A DSH roleplay plugin for managing character cards, worldbooks, presets, and story memories.
description.zh: 酒馆管理面板：多角色卡、多世界书、多预设与会话级隔离，记忆总结、角色关系网、剧情选项一键发送，另有 NSFW 模式。完整效果需同时安装伴生插件 dsh-muv-engine 与 dsh-muv-table，用于渲染状态栏、剧情选项与变量表格。

description.en: Advanced per-model reasoning and capacity settings for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面添加模型高级配置页面，轻松创建自定义端点并调整每个模型的能力参数。

description.en: Hash-anchored read / edit / batch_edit / undo_last_edit tools: every line gets a unique 3-character content hash, edits target hashes instead of line numbers, and served-state verification rejects stale ranges with fresh anchors.
description.zh: 基于哈希锚定的 read / edit / batch_edit / undo_last_edit 工具：每行分配唯一的 3 字符内容哈希，编辑按哈希而非行号定位；对已提供状态逐行校验，过期范围会被拒绝并回传新锚点。

description.en: Bottom info bar for the DSH Web UI: provider/model, live balance, peak/off-peak pricing with countdown, and real persisted per-session spend in a single line.
description.zh: DSH 底部信息栏：一行显示服务商/模型、真实余额、高峰(琥珀)/空闲(绿)价与倒计时，以及本对话·今日·近一月·全部花费（真实落盘统计）。

description.en: Recall any user message: rolls the conversation (official session fork) and workspace files (per-message shadow git snapshots) back to before it, with a diff-preview confirmation panel.
description.zh: 消息撤回：在用户消息旁加「撤回」按钮，把对话历史（官方会话 fork）与项目文件（逐消息影子 git 快照）一并回退到该消息发送之前，带差异预览确认面板。

description.en: High-reliability Feishu/Lark bridge for DeepSeek Harness — QR one-click auth, multi-mode agents, card-based commands, zero-loss outbox, media in/out, session-log doctor, reusable DSH Web GUI
description.zh: 连接飞书/ Lark，支持扫码认证、多模式 Agent、卡片命令与可靠消息收发。

description.en: Bundles Chinese traditional wisdom skills like Bazi, Ziwei, and Feng Shui with a deterministic engine and dashboard.
description.zh: 中华传统智慧（玄枢）AI Agent 技能包的 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）Cordis 插件：八字/紫微/六爻/梅花/奇门/风水/五运六气/体质全融合，本地确定性引擎 + 可视化 Dashboard，一行 dsh plugin add 安装。

description.en: Manages model tiers or routing for different AI models in scientific workflows.
description.zh: 在科学工作流中管理不同 AI 模型的层级或路由。

description.en: Second brain for coding agents. Seal the day, distill into Obsidian, hit that page tomorrow. Cursor, Codex, Claude Code, DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给编程智能体装上第二大脑，把每天的工作沉淀到 Obsidian，第二天直接接着干，跨工具共享记忆。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 接入飞书/Lark bot，扫码即用：流式卡片、项目工作区、并行任务、多角色 Agent、跨会话通知、对话内模型/密钥管理与安全网守护（dsh 崩溃后飞书仍可自救）。A scan-to-connect bridge bot connecting DeepSeek Harness (dsh) into Feishu/Lark: streaming cards, workspaces, parallel tasks, multi-role agents, cross-session notify, in-chat model/key management, and a safety-net guardian.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接入飞书/Lark 的机器人，支持完整项目工作区管理，方便团队协作。

description.en: Local Obsidian vault as the agent knowledge store, with read-only DSH tools that route status, preference, correction, memory, project, search, and suggest to the matching page.
description.zh: 把本地 Obsidian 库当作 Agent 知识库，并用只读 DSH 工具把状态、偏好、纠错、记忆、项目、搜索与建议路由到对应页面。

description.en: Claude Science-style research workbench: ReAct research-loop engine (research_*tools), versioned artifacts with provenance (artifact_* tools), and 10 science skills for genomics/pathogens/bioinformatics.
description.zh: 面向科研场景的智能工作台，支持循环研究、版本化数据追踪和基因组/病原体等生物信息分析。

description.en: Displays a showcase of Semi UI components, demonstrating interface elements for visual customization.
description.zh: 展示 Semi UI 组件示例，用于界面元素的视觉定制。

description.en: Tencent CodeBuddy model provider for DeepSeek Harness with browser OAuth sign-in and Web UI quota display; install from npm with `dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-codebuddy`.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入腾讯 CodeBuddy 模型提供方，支持浏览器 OAuth 登录和 Web UI 用量显示；npm 安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-codebuddy`。

description.en: DSH productivity plugin: timeline navigation, prompt library, conversation export, quick notes, and more.
description.zh: DSH 效率插件：时间轴、提示词库、导出对话、闪记等提效功能。

description.en: Share your conversations with one click.
description.zh: 一键分享你的对话。

description.en: Configure reasoning-effort levels and sub-agent defaults for custom DSH models.
description.zh: 为 DSH 自定义模型配置思考档位和子 agent 默认思考强度。

description.en: Save-money plugin for DSH (DeepSeek Harness) — define your own "pause / resume" time windows; at pause time running long tasks are paused (not stopped) automatically, and they resume when the window ends.
description.zh: 自定义时间窗口自动暂停/恢复任务，高峰时段节省 API 费用；含账户余额显示和 10 分钟粒度的消费柱状图。

description.en: Custom Claude provider support for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: Custom Claude provider support for DeepSeek Harness

description.en: Multi-agent team collaboration for DeepSeek Harness with per-assistant models, skills, MCP servers, independent contexts, shared workspaces, task coordination, and conversation management.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多 Agent 团队协作，支持助手独立模型、Skills、MCP 服务与上下文，以及共享工作区、任务协调和会话管理。

description.en: Custom theme plugin with video and image wallpapers, free positioning, and scale/fill modes. Extracts wallpaper colours and switches text to light or dark automatically. Per-area blur across 6 UI regions, per-area opacity, and one-click theme export/import.
description.zh: 自定义主题插件：支持视频与图片壁纸、自由拖动位置与拉伸填充模式；从壁纸提取主色并自动切换明暗字体；六个界面区域的模糊分别可调，分区不透明度可调；主题一键导出与导入。

description.en: Engineering-discipline guard: requirements grill before the first edit, red/green test-evidence gates, forked adversary review, and a delivery report with a per-dimension verification workflow.
