description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加个全局热身层，首轮自动预热，之后恢复完整模式，对话更流畅。

description.en: CloakBrowser-powered native browser tools with per-agent isolated sessions, bounded snapshots, ref-based interaction, screenshots, and safe routing.
description.zh: 基于 CloakBrowser 的原生浏览器工具：按 Agent 隔离会话，提供有界快照、ref 交互、截图与安全路由。

description.en: Simulates a Codex environment for selected model routes to improve GPT-family model tool-call success.
description.zh: 为选定的模型路由模拟 Codex 环境，以提升 GPT 系列模型的工具调用成功率。

description.en: Desktop computer use for DeepSeek Harness: macOS app listing, accessibility-tree window capture, screenshots, and synthesized input, cloned from Codex Computer Use
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek 直接操控你的 Mac：列出应用、截屏、读取窗口并模拟键鼠操作，实现桌面自动化。

description.en: Real-time chain-of-thought trajectory profiling for DeepSeek Harness: live wording indicators, profile-family judgment, per-session measurement records
description.zh: Real-time chain-of-thought trajectory profiling for DeepSeek Harness: live wording indicators, profile-family judgment, and per-session measurement records

description.en: Whale desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: live agent status + API balance as a circular sea level, with jump/dive interactions
把文件拖入/粘贴到 DeepSeek Harness Web：输入框原生引用气泡，随消息发送（含绝对路径），气泡渲染文件卡片。Drag/paste files into the DeepSeek Harness web GUI as native reference bubbles — absolute paths, file cards.
description.zh: 拖入/粘贴文件：输入框上方文件栏（chips）+ @文件名 光标内联插入 + 随消息发送（含绝对路径）+ 气泡文件卡片。Drag/paste files into the DeepSeek Harness web GUI and send them with your message (absolute paths included).

description.en: Drag & drop or click to attach any non-image file (PDF/Word/Excel/ZIP/text) into the composer: in the desktop shell it resolves the real Finder path instantly; otherwise it uploads to the workspace and inserts the path.
description.zh: 拖拽/点击上传任意非图片文件（PDF/Word/Excel/ZIP/文本）到输入框：桌面壳下直取 Finder 原始路径；无壳时上传到工作区并插入路径。

description.en: Runtime extension suite for DeepSeek Harness: cross-session mailbox with wake cold-start, agent teams (captain + members + dependency task board + team_wait), subagent spawn policy with escalation approval, task-aware routing preset, plugin market, skill manager and runtime injector.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 扩展套件：跨会话邮箱与 wake 冷启动、代理团队（队长 + 成员 + 依赖任务板 + team_wait）、子代理派发策略（提权自动审批）、任务感知路由 preset、插件市场、技能管理器与运行时注入器。

description.en: 听雨的声音 一滴滴清晰， 你的呼吸像雨滴渗入我的爱里， 真希望 雨能下不停， 让想念继续 让爱变透明， 我爱上 给我 勇气的 Rainie Love， 窗外的雨滴 一滴滴 累积， 屋内的湿气 像储存爱你的记忆， 真希望 雨能下不停， 雨爱的秘密 能一直延续， 我相信我将会看到彩虹的美丽。

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 微信网关适配插件：复用 DeepSeekAdapter + 流式 think 标签转译

description.zh: 会话日志守护弹窗：打开 Web 即提醒（间隔 10 分钟至 3 小时可调），一键增量备份 ~/.dsh/sessions 全部 session.jsonl(.zstd)，可选原始压缩或可读聊天记录两种格式，弹窗内可选备份文件夹。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin: add an IDE button that auto-detects local IDEs and opens the current workspace folder.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面顶部加个 IDE 按钮，自动识别本机安装的编辑器，一键打开当前工作区文件夹。

description.en: 桥接 GitHub Copilot 订阅到 DeepSeek Harness（移植自 github/copilot-sdk）

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 统一绘图路由器：自动识别任意 OpenAI 兼容接口的绘图模型，提供 draw_image 和 draw_list_sources 工具，支持商汤、阶跃、Agnes、千问、Flux、SD、Imagen 等。

description.en: Permanent composer-dock balance card: real-time DeepSeek API account balance with 5-minute auto-refresh, a manual refresh button, and low-balance color warnings.
description.zh: 输入框下方常驻余额卡片：实时显示 DeepSeek API 账户余额，每 5 分钟自动刷新，支持手动刷新，余额过低自动变色提醒。

description.en: dsh plugin for MCP status inspection and server management | dsh 的 MCP状态查看与服务管理插件
description.zh: 在 dsh 里直接查看 MCP 服务状态，还能在设置页增删改启停，配置自动写回文件。

description.en: DSH 思维导图模式插件：课件(PPT/PDF/Word)+电子书 → 打印级复习思维导图 HTML（A3 横向、每主干一页、大括号式横向、黑体、4 种风格、右侧笔记区、封面总览 + 交互式测试题）。建议配合 dsh-IDE 插件预览生成的 HTML。
description.zh: DSH 思维导图模式插件：课件(PPT/PDF/Word)+电子书 → 打印级复习思维导图 HTML（A3 横向、每主干一页、大括号式横向、黑体、4 种风格、右侧笔记区、封面总览 + 交互式测试题）。建议配合 dsh-IDE 插件预览生成的 HTML。

description.en: Adds searchable filtering to the model selector by provider, model name, and model ID; spaces act as wildcards.
description.zh: 为模型选择器增加按提供方、模型名称和模型 ID 搜索的筛选框，空格表示任意字符。

description.en: Settings -> Plugins switchboard: every loaded plugin card shows its package description and runtime phase, with fuzzy search and start/stop toggles that never rewrite config files.
description.zh: 设置→插件开关面板：每个已加载插件的卡片显示简述与运行阶段，支持模糊搜索与运行时启动/关闭（不改写配置文件）。

description.en: Vision for text-only LLMs in DeepSeek Harness (DSH): describe images / OCR / VQA via free Gemini & GLM vision APIs
description.zh: Vision for text-only LLMs in DeepSeek Harness (DSH): describe images / OCR / VQA via free Gemini & GLM vision APIs

description.en: DSH 会话选区引用与锚点批注插件：选中文字 → 批注 → 引用锚点 chip（点击跳回原文、悬停显示原文）。Contextual selection & anchored annotation plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 选中会话文字就能加批注、生成引用锚点，点击跳回原文，悬停看原句，让提问和评论精准对位。

description.en: A small self-contained power control for DSH: sidebar power button with an upward restart/shutdown menu and a Windows-shutdown-style overlay. Own restart & shutdown engine (no dependency on other plugins), dynamic-port aware.
description.zh: 一个小而自洽的 DSH 电源控制插件：侧边栏电源按钮 + 上拉「重启/关机」菜单 + Windows 关机风格过渡遮罩。自带重启/关机引擎（不依赖其它插件），动态端口适配。

description.en: Aggregate and natively control multiple remote DeepSeek Harness (DSH) servers' sessions from one official Web UI — hub gateway + official-UI bridge. 多服务器 DSH 会话聚合与原生操控
description.zh: dsh-session-hub — DSH 插件（会话）

description.en: Theme studio for the DSH Web GUI: five built-in presets plus fully customizable light/dark palettes (accent, background, foreground, UI and code fonts, translucent sidebar, contrast), hot-swapped instantly and persisted in localStorage.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 主题工作室：5 套内置预设 + 完全可自定义的浅/深配色（强调色、背景、前景、UI 与代码字体、半透明侧栏、对比度），即时热切换并持久化到 localStorage。

description.en: Customize DSH Web thinking status with custom flowing text, animated GIF/APNG/WebP, or combined image-and-text modes.
description.zh: 纯 CSS 定制 DSH Web 思考状态文字与双色流动效果，无需改源码或 DOM，安全又省心。

description.en: Connects DSH to Timeline Studio for `.timeline` project inspection, semantic edit previews, transactional edits, and verified MP4 rendering.
description.zh: 把 Timeline Studio 的确定性时间线编辑能力接入 DeepSeek Harness，让 AI 能直接检查、编辑和渲染视频项目。

description.en: UI butler for every plugin UI: official/plugin categories, per-widget toggles, drag move/resize, collision avoidance and one-click auto arrange.
description.zh: UI 管家：官方/插件 UI 分区折叠、逐条开关，拖拽移动/改大小，碰撞避让与一键自动排布。

description.en: DSH 插件：在 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面（对话/轨迹）顶部新增「终端」Tab，内置 xterm.js + node-pty 交互式终端，让你在编码完成后即时在终端执行指令调试。
Toggle switches for the plugin inventory: enable/disable any plugin live from Settings → Plugins → Plugin list without restarting, with groups/filters, bulk toggle, undo, and backup.
description.zh: 插件清单页滑块开关：在设置 → 插件 → 插件清单实时启用/停用任意插件，无需重启；支持分组/筛选、批量开关、撤销与自动备份。

description.en: HeartFlow (心虫) AGI layer-1 discriminator gate as a DSH plugin: 47-dimension rule-based text checking (heartflow_check tool) plus automatic output supervision at tools/post-execute, fail-closed when engine missing.
description.zh: 心虫（AGI 第1层辨别门禁）作为 DSH 插件：47 维纯规则文本判别（heartflow_check 工具）+ 工具调用后自动输出监督（fail-closed，引擎缺失时拒绝放行）。

description.en: ADHD behavioral coaching skill: task breakdown, overwhelm management, launch rituals, and failure recovery.
description.zh: ADHD 行为辅导技能：任务拆解、事项过载管理、启动仪式与失败重启。

description.en: Fail-closed Feishu (Lark) channel bridge: chat with a bot, get dsh agent turns back. Official-Python-SDK-only integration (exact-pinned); deny-by-default allowlist, webhook signature/timestamp/replay verification, per-chat sticky sessions; bilingual docs.
description.zh: Fail-closed 的飞书（Lark）channel 桥：和机器人聊天即驱动 dsh agent turn。仅经官方 Python SDK 集成（精确锁版）；白名单默认全拒、webhook 验签/时间窗/防重放、按 chat 粘性会话；中英双语文档。

description.en: DSH 插件：让纯文本模型也能看图。Web 端直接粘贴图片即可发送，无需指定图片路径；模型自主调用视觉技能查看，多模态模型原生直通，零skill绑定。
description.zh: DSH 插件：让纯文本模型也能看图。Web 端直接粘贴图片即可发送，无需指定图片路径；模型自主调用视觉技能查看，多模态模型原生直通，零skill绑定。

description.en: 为deepseek harness构建的奶蛙主题，可是我觉得很神圣呀。（素材来自互联网）
description.zh: 为deepseek harness构建的奶蛙主题，可是我觉得很神圣呀。（素材来自互联网）

description.en: DSH 户外皮肤 · 山野向导（Trail Guide）
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换上徒步山野风格皮肤，带路标进度面板，纯换皮不改功能，界面更养眼。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness community plugin: longgraph / loop-graph / loop-converge authoring skills on ctx.skills
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中注册长图、循环图与汇聚图的创作技能，方便直接调用。

description.en: 一个 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件： 在 Web 输入框的工具行中添加一个 ✨ 图标按钮。点击后选择打磨风格，已接入的大模型 会把你草稿中的提示词改写得更专业、更易被 AI 理解 。A DeepSeek Harness plugin: icon-only composer button that rewrites your prompt via the connected LLM (balanced/concise/detailed/code styles, i18n)
description.zh: 在网页输入框一键点亮✨，用大模型把你的提示词打磨得更专业、更易懂。

description.en: 滑动变祖器
description.zh: 把模型选择换成滑块，三档推理强度随心调，轻松控制回答深度。

description.en: 完美复刻 Claude Code 皮肤，纪念我的 Vibe Coding 白月光。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换上 Claude Code 同款皮肤，重温经典终端界面，致敬 Vibe Coding 白月光。

description.en: 王虹学术手写风 PPT Skill for DeepSeek Harness · Notability-style HTML slides and PNG export
description.zh: 王虹学术手写风 PPT Skill for DeepSeek Harness · Notability-style HTML slides and PNG export

description.en: Harness Pet — an unofficial community pet for DeepSeek Harness. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or maintained by DeepSeek.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里养一只小鲸鱼桌面宠物，陪你写代码、摸鱼解闷。

description.en: DSH Web GUI 客户端插件：WebGL Silk 丝绸动态背景 + 全站玻璃化皮肤（官方主题 token 覆盖，零依赖） | WebGL silk shader background & glassmorphism skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面换上 WebGL 丝绸动态背景和全站玻璃拟态皮肤，零依赖，卸载即还原。

description.en: Real Chrome browser control for DeepSeek Harness agents, powered by Chrome DevTools MCP
description.zh: 让 DSH 智能体直接操控真实 Chrome 浏览器，自动完成网页导航、点击、填表等操作。

description.en: Self-control guard plugin for DeepSeek Harness host exit and restart workflows.
description.zh: dsh-self-control-guard — DSH 插件（编排）

description.en: DSH Relay 让你可以通过 Telegram 远程与 DeepSeek Harness 对话，并接收通知。DSH Relay turns Telegram into a remote conversation and notification channel for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 把 Telegram 变成 DSH 的移动端入口，随时远程对话并接收通知。

description.en: dsh的罗小黑插件
description.zh: dsh的罗小黑插件

description.en: Model-agnostic Computer Use for DeepSeek Harness: isolated browser, Windows native helper, third-party vision perception, and a Chrome Cook…
description.zh: 模型无关的 Computer Use：隔离浏览器 + Windows 原生控制。

description.en: A Cordis plugin that enables DeepSeek Harness to proactively preview and display web pages.
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件商店：浏览、搜索、筛选并一键安装 dsh-plugin 生态插件
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件商店：浏览、搜索、筛选并一键安装 dsh-plugin 生态插件

description.en: Ready-to-publish DeepSeek Harness plugin skeleton: bundle format, tool DSL, config, tests, and a scaffold script
description.zh: 开箱即发的插件骨架：bundle 格式、工具 DSL、配置、测试和脚手架脚本齐全。

description.en: VS Code-style three-column Explorer + Monaco editor plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI
description.zh: VS Code 风格三栏文件浏览 + Monaco 编辑器，网页版 DSH 直接变身 IDE。

description.en: Unofficial community pet for DeepSeek Harness — a native DSH web plugin
description.zh: harness-whale — DSH 插件（界面）

description.en: Offline-first UI/UX design intelligence library for DeepSeek Harness: design_recommend, design_review and design_search tools with a built-in database of 84 design styles, 192 color palettes, 74 font pairings, 99 UX guidelines, 25 chart types and 22 tech stacks, Chinese-first with zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供离线可用的 UI/UX 设计智能库：内置 84 种设计风格、192 个配色、74 组字体、99 条 UX 规范、25 种图表与 22 个技术栈，提供 design_recommend / design_review / design_search 三个工具，中文优先、零运行依赖。

description.en: Complete wuyun-liuqi (five-evolutions-six-qi / 五运六气) Traditional Chinese Medicine skill pack as a DeepSeek Harness Cordis plugin: annual and guest-qi calculation, clinical pattern differentiation, and pathogenesis reasoning.
description.zh: 完整 wuyun-liuqi（五运六气）中医运气学技能包，封装为 DeepSeek Harness 插件：年度与客气推算、临床辨证、病机推演。

description.en: Coordinates Codex planning and independent review while the original DSH session implements and tests changes.
description.zh: 协调 Codex 制定计划和独立审查，由 DSH 原会话完成代码修改与测试。

description.en: Proactive per-provider token-bucket rate limiting that queues over-limit requests before they are sent, preventing upstream 429 errors.
description.zh: 按 provider 令牌桶主动限速，超限请求在发出前延迟排队而非失败，避免触发上游 429。

description.en: Conversation history recall for DSH: three-layer (literal/fuzzy/semantic) retrieval over every past session's original text, fully local & offline — AI never forgets what you told it. One-command install via `dsh.bundle.patch`, semantic layer runs in a worker thread.
description.zh: 对话历史回忆：字面/模糊/语义三层检索全部历史会话的原始文本，完全本地离线——AI 再也不会忘记你说的话。一条命令安装（自带 `dsh.bundle.patch`），语义推理跑在 worker 线程。

description.en: Floating card showing your real position P&L (今日盈亏), Shanghai Composite Index, and intraday chart, auto-synced from the Tonghuashun investment-ledger — no manual watchlist setup.
description.zh: 悬浮卡片，自动同步同花顺投资账本的真实持仓盈亏，显示今日盈亏、上证指数和当日走势图，无需手动添加股票。

description.en: Adds Windows-native toast notifications and a system tray icon to dsh: alerts when the agent finishes, stops, or errors, with a tray menu to reopen the web page or quit the background process.
description.zh: 为 dsh 添加 Windows 原生 Toast 通知与系统托盘图标：agent 完成、停止或出错时弹通知，托盘菜单可重新打开网页或退出后台进程。

description.en: DSH-side remote session driver for the dsh-overdrive chat gateway: exposes sessions, trajectory replay and tap-to-approve to Telegram / Discord / Slack / WhatsApp / Feishu / DingTalk / WeCom bridges. Requires running @dsh-overdrive/gateway alongside.
description.zh: dsh-overdrive 聊天网关的 DSH 侧远程会话驱动：把 Telegram / Discord / Slack / WhatsApp / 飞书 / 钉钉 / 企业微信 的会话、轨迹回放与一键审批接入 Harness。需配套运行 @dsh-overdrive/gateway。

description.en: Real-time local TTS for DeepSeek Harness: voice presets, auto-read, engine setup assistant, a read-aloud button, and a settings panel for the GSV-TTS-Lite engine.
description.zh: 将本地高性能 TTS 引擎 GSV-TTS-Lite 实时接入 DeepSeek Harness：语音预设、自动朗读、引擎配置助手、朗读按钮与设置面板。

description.en: Specialized in Git branch and status handling: a Git status drawer on the right edge of the DSH web UI with a commit DAG lane graph, uncommitted changes and stash rows, inline diffs, right-click branch/tag actions, and one-click fetch from all remotes.
description.zh: 专精于 Git 分支与状态处理：Web 右缘 Git 状态浮窗，commit DAG 泳道图、未提交改动与 stash、行内 diff，右键分支/tag 切换、合并、重命名、删除、新建，一键拉取全部远程。

description.en: Smooth comet-mode animated caret for the DSH Web composer: a glowing comet trail replaces the native blinking caret and glides across the input as you type, with configurable accent color, thickness, and trail, IME-aware for CJK input.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 输入框提供流畅的彗星光标：以发光的彗星拖尾取代原生闪烁光标，随输入平滑滑动，可配置强调色、粗细与拖尾，并适配中文等 IME 输入。

description.en: Adds subagent_route and subagent_fork_route delegation tools where the model itself picks the provider/model route for each child; the deployment only sets the spawn/fork backend, background policy and allowedProviders allowlist, while continuable children and background jobs reuse the official send_message / job_output tools.
description.zh: 新增 subagent_route 与 subagent_fork_route 委托工具：由模型自主为子代理挑选 provider/model 路由，部署方仅配置 spawn/fork 后端、调度策略与 allowedProviders 白名单；续聊子代理与后台任务复用官方 send_message / job_output 工具。

description.en: Citation tools for agents: exact DOI lookup, Crossref bibliographic search, GB/T 7714 / APA / MLA / Chicago formatting, BibTeX generation, bounded-concurrency DOI validation and health self-check.
description.zh: 参考文献工具：DOI 精确查询与 Crossref 题录检索，GB/T 7714 / APA / MLA / Chicago 格式化，BibTeX 生成、有界并发 DOI 校验与健康自检。

description.en: Theme pack for the DSH Web UI: 30 drop-in CSS themes with light and dark variants, integrated into Settings → General with a programmatic API.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 主题包：30 款即插即用的 CSS 主题，每款含浅色与深色变体，集成于「设置 → 通用」，并提供程序化 API。

description.en: Draggable transparent balance card with a blood-bar of remaining balance vs month-opening, today/month spend (official when the platform token is configured), and session cost.
description.zh: 可拖动透明余额卡片：余额/月初额度血条、今日/本月用量（配置平台 token 后为官方精确数据）、当前对话费用。

description.en: Tender search and bid intelligence in DeepSeek Harness with proposed project search, rule screening, human review and Excel/PDF exports using user-authorized Qichacha MCP.
description.zh: 招投标智能体：支持招投标搜索、招标查询、投标查询、标讯查询、拟建项目与项目筛选，辅助商机发现、人工复核及 Excel/PDF 导出，使用客户自备授权的企查查 MCP。

description.en: Cross-session reference (mention) plugin — paste @[label](dsh-session:…) into any session, including one in another workspace, and the host injects the referenced session snapshot for the model to read; includes a one-click copy-reference button.
description.zh: 跨会话引用插件：在任意会话（含其他工作区）粘贴 @[label](dsh-session:…) 引用，宿主注入被引用会话的快照供模型阅读，并提供一键复制引用按钮。

description.en: Task-completion chime for DeepSeek Harness, playing the original opencode sounds for done, question, plan-review and error events with zero external dependencies.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 复刻 opencode 的任务完成提示音，完成、提问、计划待审、出错四种场景播放原始音效，零外部依赖。

description.en: Role-based AI swarms for DeepSeek Harness: an architect plans, parallel builders execute, reviewers gate quality, and an integrator ships. Per-role model pinning with fallback chains, review loops, evidence contracts, human-gated reviews, quota-aware pause/resume, and a live kanban + flow chart in the web GUI. 40 tests; installs from GitHub or npm.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的角色化 AI 蜂群：架构师规划、多个建造者并行执行、评审代理把关、集成代理收尾。按角色钉选模型（含回退链），支持评审循环、证据合约、人工评审门、配额耗尽自动暂停与恢复，Web GUI 内置实时看板与任务流程图。40 个测试用例；支持 GitHub 或 npm 安装。

description.en: Web search pool for the native web_search tool: fails over across 8 free/paid backends with quota-aware circuit breaking, settings-page API key management, custom SearXNG instances, failover/rotate strategy switching and live SerpApi quota.
description.zh: 原生 web_search 的搜索池：8 个免费/付费后端自动故障转移与额度感知熔断，设置页管理 API Key、自定义 SearXNG 实例、failover/rotate 策略切换与 SerpApi 实时额度查询。

description.en: Fetches up-to-date, version-pinned library documentation and code examples from context7.com for DSH agents via context7_search and context7_get_docs tools.
description.zh: 通过 context7_search 与 context7_get_docs 工具，为 DSH 智能体从 context7.com 获取最新、可锁定版本的库文档与代码示例。

description.en: Evidence-driven goal verification plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Locks goals via /ultragoal and verifies completion against command exit codes and generated artifacts, preventing the model from falsely reporting task completion.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的证据驱动目标校验插件。通过 /ultragoal 锁定目标，并依据命令退出码与生成产物验证完成状态，防止模型虚报任务完成。

description.en: Make your dsh ready for serious coding. (Tools x Schemas)^REPL. `skill://`, `ctx://`, `agent://`, `dvc://`, `dsh://`, IPython REPL, Context as Variables, cross compactions recallable, full context revive. `hash-edit`, `dvc://browser`, subagent as function, workflow as function.
description.zh: 能胜任严肃编程任务的 dsh。（Tools x Schemas）^REPL。`skill://`，`ctx://`，`agent://`，`dvc://`，`dsh://`，IPython REPL，Context as Variables，抗压缩可回溯、完整上下文重构。`hash-edit`、`dvc://browser`、subagent as function、workflow as function。

description.en: Adds specification artifacts, skills, commands, goal-backed implementation, and task-progress context.
description.zh: 增加规格工件、技能、命令、由 goal 驱动的实施流程和任务进度上下文。

description.en: Read-only DSH Web plugin for inspecting and searching Milvus or Zilliz Cloud collections from chat, including scalar, BM25, dense, and hybrid queries.
description.zh: 只读 DSH Web 插件，可在对话中检查和搜索 Milvus 或 Zilliz Cloud Collection，支持标量、BM25、稠密向量与混合查询。

description.en: Conversation Canvas tab: live-preview workspace HTML artifacts and export PNG/JPG/SVG locally (`npx dsh-canvas-preview`).
description.zh: Conversation Canvas 标签页：实时预览工作区内的 HTML artifact，并支持本地导出 PNG/JPG/SVG（`npx dsh-canvas-preview`）。

description.en: Learns what you leave unsaid in your prompts from messy turns and your own corrections, and injects the learned directives into the system prompt of every new conversation; the directives are editable in Settings and a composer button rewrites the current draft with them.
description.zh: 从不顺的轮次和你自己的纠正中学习你在提示词里没说出口的东西，并把学到的指令注入每个新对话的系统提示；指令可在设置中编辑，输入框按钮可用它们改写当前草稿。

description.en: Runs AItelier pipelines from DSH over MCP: 39 tools (22 read, 17 write) to generate, run, inspect, edit, export and import multi-step SkillFlow pipelines. The steps execute in AItelier rather than in the DSH session and are polled by run_id, pause at engine-enforced checkpoints answered with answer_checkpoint, and leave per-step traces and step outputs to read afterwards; add_provider / map_model / edit_role point an individual role at a local or cheaper endpoint. Bundles an aitelier-pipelines skill.
description.zh: 从 DSH 经 MCP 运行 AItelier 流水线：39 个工具（22 读、17 写），用于生成、运行、查看、编辑、导出与导入多步 SkillFlow 流水线。步骤在 AItelier 中执行而不占用 DSH 会话，按 run_id 轮询，在引擎强制的检查点暂停并由 answer_checkpoint 应答，事后可读取逐步 trace 与各步输出；add_provider / map_model / edit_role 可把单个角色指向本地或更便宜的端点。随包附带 aitelier-pipelines skill。

description.en: GitHub sidebar workbench for DSH: remote tree plus Issues, Pull requests and Actions tabs, with create/comment/edit/close, merge/squash/rebase, and rerun or cancel CI; mounts as a better-sidebar tab or a standalone right panel.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏 GitHub 工作台：远端目录树加 Issues / Pull requests / Actions 页签，支持建 Issue/PR、评论、编辑、关闭、merge/squash/rebase 与重跑或取消 CI；挂载为 better-sidebar 页签或独立右侧面板。

description.en: Wraps Python virtual environment management commands: reduces the network and permission problems agents hit when managing environments through terminal commands, works across operating systems, and routes installs automatically through mirrors and local proxies. The tools are strictly confined by the granted read/write permissions.
description.zh: 封装了Python虚拟环境管理指令，减少Agent使用终端指令管理环境时遇到的网络问题和权限问题，兼容不同操作系统，工具内部设置自动网络与镜像路由。工具严格受给定读写权限限制。

description.en: Design-artifact skill adapted from Anthropic canvas-design / web-artifacts-builder: turns a design brief into a self-contained HTML/SVG artifact (posters, infographics, landing pages, charts, component mockups) with a pre-delivery quality checklist and an anti-AI-look pattern list.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的设计稿生成 skill（改编自 Anthropic canvas-design / web-artifacts-builder）：把设计需求做成可直接打开的自包含 HTML/SVG 设计稿（海报、信息图、落地页、图表、组件稿），内置交付前质量清单与「去 AI 味」反模式清单。

description.en: Image viewer for the dock workbench: PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP, SVG, ICO and AVIF, with SVG rendered as image data only.
description.zh: dock 系列图片查看器：支持 PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP/BMP/SVG/ICO/AVIF 格式，SVG 仅以安全方式渲染。

description.en: Electrical and electronics calculation plugin for DeepSeek Harness: every computation runs through dedicated tools on self-describing complex value objects in SI base units, with an isolated calculation agent preset and a records panel that archives every solve on disk.
description.zh: DSH 电气电子计算插件：所有计算都通过专用工具完成，基于 SI 基本单位的自描述复数值对象；附带隔离的计算智能体预设与记录面板，每次求解落盘存档。

description.en: Warm light and dark theme for DSH Web with responsive layout, bilingual settings, safe Markdown preview, per-block copy controls, and no telemetry.
description.zh: DSH Web 暖中性色明暗主题，支持响应式布局、双语设置、安全 Markdown 预览、内容块复制与无遥测运行。

description.en: Scheduled tasks panel for managing DSH agent and system crontabs with natural language input and execution logs.
description.zh: 定时任务面板：分区管理 DSH 与系统 crontab、自然语言生成表达式、执行日志与完成后消息推送。

description.en: Installed-plugin catalog for DSH: group plugins by origin (official vs self-installed) in a searchable panel with enable/disable, uninstall, and one-click update. Published on npm as dsh-plugin-diraud.
description.zh: 装在 DSH 里的插件目录：按来源（官方/自装）分组展示已安装插件，可搜索，支持启用/停用、卸载和一键更新。已发布 npm 包 dsh-plugin-diraud。

description.en: Local image, voice, music and SFX generation plus transcription, with pinned identity: characters, animals, objects and actor voices are defined once and reused on every later call, degenerate output (a near-flat image, silent audio) is rejected instead of returned as success, and a generated line can be read back as text so a clone that swallowed its ending becomes visible. The engines unload when idle, and image generation and transcription can each be pointed at an OpenAI-shaped API instead of the local Vulkan backend.
description.zh: 本地生成图像/配音/音乐/音效并听写，同一性锁定：角色、动物、道具与配音角色定妆定声一次，之后每次调用复用同一份参考；退化产物（接近纯色的图、静音的音频）被拒绝而不是当成成功返回；生成的台词可以听写回文字，好让吞掉结尾的克隆暴露出来。空闲时引擎卸载显存，生图与听写也可改指向任意 OpenAI 形状的 API 而不用本地 Vulkan 后端。

description.en: Pre-visit due diligence and company research in DeepSeek Harness for customer background checks and risk briefs, with Qichacha MCP tool-call budget approval and entity confirmation.
description.zh: 访前尽调智能体：面向拜访前调查，提供企业尽调、客户尽调、客户背景调查、工商核验与风险信息整理；使用企查查 MCP，设有调用预算授权和主体确认。

description.en: Auto-switches the agent to ultra-compressed caveman-style output during DeepSeek peak-pricing hours (Beijing 09:00–12:00 / 14:00–18:00, price x2) and shows a status badge plus transition toasts.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek 高峰计价时段（北京时间 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00，价格 ×2）自动切换 caveman 超精简输出省 token，标题栏常驻状态徽章，档位切换时弹提醒。

description.en: 11 shareable workflow skills (handoff, triage, to-spec, to-tickets, wayfinder, teach, wait-what, dsh-mode-routing, ask-matt, overnight-execution, full-throttle) as an installable skill pack.
description.zh: 11 个可分享的工作流 skills（handoff、triage、to-spec、to-tickets、wayfinder、teach、wait-what、dsh-mode-routing、ask-matt、overnight-execution、full-throttle），打包为可安装 bundle。

description.en: Desktop pet drawn from the official whale outline: pure-SVG animation follows agent state (thinking, working, celebrating, error), with poke and double-click flip interactions, cursor avoidance, 7 palettes, light/dark theme sync, and a playable web preview.
description.zh: 官方鲸鱼轮廓的桌宠：纯 SVG 动画随 agent 状态切换（思考／工作／完成／报错），可戳可拖、双击翻滚，光标停留在身侧会自己避让，7 套色板并跟随亮暗主题，附网页预览可直接试玩。

description.en: Local-first token usage heatmap inside DSH settings: GitHub-style week/month/quarter/year grids, hourly usage per day, per-model and per-provider Top 5, and persisted history that survives session deletion. Zero network, zero billing.
description.zh: DSH 设置内的本地 Token 用量热图：GitHub 风格周/月/季度/年视图、每日小时级展开、模型与供应商 Top 5，历史持久化，删除会话不丢数据。零联网、零计费。

description.en: Shows every session theme in the DSH Web left sidebar immediately on page load by warming the session projection cache at startup; no need to click into a conversation first.
description.zh: 打开页面时左侧边栏直接显示每个会话的主题，无需点进会话。启动时预热会话投影缓存，让冷会话也能显示真实标题。

description.en: During Beijing working-day peak hours (default 09:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00) it blocks official DeepSeek requests or reroutes them to a configured target provider; off-peak traffic flows to official as usual.
description.zh: 北京时间工作日高峰时段拦截发往官方 provider 的请求，默认 09:00-12:00、14:00-18:00，可切到配置的中转目标或直接阻止并提示，非高峰正常走官方。

description.en: Session hotkeys for the DSH Web GUI: switch sessions like browser tabs (positional Alt+1-9, pinned slots, previous/next, new/archive/rename), keyboard model switching via Alt+M, alternate send and archive confirmation, all rebindable with Windows/macOS presets.
description.zh: Web 会话热键插件：像切浏览器标签页一样用键盘管理会话——Alt+1-9 顺序切换、固定槽位、上/下一个、新建/归档/重命名、Alt+M 键盘切换模型与备用发送，键位可在面板录制重绑，Windows/macOS 双预设。

description.en: Early-stage plugin connecting DeepSeek Harness to a separately deployed, self-hosted OwnDsh server for team identity, model access control, quotas, and usage auditing.
description.zh: 早期开发中的团队管理插件，将 DeepSeek Harness 接入独立部署的自托管 OwnDsh 服务端，提供团队身份、模型授权、配额与用量审计。

description.en: Browser tab favicon mirrors the DSH session state (idle / running / asking / done), recolored and animated from one base SVG entirely in the browser, with colors and effects configurable from the Settings page.
description.zh: 浏览器标签页 favicon 实时反映 DSH 会话状态（待机 / 运行中 / 提问 / 完成）：单个 base.svg 在浏览器端上色与动画，颜色与特效均可在设置页配置。

description.en: Forge quality gates for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): task gates, read-before-edit, bash hazard interception and quality scoring, driven by the forge CLI through DSH's typed interception points.
See which skills and tools your agent can actually reach right now — true in-context state (loaded/truncated/evicted) and per-session switches.
description.zh: 看清 agent 此刻真正能触达哪些技能与工具——真实的在上下文状态(已加载/已截断/已挤出),并按会话开关。

description.en: Deep research as an agent mode: one reviewed loop that plans, researches in adaptive parallel rounds driven by the gaps the researchers themselves declare, synthesises a cited report and then reviews it adversarially, instead of a script the model rewrites per call. Questions the round budget never reached are named in the report rather than dropped.
description.zh: 把深度研究做成一种代理模式：一条经过审阅的固定循环——先规划，再按研究员自行声明的缺口进行自适应并行轮次，综合出带引用的报告，最后对其做对抗性审阅——而不是让模型每次现写脚本。轮次预算未能覆盖的问题会在报告中被逐一点名，而不是被悄悄丢弃。

description.en: DeepSeek API 实时价格鱼缸浮窗 — 一键装进 DeepSeek Harness，像素风陪伴式动画，自动跟随峰谷时段

Automatic session retrospective: after a conversation wraps up, distills useful experience into reusable skills stored in the skill library for the model to call, with signal-accelerated triggers, manual runs, an approval mode, and skill-library governance (archive/restore, never deletes directly).
description.zh: 自动复盘：对话收尾后自动把有价值的经验蒸馏成可复用的技能（skill）存入技能库，支持信号加速触发、手动立即复盘、审批模式与技能库治理（归档/恢复，永不直接删除）。

description.en: Per provider/model generation concurrency, with a settings card: a cap on how many sessions may stream at once, enforced at the stream and again at subagent spawn, where a fan-out past the cap waits in a FIFO queue instead of failing.
description.zh: 按提供方/模型限制并发生成，并附带设置卡片：限定同时进行流式生成的会话数，在流式调用与子代理派生两处强制执行；超出上限的扇出会进入 FIFO 队列等待，而不是直接失败。

description.en: DSH plugin bridging agents to Cheat Engine for dynamic memory debugging: scanning, pointer analysis, breakpoints, and game memory hacking.
description.zh: 让 DSH Agent 通过 Cheat Engine 进行动态内存调试：扫描、指针分析、断点与游戏内存修改。

description.en: Registers a /code-review slash command with five parallel review lenses and per-finding confidence scoring, for both pull requests and local code.
description.zh: 注册 /code-review 斜杠命令，五个并行审查视角、逐发现置信度打分，同时支持拉取请求与本地代码审查。

description.en: Reuses the CodeBuddy CLI sign-in to bring its models into DeepSeek Harness, with a settings card showing account, token expiry, and remaining credit.
description.zh: 复用 CodeBuddy CLI 的登录态，把 CodeBuddy 包含的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，设置卡片可查看账号、令牌有效期与剩余积分。

description.en: Import Claude Code sessions, skills and plugin assets into DSH as native resumable sessions, and export or sync DSH sessions back to Claude Code JSONL.
description.zh: 将 Claude Code 会话、技能与插件资产导入为 DSH 原生可续聊会话，并支持将 DSH 会话导出或同步回 Claude Code JSONL。

description.en: Brain-inspired cognitive plugin: episodic, semantic, procedural and emotional memory with reinforcement-learning signals, a goal stack with time triggers, curiosity-driven autonomous web research and proactive initiatives.
description.zh: 受大脑启发的认知插件:情景、语义、程序与情绪记忆,带强化学习信号;目标栈支持时间触发器,好奇心驱动的自主网络研究与主动提议。

description.en: Points web_search at a self-hosted SearXNG instance instead of the native route: pages until maxResults is satisfied, and reports degraded coverage when engines fail so a thin result set is not read as a thin web.
description.zh: 把 web_search 指向自建的 SearXNG 实例而非原生搜索路由：自动翻页直到满足 maxResults，并在引擎失败时报告覆盖不全，避免把稀少的结果误读成网上本就没有内容。

description.en: DSH Web Usage Center with local SQLite history, HUD and dashboard, Hub account/quota snapshots, custom pricing and fee ledger, and CSV/JSON export, plus coding-plan OAuth and an optional loopback OpenAI/Anthropic gateway.
description.zh: DSH Web 用量中心：本地 SQLite 历史、HUD 与仪表盘、Hub 账户与额度快照、自定义定价与订阅费用账本、CSV/JSON 导出，并含 coding 计划 OAuth 与可选回环 OpenAI/Anthropic 网关。

description.en: Multi-model orchestrator: the main brain decomposes complex tasks and dispatches subtasks to GLM / Kimi / Qwen sub-agents by each model's strengths, with per-model token usage.
description.zh: 多模型主脑编排器：主模型将复杂任务拆解，按各模型优劣分派给 GLM / Kimi / Qwen 子代理执行，并按模型统计 token 用量。

description.en: Config-driven lifecycle hooks, including context injection: declare event, handler and outcome in YAML, where the handler is an in-harness tool (MCP included), a shell command or an HTTP endpoint, and the outcome is model-visible context, a denied tool call, or fire-and-forget.
description.zh: 以配置驱动的生命周期钩子，并支持上下文注入：在 YAML 中声明事件、处理器与结果——处理器可以是进程内工具（含 MCP）、shell 命令或 HTTP 端点，结果可以是模型可见的上下文、拒绝该次工具调用，或触发即忘。

description.en: Plays a chime and speaks a Chinese voice alert when an approval, question, or plan-review popup appears in the DSH web GUI, so you never miss a request.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 中出现审批、提问或计划审批弹窗时，播放提示音并中文语音播报，避免漏看待处理请求。

description.en: Persistent local token-usage accounting for DSH Web with automatic history discovery and compact provider/model details.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供自动发现历史记录的本地持久化 Token 用量统计与紧凑的供应商/模型明细。

description.en: Automatic model catalog synchronization for API-key DeepSeek Harness providers.
description.zh: 自动从服务商同步 API Key 提供方的模型列表，无需手动维护。

description.en: Mixture-of-Agents plugin for DeepSeek Harness: a /moa slash command fans a prompt out to multiple models in parallel, merges their responses in a file workspace, and integrates with Live Canvas for visual output.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的混合智能体（MoA）插件：/moa 斜杠命令将提示词并发分发给多个模型，在文件工作区合并响应，并与 Live Canvas 集成以呈现可视化输出。

description.en: A guarded local fetch provider for the ctx.web seam — the backend dsh does not ship for its own web_fetch tool. Every redirect hop is re-resolved and checked against the non-routable ranges, with a streamed size cap and a content-type allowlist.
description.zh: ctx.web 接口的本地受控抓取提供方——dsh 自带完整的 web_fetch 工具，却没有随附后端。每一跳重定向都会重新解析并对照非公网地址段校验，另有流式大小上限与内容类型白名单。

description.en: Aggregated web-search provider for the built-in web_search tool: one prioritized queue over nine providers (AnySearch, TinyFish, Tavily, Brave, Exa, Firecrawl, Jina, SerpApi, Serper), with multi-key rotation per provider, ordered fallback on failed attempts, and a live settings card.
description.zh: 聚合式网页搜索提供方：为内置 web_search 工具提供一条按优先级排序的搜索队列，覆盖 AnySearch、TinyFish、Tavily、Brave、Exa、Firecrawl、Jina、SerpApi、Serper 九家服务，每家支持多把 API Key 轮换，失败时逐级回退，并附带实时生效的设置卡片。

description.en: A thinking level stored per provider and model, so reasoning effort outlives the session it was set in and also reaches subagents, which dsh never asks. The in-session picker still wins, and a model with no row keeps its provider default.
description.zh: 按提供方与模型保存思考等级：推理强度不再只属于设置它的那次会话，还会应用到 dsh 从不询问的子代理。会话内的手动选择依然优先，没有配置的模型保持提供方默认值。

description.en: Visual theme customizer for the DeepSeek Harness web UI — backgrounds, text colors, borders and details, all adjustable visually, with presets you can import and export, persisted across restarts.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 界面自定义主题插件：背景/文字/框线/细节全可视化调整，可导入导出预设，持久化保存。

description.en: Academic literature search and citation tools for DeepSeek Harness: paper search via Crossref and OpenAlex with no API key, related-works discovery, and citation formatting in GB/T 7714, APA and BibTeX.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的学术文献检索与引用工具：基于 Crossref 与 OpenAlex 检索论文（无需 API key），支持相关工作发现，并可按 GB/T 7714、APA 与 BibTeX 格式生成引用。

description.en: Free conversational ChatGPT Web (GPT 5.6 Luna) model provider for DeepSeek Harness with streaming Markdown.
description.zh: 基于免费 ChatGPT 网页端（GPT 5.6 Luna）的 DeepSeek Harness 零成本对话模型提供者，支持流式 Markdown。

description.en: Identity-gated Tailscale access to the Web GUI with dsh still bound to loopback: a 127.0.0.1 proxy published by `tailscale serve` admits a request only when the Tailscale login it stamps is allowed, with an optional per-device allowlist, so the privileged /api methods behind the loopback check — Settings, Models, Plugins — answer without dsh being told to trust a remote host.
description.zh: 在 dsh 仍绑定回环地址的前提下，为 Web 界面提供基于身份的 Tailscale 访问：由 `tailscale serve` 对外发布的 127.0.0.1 代理，仅当其标记的 Tailscale 登录账号在允许列表内时才放行请求，并可另按设备白名单限制；这样受回环检查保护的特权 /api 方法（设置、模型、插件）无需让 dsh 信任远程主机即可正常响应。

description.en: Weak-network adaptor: transparent long-backoff model-stream retries (10-min cap), local response replay cache, heartbeat auto-reconnect, and degraded-mode token economy, with a bilingual (zh/en) settings page.
description.zh: 弱网适配器：模型流式请求的长退避透明重试（上限 10 分钟）、本地响应重放缓存、心跳自动重连、降级模式 token 节流，并提供中英双语设置页。

description.en: Sidebar instance manager for DSH web: lists every local dsh instance on ports 3080-3129 (port, PID, uptime, live session count) and starts or gracefully stops them in one click, including Task-Manager-style stop of the current instance.
description.zh: 侧边栏实例管理面板：统一列出本机 3080–3129 端口的全部 dsh web 实例（端口、PID、运行时长、会话数），一键启动或优雅停止任意实例，含当前实例的任务管理器式停止。

description.en: Progressive tool disclosure: a deferred tool group costs one catalog line instead of its full schemas until the model loads it with tool_search, with one switch per group in Settings and each group measured against the live registry.
description.zh: 渐进式工具披露：被延后的工具组在每次请求中只占目录里的一行，模型用 tool_search 加载后才拿到完整 schema；设置页为每个组提供一个开关，各组开销按当前工具注册表实测。

description.en: Registers a SpecWorkflow skill pack for requirement clarification, implementation specs, execution, delivery review, repair planning, bug diagnosis, and source-backed research.
description.zh: 注册 SpecWorkflow 技能包，覆盖需求澄清、实施规格、代码执行、交付检查、修复规划、bug 诊断和带来源调研。

description.en: Yellow one-line notice for a prompt cache miss after the cache was rebuilt; shows re-billed uncached input tokens, cached hit tokens, and TTFT.
description.zh: 提示缓存未命中（cache miss）时，在重建缓存的 assistant 回复下方显示一条黄色缓存提示，展示未缓存（uncached）重新计费（re-billed）的输入 token、缓存命中 token 与首字延迟（TTFT）。

description.en: Rewrites the Chinese copy of a market-installed plugin into English using a model already configured in the harness — automatically when the plugin is installed, then live-reloaded. Each file is translated in one whole-file pass, validated by a real parser where one exists (node --check for JavaScript, JSON and YAML parsers otherwise) and handed back to the model with the error for up to three repair attempts; files above 48 KB, or that never parse, fall back to a line-range pass that checks every returned line against the original for structure. Trigger phrases and locale tables can optionally be preserved rather than translated, and the untouched original is kept beside the file as a .zh.bak.
description.zh: 用你已经配置好的模型，把从市场安装的插件里的中文文案改写成英文——安装时自动运行，随后热重载。每个文件整体翻译一遍，凡是有解析器的都会实际校验（JavaScript 用 node --check，其余用 JSON、YAML 解析器），失败时把报错交回模型，最多修复三次；超过 48 KB 或始终无法解析的文件，回退到按行区间翻译，逐行与原文做结构比对。触发短语与本地化表可以选择保留而不翻译，未改动的原文件保留在同目录下的 .zh.bak。

description.en: Consolidated toolkit for session identity, global & workspace prompts with referenced files, session auto-resume, UAC-free web restart, and peer-session messaging.
description.zh: 整合工具包：会话身份、全局/工作区提示词（含引用文件）、会话自动上线、免 UAC 网页重启、会话间消息。

description.en: Conversation minimap docked on the right edge of the dsh Web chat: colour-block and to-scale thumbnail modes, drag-to-resize (10–320px), hover loupe preview, click-to-jump and drag-to-scroll with a live viewport indicator, and collapse to a 4px strip.
description.zh: 停靠在 dsh Web 对话区右缘的会话代码地图：色块/缩略图双模式、拖动调宽（10–320px）、悬停放大镜预览、点击跳转与拖动滚动（带实时视口指示条）、可收起为 4px 细条。

description.en: Full vision-capability bundle for DeepSeek Harness: a vision_understand tool (OpenAI-compatible vision APIs, free Zhipu GLM-4V-Flash by default) plus paste/drag-and-drop/button entry points for image recognition.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 视觉能力全家桶：vision_understand 工具（OpenAI 兼容视觉 API，默认免费智谱 GLM-4V-Flash）+ 粘贴/拖拽/按钮三入口识图。

description.en: Model-facing `vision` tool for DeepSeek Harness: describe and OCR image files by calling the free Zhipu GLM vision API directly (glm-4v-flash fallback chain), no external CLI required.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的纯文本模型补上免费识图：`vision` 工具直连智谱 GLM 视觉 API 描述/OCR 图片文件（glm-4v-flash 降级链），无需任何外部 CLI。

description.en: AgentDuel is a code-battle game. This plugin lets you complete the entire game loop inside DSH: manage deathmatch characters and capture-the-flag teams, submit agent code, start battles, watch replays, and use DSH conversations to keep improving agents based on battle results.
description.zh: AgentDuel 是一款代码对战游戏，通过这款插件，在 DSH 内部完成整个游戏过程，实现死斗角色与夺旗团队、提交 Agent 代码、发起战斗、观看回放，并通过 DSH 会话依据战果继续优化 Agent。

description.en: Group installed skills and manage MCP servers from a left-panel UI: filter the model skill catalog by enabled groups (union-deduped) and toggle MCP servers independently.
description.zh: 将已安装的技能分组管理、独立开关 MCP 服务器：按启用分组过滤模型可见的技能目录（并集去重），全部操作集中在左侧面板。

description.en: Configurable default model for subagent delegations via settings.yaml, with single-model and multi-model round-robin or random strategies.
description.zh: 通过 settings.yaml 为子代理派发配置默认模型，支持单模型与多模型轮换/随机分配策略。

description.en: Cursor-style New Session: every click creates a fresh blank draft session (persisted before the first message) instead of reusing the workspace's single one, plus a sidebar Drafts switcher to keep several empty chats open at once.
description.zh: Cursor 风格的新会话：每次点击都新建一个空白草稿会话（首条消息前即持久化），不再复用工作区唯一的空会话；侧栏新增草稿切换器，可同时保留多个空会话。

description.en: Instantly find DSH settings pages, tabs and rows by keyword, pinyin, intent or AI — and jump straight to them.
description.zh: 通过关键词、拼音、意图或 AI 一键搜索 DSH 设置面板，并直达目标设置页、标签或选项。

description.en: Evidence-first conclusion gate that cross-checks first-hand claims against a durable per-session tool-activity index, blocks unverified guesses and tracks blocked-versus-converted metrics.
description.zh: 实证门——按会话将第一手结论与持久工具活动索引交叉核验、拦截未验证猜测并以台账统计拦截与转化，中英双语界面。

description.en: Manage global AGENTS.md in DSH Web with Markdown preview, reusable templates, version history, import/export, failed-import rollback, and revision-conflict protection.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 中管理全局 AGENTS.md，支持 Markdown 预览、可复用模板、版本历史、导入导出、失败导入回滚与修订冲突保护。

description.en: Prompt enhancer for the DSH web UI with basic/standard/expert modes: standard/expert modes rewrite drafts with project context and recent session history, retry gracefully when gateways reject reasoning-effort settings, and show a before/after review with undo.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面提示词增强插件：基础/标准/专家三档模式，标准/专家模式结合项目上下文与最近会话历史重写草稿；网关拒绝推理档位参数时自动去参重试；增强结果支持对比确认与撤回。

description.en: Registers a `deepseek-vision` provider route: the Web GUI accepts pasted images and transcribes them to text via the free Zhipu GLM vision API before delegating to the DeepSeek adapter.
description.zh: 注册 `deepseek-vision` 路由：Web GUI 直接粘贴图片，由免费智谱 GLM 视觉模型转译为文字后，再交给 DeepSeek 适配器作答。

description.en: Tripo 3D generation skills driving the tripo-cli through the shell: text-to-3D, image-to-3D, rigging with locomotion clips, decimation and LOD chains, and export to GLB/FBX/OBJ/STL/USDZ/3MF, with headless device login for both China-mainland and international accounts; installable as `tripo-dsh`.
description.zh: 通过 shell 驱动 tripo-cli 的 Tripo 3D 生成 Skill：文生 3D、图生 3D、绑骨与走跑动画、减面与 LOD 链，导出 GLB/FBX/OBJ/STL/USDZ/3MF，支持国内站与海外站账号的无头设备码登录；npm 包名 `tripo-dsh`。

description.en: Displays CodexRadar model capability benchmarks in a Settings page and shows the selected session model's DeepSWE score beside the composer.
description.zh: 在设置页展示 CodexRadar 模型能力评测，并在输入框旁显示当前会话所选模型的 DeepSWE 分数。

description.en: Notifies you with a browser notification and toast whenever a session turn ends, with 5-language templates and custom presets.
description.zh: 会话轮次结束时推送浏览器系统通知与页内提示，内置 5 种语言模板与自定义预设。

description.en: 🎲 Dice Battle — six classic dice games (Liar's Dice, Guess Red Dots, Red/Blue, Big/Small, Odd/Even, Straight) for the DSH web GUI. Single vs AI plus PeerJS WebRTC online play, fully bilingual zh/en, sidebar entry opens the game in the center column.
description.zh: 🎲 骰子大作战 — 六种经典骰子玩法（吹牛、猜红点、猜红蓝、猜大小、猜单双、猜顺子），单人 vs AI + PeerJS 联机，全量中英双语，侧边栏入口打开游戏面板。

description.en: Interval heartbeat that wakes each root agent itself (followup injection) to proactively report progress, risks or blockers: busy-safe queuing, no stacking, auto-pauses when no human replies, re-arms on the next user message.
description.zh: 定时心跳：用 followup 注入唤醒每个根 agent 主动汇报进展、风险与卡点——忙碌时排队不打断、最多保留一条、连续无人回应自动暂停，用户下一条消息即恢复。

description.en: 给 DSH 模型页补上官方适配器缺的那半：网关可达性探测、模型目录拉取并勾选写回、余额/配额常驻、协议与接入地址可见。零运行时依赖，不改动 DSH 安装。
description.zh: 给 DSH 模型页补上网关探测、模型拉取勾选、余额常驻和接入地址显示，装完即用。

description.en: dsh-dock · DeepSeek Harness 功能坞插件：一张面板统一注册/开关所有小功能——用量记账（自定义单价·分时价）、模型设置与余额、19 种任务动画、任务通知（钉钉/飞书）、运行状态、图片理解代理、账号密码远程访问、10 款小游戏。每个功能独立模块，可开关、错误隔离、即插即用。
description.zh: 一张面板管住所有小功能：用量记账、模型余额、任务动画通知、小游戏，随开随关。

description.en: Lazy MCP gateway for DeepSeek Harness: one stable proxy tool instead of N tool schemas, servers connect on first use and idle out, metadata cached to disk.
description.zh: 把一堆 MCP 工具收成一个代理，按需连接、闲置自动断开，省 token 又省心。

description.en: Local personal memory and knowledge management for DeepSeek Harness. It supports local FTS, CPU-embedding or OpenAI-Compatible Embedding API.
description.zh: 把个人记忆和导入资料存在本地 SQLite 里，支持全文检索和向量语义搜索，随时问随时答。

description.en: Balanced web search plugin/MCP server for DeepSeek Harness: Keenable / Exa / Tavily round-robin with failover. / 均衡搜索插件：Keenable / Exa / Tavily 轮流调用，自动故障切换。
description.zh: 把 Keenable、Exa、Tavily 三个搜索源轮流调用，一个挂了自动换下一个，让联网搜索更稳。

description.en: Google Antigravity OAuth Gemini provider for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把 Google Antigravity 账号里的 Gemini 模型接进 DeepSeek Harness，直接当原生模型用。

description.en: dsh-enhanced-plugins 是一站式 DeepSeek Harness 增强插件包，集成 MCP 管理、插件市场、文件引用、模型能力配置及子智能体开关。
description.zh: DSH 增强插件全家桶，一键搞定 MCP 管理、插件市场、文件引用和子智能体开关，让 DeepSeek Harness 更好用。

description.en: dsh-plugin-kit is a general-purpose plugin collection for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI: environment variable / secret management, MCP server configuration, Prompt management, Profile management, RSS / news aggregation, and a desktop client launcher。
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的终端面板：侧边栏「终端」打开多标签页 xterm.js 全交互终端（node-pty 真实 PTY），支持 ssh2 原生 SSH 远程标签页（agent/key/password 三种认证），cwd 跟随当前会话，并提供 tty_list / tty_capture / tty_send 三个 agent 工具。

description.en: Read assistant replies aloud in DeepSeek Harness: text-to-speech providers with streaming playback.
description.zh: 把 AI 回复朗读出来，支持多种语音引擎和流式播放，边生成边听。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 持久化、审批驱动的项目编排工作台
description.zh: 内置状态持久化与审批关卡，帮你把零散任务串成完整项目流，让复杂编排更省心。

description.en: Project file explorer in the details column (multi-select, drag-move, upload, download, rename, trash, system-open) with an in-session read-only preview tab for Markdown/HTML/JSON/CSV/notebook/PDF + code highlighting, a live model throughput badge, and a multiline GoalBar.
description.zh: DSH 右侧 details 列项目资源管理器（多选、拖拽移动、上传、下载、重命名、废纸篓、系统打开），会话内只读预览 Markdown/HTML/JSON/CSV/Notebook/PDF 与代码高亮，附带模型实时吞吐徽标与多行 GoalBar。

description.en: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web GUI 安全地开放到局域网或公网，自带密码鉴权，支持可选的TLS。Securely expose DeepSeek Harness's Web GUI to your local network or the public internet, with built-in password authentication and TLS support.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的网页界面安全地开放到局域网或公网，带密码保护和可选 TLS 加密，方便随时随地访问。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 回退链插件：主模型失败自动切换备用 provider，带 Web UI 配置面板 | Provider fallback chains for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 主模型失败时自动按配置顺序切换备用模型重试，避免限流超时中断对话。

description.en: Universal AI Agent Development Skills Hub & Cordis Plugin for Govard, Magento 2, Laravel. Works with Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot, DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为AI编程助手提供统一技能库，支持多框架与多工具，即插即用提升开发效率。

description.en: Correctness-oriented MCP server and batch CLI for compact structural reads and reviewed TypeScript/JavaScript edits.
description.zh: 面向代码正确性的MCP服务器，支持结构化代码读取和TypeScript/JavaScript批量编辑审查。

description.en: 把单一会话不可能的巨任务拆成无数可验证子系统，大规模并行有纪律执行
description.zh: 把一次会话做不完的大任务拆成可独立验证的子任务，逐波并行执行、审查通过才合入。

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory under the "memory palace" metaphor: dual-scope SQLite stores (user + per-git-origin project), hybrid FTS5 + local-vector retrieval with RRF fusion and recency/proof ranking boost, automatic capture from the session log (including the final turn), provenance audit chains, consolidation distillation and decay forgetting, and a settings-page Memory Library panel with corridor topology, tour butler, and refurb list.
description.zh: 跨会话长期记忆插件，以「记忆宫殿」隐喻重构 agent 长期记忆：双层 SQLite 分库（用户级 + 按 git origin 隔离的项目级）、FTS5 + 本地向量 RRF 融合与新鲜度/命中排序 boost、从会话日志自动摄取（含末轮）、来源审计链、巩固蒸馏与衰减遗忘，以及设置页「记忆库」面板（走廊拓扑、导览管家、翻新清单）。

description.en: 为DSH接入本地大模型能力：在「设置→插件」页一键启停本地 llama.cpp 大模型（双槽x双模态x双预设），卡片内配置、一条命令安装、自动注册，装完即用| Enable local large model capabilities for DSH: One-click start/stop for local llama.cpp models (dual‑slot × dual‑modal × dual‑preset) right in Settings → Plugins; configure within the card, install with a single command, automatically register, and ready to use
description.zh: 在设置页一键启停本地llama.cpp模型，让大模型直接接入DSH会话，装完即用。

description.en: ChatGPT-style right-edge turn navigation plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页版添加 ChatGPT 风格的右侧导航栏，方便快速切换对话和浏览上下文。

description.en: 基于原版 DSH 扩展，提供项目层、用户层更完整 MCP 管理 || Extended from the original DSH code, providing more complete MCP management at both project and user levels
description.zh: 在项目里写个 mcp.yml 或 mcp.json，MCP 服务就自动挂载，项目和用户层都能统一管理。

description.en: deepseek harness 皮肤插件。支持选择本地目录下的图片作为背景设置
description.zh: 给 DSH 界面换上本地图片当磨砂背景，还能调模糊、暗化，明暗主题自动适配。

description.en: Teach Math with Manim — 图书《用 Manim 讲好数学》官方配套开源仓库
description.zh: 用 Manim 做数学教学动画的官方配套仓库，含 60+ 案例源码和 AI 技能，拿来就能用。

description.en: 基于 DeepSeek Harness 的钉钉群聊常驻个人助理插件
description.zh: 在钉钉群聊里常驻一个 DeepSeek 数字员工，帮你自动处理任务、协作答疑，提升团队效率。

description.en: Text viewer and editor for the dock workbench: undo/redo, Ctrl+S save, unsaved-change confirmation and binary detection, registered as the default file viewer.
description.zh: dock 系列文本查看与编辑器：支持撤销重做、Ctrl+S 保存、未保存确认和二进制检测，作为 dock-files 的默认文本查看器。

description.en: Git history visualization for the dock workbench: swimlane commit graph, branch and tag management, stage/commit/push and remote operations.
description.zh: dock 系列 Git 历史可视化插件：泳道式提交图、分支/标签管理、暂存/提交/推送与远端操作。

description.en: Scheduled tasks (cron) for DeepSeek Harness: model- and human-callable scheduling that fires followup/inject into agent sessions
description.zh: 给 DSH 加上定时任务，按计划自动向会话注入消息或触发后续动作。

description.en: Read-only, redacted provider error diagnostics for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 里模糊的报错整理成可操作信息，还能一键生成脱敏诊断报告，方便排查和反馈问题。

description.en: Generic LLM gateway provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness: newapi / LiteLLM / Higress / any OpenAI-compatible gateway, multi-protocol (OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini) via pi-ai SDK, models.dev enrichment
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入任意 OpenAI 兼容网关（newapi/LiteLLM/Higress 等），统一多协议调用，自动补全模型信息。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness の日本語化プラグイン
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的网页界面加上日语，让日文用户也能顺手使用。

description.en: Evidence-bound negative-knowledge ledger: persists disproven paths (command_failed, file_missing) with their outcome and precondition evidence, then warns or blocks repeat attempts until the evidence changes.
description.zh: 记录编程智能体走过的弯路，避免重复踩坑，提升开发效率。

description.en: Self-contained power control for DeepSeek Harness: sidebar power button with upward restart/shutdown menu, Windows-shutdown-style overlay, own restart & shutdown engine (no dependency on other plugins).
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏加个电源键，一键重启或关机，自带重启/关机引擎，不依赖其他插件。

description.en: dsh 工作区可添加多文件夹/第三方厂商模型可开启推理等级插件
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 里的第三方模型加上推理等级调节，像 Codex 一样选 Off 到 High，模型选择器直接显示。

description.en: This is a plugin that allows deepseek harness own the ability of lx music.
description.zh: LX Music 增强控制插件：内置音源引擎（SDK 搜索 + 音源脚本沙箱）、侧边栏迷你播放卡（含播放模式切换）、细粒度 LLM 音乐工具集（music_search/play/playlist/prev/next/control）、设置窗口音源管理。

description.en: dsh 登录门卫插件：让只监听本机的 dsh Web UI 安全地对外开放——登录墙 + 全量反代，零依赖、零侵入。
description.zh: 给 dsh 的 Web UI 加一道登录墙，让本机服务安全地对外开放，登录后全功能反代，零依赖零侵入。

description.en: Map and routing tools: driving/transit/walking/bicycling route planning, geocoding and POI search via free OSM/OSRM data by default, with an optional Amap (高德) key for better China coverage.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供地图展示与路线规划工具，方便处理地理位置相关任务。

description.en: DSH 三合一扩展插件：用量工作台 · 技能管理 · 长期记忆引擎。零 DSH 源码改动，一句话安装。
LLM auto-approval for sandbox escalation requests, with presets and a fail-closed fallback.
description.zh: 沙箱升权申请的 LLM 自动审批：内置预设，fail-closed 兜底。

description.en: 接入 Google Anti Gravity Coding Plan 作为 DeepSeek Harness LLM Provider，直接使用账号下的 Gemini / Claude / GPT-OSS。 | Google Anti Gravity Coding Plan LLM Provider for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 接入 Google Anti Gravity Coding Plan，让 DeepSeek Harness 直接调用你账号下的 Gemini、Claude 等顶尖 AI 模型。

description.en: A DSH Web plugin that keeps long answers and detailed prompts side by side with a dockable Composer.
description.zh: 让长回答和详细提示词并排显示，配合可停靠的Composer面板，提升DeepSeek Harness网页版的操作效率。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 消息级删除插件，用于避免用户误发或错误的助手消息污染会话上下文。
description.zh: 消息级删除插件，一键移除误发或错误消息，防止污染模型上下文，聊天更干净。

description.en: DSH Web 输入历史插件：Ctrl+Up / Ctrl+Down 像终端一样召回与切换已发送消息，零核心改动
description.zh: 像终端一样用 Ctrl+上/下键快速翻看历史消息，还能保留未发送的草稿，聊天效率翻倍。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供多供应商真实账户余额显示
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面里直接查看多家供应商的真实账户余额，不用来回切换后台。

description.en: Electronic wooden fish in the bottom-right corner of the DSH web UI, a whale-girl sprite by default: tap the head to earn merit; it knocks by itself while the model is busy; per-session merit is stored locally, and the sprite can be swapped for custom art.
description.zh: 右下角电子木鱼，默认是鲸鱼娘图包：敲头记功德，模型忙碌时自动敲；功德按会话存本机，可换自定义图源。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that lets you control Universal Robots (UR) collaborative arms directly from natural language, developed by Suzhou Nonead Robot Technology Co., Ltd. based on the same logic as the company's own nUR MCP Server. (Suzhou Nonead Robot Technology Co., Ltd.)
description.zh: 让 DSH 用自然语言直接控制 Universal Robots（UR）机械臂的插件，由拓德科技（Nonead）基于自研的 nUR MCP Server 同源逻辑开发。（Suzhou Nonead Robot Technology Co., Ltd.）

description.en: Native AnySearch /v1/search WebSearchProvider for DeepSeek Harness with Web UI, credentials integration, and Web/Headless support.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 AnySearch 搜索，支持网页界面和凭据配置，轻松实现联网检索。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 生态的 Windows 桌面插件项目。 A Windows desktop plugin project for the DeepSeek Harness ecosystem.
description.zh: 在 Windows 桌面上以原生窗口运行 DeepSeek Harness，提供托盘、主题同步和系统通知，方便日常使用。

description.en: Docker tools for agents: ps/images/logs/inspect/exec/manage/health with JSON output, env-configurable CLI path, approval-gated exec and zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: Docker 工具：ps/images/logs/inspect/exec/manage/health 七工具，JSON 输出、DSH_DOCKER_PATH 环境变量、exec 审批门、零运行时依赖。

description.en: dsh-doctor: self-healing watchdog for the DeepSeek Harness web profile. Recovers from plugin-induced boot failures within 60s, runs an unbounded CLI doctor, captures every tool error, and watches all live sessions for stuck turns.
description.zh: DSH 自愈看门狗，插件导致启动失败时 60 秒内自动恢复，并持续监控工具错误，保障工作台稳定运行。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness <-> Feishu (Lark) bridge with streaming reply card / 自研 DSH 飞书桥：长连接 + 流式回复卡片（工具面板/状态符号/限流熔断兜底）
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness <-> Feishu (Lark) bridge with streaming reply card / 自研 DSH 飞书桥：长连接 + 流式回复卡片（工具面板/状态符号/限流熔断兜底）

description.en: Focus mode with a full-screen reading overlay that hides the header and composer and folds AI tool calls into summaries.
description.zh: 专注模式：全屏阅读视图，隐藏标题与输入区，把 AI 工具调用折叠成摘要。

description.en: 简洁、克制、安静，旨在为您的Vibe Coding增加些许文艺感。每次打开WebUI，左下角都会出现一句话，从古诗词到文采句，再到脍炙人口的游戏台词，应有尽有。语料库可高度自定义，插件风格完全适配原生Harness界面，功能简洁明确，绝不喧宾夺主。
description.zh: 每次打开WebUI，左下角自动显示一句古诗词或经典台词，给Vibe Coding加点文艺感，语料库还能自己定制。

description.en: DSH STORE — third-party plugin marketplace and guarded lifecycle manager for DeepSeek Harness.
DeepSeek Harness 网页搜索插件：多个 Tavily/Exa key 按限流负载均衡，429 自动换 key，含设置页 UI 与 Tavily 额度总览。
description.zh: 多供应商网页搜索负载均衡插件，自动轮换 Tavily/Exa 密钥，应对限流不中断，附额度总览。

description.en: A version‑aware adapter registry that decouples third‑party Cordis plugins from dsh’s internal service names, paths, and RPC internals. 基于版本感知适配器注册表，为 dsh Cordis 插件提供运行时兼容层，使第三方插件与内部服务名、模块路径及 RPC 细节解耦。
description.zh: 为 dsh 插件提供版本兼容层，升级后第三方插件无需改动即可继续使用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness web notifications plugin
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供浏览器通知功能，让任务完成或需要关注时及时提醒你。

description.en: Cross-session usage & cost observatory for the DeepSeek Harness web profile — trend/heatmap dashboards, per-model peak-hour pricing (CNY/USD), official DeepSeek balance with spend reconciliation.
description.zh: 跨会话统计 DeepSeek Harness 的用量与费用，提供趋势热力图、分时段价格和余额对账，帮你掌握成本。

description.en: Agent run-rhythm guard for DeepSeek Harness: reasoning dead-loop interception (guard) + automatic continuation after premature stops (continue)
description.zh: 守护 Agent 运行节奏，防止推理死循环或过早收工，让长任务稳定跑完。

description.en: 🐟 Salted Fish Pet — a Cordis-based web-client UI plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI. Injects a draggable, feedable salted fish mascot + full-viewport engineer wallpaper into the shell.overlay slot. Pure front-end (React + CSS Modules), zero server-side.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面加一只可拖拽投喂的咸鱼宠物，配上工程师壁纸，让开发环境更有趣。

description.en: PiUI-inspired home feed visual refinement plugin for DeepSeek Harness web client (pure extension, zero core changes)
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 主页信息流更好看，纯前端视觉优化，不改底层逻辑。

description.en: 在DeepSeek Harness Web 会话头部添加胶囊拆分按钮，一键在当前工作区打开VS Code、终端（CMD / PowerShell）和文件资源管理器。
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供灵活的文件打开方式，让你快速选择应用或工具处理内容，提升操作效率。

description.en: Community plugins for DeepSeek Harness — starting with a Telegram channel the harness does not ship
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供社区插件，内置 Telegram 通道，让智能体直接对接聊天工具。

description.en: 让 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）住进 QQ：基于腾讯官方 Bot API，支持私聊白名单、持久会话、模型切换与远程权限审批。
description.zh: Security-first QQ Bot channel plugin for DeepSeek Harness, built on Tencent's official SDK

description.en: MobaXterm-style SSH/SFTP tool plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): saved connection profiles, persistent multiplexed sessions, remote command execution, SFTP file transfer, and a web GUI console with file browser + live xterm terminal.
description.zh: 像 MobaXterm 一样管理 SSH/SFTP 连接，支持远程命令、文件传输和网页终端，轻松接入 Linux 主机。

description.en: Visual development studio for DSH WebUI plugins with isolated Git worktrees, live official-WebUI previews, source editing, patch inspection, builds, and validation.
description.zh: 面向 DSH WebUI 插件的可视化开发工作室，提供隔离的 Git worktree、真实官方 WebUI 预览、源码编辑、Patch 检查、构建与验证。

description.en: dsh-companion turns DeepSeek Harness into a focused AI companion experience, with persistent relationship state and continuity across sessions
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供一个轻量、专注的 Svelte 聊天界面，让你在 /companion/ 路径下更舒服地和 AI 对话。

description.en: 为DeepSeek Harness制作的极简“对话密度地图”插件（右侧对话历史标签）A minimal "Conversation Density Map" extension for DeepSeek Harness (Right Chat History Tab)
description.zh: 在右侧历史对话栏生成可视化密度图，一眼看清聊天活跃度，快速定位目标会话。

description.en: 一款基于主播女孩重度依赖创建的 适用于 DSH 的 实验性主题皮肤 / Unofficial pixel desktop skin for DSH Web inspired by NEEDY GIRL OVERDOSE. Experimental, non-commercial fan project.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web 变成主播女孩重度依赖风格的像素桌面，边玩边干活，娱乐工作两不误。

description.en: dsh's tui base on nvim
description.zh: 把 dsh 的终端界面换成 Neovim 风格，分屏看会话、工具卡片和推理过程，还能直接审批操作。

description.en: 增强提示词魔法棒:DSH Web 对话输入框的灵活自适应提示词增强插件
description.zh: 在DSH对话输入框加个魔法棒按钮，一键把口语化、零散的输入润色成精准清晰的提示词，让AI更懂你。

description.en: DSH Web 插件「基础能力面板」：在 DSH 设置中可视化并管理 MCP 服务器、技能 与 规则。采用模块化 feature 注册表，后续的 DSH 可视化功能只需新增一个 feature 目录并在注册表加一行即可，无需改动面板骨架。
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中可视化查看和管理 MCP 服务器、技能与规则，模块化设计方便后续功能扩展。

description.en: Archived-session management, task-stop notifications, an update checker, model routing (keyword rules + allowlist-gated model_route), multi-task scheduled triggers (heartbeats and fixed-time tasks), and a DeepSeek-style message scroll nav for the dsh web GUI.
description.zh: 归档会话管理、任务完成桌面通知、更新检查、模型路由（关键词规则 + 白名单门控 model_route）、多任务定时触发（心跳与定点任务），以及 DeepSeek 风格的消息滚动导航。

description.en: Digital Employee，Integrates three catalogs — Experts, Skills, and Connectors — supporting browsing, favoriting, invoking, and publishing without modifying the host.
description.zh: 数字员工，整合专家、技能、连接器三大目录，支持浏览、收藏、召唤与发布，且无需改动宿主代码。

description.en: Adds the DeepSeek Harness homepage background to dsh web: WebGL fluid light, dot-line grid and a digital point-cloud whale, with dark and light palettes.
description.zh: 给 dsh web 铺上 DeepSeek Harness 首页同款背景：WebGL 流体光效、点线网格与数字点云鲸鱼，深色/亮色两套配色。

description.en: One toggle makes the whole DeepSeek Harness shell translucent, with an opacity slider and a custom full-page background.
description.zh: 一键让整个 DeepSeek Harness 界面通透起来：透明度滑块随心调，背景图自由换。

description.en: Search-first capability workflow for DSH agents (v1.0.0): reuse local tools or review exact-source plugins before installation, adapt or create capabilities in managed source work, and use receipts that distinguish installed, loaded, activated, and verified states; version tools cover rollback, adoption, and upstream updates.
description.zh: AutoEvo v1.0.0 为 DSH Agent 提供 Search-first 能力工作流：优先复用本地工具或审查精确来源插件后再安装；可在受管源码中改造或新建能力；回执区分 installed、loaded、activated、verified，版本工具支持回滚、领养与上游更新。

description.en: Loom Chat is a DSH Web client plugin that turns linear ordinary sessions into a pannable, zoomable Loom-style canvas for parallel exploration.
description.zh: 把普通对话变成可缩放平移的无限画布，让你并行探索多个话题，聊天不再是一条线。

description.en: chinng-inta/dsh-web-search-searxng 声明为 DeepSeek Harness 生态插件。
description.zh: 用自托管的SearXNG给DeepSeek Harness加联网搜索能力，让模型能实时查资料。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for agent workspace hygiene: artifact value assessment, metadata indexing, and auditable cleanup.
description.zh: 帮你自动整理智能体工作区，评估文件价值、建立索引，并安全清理无用文件，让任务运行更清爽高效。

description.en: DSH plugin bundling the kimi-ppt skill: create, edit and export presentations as a locally generated .pptx with Pillow-rendered previews. Derived from the MIT open-kimi-ppt-skill.
description.zh: 内含 kimi-ppt 技能的 DSH 插件：本地生成 .pptx 完成 PPT 的创建、编辑与导出，Pillow 生成预览图；衍生自 MIT 项目 open-kimi-ppt-skill。

description.en: Governed long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: append-only evidence ledger with write guards, 7-tier authority claims, supersede chains, and budgeted pre-step injection with per-domain quotas.
description.zh: 带治理的长期记忆：只追加证据账本、写入闸门、7 级权威声明与取代链，pre-step 按领域配额预算注入。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 自动审批插件：在 workspace-write 沙箱之上叠加确定性规则 + LLM 安全审批，自动模式不放宽沙箱、fail-closed。 Safe auto-approval for DeepSeek Harness — deterministic rules + LLM review on top of the workspace-write sandbox. Auto mode without ever granting full-access.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 自动审批插件：在 workspace-write 沙箱之上增加 Auto 档——确定性规则放行/拒绝，模糊操作由 LLM 裁决，危险操作转人工。保留工作区沙箱边界，不放宽为 full-access。

description.en: Agent security guardrail: intercepts and audits every tool call, requiring human confirmation on sensitive operations.
description.zh: Agent 安全护栏：拦截并审计所有工具调用，命中敏感操作就要求人工确认。

description.en: Live2D companion for DSH: a floating Cubism model with state-driven expressions and mouse tracking; config-driven geometry (size/position from the plugin config); official Haru sample bundled (© Live2D Inc.).
description.zh: DSH 的 Live2D 桌宠：悬浮的 Cubism 模型，表情随状态变化并跟随鼠标；尺寸与位置由插件配置驱动；内置官方 Haru 示例模型（© Live2D Inc.）。

description.en: Auto-repairs the messages array after a tool-dispatch crash (orphaned tool_calls / tool messages), preventing 400 INVALID_REQUEST session lock-ups.
description.zh: 工具调度崩溃后自动修复 messages 数组（孤儿 tool_calls / tool 消息），防止 400 INVALID_REQUEST 会话卡死。

description.en: Connect ChatGPT Codex, xAI Grok, Zhipu GLM, AWS Kiro, Google Antigravity, and Cursor subscriptions to DeepSeek Harness through OAuth and a local proxy.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 和本地代理，将 ChatGPT Codex、xAI Grok、智谱 GLM、AWS Kiro、Google Antigravity 与 Cursor 订阅接入 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: deepseek harness opencode + omo (oh-my-openagent) preset
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 集成 opencode 与 oh-my-openagent 预设，开箱即用，提升开发效率。

description.en: 增强提示词魔法棒:DSH Web 对话输入框的灵活自适应提示词增强插件
JSON queries with a JMESPath subset.
description.zh: JMESPath 子集 JSON 查询。

description.en: Test/extract/safe-replace/statically explain regexes without executing code.
description.zh: 正则测试/提取/安全替换/静态解释（不执行代码）。

description.en: JSON Schema validation: validate/paths/explain/normalize.
description.zh: JSON Schema 验证：validate/paths/explain/normalize。

description.en: Settings usage dashboard: tokens, requests, output tokens, and cache-hit rate from session logs, with a stacked chart and a breakdown table by provider, model, or workspace.
description.zh: 设置页用量仪表盘：从会话日志汇总 token、请求、输出 token 与缓存命中率，含堆叠图，并按供应商、模型或工作区分组列表。

description.en: Editable, session-isolated personalization memory for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: Editable, session-isolated personalization memory for DeepSeek Harness

description.en: DingTalk group-robot notifications (notify/text/health; webhook + HMAC signing, zero runtime dependencies).
description.zh: 钉钉群机器人通知：dingtalk_notify/text/health 三工具，webhook + HMAC 加签，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Multi-agent teams, model routing, and declarative orchestration for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 轻松组建多智能体团队，智能路由模型，并声明式编排复杂任务流程。

description.en: Dialog-style model picker for the DSH Web UI: fuzzy search, collapsible provider groups, favorites with a favorites-only filter, and a thinking-level dropdown, replacing the built-in model selector with official UI primitives and DSW tokens.
description.zh: Web UI 模型选择器替换插件：对话框式选择，支持模糊搜索、供应商折叠分组、收藏与只看收藏过滤，以及思考档位下拉，复用官方组件库与 DSW 设计 token。

description.en: PaddleOCR skills for DeepSeek Harness with native tools and GUI configuration
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 PaddleOCR 文字识别能力，自带原生工具和图形界面配置，开箱即用。

description.en: Local-first usage and cost meter for the DSH web UI: composer button with live session cost and balance; panel with a stacked per-model daily/7-day chart priced per effective list-price interval (official pricing page synced daily), monthly usage tiers with a canvas share card, 30/50/85% context-pressure warnings with one-click /compact, budget alerts, and an in-panel npm update check with one-click update.
description.zh: 本地优先的用量与费用仪表：输入框下方按钮显示实时费用与余额，面板含按模型堆叠的当日/近 7 天柱状图（按刊例价生效区间计价、官方定价页每日同步）、本月消耗段位与画布分享卡片、30/50/85% 上下文压力三档预警与一键 /compact、预算提醒，以及面板内 npm 检查更新与一键更新。

description.en: 钱学森《工程控制论》全书蒸馏的 DeepSeek Harness 方法论技能插件 | A DeepSeek Harness skill plugin distilled from Qian Xuesen's Engineering Cybernetics

Give DeepSeek (text-only) models **vision** in Claude Code and Codex by routing image files to any OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint (OpenRouter, SiliconFlow, DashScope, Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM, LM Studio, …). Zero runtime dependencies, MIT licensed.
description.zh: 让纯文本 DeepSeek 也能看懂图片，自动转发给外部视觉模型处理，兼顾代码编写与图像识别。

description.en: Custom product name and logo branding for DeepSeek Harness Web 自定义 DeepSeek Harness Web 端 logo 和产品名称
description.zh: 不改源码，轻松给 DeepSeek Harness 换上自己的产品名和 logo，让界面更贴合品牌。

description.en: Lark/Feishu IM bot channel for DeepSeek Harness: session mirroring, interactive cards, topic-level sync

DSH balance and quota card showing up to 3 recently used providers. Supports DeepSeek, Moonshot, Kimi For Coding, OpenAI Codex, and OpenCode Go, with auto-discovery, quota windows, reset times, color-coded status, dragging, and automatic refresh.
description.zh: DSH 余额与配额悬浮卡片：常驻显示最近使用的最多 3 个 provider，支持 DeepSeek、Moonshot、Kimi For Coding、OpenAI Codex 和 OpenCode Go；自动发现配置，展示配额窗口与重置时间，并支持分档着色、拖动和自动刷新。

description.en: DSH 插件管理器：内置/三方插件安装、卸载、启动、停用与 GitHub 直跳
description.zh: 在 Web 设置页一站式管理 DSH 插件，支持安装、卸载、启用、停用，还能从 GitHub 搜索安装或一键装载非 bundle 插件。

description.en: Replay a DeepSeek Harness session at its original token cadence — an in-app playback theater with play/pause/step/speed/seek.
Improve web search in Deepseek Harness, use server-side search service.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入服务端搜索服务，提升联网搜索能力，让 AI 获取更实时的信息。

description.en: Native DeepSeek Harness plugin for controlling ComfyUI queues, history, outputs, models, uploads, and generation.
description.zh: 让 AI 直接操控本机 ComfyUI，查队列、中断任务、看产出图、管理模型，还能上传图片和提交生成工作流。

description.en: Four-module session companion: smart conversation export (Markdown/PDF/JSON/PNG long-image with privacy redaction and batch ZIP), context handoff summaries with template save/import, API cost optimization (live official pricing, peak/off-peak scheduling, daily/monthly budgets, model routing), and global conversation search with in-chat find (Ctrl+F, CSS Custom Highlight API).
description.zh: 四模块会话伴侣：对话智能导出（Markdown/PDF/JSON/PNG 长图、隐私脱敏、批量 ZIP）、上下文交接摘要（模板保存与导入继承）、API 成本优化（官方动态计价、峰谷调度、日/月双档预算、模型路由）、全局对话检索与对话内搜索（Ctrl+F、CSS Custom Highlight API）。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 数据源连接插件，支持数据库元数据发现、AI 语义建模、只读 SQL 查询和固定 HTTP API 调用
dsh 插件：让自定义提供方（pi-ai 手写路由）的所有模型都能选择思考强度（推理等级），选择经原厂适配器真正发往线上。A dsh plugin giving every custom-provider model selectable reasoning effort, wired through the stock pi-ai adapter.
description.zh: 让自定义提供方的所有模型都能选思考强度，选择真实生效并发送到线上。

description.en: DeepSeek API quota (balance) widget for the DSH web GUI: a floating bottom-right card showing remaining DeepSeek API balance.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面挂个悬浮卡片，实时显示 DeepSeek API 剩余余额和今日用量，自动刷新。

description.en: Config-driven development-task orchestration for DSH: graph workflows (task/gateway/human nodes) with per-stage persistence, plus an in-editor AI assistant that configures workflows through conversation with live validation.
description.zh: 配置驱动的工作流与开发任务编排：图式工作流（任务/网关/人工审批节点）+ 阶段级断点持久化，内置 AI 助手在图编辑器中通过对话配置工作流，逐条校验实时应用到画布。

description.en: nebula v5 plugin for deepseek harness
description.zh: 连接 NebulaGraph v5 图数据库，在 DeepSeek Harness 中直接执行 ISO-GQL 查询语句。

description.en: Obsidian bridge plugin for DSH
description.zh: 把 Obsidian 变成 DSH 的本地控制台，直接在笔记里管理和运行 DeepSeek Harness 任务。

description.en: Omni Router - auto-routing DeepSeek Harness preset: simple tasks run directly, complex tasks plan first with approval gate.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一层任务级可靠性，自动判断何时介入、验证证据并处理失败，让结果更靠谱。

description.en: Long-term cross-session markdown memory with an LLM-Wiki structure and a SOUL.md persona, injected at session start (by default only after the first user message and only in the active session), plus remember/recall/consolidate/forget workflows, an embedded memory skill, pack/unpack migration tooling, and an idle-time first-person recall nudge that surfaces real memories in a companion voice.
description.zh: 带 LLM Wiki 结构与 SOUL 人格文件的长期 markdown 记忆库：会话启动注入 boot 块（默认提问后才注入、且只注入当前激活会话），含 remember/recall/consolidate/forget 工作流、内嵌 memory 技能、pack/unpack 迁移工具，以及空闲时以第一人称主动追忆（recall nudge）的拟人化能力。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：回复/提问/审批三类会话通知（系统原生 toast）+ 会话内梯子目录导航。DeepSeek Harness plugin: session notifications (reply/ask/approval) with native OS toasts + an in-conversation ladder outline.
description.zh: AI回复、提问、审批时自动弹系统通知，会话内快速跳转目录，提升多任务处理效率。

description.en: Connects dsh to Weixin, with arbitrary file sending support.
description.zh: 通过微信远程控制 DeepSeek Harness，支持任意文件传输。

description.en: 用于DeepSeek Harness的林翩翩主题UI插件。使用《哀鸿：城破十日记》的角色林翩翩作为页面半透明背景，并支持透明度和深度调节。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换上林翩翩主题，半透明背景可调深浅，聊天界面颜值拉满还不影响阅读。

description.en: Import high-quality conversations into Claude Code and provide CLAUDE.md recognition, add basic features like the "/init" command, and help speed up migration progress | 高质量导入Claude Code中的对话，并提供CLAUDE.md识别，添加"/init"命令等基础功能，帮助快速迁移进度
description.zh: Import high-quality conversations into Claude Code and provide CLAUDE.md recognition, add basic features like the "/init" command, and help speed up migration progress | 高质量导入Claude Code中的对话，并提供CLAUDE.md识别，添加"/init"命令等基础功能，帮助快速迁移进度

description.en: Three-tier now/next/later input planning dock for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a red/yellow/green priority strip replaces the busy-Enter queue, plain Enter queues to later, with in-place multi-line editing, drag reorder, and session-isolated freeze/resume; the freeze button bridges a separate plugin, [dsh-session-guard](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-session-guard) (installable from dsh-market), via stopNextTurn/resume RPC + composer lock for a real per-session lock, pairing with its global peak-hour auto-pause to stop sessions during DeepSeek's high-cost windows and resume off-peak.
description.zh: 三档（now/next/later）输入规划 dock：以红/黄/绿色优先级条取代忙碌 Enter 排队栏，普通 Enter 排入 later，支持多行原位编辑、拖拽排序与会话级冻结/恢复；冻结按钮经 stopNextTurn/resume RPC + 输入框锁定，桥接另一独立插件 [dsh-session-guard](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-session-guard)（可在 dsh-market 安装）实现按会话真实冻结锁定，并配合其高峰全局自动暂停，在 DeepSeek 高价时段停止会话、错峰自动恢复。
让多台设备上的 DSH 和 AI 像群聊一样互相交流，自动接话、排队投递，人类随时插话管理。

description.en: Query local log files with Chinese natural-language time expressions (e.g. "yesterday afternoon", "3 hours ago") — precise time range, matched lines, ERROR/WARN/INFO level stats, fully offline.
description.zh: 用中文自然语言时间描述查询本地日志（如「昨天下午」「3小时前」）——精确时间范围、匹配行、级别统计，完全离线。

description.en: An accumulated design-taste corpus for DSH agents: feed good and bad examples, distill principles, and review new designs against learned judgment rather than a fixed ruleset.
description.zh: 给 DSH agent 的积累型设计品味语料库：喂好坏例子、提炼原则，用学到的判断评审新设计，而不是套固定规则。

description.en: Prompt enhancement for the composer: an "✨ Enhance" button rewrites your draft prompt into a clearer, more structured version with first-principles thinking, grounded in session context, memory and recent conversation; asks clarifying questions in a card when key info is missing, then previews the result before applying it to the input.
description.zh: 输入框提示词增强：✨ 增强按钮用第一性原理、结合会话上下文/记忆/最近对话，把草稿扩写为更清晰、更结构化的提示词；关键信息缺失时以提问卡片澄清，预览确认后再应用到输入框。

description.en: Harmony WebUI Studio for isolated DSH plugin development
一个基于tv动画yumemita中的人物千石由乃，使用剧照素材，应用于deepseek-harness的自定义配色插件；A custom color scheme plugin for deepseek-harness, based on the character Yuno Sengoku from the TV anime "Yumemita"
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换上由乃粉主题，界面秒变二次元，好看又护眼。

description.en: Loopback-first multi-agent message relay: HMAC-authenticated broker plus dsh plugin (relay_send/recv/peers/history), zero-dependency CLI and Python clients, wire protocol v1.0.
description.zh: 本地优先的多 Agent 协作中继：HMAC 认证 broker + dsh 插件（relay_send/recv/peers/history）+ 零依赖 CLI 与 Python 客户端，wire protocol v1.0。

description.en: Use your ChatGPT subscription in DeepSeek Harness to access Codex models and generate or edit images with gpt-image-2—no OpenAI Platform API key required.
description.zh: 用 ChatGPT 订阅在 DeepSeek Harness 里调用 Codex 模型，还能用 gpt-image-2 生成和编辑图片，无需 OpenAI 平台 API 密钥。

description.en: Deep links: open a specific session or workspace via `?session=` / `?workspace=`.
description.zh: `?session=` / `?workspace=` 深链直达指定项目对话。

description.en: DeepTutor tutoring bridge: deep explanations, self-test questions, learning-path planning, personal knowledge-base search (RAG), and note archiving via deeptutor_run / deeptutor_kb / deeptutor_note tools.
description.zh: DeepTutor 学习辅导桥接插件：通过 deeptutor_run / deeptutor_kb / deeptutor_note 工具为 agent 接入深度讲解、自测题、学习路径规划、个人知识库检索（RAG）与笔记归档。

description.en: OpenCode Go subscription chat for DSH with per-model Completions, Responses, or Anthropic protocol selection, model discovery, context, vision and thinking metadata, effort defaults, and usage meters.
description.zh: DSH 的 OpenCode Go 订阅聊天：按模型选择 Completions、Responses 或 Anthropic 协议，支持模型发现、上下文、视觉与思考元数据、effort 默认值和用量仪表。

description.en: Karpathy LLM Wiki pattern knowledge base for DSH: wiki-write/wiki-search skills, zero-dependency pipeline (lint/index/mnemon memory sync/quality feedback), minimal lifecycle plugin injecting schema + knowledge preview, SiliconFlow semantic recall via an Ollama-compatible proxy.
description.zh: Karpathy LLM Wiki 模式的 DSH 知识库系统：wiki-write/wiki-search 技能引导模型写读 Obsidian wiki，零依赖管线（lint/索引/mnemon 记忆体同步/质量闭环），极简生命周期插件注入守则与知识预览，Ollama 兼容代理接 SiliconFlow 语义召回。

description.en: dsh markdown 主题插件
description.zh: 轻量级对话 Markdown 主题插件——增强原生着色，4 套内置主题（浅/深双档）、用户自定义 CSS 主题、系统感知自动切换、内置主题编辑器，提升快速阅读体验。

description.en: Cross-session plaintext memory: deterministic BM25 keyword recall (no embeddings), memory_save/list/search/confirm/forget tools behind a human-confirm gate, and global + project-scoped JSON stores that follow your git repo.
description.zh: 跨会话明文记忆：确定性 BM25 关键词召回（无向量嵌入），memory_save/list/search/confirm/forget 五个工具 + 人工确认闸门，global/project 两层 JSON 存储（project 随 git 分享）。

description.en: OneBot Adapter For DSH
description.zh: OneBot v11 适配器：HTTP、正向/反向 WebSocket 都支持。

description.en: 面向 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的**第三方插件管理器**：在 Web UI 设置页选择第三方插件库文件夹，搜索其中所有第三方插件，并一键关闭/启动（刷新 dsh 后生效）。
description.zh: 在 dsh 设置页选择第三方插件库，一键启用或停用插件，刷新后生效，轻松管理扩展功能。

description.en: DSH 插件: 按 workspace 加载 MCP server (agent-scoped)
description.zh: 按项目目录自动加载各自的 MCP 服务器，不同项目工具互不干扰，随会话生灭自动回收。

description.en: Context-aware next-message suggestions in the DSH composer, with repeated Trigger cycling and explicit user review before sending.
description.zh: DSH 输入框的上下文感知下一句建议：重复 Trigger 可持续换一条，发送前始终由用户确认。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）Web UI 提供的 19 个精品风格主题，完整移植自 YiziMarkdown 的设计语言。
description.zh: YiziMarkdown theme pack for DeepSeek Harness — 19 style themes with custom brand and prompt mapping.

description.en: deepseek harness plugin for medical image analysis
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek 直接看懂医学影像，自动分析病灶并生成报告，辅助医生快速诊断。

description.en: 在 Web GUI 里可视化管理项目的全部能力——Skills、MCP 服务器、快捷消息， 全部支持项目级 / 全局级双作用域，全部可以不离开浏览器完成安装、启停与分发
description.zh: 在浏览器里统一管理项目的 Skills、MCP 服务器和快捷消息，支持项目级与全局级，装好即用。

description.en: The model switch for DSH: point it at any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with curated free/cheap DeepSeek provider presets and automatic fallback when a free tier rate-limits you.
description.zh: DSH 的模型切换器：指向任意 OpenAI 兼容端点，内置精选免费/低价 DeepSeek 服务商预设，免费额度限流时自动回退。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that auto-nudges agents to consult docs or web search when local trial-and-error becomes costly. DeepSeek Harness 插件：当本地试错成本升高时，自动注入检索提示，引导 Agent 查阅文档或联网搜索。

Named subagent roster: manage role entries (model, persona, tool filter, depth, background mode) from a hot-reloaded settings page; the model picks one with list_subagents and dispatches by id with delegate — foreground, background, or continuable.
description.zh: 具名子代理名册：设置页可视化维护角色条目（模型、persona、工具过滤、深度、后台模式），热生效；模型用 list_subagents 选人、delegate 按 id 派活，支持前台、后台与可续聊。

description.en: Accessible collapsible provider groups for the DeepSeek Harness model selector.
DSH version badge + one-click auto-update (dual-surface Cordis plugin)
Floating notes for the dsh web GUI: keep commands, credentials and snippets at hand, insert any note into the composer, save any selection as a note
View and manage archived sessions in DSH: browse the archive, read full transcripts (turns/reasoning/tools/markdown tables), remove records. Desktop + web.
Local-first experiment and evaluation workbench plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Host-side unattended job scheduler: runs one-shot agent tasks or shell commands on cron, interval, or one-time schedules, with persisted at-most-once dispatch state, overlap/misfire policies, and bounded run history.
description.zh: 宿主侧无人值守定时任务：按 cron 表达式、固定间隔或一次性时点运行一次性 agent 任务或 shell 命令，调度状态持久化（至多一次语义），支持重叠/错过策略与有界运行历史。

description.en: Image preview for DSH (DeepSeek Harness) web sessions: read_image results render as a thumbnail, click for full size in the built-in lightbox.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页会话中，将 read_image 结果渲染为缩略图，点击即可在灯箱中查看原图，告别原始 JSON。

description.en: 为了开发插件，开发了一个开发插件的插件。通过可视化的事件流、插件管理、工具管理、技能管理、预设管理，简化插件的开发流程，方便开发者理解插件的作用。

Cache-stable progressive tool discovery: a fixed tool_search and tool_dispatch surface on every request, in-memory catalog search, nested dispatch through the Harness pipeline, and a byte-stable native tool list across discovery.
description.zh: 缓存稳定的渐进式工具发现：每次请求使用固定的 tool_search 与 tool_dispatch 工具面，从内存目录搜索后经 Harness 管线分发，发现过程中原生工具列表保持字节稳定。

description.en: Browse the public skillhub.cn catalog from Settings and install selected SKILL.md bundles into ~/.dsh/skills.
description.zh: 在设置页浏览 skillhub.cn 公开技能目录，并将选中的 SKILL.md 技能包安装到 ~/.dsh/skills。
