description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：pip/GitHub 下载卡死一键急停 + 下载进度检测 + 卡死识别 + 隐形追加条件。Emergency stop for stuck pip/GitHub downloads in DSH.
description.zh: 下载卡死一键急停，实时检测pip/GitHub下载进度，自动识别卡死并隐形追加条件，告别网络超时干等。

description.en: Declarative deny-by-default tool policy plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: dsh-tool-policy — DSH 插件（工具）

description.en: DSH web 用量/费用悬浮按钮插件：账户余额、峰谷时段、今日/本会话消费估算与 token 统计（含设置开关）
description.zh: 网页右下角悬浮金币按钮，一键查看账户余额、峰谷时段、今日及本会话消费与token统计，还能在设置里开关。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可视化 goal 模式：Goal 栏 / 头部入口 / 设置页（历史+多会话总览）/ goal_overview 模型工具
Agent preset that turns multi-stage objectives into resumable flows: refereed stages, SHA-256 lock identity, an HMAC-signed terminal review gate and event-sourced run logs; ships 15 agent tools.
description.zh: 把多阶段目标编排为可恢复 Flow 的 agent 预设：阶段带裁判、SHA-256 流锁身份、HMAC 终局评审门禁、事件溯源运行日志；附 15 个工具。

description.en: Browse, preview, edit, and save files under the current project's openspec/ directory from a Web UI header panel that follows the session workspace.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 会话标题栏打开当前项目的 openspec/ 目录，浏览、预览、编辑并保存其中的文件，自动跟随会话工作区。

description.en: Writing bridge to the open-source QingAgent client: the agent drafts and revises documents through qing_ prefixed host tools, typeset on a rice-paper panel with mermaid, drawio, tables and KaTeX; edits stage as reviewable diffs and land only on commit, and it requires the QingAgent desktop app on the same machine.
description.zh: 青简写作桥：agent 通过 qing_ 前缀工具起草改稿，右侧宣纸面板排版呈现（mermaid、drawio、表格、公式）；每处修改先摆在纸上供审阅，提交才落稿。需本机运行开源的青简桌面客户端。

description.en: DSH meets Kimi WebBridge.
description.zh: DSH 结合 Kimi WebBridge。

description.en: DSH plugin bridging DeepSeek Harness agents to Cheat Engine: dynamic debugging, memory scanning, pointer analysis, breakpoints, and game memory hacking via ce_* tools.

Adds a Compact context button and a New session button to the context meter panel; compact submits /compact through the same command channel, and new session starts a fresh session in the same workspace.
description.zh: 在上下文计量面板中添加「压缩上下文」与「新建会话」两个按钮：压缩按钮通过与手敲 /compact 相同的通道提交命令，新建会话按钮在同一 workspace 中开启新会话。

description.en: Adds COS storage browsing and transfers, workspace artifact uploads, temporary links, and conversation attachments that retain local copies with cloud object identity, plus Agent tools for Tencent Cloud COS, CI, and MetaInsight.
description.zh: 提供 COS 云存储浏览与传输、工作区产物上传、临时链接，以及同时保留本地副本和云端对象身份的会话附件，并提供腾讯云 COS、数据万象和 MetaInsight 的 Agent 工具。

description.en: Runs 3 or 5 coding-agent candidates in detached Git worktrees, validates their patches with project commands, ranks only passing candidates, and requires separate approval before applying the winner.
description.zh: 在独立 Git worktree 中运行 3 或 5 个编码智能体候选，用项目命令验证补丁，只对通过者排序，并在应用获胜补丁前要求再次批准。

description.en: DSH 实时思维导图插件：Agent 与你共编同一棵树，改动即时互相同步，支持停靠分屏与全屏专注两种视图

Manages OpenCode Zen free-tier and Go-tier models in settings.yaml — fetches the live model listings from opencode.ai, reports configured-versus-live drift per route, and adds or removes entries through four agent tools and an OpenCode Models settings section.
description.zh: 在 settings.yaml 中管理 OpenCode Zen 免费档与 Go 档模型——实时拉取 opencode.ai 的最新模型列表，按路由对比已配置与线上差异，通过四个 agent 工具和设置页分区增删模型条目。

description.en: Per-model thinking-level settings page for custom DSH llm-pi-ai providers (official dsh client-plugin form)
description.zh: 为DSH Web新增思考级别设置页，可针对自定义llm-pi-ai提供商的每个模型单独调整推理强度。

description.en: Session-scoped Markdown writing pad docked beside the conversation, with edit/preview modes, selection-based AI rewrites, diff review, undo, and draft recovery.
description.zh: 停靠在对话旁的会话级 Markdown 写作板，支持编辑/预览、选区 AI 改写、Diff 审核、撤销与草稿恢复。

description.en: Volcengine Mobile Use Agent plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 直接操控手机和电脑界面，自动完成点击、输入等操作。

description.en: DSH 插件：为 OpenAI 兼容中转站按模型管理思考强度，并自动识别公开能力
Enhances the DSH web session view — one-click collapse of reasoning and tool chains, numbered history quick-jump, Markdown export, AI avatars.
description.zh: 增强 DSH Web 会话视图：一键折叠思考链与工具链、历史快速定位、Markdown 导出、AI 头像。

description.en: DSH tools for reproducing and validating the ml-quant-trading protocol v1 CPU benchmark, then drafting an issue-ready report. Requires a local clone of initial-d/ml-quant-trading (set as the workspace or repoPath) plus Python and PyTorch; this plugin does not fetch the repository or install its dependencies.
description.zh: 用于复现并校验 ml-quant-trading protocol v1 CPU 基准测试，并生成可提交 issue 报告的 DSH 工具。需要本地 clone initial-d/ml-quant-trading，并将其设为 workspace 或 repoPath，同时自行准备 Python 和 PyTorch；本插件不会获取仓库或安装依赖。

description.en: Device channel between the agent and your own phone: it sends files it just produced, and you @-reference what your phone sent back. End-to-end encrypted P2P through the SwarmDrop CLI, with no account and no public IP; node status, paired devices and QR pairing sit in a sidebar panel.
description.zh: 在 agent 和你自己的手机之间开一条设备通道：agent 把刚产出的文件发过去，手机传回来的东西可以在输入框里 @ 引用。底层经 SwarmDrop CLI 走端到端加密的 P2P，不需要账号，也不需要公网 IP；节点状态、已配对设备与扫码配对都在侧边栏面板里。

description.en: Workspace/chat context menu for the DSH home page: pin, rename, open in file explorer, archive, fork, copy, and open in a new window.
description.zh: DSH 主页工作区/会话增强菜单：置顶、重命名、资源管理器打开、归档、分叉、复制、新窗口打开。

description.en: reSanity 散修 — 散户的认知组合管理：查证、避坑、记忆、复盘。一份 SKILL.md，零依赖。
description.zh: reSanity 散修 — 散户的认知组合管理：查证、避坑、记忆、复盘。一份 SKILL.md，零依赖。

description.en: Vault button beside the DSH composer: save keys, servers, phone numbers, addresses and URLs, auto-collected from conversations, password-protected with WebDAV backup; click to insert, Ctrl+click to send.
description.zh: 输入栏旁的保险箱按钮：保存密钥、服务器、手机号、地址与网址，自动识别会话中的敏感信息提醒收录，密码保护并支持 WebDAV 备份；点击填入输入框，Ctrl+点击直接发送。

description.en: 用DSH 开发的轻量化插件:按 Ctrl+Shift+L 一键把页面伪装成静态 404 截图,暂时锁死鼠标键盘,防止别人乱动电脑
description.zh: 按 Ctrl+Shift+L 一键把页面伪装成静态 404 截图，锁死鼠标键盘，防止别人乱动电脑，再按一次恢复。

description.en: Requires DSH 0.1.5-alpha.1. Annotate selected text in finished assistant messages, then submit multiple drafts with official composer text, images, and files as one Session user message; the model answers each annotation in order with hoverable reply chips.
description.zh: 需要 DSH 0.1.5-alpha.1。在已完成的助手消息中选中原文并添加多条注解，再与官方输入框文字、图片和文件合并为一条会话用户消息；模型按顺序逐条回答，并用可悬浮的回复芯片关联原文。

description.en: Give agents access to files on the machine where the browser runs: user authorizes a local directory via File System Access, tool calls relay over the plugin's own WebSocket; read-only compat mode for mobile/insecure contexts.

description.zh: 让你选择 DeepSeek Harness 设置页左侧导航要显示哪些栏目。

description.en: A settings-panel skin manager that auto-discovers installed Web UI skins, switches between them in one click, and maintains the profile patch automatically.
description.zh: 设置面板皮肤管理器：自动扫描已安装的 Web UI 皮肤并一键切换，profile 补丁自动维护。

description.en: Adds a subagent_codex tool that delegates tasks to the local OpenAI Codex CLI, running the work in an isolated external process.
description.zh: 新增 subagent_codex 工具，把任务委派给本机 OpenAI Codex CLI 在独立外部进程中执行，与主对话完全隔离。

description.en: Merged plugin: wallpaper customization (original-resolution uploads, crop editor, per-area opacity, MP4/WebM dynamic wallpapers) + Steam Workshop wallpaper extraction (parses scene.pkg/.tex via a bundled Python script, preview/download) + DeepSeek balance & usage widget + OpenCode Go plan usage (rolling/weekly/monthly percents in a top header pill; expand for progress bars & reset countdowns). API keys are read from DSH's credential store by the host — never stored in source or the browser.
description.zh: 合并插件：壁纸定制（原图不压缩、裁剪编辑器、左/中/右分区不透明度、MP4/WebM 动态壁纸）＋ Steam 创意工坊壁纸提取（内置 scripts/extract_scene_pkg.py 解析 scene.pkg/.tex，支持预览/下载）＋ DeepSeek 余额与用量小组件 ＋ OpenCode Go 套餐用量（会话顶部药丸按钮显示滚动/周/月用量百分比，点开展开进度条与重置倒计时）。各 API key 均由 host 从 DSH 凭据库读取，不入源码/浏览器。

description.en: Global frosted-glass (backdrop blur) theme plugin for the dsh web UI with animated light/dark switching and a scheduled theme timer
description.zh: Global frosted-glass (backdrop blur) theme plugin for the dsh web UI with animated light/dark switching and a scheduled theme timer

description.en: Whale-girl wallpaper background with a frosted semi-transparent app surface; customize image, opacity, and contain/cover from the Web settings, with remote image preflight and no-referrer loading.
description.zh: Web UI 鲸鱼娘壁纸背景，应用表面半透明磨砂；支持在设置页自定义图片、透明度与 contain/cover 铺放方式，远程图片自动预检并 no-referrer 加载。

description.en: Kabutack 是一个面向 DSH 的插件，用于在一个界面里统一管理插件、Skill 和 MCP，并支持按“角色”一键动态装载、切换与恢复能力组合。
description.zh: 把 DSH 插件、Skill 和 MCP 按角色打包，在 Web UI 里一键切换不同工作台。

description.en: 牛来A股桌宠 (Electron + DSH bundle)

One-click OAuth (PKCE) connect to Qichacha (qcc.com) legal-data MCP services — regulation search and case search — with dynamic client registration, token auto-refresh, and dynamic mcp-client configuration.
description.zh: 一键 OAuth（PKCE）授权接入企查查法律产品——法律数据 MCP 服务（法规检索、案例检索）：动态注册客户端、token 自动刷新、动态配置 mcp-client 条目，一次授权覆盖法规与案例服务。

description.en: 越写越像你：学会同事/领导/偶像的写作风格，AI 替你写但像你写的。DeepSeek Harness 写作插件：41 个 MCP 工具 + 项目自动提炼 + 去 AI 味 + 文件预览
Imports chat.deepseek.com web conversations into DeepSeek Harness as resumable sessions, from a settings-page UI.
description.zh: 从设置页把 chat.deepseek.com 网页端对话导入为 DeepSeek Harness 会话，导入后可在其中继续对话。

description.en: Engineering workflow agent preset for dsh: five gated phases (requirements clarification, plan approval, TDD, parallel subagents, verified finishing) with six workflow skills adapted from obra/superpowers.
description.zh: 工程化工作流 agent preset：五阶段硬门禁（需求澄清、计划审批、TDD、子 Agent 并行、验证收尾），附 6 个改编自 obra/superpowers 的工作流技能。

description.en: A Git GUI plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web UI
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面里直接操作 Git，可视化查看提交、分支和变更，不用敲命令。

description.en: Matter-aware legal workspace dashboard and document agent tools for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: Matter-aware legal workspace dashboard and document agent tools for DeepSeek Harness

description.en: DSH 用户插件管理器:在 设置→插件 统一管理插件目录散件、运行树插件与 npm 插件包——挂载/卸载/启用/停用(cordis.patch.yml 补丁层 + HMR 热生效)
description.zh: 在设置→插件里统一管理所有插件，支持挂载、卸载、启用和停用，还能热生效，不用重启。

description.en: Adds a prompt-enhancement button to the DSH composer that rewrites drafts into agent-ready prompts.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框添加提示词增强按钮，将草稿改写为可直接交给 Agent 执行的提示词。

description.en: 省钱+余额监控悬浮窗（DSH Web UI 插件）：DeepSeek / OpenCode Go 双标签余额、限额监控（金额/tok/小时）、语音提醒、超限断点截断
DSH Web UI 声音提示插件：需要授权/提问与任务完成时播放提示音 (Web Audio, no assets)
Local-first A-share portfolio and watchlist monitor for DSH: sidebar quotes, holdings P&L, browser add/edit/delete, and JSON persistence.
description.zh: DSH 本地优先的 A 股持仓与自选监控：侧栏行情、持仓盈亏，以及网页添加、修改、删除和 JSON 保存。

description.en: 本地 OCR 插件：让纯文本生成 LLM 也能读懂图片 | Local OCR plugin: give text-only generative LLMs the ability to read images
description.zh: 本地 OCR 插件：让纯文本生成 LLM 也能读懂图片 | Local OCR plugin: give text-only generative LLMs the ability to read images

description.en: Shows DeepSeek balance and estimated daily spend, merges external vision-call JSONL records, and adds a per-session dashboard with model statistics, TTFT, cache rate, call logs, cost estimates, filters, and CSV export.
description.zh: 显示 DeepSeek 余额与今日花费估算，合并外部视觉调用 JSONL 记录，并提供含模型统计、TTFT、缓存率、调用日志、费用估算、筛选与 CSV 导出的会话看板。

description.en: DSH 用户插件管理器:在 设置→插件 统一管理插件目录散件、运行树插件与 npm 插件包——挂载/卸载/启用/停用(cordis.patch.yml 补丁层 + HMR 热生效)
Playable world-model toolkit for DeepSeek Harness: look at frames, name the 3D / pixel / latent route, measure a run, and RSI the research loop.
description.zh: 世界模型研究工具箱，可查看帧、标记3D/像素/潜空间路径，对比预测与真值，并评估RSI技能和wm.yaml配置。

description.en: Literary DSH plugin: one session is one book. Cover-card /new opens one of 19 realms, a prose-only 诸天万界DSH preset keeps the model writing fiction, keyword worldbook entries ground each turn, and /export-story typesets the session into a Markdown novel.
description.zh: 诸天万界DSH：一个会话就是一本书。封面开书，十九界任选，文学预设只写正文，规则书按关键词注入，/export-story 把整场会话誊成 Markdown 小说。

description.en: browser-use style browser automation plugin for DeepSeek Harness: drives a dedicated Chrome instance (persistent profile) via playwright-core — fine-grained tools, autonomous tasks, scheduling, dangerous-action confirmation, captcha hand-off
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek 直接操控 Chrome 浏览器，自动完成网页操作、数据抓取和定时任务，像真人一样上网办事。

description.en: 深法：DeepSeek Harness 本地法律工作台插件，提供法律模式原生对话、案件看板、日程期限、可调分栏与多套法律主题
可以看见ai的执行步骤，将ai的步骤抽出来为对应动画，增加编码时等待的娱乐性。
description.zh: 把AI执行步骤变成可视化动画，在3D办公区里看智能体干活，等代码时不再无聊。

description.en: Writes live provider model lists into DSH settings and shows 5h/7d plan windows or metered balance for the current session model.
description.zh: 把各提供方线上模型列表写进 DSH 设置，输入框圆环显示当前会话模型的 5 小时/7 天窗口或按量剩余余额。

description.en: 添加deepseek harness生图识图能力插件
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加图像识别与生成能力，让模型能看懂图片并产出新图像。

description.en: DeepEye vision plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): image description, OCR, VQA, UI layout, and clipboard analysis.
description.zh: dsh-plugin-deepeye — DSH 插件（模型）

description.en: MuApi media-generation tool: a muapi_generate tool that submits and polls jobs against any of MuApi's 100+ image, video, audio, and 3D models through one x-api-key.
description.zh: MuApi 媒体生成工具：muapi_generate 工具通过一个 x-api-key 提交并轮询 MuApi 100 多个图片、视频、音频与 3D 模型的生成任务。

description.en: DSH recap plugin: distills every model request (turn:step) into one sentence, rendered inline in the conversation flow
Session row menu extras for DeepSeek Harness: pin sessions, copy session id, export structured Markdown, and permanently delete sessions.
description.zh: 会话行菜单增强：置顶会话、复制会话 ID、导出结构化 Markdown、弹窗确认后永久删除会话。

description.en: A Cordis plugin for DeepSeek Harness that suspends the entire conversation state and resumes it after restart.
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Tavily web search for DSH with a settings toggle, keyless by default, and a connection test.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Tavily 网页搜索：设置开关、默认无 Key，以及连通测试。

description.en: A simple popup that can quickly show when Deepseek has finished thinking or is requesting permission during split-screen.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness desktop popup plugin: shows AI thinking status in a bottom-right always-on-top card, alerts on permission requests and completion, with a DeepSeek-style UI

description.en: Real-time token billing for DSH web: official DeepSeek CNY pricing with automatic peak/off-peak switching, hourly price sync from the official site, visual custom model prices, and multi-currency fallback.
description.zh: DSH Web 实时 token 计费插件：官网人民币价直接计费、高峰/错峰自动切换、价格实时跟随官网、可视化自定义模型价格、多币种兜底。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 用户记忆插件
description.zh: 让 agent 跨会话记住你的语言习惯、沟通风格和项目背景，不用每次重新自我介绍。

description.en: 火山方舟 Coding Plan / Agent Plan 额度实时查看的 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件：AK/SK 直连官方 API，悬浮小球 + Donut 环形图展示各窗口已用/剩余/重置倒计时（两位小数）
description.zh: 火山方舟 Coding Plan / Agent Plan 额度实时查看 DSH 插件：AK/SK 直连 open.volcengineapi.com（GetCodingPlanUsage / GetAgentPlanAFPUsage），悬浮小球 + 可拖拽悬浮窗展示各窗口已用/剩余/重置倒计时（两位小数），AK/SK 在「设置 → 插件」页配置。

description.en: WeChat automation for DSH: push task progress to WeChat, listen for messages with keyword auto-reply, and a WeChat ↔ DSH two-way bridge controllable from the settings page, built on wxauto4.
description.zh: 基于 wxauto4 的微信自动化插件：任务进度微信推送、消息监听（关键词自动回复）、微信⇄DSH 双向桥，设置页开关与配置。

description.en: Better Deepseek Harness, with some functional extensions to webui and Deepseek Harness·更好的deepseek harness，对webui和deepseek harness进行了一些功能扩展
description.zh: Better Deepseek Harness, with some functional extensions to webui and Deepseek Harness·更好的deepseek harness，对webui和deepseek harness进行了一些功能扩展

description.en: Achievement system for the DSH Web UI: gallery with category/rarity sorting, unlock toasts, sidebar trophy, composer dock, crossover achievements, and local persistence.
description.zh: DSH Web 成就系统：画廊支持按分类/难度双排序、解锁 toast、侧栏奖杯、输入坞进度读条、联动成就，并本地持久化进度。

description.en: 添加headers到dsh的ChatCompletions请求中，可用于接入OpenCode的免费v4-flash、hy3等模型

Free voice closed loop for the Web UI: browser SpeechRecognition mic input with live interim results plus read-aloud speaker buttons and auto-read for assistant replies, zero configuration and no API key.
description.zh: Web UI 免费语音闭环：浏览器语音识别输入（实时中间结果上屏）+ 助手回复朗读与自动朗读，零配置、免 API key。

description.en: Conversation indicator plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a compact rail beside the scrollbar marks each user message; hover for the summary, click to jump. / DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 对话指示器插件：滚动条旁紧凑面板标记每条用户消息，悬停看摘要，点击跳转。
description.zh: 在长对话中快速定位和跳转到每条用户消息，不用再费力滚动查找。

description.en: FileScope · 文件视界 — DeepSeek Harness 工作区文件浏览器插件（右侧抽屉 + 实时预览）
description.zh: FileScope · 文件视界: workspace file-explorer drawer with live file preview for DeepSeek Harness

description.en: Reproducible DeepSeek Harness plugin development environment
description.zh: A reproducible, runtime-aware DeepSeek Harness plugin development profile

description.en: Upload an image as a full-window frosted-glass theme: sidebar/conversation/details share one frost layer, Save/Delete, official Light/Dark/System stay in charge.
description.zh: 上传图片作为整窗磨砂玻璃主题：侧栏/会话/详情同一层磨砂，保存/删除，官方浅色/深色/跟随系统仍有效。

description.en: 滑动变祖器
dsh-macos-desktop 把 DSH 的 Web 界面变成一个 macOS 桌面：左侧桌面（多窗口/文件/回收站/便签/Spotlight/天气/深色模式）+ 右侧原生对话（主题化），内置终端、文档(Word/PDF/PPT)、浏览器、知识库、番茄钟、截图、AI 生图与「用 AI 看图」，通过官方 shell.overlay 挂载、卸载即恢复
Zero-dependency MCP client bridge that connects stdio and HTTP MCP servers and registers their tools as mcp_<server>_<tool> for the agent.
description.zh: 零依赖 MCP 客户端桥接，连接 stdio 与 HTTP MCP server，把其工具注册为 mcp_<server>_<tool> 供 agent 调用。

description.en: Microphone voice input for the composer: browser Web Speech API live transcription, dedupe/auto-continue, smart punctuation, language and auto-send settings.
description.zh: 输入框麦克风语音输入：浏览器 Web Speech API 实时转写，自动去重/续听、智能标点，支持语言与自动发送设置。

description.en: Neo-brutalism skin with two switchable schemes (Blue Command / Aged Newspaper), hard shadows, sharp corners, and light/dark theme support.
description.zh: 新粗野主义换肤皮肤：双方案（蓝统治 / 做旧报纸）随时切换，硬阴影 + 直角 + 2px 边框结构层，浅色/深色自适应。

description.en: Agent config packer for DeepSeek Harness: pack local agent assets (skills/sessions/profiles/settings/memory) into a zip for migration or sharing, with privacy scanning, diff-based restore, pack management, and a settings panel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 Agent 配置打包器：把本地 Agent 资产（Skills/会话/Profile/全局设置/记忆）打包成 zip，用于迁移或分享；带隐私安全扫描、恢复差异对比、包管理与设置面板。

description.en: MCP 服务器管理面板：GUI 增删改 MCP 服务器配置（写入 cordis.patch.yml + HMR 实时挂载）+ 工具浏览 + agent 面 mcp_* 管理工具 | MCP server management panel: GUI add/edit/delete MCP server configs (writes cordis.patch.yml + HMR hot-mount) + tool browsing + agent-side mcp_* management tools
description.zh: 可视化面板管理 MCP 服务器，增删改配置实时生效，还能浏览工具和远程操控，省心又高效。

description.en: Advertise image paste on text-only DeepSeek routes, describe attachments with a vision sidecar, and leave native vision models untouched.
description.zh: 在纯文本 DeepSeek 线路上开放贴图准入，用视觉 sidecar 把附件转成文字，原生视觉模型不改写。

description.en: DSH Web right-side output dock: session-scoped tabs for reports, images, data, video, and audio, with inline previews, output quality checks, and a searchable per-turn history.
description.zh: DSH Web 原生右侧产物栏：按会话管理报告、图片、数据、视频与音频，提供内联预览、产物质检和可按轮次检索的历史目录。

description.en: DSH sandbox tester: process-isolated testing ground for DeepSeek Harness

Google Antigravity CLI (agy) as a DSH product subagent: delegate tasks to a Gemini coding agent with your Antigravity login (no API key), with conversation follow-ups, background streaming progress, image analysis by path, and a pop-up login window.
description.zh: 把 Google Antigravity CLI（agy）接入 DSH 作为产品子代理：用 Antigravity 登录态（无需 API key）委托 Gemini 编程智能体干活，支持对话续聊、后台流式进度、按路径识图与自动弹出登录窗口。

description.en: Questionnaire-style batch questioning plugin for DeepSeek Harness: 10+ questions at once (single/multi/yes-no toggle/compare/open), per-question skip, fullscreen overlay, two-column recap after submit
description.zh: Questionnaire-style survey plugin for DeepSeek Harness: the do_a_survey tool asks 1-10+ questions at once (single/multi/yes-no/compare/open types) in four presentation modes (compact/inline/overlay/grid), with per-question skip, full Markdown & color rendering, and a two-column recap after submit. Bundle form resident in the Web profile; companion skill ship

description.en: DSH 插件：极简提问时间线——每条提问一个圆点，点击跳转，悬停预览。Minimal question timeline for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DSH 插件：极简提问时间线——每条提问一个圆点，点击跳转，悬停预览。Minimal question timeline for DeepSeek Harness.

description.en: Structured safe Git tools for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): git_status/diff/log/branch/stage/commit/stash/show + destructive-command guard
description.zh: 结构化封装 Git 常用操作，带危险命令保护，让 AI 安全地帮你管理代码版本。

description.en: Multi-session agent status monitor for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness的每个会话提供桌面悬浮红绿灯，一眼看清Agent运行状态，告别频繁切窗。

description.en: Agent trajectory governance and anomaly diagnosis: rebuilds flat session logs into multi-branch trajectory trees, detects loop deadlock, invalid retry, and goal drift, alerts with cost attribution, one-click interrupt and breakpoint fork via official APIs, independent GUI tab.
description.zh: Agent 轨迹治理与异常诊断：把平铺会话日志重建为多分支轨迹树，识别循环死锁/无效重试/目标漂移，带成本归因的告警与一键中断/断点分支（官方 API），独立 GUI Tab。

description.en: Combine text, vision, and image-generation APIs into one Mix model with automatic routing: text-only requests go to the chat model, user images and agent screenshots go to the vision model, follow-ups keep using the same session image, and agents can generate or edit images with session-scoped call history.
description.zh: 把文本、识图和生图 API 组合成一个 Mix 模型并按对话内容自动路由：纯文本走聊天模型，用户图片和 Agent 截图走识图模型，后续可继续追问同一张图；还支持图片生成与编辑及会话级调用记录。

description.en: Image understanding for text-only models via OpenRouter free vision models
description.zh: Image understanding for text-only models via OpenRouter free vision models

description.en: Remote access for the DSH Web GUI: LAN QR access, cloudflared quick tunnels, and frp reverse proxying via your own server, with a built-in auth portal.
description.zh: Web GUI 远程访问：局域网二维码直连、cloudflared 快速隧道、frp 自有服务器反代，内置登录门户，并放行设置接口。

description.en: DSH ↔ agentmemory session-memory bridge: mirrors session lifecycle into a local agentmemory daemon (REST), exposes memory_recall / memory_remember tools, and injects a per-session memory context window via agent/pre-step.
description.zh: DSH ↔ agentmemory 会话记忆桥：把会话生命周期镜像到本地 agentmemory 守护进程（REST），提供 memory_recall / memory_remember 工具，并通过 agent/pre-step 按会话注入记忆上下文窗口。

description.en: Shows DeepSeek API account balance and Volcengine Ark Coding/Agent Plan quota windows (5h/weekly/monthly with reset countdowns) in the settings panel, composer dock, and a draggable floating refresh button.

description.en: A personal DSH browser plugin: persistent profile, visible window, human-in-the-loop login, and safe agent browser tools.
description.zh: A personal DSH browser plugin: persistent profile, visible window, human-in-the-loop login, and safe agent browser tools.

description.en: Renders the built-in cache-hit percentage with three decimals and widens the composer stats line to prevent truncation.
description.zh: 把内置缓存命中率原位显示为 3 位小数，并加宽底部统计行避免内容被截断。

description.en: GPT plans dependency DAGs, DeepSeek workers execute tasks with adaptive parallelism, and an optional GPT reviewer audits incremental Git diffs and drives repair rounds.

description.zh: 在对话输入框旁常驻常用词/短语面板，支持全局与当前项目分组，一键插入，提升输入效率。

description.en: Steam Workshop-style plugin store for the DSH Web UI: browse, search, and one-click install community plugins with mirror acceleration, progress UI, security checks, and Chinese descriptions.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的 Steam 创意工坊式插件商店：浏览、搜索并一键安装社区插件，支持镜像加速、进度 UI、安全检测与中文描述。

description.en: 一个把文件工作区直接带进 DeepSeek Harness WebUI，并为手机和第三方客户端提供稳定的远程接口插件。A bilingual file workspace and secure remote API for DeepSeek Harness WebUI and mobile clients.
VS Code 风格双栏资源管理器。左侧多工作区文件树：语言着色 SVG 图标、行内重命名、新建文件/文件夹；右侧编辑器可拖拽缩放，行号 + 状态栏，语法高亮（函数/关键字/注释/字符串分色，支持 10 种语言）
description.zh: VS Code 风格双栏资源管理器。左侧多工作区文件树：语言着色 SVG 图标、行内重命名、新建文件/文件夹；右侧编辑器可拖拽缩放，行号 + 状态栏，语法高亮（函数/关键字/注释/字符串分色，支持 10 种语言）

description.en: YouMind OpenAPI tools and skill bundle for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: YouMind OpenAPI 工具 + 技能包：把 YouMind 的开放接口接进 DSH。

description.en: 语织：中文优先、用户可控的 AI 写作风格记忆层，让 AI 学会你的表达，需要时再调用。Chinese-first style memory for AI; DeepSeek Harness adapter included.
description.zh: 语织：中文优先、用户可控的 AI 写作风格记忆层，让 AI 学会你的表达，需要时再调用。Chinese-first style memory for AI; DeepSeek Harness adapter included.

description.en: Multi-agent orchestration for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: DSH 多 agent 编排。

description.en: Appends local hash-chained JSONL receipts for tool results and session events without storing prompts, tool arguments, result text, or raw session IDs.
description.zh: 把工具结果与会话事件的 receipt 写入本地哈希链 JSONL，不保存提示词、工具参数、结果正文或原始会话 ID。

description.en: session 关系型数据库持久化
Coding Coach: 35-skill bundle plus a full agent preset for non-developers (8-stage idea-to-launch pipeline; engineering/product/UI skills).
description.zh: 不懂代码也能从想法做到上线，35 项技能加教练式引导，全程帮你把产品落地。

description.en: Guardian-style auto approval for DeepSeek Harness, aligned with Codex's Approve for me: a judge model reads the session transcript, verifies local state with read-only tools, and scores risk x authorization against a declarative policy before granting (out-of-tree plugin)
description.zh: Guardian-style auto approval for DeepSeek Harness, aligned with Codex's Approve for me: a judge model reads the session transcript, verifies local state with read-only tools, and scores risk x authorization against a declarative policy before granting (out-of-tree plugin)

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 黑鲸实验室主题：官网黑鲸 × 夕小瑶 IP，真实 profile 可安装的 Web UI 插件
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 黑鲸实验室主题：官网黑鲸 × 夕小瑶 IP，真实 profile 可安装的 Web UI 插件

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 插件：/cost 查看每个会话花费 + 可拖拽的悬浮费用胶囊
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 插件：/cost 查看每个会话花费 + 可拖拽的悬浮费用胶囊

description.en: Animated deepseek girl desktop pet plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加个会动会看你的桌宠娘，右下角陪你聊天写代码。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that allows you to change the reasoning effort of custom models in WebUI.
description.zh: dsh-effort-tweak — DSH 插件（模型）

description.en: 一个可以让ai自动调用VLM(多模态模型)进行视觉分析的dsh插件。A dsh plugin that allows AI to automatically invoke VLMs (multimodal models) for visual analysis.
description.zh: 让 AI 自动调用 VLM 做视觉分析的 dsh 插件。
为 DeepSeek Harness 提供社区插件目录和配置生成管理，方便你发现、安装和复用各类扩展。

description.en: Safe OpenAPI 3.x discovery and API calling tools for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: Safe OpenAPI 3.x discovery and API calling tools for DeepSeek Harness

description.en: HTML↔Markdown conversion, GFM table normalization, and TOC generation.
description.zh: HTML↔Markdown 转换、GFM 表格规范化、目录生成。

description.en: A small, session-aware terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness
Voice notes in, spoken answers out: dictate audio that becomes user messages (transcribe), have the agent read replies aloud (speak), local-first under ~/.dsh/voice.
description.zh: 语音输入、语音输出：把口述音频转写为用户消息（transcribe），让 agent 朗读回复（speak），本地优先，音频存于 ~/.dsh/voice。

description.en: Video Frame Interpolation for Windows
Support for the microsandbox backend.
description.zh: microsandbox 沙箱支持。

description.en: WeCom AI Bot text and image bridge for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 企业微信机器人桥接：文本+图片双通道，企业微信直接当 DSH 聊天入口。

description.en: 为 DSH Web UI 增加跨平台文件拖拽与原始路径插入能力，无需复制文件
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 增加跨平台文件拖拽与原始路径插入能力，无需复制文件

description.en: 在 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 底部状态栏实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额。
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 底部状态栏实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额。

description.en: Zero-config Tailscale sync for DeepSeek Harness (dsh-plugin). 零配置：在手机上继续电脑端 DeepSeek Harness 的工作。
description.zh: Zero-config Tailscale sync for DeepSeek Harness (dsh-plugin). 零配置：在手机上继续电脑端 DeepSeek Harness 的工作。

description.en: Free keyless Tavily web search tool for DeepSeek Harness (dsh)
description.zh: dsh-tavily-search — DSH 插件（工具）

description.en: 通过 Telegram 私聊远程使用和查看 DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 通过 Telegram 私聊远程使用和查看 DeepSeek Harness

description.en: Floating NetEase Cloud Music player for DSH Web: draggable collapsible window with mini mode, playlist discovery with search and hot lists, synced lyrics with translations, persistent playback queue, QR-code or Cookie login, colors following the DSH skin theme.
description.zh: 网易云音乐浮窗播放器：可拖拽/折叠浮窗与迷你条，歌单发现（搜索/热门歌单），逐行同步歌词与翻译，播放队列持久化，扫码或 Cookie 登录，颜色跟随 DSH 皮肤主题。

description.en: Native-feel DSH attachments: official PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF thumbs plus 64px cards for other files via drag, paste, or paperclip; non-images land in .dsh-uploads and sent cards sit on the user bubble.
description.zh: 接近原生的 DSH 附件：PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF 走官方缩略图，其它文件经拖入、粘贴或回形针变成 64px 卡片；非图片落到 .dsh-uploads，发送后贴在用户气泡旁。

description.en: Keyboard-oriented iKanban web application bundle for DeepSeek Harness
Auto-saves large pasted text as an attachment file in the DeepSeek Harness web input box; with dsh-better-sidebar installed, the paste pill opens the file in the sidebar editor and saves it back.
description.zh: 在输入框粘贴大段文本时自动保存为附件文件；装了 dsh-better-sidebar 时，药丸上的「查看」可在侧栏编辑器打开并保存回原文件。

description.en: Usage statistics dashboard for the DSH Web UI: info cards, a 280-day GitHub-style activity heatmap, daily token trend, and model-usage donut chart.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 用量统计面板：信息卡、280 天活跃热力图、按天 Token 趋势与模型用量双环饼图。

description.en: Windows-only computer use for DeepSeek Harness: captures the virtual screen and drives mouse & keyboard through 9 tools built on PowerShell and Win32 SendInput; pairs with picturereader so text-only models can complete the screenshot-analyze-act-verify loop fully locally.
description.zh: 仅 Windows 的 DSH 电脑操作插件：以 PowerShell + Win32 SendInput 实现 9 个工具，截取虚拟屏幕并驱动鼠标键盘；配合 picturereader 让纯文本模型在本地完成「截图-分析-操作-验证」闭环。

description.en: DSH 多对话思维导图与静态知识图谱
Multi-backend web_search provider (Exa + Firecrawl) for the built-in web_search tool, with automatic failover, per-backend 429 cooldowns, and key-free anonymous access.
description.zh: 面向内置 web_search 工具的多后端搜索提供方（Exa + Firecrawl）：自动故障切换、按后端 429 冷却、无密钥匿名可用。

description.en: Self-update plugin for DeepSeek Harness: DSH core upgrades via detached swap script; plugin self-update installs in-place without killing the host and prompts for restart. DSH 主程序与已装插件的一站式在线更新插件。
Academic writing toolkit for DSH agents: paper outlines, title and abstract skeletons, GB/T 7714 / APA / MLA citations, phrasing QA, and a pre-submission checklist.
description.zh: 为 DSH agent 提供学术写作工具包：论文大纲、标题与摘要骨架、GB/T 7714 / APA / MLA 引文格式化、措辞质检与投稿前清单。

description.en: Autonomous permission classifier for the auto preset: tool-scoped allow/deny rules, an LLM semantic judge, and git checkpointing for unattended sessions.
description.zh: auto（自主模式）权限分类器：工具作用域的放行/拒绝规则、LLM 语义裁判与 git 快照，面向无人值守会话。

description.en: A self-evolving plugin for DeepSeek Harness: it observes how the agent runs, proposes improvements to its own assets via the LLM, validates each proposal inside a sandboxed trial agent, and applies only verified mutations — with a versioned ledger and automatic rollback on regression.
description.zh: 一个自我进化的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：观察代理的运行方式，通过 LLM 对其自身资产提出改进方案，在沙箱试运行代理中验证每个方案，只应用通过验证的变更——带版本化账本，出现性能回退时自动回滚。

description.en: Local tool-call failsafe for DSH: blocks a fixed list of high-risk shell patterns and credential-file reads before execution, with a per-session hash-linked JSONL audit log, and an optional external Gateway for centralized policy.
description.zh: DSH 本機工具調用防護外掛：攔截高風險 Shell 指令模式與敏感憑證讀取，具備持久化哈希鏈 JSONL 審計記錄，可選配外部 Gateway 集中治理。

description.en: Renders edit and write tool calls as always-expanded side-by-side diffs styled like git diff, with optional syntax coloring and word-level highlighting.
description.zh: 将编辑与写入工具调用渲染为常开的双栏 diff，样式类似 git diff，可选语法配色与词级高亮。

description.en: Conversation node appearance for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: configurable per-category and per-tool colors (left accent bar + tinted background), plus a show-thinking toggle; pure frontend rendering, takes effect instantly and persists to the DSH user settings file.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 会话节点外观插件：按节点类别/工具名可配置着色（左侧色条 + 淡色底），附带"显示思考过程"开关；纯前端渲染增强，改动即时生效并持久化到 DSH 用户设置文件。

description.en: Share the current session over the LAN as a read-only, token-guarded HTML snapshot with session stats and Markdown rendering.
description.zh: 将当前会话以只读、token 保护的 HTML 快照分享到局域网，附带会话统计与 Markdown 渲染。

description.en: Vision toolkit for text-only DeepSeek: model-invokable `vision` tool, wrapper adapters for deepseek/opencode-go (v4 flash/pro), Antigravity IDE quota (default, flash/pro) / any OpenAI-compatible VLM / Gemini / local Ollama channels, evidence memory with compaction rehydration, content-hash cache, and a bilingual client panel.
description.zh: 纯文本 DeepSeek 的识图工具包：模型可主动调用的 `vision` 工具、deepseek/opencode-go 包装适配器（v4 flash/pro）、反重力额度（默认，flash/pro）/ 任意 OpenAI 兼容 VLM / Gemini / 本地 Ollama 通道、证据记忆与会话压缩恢复、内容哈希缓存、双语客户端面板。

description.en: PDF parsing tools for DSH: pdf_info, pdf_extract_text, and pdf_render_page with dual pdfjs and built-in rendering engines, including system-font rendering for PDFs with non-embedded CJK fonts.
description.zh: DSH 的 PDF 解析工具：pdf_info、pdf_extract_text、pdf_render_page 三件套，pdfjs 与自研渲染器双引擎，未内嵌 CJK 字体的 PDF 也能用系统字体渲染出图。

description.en: 跨工具（Cursor / WorkBuddy / Claude Code 等）的 SKILL.md 技能管理器与 Rules 规则管理器（含远程规则导入），TypeScript 零运行时依赖实现

Fan-made wallpaper plugin themed on the streamer Zhang Shunfei: full-screen high-definition rotating colorful pegasus GIF wallpaper with theme blending and prominence control, plus a Bilibili music player (add songs by pasting a link, delete, volume, seek, single/list/shuffle loop, and a sidebar mini player).
description.zh: 以网络主播张顺飞为主题的粉丝同人二创壁纸插件：彩色飞马高清旋转动图全屏壁纸，支持主题融合与突出度调节；附带 B站音乐播放器，可粘贴链接添加歌曲、删除、调音量、拖进度条、切换单曲/列表/随机循环，并有侧栏迷你播放器。

description.en: Automatic Flash/Pro routing for DeepSeek Harness subagent calls: light tasks run on a cheap model (e.g. V4 Flash), heavy tasks stay on the strong model — with per-call overrides and /delegate session modes.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的子代理调用做 Flash/Pro 自动分派：轻任务自动用便宜模型、重任务留在强模型，支持手动覆盖与 /delegate 会话模式。

description.en: Interactive canvas for visualizing Agent, Subagent, Workflow, Phase, and tool relationships in DSH Web.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供可交互画布，用于展示 Agent、Subagent、Workflow、Phase 与工具调用之间的关系。

description.en: Sync cc-switch provider balances and track token usage & cost by day/month/total with relay-aware currency settings.
description.zh: 同步 cc-switch 各 provider 余额，按日/月/总量统计 token 用量与花费，支持中转站币种与汇率设置。

description.en: China A-share stock research: ticker search, announcements over any date range, financial report cards, valuation profiles and signal-factor explanations (~5,000 stocks since 2011, public read-only data service), plus a link-out tool to an external trading-sandbox product.
description.zh: A股个股研究：搜股票、查任意区间公告、财报卡、估值画像与交易信号科普（约 5000 只、2011 年至今，公共只读数据服务），另有一个跳转外部交易推演产品的链接工具。

description.en: Adds a take screenshot tool plus two optional automatic capture points, putting the screen into the conversation as an image block; requires an image-capable model.
description.zh: 一个截图工具，外加两个默认关闭的自动截图时机。需要模型支持图片输入。

description.en: Expert manager: manage ntd-format experts and expert teams (plugin.json + Agent MD + skill sets), browse and install from a built-in market of 50+ experts, and run tasks in an expert persona via /expert-<name> without consuming model directory tokens.
description.zh: 专家管理：管理 ntd 格式的专家与专家团队（plugin.json + Agent MD + 技能集），内置 50+ 专家市场，`/expert-名称` 以专家身份执行任务，不占模型目录 token。

description.en: Auto-resumes interrupted DSH turns: sends a queued 「继续」 after turn/end with error, interrupted or max-tokens reasons, with a grace period, cooldown, exponential backoff, a consecutive-attempts cap, boot-time scanning, a settings card and a per-session stop/restore button in the composer toolbar; it never switches models or providers.
description.zh: 回合中断自动续跑：turn/end 因 error / interrupted / max-tokens 结束时自动发送「继续」，支持宽限期、冷却、指数退避、连续次数上限、启动扫描、设置卡片，以及输入框工具行的会话级停止/恢复按钮；不切换模型/provider。

description.en: Wraps work in named tasks and, once a task closes, folds its whole span of messages into one summary at the next step boundary; the original content can be restored on demand.
description.zh: 用命名任务包住工作过程；任务结束后，在下一个步骤边界把整段消息折叠成一段摘要，原文可随时还原。

description.en: Turns the latest completed DSH session turn into a shareable vertical recap video: editable five-scene storyboard, host-side privacy redaction, optional AI polish and TTS narration, MP4/WebM export with PNG cover.
description.zh: 把最近一次已完成的 DSH 任务生成为可分享的竖屏战报视频：五幕可编辑故事板、Host 侧脱敏、可选 AI 润色与配音，导出 MP4/WebM 和 PNG 封面。

description.en: Media and vision workspace for DeepSeek Harness: image, video and speech generation, image Q&A and element locating, long-image OCR, pixel diff, HTML-screenshot verification and video summarization, with DashScope and OpenAI-compatible providers, model pools and a workbench client.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的媒体与视觉工作台：文生图、图/文生视频、语音合成与转写、图像问答与元素定位、长图 OCR、像素比对、HTML 截图验证、视频摘要；支持 DashScope 与 OpenAI 兼容供应商，含模型池与工作台客户端。

description.en: Manage, discover, install, update, and uninstall DSH skills as plugins.
description.zh: 类 Codex 插件市场的 DSH 技能管理器。

description.en: Long-lived AI companions with WeChat, Matrix and Mattermost channels for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 提供隔离记忆、微信渠道、Skill、定时任务、伙伴挂念与依赖任务看板的长期 AI 伙伴。

description.en: Makes plain Enter insert a newline in the composer and Ctrl/Cmd+Enter submit, toggleable in settings.
description.zh: 让对话框中普通 Enter 换行、Ctrl/Cmd+Enter 提交，可在设置中开关。

description.en: Connects ChatGPT accounts through OAuth, switches among them manually or automatically, and adds Codex models with usage limits to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 连接 ChatGPT 账号，支持手动或自动切换，并为 DeepSeek Harness 添加带用量限额信息的 Codex 模型。

description.en: Upgrades DSH image viewing with pointer-centered zoom, pan, galleries, downloads, keyboard support, and inline region notes.
description.zh: 增强 DSH 原生图片查看体验，支持指针中心缩放、拖动、画廊、下载、键盘操作和图片区域备注。

description.en: Sidebar panel for account balances and local token usage, with provider/model breakdowns and a 27-week daily heatmap.
description.zh: 侧边栏面板展示账户余额与本地 Token 用量，包含供应商/模型明细和 27 周每日热力图。

description.en: Tracks DSH's file reads, image views, and code edits in WakaTime, including exact counts of lines added and deleted by AI. Keeps activity tracking running while DSH responds, batches updates across files, and coordinates per-project reporting limits across parallel DSH processes. Automatically installs and updates wakatime-cli.
description.zh: 在 WakaTime 中记录 DSH 读取文件、查看图片和编辑代码的活动，并准确统计 AI 新增和删除的代码行数。DSH 回复期间持续记录活动，多个文件的记录批量上报，并在并行运行的 DSH 进程间统一控制各项目的上报频率。自动安装和更新 wakatime-cli。

description.en: Cross-device workspace backup, restore, and ecosystem update via the uagent-sync CLI.
description.zh: 工作区跨设备备份、恢复与扩展更新，经 uagent-sync CLI 桥接执行。

description.en: Git view for DeepSeek Harness: status, commit graph, branches, diff, staging/commit, push/pull and blame.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Git 视图：状态、提交图、分支、差异、暂存提交、推送拉取与逐行溯源。

description.en: Separate slash-command group in the Web UI composer: /steer injects text on the agent's next step without interrupting the turn, /new starts a blank session, /skill and /docs wrap /steer with post-turn skill or docs tasks, and custom /steer aliases are configurable in Settings.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 输入框的斜杠菜单里单独一组插件命令：/steer 在模型下一步注入内容且不打断当前回合，/new 开启空白会话，/skill 与 /docs 在 /steer 基础上附加完成后写入 skill 或 docs，并可在设置里为常用 /steer 内容配置自定义快捷命令。

description.en: Project .pack.json/.pack.zip into .agent-pack/modpacks/ and expose skills via a workspace allow-list.
description.zh: 把 .pack.json/.pack.zip 投影到 .agent-pack/modpacks/，按工作区白名单暴露 skill。

description.en: Panel hotkeys for the web UI: Enter presses the confirm action and Esc presses the cancel action on every interaction panel (approval, question, plan review).
description.zh: Web UI 面板快捷键：在审批、提问、计划审查等交互面板上，Enter 触发确认操作、Esc 触发取消操作。

description.en: Adds an input-modality selector to custom model settings in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的自定义模型设置添加输入模态选择器。

description.en: Rules, commands & skills manager for dsh: /rules slash command, settings panel with visual rule editing (add/edit/disable/delete, free-zone support), user-defined custom commands with {input} arguments, skill management, and automatic backup & one-click restore of AGENTS.md.
description.zh: dsh 规则、命令与技能管理：/rules 斜杠命令、设置面板可视化编辑规则（增改禁用删除、自由区域支持）、带参数的自定义命令、技能管理、AGENTS.md 自动备份与一键恢复。

description.en: Unified IM channel for DeepSeek Harness: Feishu, Telegram, DingTalk, Slack, Discord — persistent conversations, true streaming replies, 40 MCP Feishu tools, slash commands, and an IM-bot status tab in the plugin settings.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的统一 IM 渠道：飞书、Telegram、钉钉、Slack、Discord —— 持久会话、真流式回复、40 个飞书 MCP 工具、斜杠命令，以及插件设置页中的 IM 机器人状态页。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Markdown 文档与工作空间文件浏览器右侧预览插件 (支持查看/切换隐藏文件与点文件、工作区文件树、文件夹创建与文件移动、JSON 交互结构树/格式化、Java/C++/Python/JS/TS/YAML/Go/Rust 多语言语法高亮与符号大纲、自动换行与多标签 FileTabs)
DeepSeek Harness memory and knowledge hub that routes update, retrieve, and subscribe calls across compatible plugins, with an optional transactional Rust backend.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的记忆与知识中台：在兼容插件之间路由 update、retrieve 和 subscribe 调用，并提供可选的事务化 Rust 后端。

description.en: Turn a phone camera into a live viewfinder and photo input for your dsh session, over LAN or USB.
description.zh: 把手机相机变成 dsh 会话的实时取景与拍照输入，经局域网或 USB 直连。

description.en: Git sidebar panel with commit graphs, ahead/behind tracking, branch operations, and one-click chat context injection.
description.zh: Git 侧边栏面板：提交图谱、超前/落后跟踪、分支操作及改动 Diff 一键带入对话。

description.en: One-click standalone two-column code review page for Git diffs in the conversation: line numbers, add/delete coloring, character-level highlight, hunk-aware per-file sections, a file nav sidebar and a stats bar; line comments submit back to the DSH composer, and the UI follows the DSH locale.
description.zh: 把对话里的 git diff 一键打开为独立标签页的双列代码评审页：行号、增删配色、字符级高亮、hunk 感知的多文件分段、文件导航侧栏与统计条，行内评论可提交回 DSH 对话框，界面跟随 DSH 语言（中英）。

description.en: Claude-style warm-editorial skin for the DSH web GUI — ivory/warm-black canvas, a clay ember accent, serif display + sans UI + mono labels, hairline borders and pill CTAs, light/dark themes.
description.zh: Claude 风格暖调编辑 DSH Web 皮肤：象牙白/暖黑双画布、陶烬橙点睛、衬线标题+无衬线界面+等宽标签、发丝线与胶囊 CTA，亮暗双主题跟随系统。

description.en: All-in-one UI plugin for DSH Desktop (Windows): conversation-width slider with fullscreen preview and follow-window mode, thinking-block enhancements (forced Chinese, expand/collapse, Markdown rendering), an Open With header button, UI label localization, a resizable settings dialog, session delete, and workspace tabs.
description.zh: DSH 桌面版多功能 UI 插件：对话宽度滑块（按下全屏预览、跟随窗口宽度）、思考块增强（思考/回复强制中文、展开收起、Markdown 渲染）、Open With 头部打开按钮、界面英文标签中文化、设置弹窗窗口化、会话删除与工作区分页。

description.en: Give DeepSeek (text-only) models vision in Claude Code, Codex, and Agent Plugins clients: describe images via any OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint.
Markdown viewer for the dock workbench: GFM rendering with DOMPurify sanitization, document outline and relative-path image/link resolution, with one-click switch to editing.
description.zh: dock 系列 Markdown 查看器：GFM 渲染 + DOMPurify 消毒、文档大纲、相对路径图片/链接解析，可一键切换编辑。

description.en: Vision provider route that transcribes attached images to text through a configurable model (15+ OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic vendors) while DeepSeek keeps answering.
description.zh: 视觉模型路由：把附加图片经可配置模型（15+ OpenAI 兼容与 Anthropic 供应商）转译为文字，对话仍由 DeepSeek 作答。

description.en: DSH Usage Monitor: auto-query provider credit balances and time-window limits from configured API keys, with input capsule and custom provider support.
description.zh: DSH 用量监控：自动查询已配置 API Key 的供应商余额和时间窗口限制，支持输入框余量胶囊和自定义供应商。

description.en: Local-first fiction workspace that links outlines, chapters, characters, timelines, writing rules, and continuity checks to the conversation.
description.zh: 本地优先的小说创作工作台，将大纲、章节、人物、时间线、写作规则与一致性检查联动到对话。

description.en: Sidebar session-title icons: an auxiliary model call on the same route as title generation draws a 24x24 monochrome SVG metaphor shown before each session row title, with disk caching.
description.zh: 侧边栏会话标题图标：标题生成时用同一路由的辅助模型调用画一枚 24×24 单色 SVG 隐喻图标，显示在每行标题左侧，带磁盘缓存。

description.en: Web chat entry for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar button opening chat.deepseek.com in a dedicated desktop window under dsh-desktop, with in-webview fallback for plain web environments.
description.zh: 网页对话入口插件：侧边栏一键打开 chat.deepseek.com 独立窗口（dsh-desktop 桥接），纯网页环境自动回退内嵌打开。

description.en: Unified model routing for DeepSeek Harness: one logical ModelID over multiple providers with first-token failover and cooldown, health-aware candidate ranking, three tiers (tier1/tier2/tier3) auto-selected by purpose, per-candidate reasoning effort, and a settings-page management panel.
description.zh: 统一模型路由：一个逻辑 ModelID 汇聚多家供应商，首 token 前失败自动切换并冷却、健康度择优、按 purpose 三档分级（tier1/2/3）、每候选思考级别，设置面板自动保存即时生效。

description.en: Rearranges DSH Web into a three-column workbench with file editing, Git views, Markdown preview, and workspace terminals.
description.zh: 将 DSH Web 重排为三栏工作台，提供文件编辑、Git 视图、Markdown 预览和工作区终端。

description.en: Switches DSH's package download source between the npmmirror China mirror and the official npm registry on timeout or failure, with a Web UI to inspect and switch manually.
description.zh: 在下载超时或失败时，于 npmmirror 国内镜像与官方 npm 源之间自动切换下载源，并附带 Web UI 可手动查看与切换。

description.en: Agent-driven kanban board: one board per workspace, per-task agent sessions, and a guarded human/agent workflow (Backlog → To Do → In Progress → Review → Done).
description.zh: agent 驱动的看板：每个工作区一块看板、每个任务一个 agent 会话，以及带护栏的人机协作流程（Backlog → To Do → In Progress → Review → Done）。

description.en: Engine-enforced guardrails for DeepSeek Harness agent swarms: quality gates reject half-done work, crash-safe checkpoints resume in place — keeps AI teams from breaking, not just running.
description.zh: dsh 单机多子 Agent 集群治理：引擎级质量门禁拒收半成品、崩溃断点续跑不重来——给 AI 团队装上"跑不坏"的工程护栏。

description.en: Sends a desktop notification and chime when a DeepSeek Harness run completes, errors, or waits for approval, with a configurable duration threshold.
description.zh: DSH 桌面通知插件：运行完成、出错或等待审批时发送桌面通知并播放提示音，支持可配置的时长阈值。

description.en: Run Stata through DeepSeek Harness: the native Stata AI Skill service auto-starts with DSH (macOS/Windows binaries bundled), so you can run regressions, do-files and econometrics workflows with no manual setup.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中运行 Stata：Stata AI Skill 原生服务随 DSH 自动启动（内置 macOS/Windows 多平台二进制），无需手动配置即可跑回归、do 文件与计量工作流。

description.en: Arknights-inspired fan skin for the DSH Web UI featuring Pramanix and Eyjafjalla in a day/night celestial garden.
description.zh: DSH Web 明日方舟同人皮肤“初雪和小羊”，包含昼夜星海庭园背景与双角色布局。

description.en: COM-driven real Microsoft Office automation for DeepSeek Harness: drives a running Excel/Word instance through OfficeMCP — VBA macros, pivot tables, live formula recalculation, and deep document layout; plus an accounting suite (double-entry journal posting with debit/credit balance check, and SUMIF general ledger).
description.zh: COM 驱动真实 Microsoft Office 实例的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：经 OfficeMCP 操作运行中的 Excel/Word——VBA 宏、透视表、活公式重算、文档深度排版；含会计场景（复式记账分录 + 借贷平衡校验、SUMIF 科目总账）。

description.en: DSH 手机远程访问 + 远程桌面：内置本地代理(8090)+配置面板+远程屏幕/鼠标/键盘。配合任意内网穿透工具（cpolar/frp/ngrok等）把公网URL转发到 127.0.0.1:8090 即可用手机浏览器远程使用本机 Harness。自动安装配套的 dsh-browser-polyfill。
Floating widget showing real-time OpenCode Go subscription usage (rolling/weekly/monthly) for every API key, with rate-limit alerts and automatic key-pool discovery.
description.zh: 悬浮组件实时显示 OpenCode Go 各 key 用量（滚动/每周/每月），限流预警，自动发现 key 池。

description.en: One-click OpenAI-compatible API (CodeBuddy/vLLM/proxies) with thinking mode, avoiding developer-role content_filter rejection.
description.zh: 一键接入 OpenAI 兼容 API（CodeBuddy、vLLM、各类代理）并开启思考模式，绕开第三方端点以 content_filter 拒绝 developer 角色的问题。

description.en: Extensible AI-driven group-reaction narrative game framework for DeepSeek Harness: type one action and multiple NPCs each respond in their own chatroom message with avatar illustrations; worlds, locations, NPCs and feature extensions (e.g. a third-party drawing API for dynamic NPC expressions) are added and modified through the harness chat dialog without code.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：可扩展的 AI 群像聊天游戏框架。输入一个行动，多个 NPC 各自回应，每条反应独立成带头像插图的聊天室消息；世界、地点、NPC 与功能扩展（如接入第三方绘图 API 实现 NPC 动态表情动作）都可以在对话框里让 agent 直接添加修改，无需写代码。

description.en: Import local Codex CLI/Desktop, Claude Code CLI, and Claude Desktop conversations into DSH with project grouping, semantic history, and tool activity; bind an existing or replacement workspace and continue with the DSH Agent.
description.zh: 将本地 Codex CLI/Desktop、Claude Code CLI 和 Claude Desktop 会话导入 DSH：按项目分组，保留语义历史和工具活动，可绑定原工作区或新工作区，并由 DSH Agent 继续对话。

description.en: Multi-candidate mode for DeepSeek Harness (test-time scaling): floating panel config, the agent auto-runs parallel candidates plus verifier selection, scoped to the current session.
description.zh: 多候选模式插件（test-time scaling）：悬浮球面板配置，模型对任务自动执行并行候选加验证选优，仅当前会话生效。

description.en: A strip above the composer listing files modified in the current session (collapsed by default), with a Review button opening a per-session change panel showing before/after hunks from the session's own edit/write tool results, no git required.
description.zh: 输入框上方的条带列出当前会话修改过的文件（默认折叠），Review 按钮打开会话变更面板，基于会话自身的 edit/write 工具结果展示前后差异块，无需 git。

description.en: Renders pasted/uploaded images inline in the DSH Web chat and gives text-only models vision: the model-invokable visual_review tool calls any OpenAI-compatible multimodal API first, falling back to a local Qwen3-VL worker.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 聊天界面内联渲染粘贴/上传的图片，并让纯文本模型“看见”图片：visual_review 工具优先调用任意 OpenAI 兼容多模态 API，未配置时回退本机 Qwen3-VL。

description.en: Native RSS monitor for DeepSeek Harness: multi-source subscription, keyword filtering, scheduled polling with smart dedup, and email notifications for new items (HTML template with thumbnail cards), with SMTP passwords stored only in the credential store.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 原生 RSS 订阅监控插件：多源订阅、关键词过滤、定时检查去重、新条目邮件通知（缩略图 HTML 模板），SMTP 密码走凭据库永不落盘，原生设置页四页签体验。

description.en: Prompt-cache diagnostics dashboard showing provider-reported token usage, adjacent logical-input changes, and Call TTFT.
description.zh: 提示词缓存诊断页，展示 Provider 回传的 Token 用量、相邻逻辑输入变化与 Call TTFT。

description.en: Installs a Web-profile helper that diagnoses and writes MCP config so Codex, Cursor, or Claude Code can spawn dsh --profile codex.
description.zh: 在 Web profile 中安装适配层，检测并写入 MCP 配置，供 Codex、Cursor 或 Claude Code 拉起 dsh --profile codex.

description.en: MUV engine for DeepSeek Harness: runs the regex_scripts from a character card against model output, tracks variables, renders a status bar, expands macros and LaTeX, and styles tagged code blocks such as letter, terminal, newspaper and phone. Needs dsh-muv-table installed as well, which is its companion plugin.
description.zh: MUV 引擎：执行角色卡的 regex_scripts 实时替换模型输出，追踪变量、渲染状态栏、展开宏与 LaTeX、为标签代码块（信纸／终端／报纸／手机）套样式。需同时安装伴生插件 dsh-muv-table。

description.en: Read-only insight panel for one profile: five views over the same data — config layers, plugin tree, services, tool names and models — each entry showing which layer inserted or disabled it and whether it is running.
description.zh: 只读的 profile 洞察面板：同一份数据的五个视图——配置层、插件树、服务、工具名、模型，每一条都给出被哪一层插入或禁用、此刻在不在跑。

description.en: Per-execution HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy routing for Agent fetches, LLM providers, and shell commands, with settings-backed hot reload, approval-gated controls, and credential-safe status.
description.zh: 按每次执行为 Agent fetch、LLM provider 与 shell 命令路由 HTTP/SOCKS5 代理；支持 settings 热更新、审批门禁和凭据安全状态。

description.en: Registers the commercial-ui-ux skill for DSH: task-aware commercial UI/UX/GUI design, review, repair, and implementation (SaaS, dashboards, admin panels, forms, tables, design systems) with a reference-doc system and quality gates.
description.zh: 注册 commercial-ui-ux 技能：以任务为中心的商业界面 UI/UX/GUI 设计、审查、修复与实现（SaaS、仪表盘、后台、表单、表格、设计系统），带参考文档体系与质量门禁。

description.en: Read-only SonarQube Community Build tools: instance status, project Quality Gate for a branch or pull request, issue and Security Hotspot search, single hotspot detail, and coverage, duplication or caller-selected measures. Issue and hotspot results carry a normalized location with component key, file path, line and text range.
description.zh: 面向 SonarQube Community Build 的只读工具：实例状态、分支或 PR 的项目质量阈、议题与安全热点搜索、单个热点详情，以及覆盖率、重复率或调用方指定的度量项。议题与热点结果附带标准化的位置信息，包含组件 key、文件路径、行号与文本范围。

description.en: Read-only Gitea and Forgejo tools over the REST API both projects share: instance info, repository listing, issue and pull request search and read, PR diffs and changed files, and Actions runs, jobs and job logs. Tool metadata is available in English, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese and Japanese.
description.zh: 面向自建 Gitea / Forgejo 的只读工具，走两者共用的 REST API：实例信息、仓库列表、议题与 PR 搜索和读取、PR diff 与变更文件，以及 Actions 运行、任务与任务日志。工具元数据支持英文、繁体中文、简体中文与日文。

description.en: Blocks edit/write writes that contain characters matching configurable regex rules, executed before the tool runs, with configurable messages and same-turn pwsh propagation; default rule matches full-width parentheses.
description.zh: 在工具执行前拦截 edit/write 写入内容里匹配配置正则的字符，默认匹配全角圆括号，同一回合命中后连带拦截后续 pwsh，报错文案与正则均可配置。

description.en: Zhipu (GLM Coding Plan) web suite as native DSH providers and tools: rebinds the built-in web_search and web_fetch to Zhipu web search and Markdown page reading, optionally registers github_search_doc / github_get_repo_structure / github_read_file repo tools, and adds a settings card with toggles and a credential-ref field.
description.zh: 智谱（GLM Coding Plan）三件套以原生 provider 与工具接入：内置 web_search / web_fetch 后端切换为智谱联网搜索与网页 Markdown 读取，可选注册 github_search_doc / github_get_repo_structure / github_read_file 开源仓库工具，附设置卡片配置开关与凭据引用名。

description.en: AI UI automation via Midscene — android_ui and web_ui tools that tap, type, query, and assert on a real Android device or an already-running Chrome through the ctx.midscene seam.
description.zh: 基于 Midscene 的 AI UI 自动化——android_ui 与 web_ui 工具，通过 ctx.midscene seam 在真实 Android 设备或已运行的 Chrome 上完成点击、输入、查询与断言。

description.en: Host-neutral durable DAG workflows for Agents with CLI, MCP, on-demand Skills, triggers, replay, and a visual Canvas.
description.zh: 面向 Agent 的 Host-neutral 持久化 DAG 工作流，提供 CLI、MCP、按需 Skill、Trigger、重放和可视化 Canvas。

description.en: DSH web plugin: a LiveBench tab in the Trajectory view (right of 对话/轨迹). Run LiveBench evaluations against every model configured in the DeepSeek Harness — pick provider/model, category, task, release and question range from dropdowns, watch progress, and
description.zh: 在轨迹视图里加个 LiveBench 标签页，一键给 Harness 里所有模型跑评测、直接看分数。

description.en: Bridge DeepSeek Harness (dsh) into Feishu / Lark with streaming cards, project workspaces, approvals and scheduling

Honcho memory plugin by Plastic Labs: injects the user profile, session summary and relevant conclusions at session start, uploads each turn to Honcho in the background with secrets redacted, and adds honcho_search / honcho_chat / honcho_remember tools plus a /honcho status command; configured through the ~/.honcho/config.json shared with the other Honcho integrations, against hosted honcho.dev or a self-hosted instance.
description.zh: 由 Plastic Labs 维护的 Honcho 记忆插件：会话启动时注入用户画像、会话摘要与相关结论，后台脱敏后逐轮上传对话到 Honcho，提供 honcho_search / honcho_chat / honcho_remember 工具及 /honcho 状态命令；通过与其他 Honcho 集成共用的 ~/.honcho/config.json 配置，支持托管的 honcho.dev 或自建实例。

description.en: DSH Companion 鲸鱼 Skill/CLI 插件前端（dual-face Cordis 插件）
Liquid Glass refraction input card for the DSH web GUI, with coupled-spring press animation. Published on npm: dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-liquid-glass-input.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web GUI 输入卡加上液态玻璃折射效果与弹簧按压动画。已发布 npm：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-liquid-glass-input。

description.en: Pull a 3D lever next to the send button and turn the model's reasoning signals into a pixel-art gacha reveal.
description.zh: 在发送按钮旁拉动 3D 拉杆，把模型思维链的文本信号变成一场像素风抽卡演出。

description.en: Vision bridge for text-only DeepSeek routes that analyzes attached and local images through configurable OpenAI Responses, Chat Completions, or Anthropic Messages endpoints while leaving image-capable routes native.
description.zh: 为纯文本 DeepSeek 路由提供视觉桥接：通过可配置的 OpenAI Responses、Chat Completions 或 Anthropic Messages 端点分析附件与本地图片，同时保持支持图片的路由走原生路径。

description.en: Test-stability tools: repeatedly run vitest/jest/pytest/node:test suites, classify flaky cases, keep history, maintain a quarantine manifest and health self-check.
description.zh: 测试稳定性工具：重复运行 vitest/jest/pytest/node:test，识别 flaky 用例，历史留档、隔离清单与健康自检。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 逐轮产出物卡片插件:每一轮(assistant 回答下方)显示该轮真正产出的文件与网址,精确按轮归属、只认非只读工具写/改/展示内容,撤回(截断)该轮后卡片随轮消失;卡片可一键用默认程序打开、在侧边栏预览或打开所在位置

SSH workspace and operations for DeepSeek Harness: bind a server directory as a workspace whose fs/subprocess calls route to the remote host via cordis seam replacement, plus web terminal, file transfers, tunnels, cluster runs and host management.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 SSH 工作区与运维：把服务器目录绑定为工作区，fs/命令经 cordis seam 替换透明路由到远端主机，并带 Web 终端、文件传输、隧道、集群执行与主机管理。

description.en: A minimal worktree management solution with only one button and one dialog.
description.zh: 极简 worktree 管理方案，只有一个按钮和一个弹窗。

description.en: Deterministic code security review: 40+ rules, secret entropy detection, staged-diff review, SARIF export, baseline acceptance, SBOM-lite dependency inventory and health self-check.
description.zh: 确定性代码安全审查：40+ 规则、密钥熵检测、staged diff 审查、SARIF 导出、基线接受、SBOM-lite 依赖清单与健康自检。

description.en: Transport-level authentication gate for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with server-side sessions, HttpOnly cookies, IP-based login throttling, and an scrypt password CLI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的传输层认证门禁，提供服务端会话、HttpOnly Cookie、基于 IP 的登录限流及 scrypt 口令 CLI。

description.en: Bridges the LiuHe MCP code toolkit (44 tools) into dsh web: repo_map, symbol search, edit_batch with tolerant matching, transactional edits with undo journal, and deterministic quality gates — backed by a crash-isolated Rust tree-sitter parse daemon and SQLite index.
description.zh: 将 LiuHe MCP 代码工具集（44 个工具）桥接进 dsh web：repo_map、符号搜索、带容错匹配的 edit_batch、带撤销日志的事务性编辑，以及确定性质量门禁——由崩溃隔离的 Rust tree-sitter 解析守护进程和 SQLite 索引支撑。

description.en: Reusable subagent definitions managed from a Settings page and dispatched through a single delegate_agent tool; ships with a built-in read-only Explorer preset and a nested-delegation policy toggle.
description.zh: 用设置页维护可复用的子代理定义，通过统一的 delegate_agent 工具委派；内置只读的 Explorer 预置与嵌套委派开关。

description.en: DSH Skill Manager: browse, enable/disable, import from Codex/Claude Code/ZCode/WorkBuddy/QCoderWork, auto-discover skills with symlink support.
description.zh: DSH 技能管理器：浏览、启用/禁用、从 Codex/Claude Code/ZCode/WorkBuddy/QCoderWork 导入，自动发现技能并支持软链接。

description.en: Analyzes conversation images through mode-specific prompts (caption, UI, document, grounding, topology, etc.) and injects structured evidence with coordinate primitives (boxes, points, refs) as text, with session-level caching for reuse across replay and compaction.
description.zh: 通过模式化提示分析对话图片（描述、UI、文档、定位、拓扑等），将含坐标原语（框、点、引用）的结构化证据以文本注入上下文，会话级缓存跨回放与压缩复用。

description.en: Workspace-scoped durable memory for DeepSeek Harness and optional voice integrations
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供工作区隔离的持久化记忆，让每个工作区拥有可检索、可审计、可纠错和可删除的独立记忆，并支持受控的全局记忆。

description.en: Official DeepSeek platform monitoring inside the provider card: a live balance chip left of the composer model name plus an expandable account-details panel with per-model monthly usage and a daily stacked chart.
description.zh: 在官方供应商卡片内实时监控 DeepSeek 余额与开放平台用量——输入框工具行模型名称左侧的余额 chip，可展开的账户明细面板含按模型用量与每日堆叠图表。

description.en: Use DeepSeek Harness as an Agent Client Protocol (ACP) stdio agent.

Reverse tunnel for the DSH Web GUI: exposes a `dsh --profile web` deployment at a public frp URL and switches the directory picker to the in-app browser, so a phone or remote machine can open and manage the workspace.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 反向隧道：通过 frp 把 `dsh --profile web` 发布到公网地址，目录选择器改用应用内浏览器，手机或远程机器可直接打开并管理工作区。

description.en: DSH plugin: an unattended AI software team. Feed it a bare Linux server, a set of secrets (env-var references only) and a git remote, and the plugin-driven AI team drives the whole project lifecycle — environment bootstrap, scaffolding, task decomposition

IDE-style run configurations for DSH: save LLM prompts and shell commands as reusable run configs (global or per-workspace), run them from the session header or the new-session page, and manage them via the task_run_config tool with approval-gated writes.
description.zh: DSH 的 IDE 风格运行配置：把常用 LLM 提示词和 Shell 命令保存为可复用的运行配置（全局或按工作区），在会话头部或新会话页一键运行，大模型可通过 task_run_config 工具管理（写操作走审批）。

description.en: Login gate for the dsh web UI: unauthenticated visitors get a login/register page and the first registrant becomes admin; includes user and role management plus login and access audit logs.
description.zh: 用户管理：给 dsh web 加登录门禁，未登录访问弹登录/注册页，首个注册者自动成为管理员；管理员可管理用户/角色，带登录与访问审计。

description.en: Forgetting-curve in-place dialogue compression for DeepSeek Harness: recent turns stay verbatim, middle turns are structurally dehydrated (zero-LLM), ancient turns fold into a bounded summary pair — unbounded conversations on a bounded memory budget.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于自然遗忘曲线的就地对话压缩：近期对话逐字保留、中期结构化脱水（零 LLM 成本）、久远对话折叠为有界摘要对——有限记忆预算上的无限对话。

description.en: JARVIS-style sci-fi HUD shell over the DSH web GUI: electric-cyan VITAL SIGNS / RT-MONITOR / RT-LOG left bar, POWER CORE gauges and a rotating RADAR scan disc on the right with up/down traffic chart, filesystem browser with file preview, and a terminal-styled composer with a JARVIS header strip that follows the active workspace.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面上叠加 JARVIS 风格科幻 HUD 外壳：电光青色 VITAL SIGNS 生命体征 / RT-MONITOR 实时监控 / RT-LOG 事件日志左栏，右侧 POWER CORE 能源核心仪表、旋转扫描的 RADAR 雷达盘与上下行流量图，左下文件系统浏览器（带文件预览），以及带 JARVIS 头部横幅、跟随当前工作区的终端风格输入框。

description.en: Free model provider plugin for DSH with 20+ models including Gemini, MiMo, GLM, etc.
description.zh: DSH free model provider plugin with 20+ models including Gemini, MiMo, GLM, etc.

description.en: Brings the codebase knowledge-base capability of langchain-ai/openwiki into DSH — one-click generate/read/update of the repository Wiki, Grounded Claims (source-traced knowledge cards) and a project knowledge base built from uploaded local files, reusing the model DSH already has configured, with no second API key.
description.zh: 把 langchain-ai/openwiki 的代码库知识库能力搬进 dsh —— 一键生成 / 阅读 / 更新仓库 Wiki 与 Grounded Claims（溯源知识卡片）与项目知识库（上传本地文件），直接复用 DSH 已配置的模型，无需二次填 Key。

description.en: Multi-tab side chat for DeepSeek Harness. Quote a whole message or text selected from a still-streaming reply into a side chat without waiting for the reply to finish, and dock the panel over the better-sidebar workbench or yield to the conversation depending on the sidebar state.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 多标签侧聊增强：可引用整条消息，也可在回复生成中选中文本追问（无需等待回复完成）；右侧停靠面板随 better-sidebar 开关在覆盖与让位间自动切换。

description.en: Turns stock names and codes in DSH output text into clickable buttons for quotes and company news.
description.zh: 将 DSH 输出文本中的股票名称和代码转换为可点击按钮，并在侧边栏展示行情与资讯。

description.en: GitHub-style daily token-usage heatmap on the new-session screen with a selectable calendar-year view, green/blue color schemes, and today / this-month / all-time totals.
description.zh: 新建会话页的 GitHub 风格每日 Token 用量热力图：可选日历年度视图、绿/蓝配色与显示开关，并附今日/本月/累计总量。

description.en: Freshness gate for the agent's test, typecheck, lint and build claims: each verification run becomes a receipt on tools/post-execute, file edits are tracked, and on agent/turn-stopping a claim whose latest receipt is stale, failed or has no readable result steers one more step naming the receipt and the files edited since.
description.zh: 为智能体的测试、类型检查、lint 与构建结论提供新鲜度检查：每次验证运行在 tools/post-execute 上记录为凭据，文件修改被跟踪；在 agent/turn-stopping 时，若结论对应的最新凭据已过期、失败或没有可读结果，则引导再走一步，并指出凭据与其后被修改的文件。

description.en: Ports the obra/superpowers methodology as 14 native DSH skills covering planning, TDD, debugging, and code review.
description.zh: 将 obra/superpowers 方法论移植为 14 个原生 DSH 技能，覆盖规划、TDD、调试与代码评审。

description.en: Requires DSH 0.1.5-rc.1. Mobile UI fixes for the dsh web profile: narrow-screen drawer and settings tabs, a full-width model menu, a stuck-request network chip, and a narrow-header collector that folds the lineage, subagent and background-job chips into one tappable sheet.
description.zh: 需要 DSH 0.1.5-rc.1。dsh web profile 的手机端体验修复：窄屏抽屉与设置标签、全宽模型菜单、卡住请求的网络状态芯片，以及把会话层级、subagent 与后台任务芯片收进一张可点开面板的窄屏头部收纳器。

description.en: Authentication gate for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: login covers pages, /api, /plugins and WebSocket upgrades; PBKDF2 password hashing, HttpOnly SameSite session cookies, IP-based login lockout, a user-management settings panel (users edit their own profile, admins add or remove users and reset passwords), admin-only model and API-key configuration guards, per-user isolation on the REST/list APIs and the WebSocket event streams, session persistence across restarts, a JSONL audit log, and a fail-closed gateway.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 认证网关：登录门禁覆盖页面、/api、/plugins 与 WebSocket 升级；PBKDF2 口令哈希、HttpOnly SameSite 会话 Cookie、按源 IP 登录锁定；设置面板内置用户管理（普通用户仅可修改本人资料与密码，管理员可新增/删除用户、重置密码、调整角色）；模型配置与 API Key 仅管理员可修改；REST/列表接口与 WebSocket 事件流均按用户隔离；会话重启后免登录恢复；JSONL 审计日志；存储故障时保持 fail-closed。

description.en: Voice assistant for dsh web: say the wake phrase (e.g. "小鲸") to activate hands-free dictation — what you say is transcribed and typed into the chat box automatically. Supports spoken edit commands (send, clear, new line, stop reading) and reads assistant replies aloud in Chinese. Speech recognition runs locally in-browser via sherpa-onnx WASM, so it works offline without an API key.
description.zh: dsh web 语音助手：说出唤醒词（如「小鲸」）即可免手听写，说话内容自动转成文字填入输入框；支持口述编辑指令（发送、清空、换行、停止朗读），并可用中文朗读 AI 回复。语音识别基于 sherpa-onnx WASM 在浏览器本地运行，离线可用、无需 API Key。

description.en: Configurable image recognition for text-only DSH models: image messages are first transcribed by an OpenAI-compatible vision model (Base URL, model ID and API key set in a Settings section) and then passed to the main model as text, while image-input support is advertised. The API key auth scheme is selectable — OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini or Azure style request headers — and a missing key is reported before any request is sent.
description.zh: 为纯文本 DSH 模型增加可配置识图能力：开启后图片消息先由任意 OpenAI 兼容视觉模型转写为文字描述，再交给主模型处理；设置页可配置 Base URL、Model ID 与密钥，并可选择密钥的鉴权方式（OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini / Azure 风格请求头）；未填写密钥时会在发起请求前明确提示。

description.en: The dsh security mode plugin achieves a zero third-party plugin startup by constructing a blank profile.
description.zh: dsh安全模式插件，通过构建空白profile实现零第三方插件启动。

description.en: Telegram bridge for DeepSeek Harness: bidirectional sessions, conversation steering, home-channel routing, and TTS voice notes sent as Telegram audio messages.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Telegram 桥接：双向会话、对话引导、主频道路由，以及以 Telegram 语音消息发送的 TTS 语音笔记。

description.en: Theme plugin for DSH with 34 built-in themes including Nord, One Dark and GitHub, with full light and dark mode support.
description.zh: DSH 主题切换插件，内置 34 款主题：Nord / One Dark / Github 等，适配浅色/深色模式。

description.en: Discord Rich Presence for Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Pi, and DeepSeek Harness, powered by one local service that keeps your active work visible in Discord.
description.zh: 把 Codex、Claude Code 等 AI 编码工具的当前工作状态同步到 Discord，让队友随时看到你在忙什么。

description.en: An architecture-graph driven framework for Agentic Engineering.
description.zh: 用架构图统一描述智能体流程和产品设计，帮你更直观地搭建、编排和管理智能体工程。

description.en: dsh-cc-studio · CCv3 角色卡工坊 从一句话点子到可导入 SillyTavern / Risu 的 chara_card_v3。专治「只有点子，世界观薄弱」。
description.zh: 一句话点子就能生成可导入 SillyTavern / Risu 的 CCv3 角色卡，专治世界观薄弱。

description.en: Model-driven context-window rollover bundle for the DeepSeek Harness: fresh working context, durable notes, verbatim recent tail, no summarization
description.zh: 让模型自己管理上下文窗口，自动滚动切换工作区，保留关键笔记和最近对话，无需压缩总结。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 增加古法编程模式，让模型监督你写代码！
description.zh: 让 AI 只出题搭骨架，你亲手写实现，它再验收讲思路，找回自己写代码的手感。

description.en: DSH provider plugin for Qoder subscriptions.
description.zh: 把 Qoder 订阅接入 DSH，支持流式输出、推理内容和工具调用，让模型适配更省心。

description.en: 用于harness的服务器连接插件
description.zh: 像 Xshell 一样保存 SSH 服务器档案，但登录始终由你亲手完成，agent 只借用已连通的通道。

description.en: One Dark Pro theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI. 为 DSH Web 界面打造的 One Dark Pro 暗色主题插件。
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面换上 One Dark Pro 暗色主题，在设置里一键切换，护眼又好看。

description.en: OpenSpec 流程的 Agent Team：面向实施阶段的多 Agent 工作流编排。
description.zh: 让多个 AI 智能体按 OpenSpec 规范分工协作，把变更方案落地成经过审查的高质量代码。

description.en: Persistent identity layer for DeepSeek Harness. The first reference implementation of AI Soul.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上持久化的灵魂层，让 AI 的身份、记忆和成长独立于模型存在。

description.en: DSH 对话流增强插件（零 DSH 源码改动，纯插件注入）。回合呈现：思考 chip（实时走秒 + 实时文字滚动）· 工具调用聚合 chip · 对话流卡片（步骤卡/总结卡）· 共享活动抽屉。正文增强：proto-tabs 可交互卡片 · diagram 流程图围栏 · 本地 HTML 内嵌预览（识别正文里的 .html 路径，host 读文件 + 同目录资源，iframe 沙箱隔离，高度自适应，1:1/等比缩放，浏览器打开）。界面与工具：会话头部对话/轨迹标签上移 · 对话截图（常驻无头浏览器渲染 markdown/shiki/mermaid 真图，可内嵌本地 HTML）· download 下载工具（实时进度条/速度/ETA）。
description.zh: 给 DSH 对话加上思考走秒、工具聚合卡片和流程图、HTML 预览，聊天体验更直观。

description.en: Use a Kimi Code subscription in DeepSeek Harness with OAuth, quota display, and composer usage
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接用 Kimi Code 会员订阅，登录、额度、调用一站式搞定，不用再单独配 API 密钥。

description.en: A production-grade, DSH-native browser runtime for DeepSeek Harness with visible human-agent collaboration.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 里的 AI 直接操控 Chrome 浏览网页，过程看得见、随时能插手。

description.en: Noname (Sanguosha-like game) extension workshop. AI writes skill and card extensions behind confirmation gates, static validation and block-based safe writes.
description.zh: 无名杀扩展开发工坊。AI 在确认协议、校验门禁与区块化写入的保护下编写武将技能与卡牌扩展。

description.en: deepseek harness 插件 替换会话持久化引擎为 MySQL 数据库
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的会话存储换成 MySQL，让对话记录更持久、好管理。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：会话同步与冲突解决（apiproxy、token 内联）
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的会话同步起来，自动解决冲突，还能内联 token 走代理，多设备用着不打架。

description.en: FEMO插件版 — 可接入dsh的多智能体引擎，差不多能做所有事：我已经用femo和我的主agent玩了好几局狼人杀了，他抽到狼他还刀我！ 我在b站的宣传视频也是用femo剪的。 coding的时候，特别难找的bug、代码重构，我都会用femo来做。 我甚至用femo模式给我的主agent养了只宠物，她很开心。
description.zh: 接入 DSH 的多智能体引擎，能陪你玩狼人杀、剪视频、查 Bug、重构代码，还能给主 Agent 养宠物。

description.en: Make destructive AI-agent actions reversible by default — quarantine + audit + human escalation for rm/git destructive operations. Reliability infrastructure, not a sandbox.
description.zh: 给AI智能体装上安全锁，让rm、git等破坏性操作默认可回滚，带隔离审查和人工升级机制，防止误操作酿成大祸。

description.en: Local-first file conversion for DeepSeek Harness — images, PDF, data, audio/video & office docs. 7 tools, 26 conversions, no API keys, no uploads.
description.zh: 本地文件格式转换工具，支持图片、PDF、音视频和办公文档等26种转换，无需API密钥，离线可用。

description.en: 给 dsh 对话区叠加 B 站风格吐槽弹幕，可接入 LLM 生成弹幕。/Bilibili-style live-chat danmaku overlay for DeepSeek Harness Web — preset packs, optional LLM quips, drag ball, per-session pools.
description.zh: 给 dsh 对话区加上 B 站风格吐槽弹幕，还能让 LLM 自动生成弹幕，聊天更有氛围。

description.en: 鲸鱼娘 Mimi：DeepSeek Harness（DSH）桌面宠物插件，内置 Windows Computer Use 与桌宠聊天好感度。
description.zh: 会跟着 DSH 干活的鲸鱼娘桌宠，能聊天、刷好感度，还能用 Windows 电脑操作帮你做事。

description.en: Real-time voice input and spoken answer summaries for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 支持实时语音输入和语音播报回答，解放双手，边说话边编程。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bundle for one-shot Claude Code and GitHub Copilot Gemini delegation through native subscription logins.
description.zh: 通过原生订阅登录，一键将 Claude Code 和 GitHub Copilot 的 Gemini 任务编排到 DeepSeek Harness，实现跨智能体协作。

description.en: Session progress tracker: system prompt injection, live % calculation, and a slide-over drawer.
description.zh: 会话任务进度跟踪：系统提示词注入、实时百分比计算与侧边抽屉面板。

description.en: Reliable todo panel for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web: survives restarts, completion verified against evidence paths
description.zh: 让待办面板重启后不丢不白，还能自动核查完成证据，防止假完成。

description.en: deepseek harness manim数学插件
description.zh: 用自然语言就能把数学概念渲染成 Manim 动画视频，讲题演示更直观。

description.en: Xianxia desktop pets tied to live agent sessions: pixel-style companions appear as subagents spawn (up to 3 on screen), with storage-bag collection, a right-click artifact menu, a pet gallery, and Codex pet-format export.
description.zh: 修仙主题桌面宠物，随智能体会话出现，可收集法宝、右键互动，让工作更有趣。

description.en: Commander mode for the dsh web GUI: a one-click session header button injects a protocol brief into the session, then parses and auto-executes task blocks in the model reply — separating the strategist loop from worker loops via a visible badge.
description.zh: dsh 网页端指挥官模式：会话标题栏一键注入协议简报，解析模型回复中的任务块并自动执行，让策略层与执行层分离；通过徽章按钮激活/停用。

description.en: DeepSeek 峰谷时刻悬浮徽章 · dsh plugin：实时峰谷档位、下一阶段倒计时、本次会话 API 花费（含三段历史价格档）| A floating tide badge for DeepSeek Harness: live peak/off-peak phase, countdown and session cost.
description.zh: 在输入框旁显示DeepSeek峰谷时段悬浮徽章，一眼看清当前价格档位、距下一阶段时间及本次会话花费。

description.en: 把本机的 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 安全地发布到公网， 让你在外面用浏览器就能用家里那台机器。
description.zh: 把家里电脑上的 DSH 网页界面安全地发布到公网，出门在外用浏览器就能连回来用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web UI Standalone Wallpaper Background Plugin: Three sources including built-in wallpapers, custom uploads, and Wallpaper Engine library (read-only). Supports image, video, and scene preview rendering, along with adjustments for overlay, blur, brightness, and safe zoom.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面加一层独立动态壁纸，支持内置、自传和 Wallpaper Engine 库，图片视频都能用。

description.en: Give your AI coding agent the Roblox DevForum and official creator docs — check if a bug is already known, read the accepted answer, and verify APIs before writing Luau.
description.zh: 把 Roblox 开发者论坛和官方文档接入 AI 编程助手，查已知 Bug、看采纳答案、写 Luau 前先验证 API。

description.en: Personal AI memory semantic layer SDK (Rust + SQLite) — short/mid/long-term memory with hybrid recall
为 DeepSeek Harness 增加一个直接续跑按钮。当会话异常结束时，可以从现有上下文继续执行，不会引入其他提示词。
description.zh: 会话中断后一键续跑，无需重输提示词，直接从原上下文接着聊。

description.en: Adds an icon button to the composer that optimizes the current draft prompt through the active model.
description.zh: 输入框加个✨按钮，一键调用当前模型把草稿提示词改得更清晰具体，自动回填后直接开写，AI编程更顺手。

description.en: 管理 DeepSeek Harness 左下侧栏按钮的插件：拖拽排序、显隐控制，隐藏按钮收进"更多"菜单，可统一按钮高度。
description.zh: 管理 DeepSeek Harness 左下侧栏按钮，支持拖拽排序、隐藏不用的按钮并收进“更多”菜单，还能统一按钮高度，让侧边栏更整洁。

description.en: In-process graph memory kernel for DeepSeek Harness, backed by TriviumDB.
Configurable non-public address allowlists for DeepSeek Harness web_fetch
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的网页抓取增加内网地址白名单，解决 Fake-IP 环境下的访问拦截，安全又省心。

description.en: A client plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI that adds chat content width tiers with a floating picker button (bottom-right, above the composer): 标准 / 中等 / 宽 / 超宽 / 全宽 (standard / medium / wide / ultra / full).
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面增加聊天内容宽度调节，通过浮动按钮一键切换标准、中等、宽、超宽和全宽五种显示模式。

description.en: Wangdefa.Memory 是一个为企业级 Agent 设计的五层记忆体组件，采用「本地优先」的存储策略，达到轻量、可控、可解释。
description.zh: 专为AI Agent设计的本地记忆组件，五层架构轻量可控，轻松实现对话与业务状态的持久化管理。

description.en: Lifecycle orchestration engine for AI agent teams with task-scoped Git worktree isolation, state-gated delivery transitions, and off-context memory.
description.zh: 基于 Git 工作树任务隔离、状态门禁交付与外置记忆的 AI 智能体软件生命周期编排引擎。

description.en: 不想当牛马了？来当老板！开插件公司，雇AI牛马，过赛博人生！
description.zh: 不想当牛马了？来当老板！开插件公司，雇AI牛马，过赛博人生！

description.en: Cost tracking plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI — snapshot-anchored per-turn pricing, account balance, and live cost estimates.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供按轮次计费、账户余额和实时费用估算的成本追踪插件。

description.en: DSH Web 输入历史插件：Ctrl+Up / Ctrl+Down 像终端一样召回与切换已发送消息，零核心改动
description.zh: 像终端一样用 Ctrl+Up/Down 快速召回和切换历史输入，提升聊天效率，无需改动核心。

description.en: dsh-llm-ollama 是一个为 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）开发的社区插件，让 Harness 通过 Ollama 原生协议（/api/chat） 接入本地 Ollama 服务。即插即用：不改动 dsh 官方任何文件，安装后自动在「设置」中多出一个 Ollama 页面，并在会话模型选择器中提供该提供方的模型。
description.zh: 让 dsh 直接连上本地 Ollama 跑模型，装完就多出设置页和模型选项，不用改官方文件。

description.en: 可以在 DSH 中使用 WorkBuddy 里面的模型
description.zh: 在 DSH 里直接调用 WorkBuddy 的模型，让工作流更顺手。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: one-click OpenCode Go model sync in the settings panel - fetch all server models, probe availability & vision, write back to llm-pi-ai config
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页一键同步 OpenCode Go 的全部模型，自动实测可用性和视觉能力，并写回 llm-pi-ai 配置。

description.en: DSH WebUI 文件输入增强：Ctrl+V 粘贴（带首次告知弹窗）+ 拖拽 + 选择文件，发送时复制进会话工作区临时目录
description.zh: 支持粘贴、拖拽快速传文件，自动存入临时目录并折叠为文件标签，聊天发附件更便捷。

description.en: 给 DSH 工作区一个用途维度：项目工作区注入项目约定，临时会话（$DSH_HOME/workspace/default，首次运行自动创建）注入『非项目』状态块。侧边栏底部一颗「临时会话」按钮 + 会话头用途徽标。dsh-plugin
description.zh: 给 DSH 加上临时会话：随手问一句、试段代码不污染项目，侧边栏一键开新会话。

description.en: Turn-atomic message editing, retry, reroll and version-tree navigation for DeepSeek Harness conversations — the restart-safe successor to dsh-message-edit
Adds Windows desktop notifications, optional sounds, and DSH-styled in-page notifications for task events.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页版提供 Windows 桌面通知、提示音和应用内通知卡片，切走页面也能实时收到消息提醒。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness achievement & gamification plugin: cross-session badges for turns, tool calls, sessions and daily streaks, with a badge panel, unlock toasts and a ctx.achievements service. Zero core changes.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness achievement & gamification plugin: cross-session badges for turns, tool calls, sessions and daily streaks, with a badge panel, unlock toasts and a ctx.achievements service. Zero core changes.

description.en: Coding workbench for DSH: docked workspace panels, a grouped project sidebar, split editor tab groups with hibernate/resume, file preview and diff views — built on parallel git worktree development with cross-session collaboration primitives.
description.zh: coding 工作台：停靠式工作区面板、项目分组侧栏、可休眠/恢复的分栏编辑器 TAB 组、文件预览与 DIFF 查看，以 git worktree 并行开发与跨会话协作为地基。

description.en: dsh-delegate: model-aware subagent delegation for DeepSeek Harness — per-call models, depends_on dependency gating, per-child personas, a durable run roster, audit events, and conversation-flow tool cards. | 给 DeepSeek Harness 的子代理委派加上：按次选模型、依赖门控、角色人设、任务花名册。
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Subagent 提供按次模型选择、依赖门控与角色设定，并记录运行与审计事件，现已暂停维护。

description.en: DSH Web Plugin: 工作区底部开辟一个迷你面板，当AI帮你工作时，不要荒废大脑，来一把掼蛋游戏。
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek 工作区底部嵌入掼蛋小游戏，AI 干活时你也能摸鱼来一把，纯前端单机版，随时开玩。

description.en: Inline, batchable comments for DeepSeek Harness assistant replies
DeepSeek Harness 基础工具增强：持久 bash、结构化 read、多模式 edit、原子 write、双引擎 grep/glob、图像直读，一个插件全覆盖

Local-first, durable workflow runtime for Agent Apps—compile static Workflow DSL to LangGraph and orchestrate trusted multi-agent execution through Codex, WorkBuddy, DeepSeek Harness, or any MCP client.
Cross-session memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): embedding search + automatic system-prompt injection
description.zh: Cross-session memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): YAML-backed remember/recall/view/list/forget/pin tools, embedding search, title-first injection, and two-level (session/auto) automatic injection.

description.en: DSH 设置-插件页新增「我的插件」标签：双列卡片展示用户自己安装的插件（配置状态、Cordis 状态、插件介绍）。Add a "My Plugins" tab to the DSH settings plugins page, listing user-installed plugins in two-column cards with configuration status, Cordis status and description.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置插件页新增「我的插件」标签，双列卡片清晰展示已装插件的配置与运行状态，方便管理。

description.en: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 侧边栏左下角显示 OpenCode Go 用量的插件。
