description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏左下角实时显示 OpenCode Go 用量，方便随时查看。

description.en: Universal Model Context Protocol (MCP) Bridge Plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — Everything is a Plugin
description.zh: 将MCP工具接入DeepSeek Harness，即插即用，让模型轻松调用外部能力和数据。

description.en: Shows a floating toolbar above text selected in a conversation, with copy, quote, ask, explain, translate, summarize, and custom prompt actions.
description.zh: 在对话中选中文本时显示浮动工具栏，提供复制、引用、询问、解释、翻译、总结与自定义提问操作。

description.en: DSH Skills 可视化管理器：在 DSH Web 界面可视化查看、编辑、创建、删除 Skills（用户级 ~/.dsh/skills 与项目级 .dsh/skills）
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页里直接管理你的 Skills，可视化增删改查，不用再敲命令行。

description.en: DSH plugin: chime + tab-title alert when tasks finish (任务完成提示音与标签标题提醒插件)
description.zh: 任务跑完自动响铃并在浏览器标签上提醒你，切走也能第一时间知道结果。

description.en: 万物皆是插件，万物皆可自定义——基于DeepSeek Harness的安全测试工作台，提示词、工具、MCP、技能、知识库、WebShell均可模块化编排，覆盖渗透测试与代码审计。
Citation extraction and evidence verification for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 引用提取与证据核验：帮 agent 的回答带可验证出处。

description.en: Human-AI collaborative prototyping for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 画码：人机协作画原型，边聊边画边生成前端页面，让需求到代码一气呵成。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 多模型路由插件：让专业的事情交给专业的 agent——自定义视觉/翻译/语音/子代理等专业 agent 并绑定独立模型，多模态账号一键登录、账号池健康路由与实时用量统计
description.zh: 给 DSH 主 agent 挂上专业小弟：视觉、翻译、语音等各配独立模型，按任务自动路由。

description.en: Balance, session cost, token usage, and invoice summaries for DeepSeek Harness Web.
description.zh: 直接在聊天栏下方显示余额、单次对话花费和Token用量，让你随时摸清AI消费账单。

description.en: One-click desktop launcher for DSH Web: creates a Windows .lnk with a WPF-style startup popup (progress + timeout), then opens the authenticated browser; plus a floating shutdown button that exits dsh gracefully via ctx.appExit.
description.zh: 一键桌面启动器：Windows 快捷方式 + WPF 风格启动弹窗（进度与超时提示），启动 dsh web 并打开认证浏览器；右下角悬浮关机按钮，经 ctx.appExit 优雅退出 dsh 进程。

description.en: Fills missing context window, max tokens, thinking levels, and image input on custom DSH models from models.dev, and lists unmatched models for manual edits.
description.zh: 按模型名从 models.dev 补全自定义模型缺失的上下文、输出上限、思考档位和图片能力，并列出未匹配模型供手改。

description.en: Quality-aware in-agent plugin discovery: a find_dsh_plugins tool that ranks the whole dsh-plugin topic through a daily quality-scored index (installable manifest, curated listing, license, activity) merged with a live gh search — zero LLM API cost, risk flags and exact install commands in every result.
description.zh: 质量感知的会话内插件发现：find_dsh_plugins 工具基于每日更新的质量评分索引（可安装声明 / 精选收录 / 许可证 / 活跃度）对 dsh-plugin topic 全量排序，并叠加实时 gh 搜索——零 LLM API 成本，每条结果附风险徽章与精确安装命令。

description.en: Prism · 棱镜 — a deeply customizable glassmorphism theme plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面换上毛玻璃质感皮肤，界面更通透美观，支持深度自定义。

description.en: Remote development over SSH: pick a directory on a registered machine as the session workspace and the file, shell, bash, and search tools run on the remote host — the agent works there with the same local tools, and no extra model-facing tools are added.
description.zh: 基于 SSH 的远程开发：把注册机器上的目录选为会话工作区后，文件、shell、bash 与搜索工具即改在远程主机上执行——agent 用与本地相同的工具在那里工作，不新增任何面向模型的工具。

description.en: Evidence-first model control plane for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 基于证据的模型控制面板，帮你智能路由和切换 DeepSeek 模型，提升调用稳定性。

description.en: Local-first, durable workflow runtime for Agent Apps—compile static Workflow DSL to LangGraph and orchestrate trusted multi-agent execution through Codex, WorkBuddy, DeepSeek Harness, or any MCP client.
Local prompt-injection and secret-exfiltration firewall for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 本地提示注入与密钥外泄防火墙：给 DSH 加一道安全闸。
把 QQ（OneBot 11）变成 DeepSeek Harness 的聊天界面，消息驱动 AI 回合，模型可主动调用工具回复。

description.en: Requires one-shot user approval before configured tools (default bash, pwsh) execute — gated tools pause and ask, everything else delegates, and a missing approval channel fails closed.
description.zh: 在配置的工具（默认 bash、pwsh）执行前要求一次性用户审批：受控工具暂停并询问，其余委托执行，缺少审批渠道时默认拒绝。

description.en: Trusted Auto: a middle permission tier for DeepSeek Harness between workspace-write and danger-full-access, auto-approving harmless commands and trusted-area targets
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness提供介于工作区写入和完全访问之间的中间权限层，自动放行无害命令和可信区域操作，兼顾安全与效率。

description.en: Liquid-glass billing overlay for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: provider balances, session cost, daily spend and token buckets. DeepSeek-first and extensible.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面添加玻璃拟态计费浮层，实时查看余额、会话费用、日消费和 Token 用量。

description.en: Surveys local code and GitHub/npm for reusable implementations before development, evaluates reuse versus rewrite, and checks architecture coupling.
description.zh: 在开发前检索本地代码与 GitHub/npm 的可复用实现，评估复用与重写成本，并检查架构耦合。

description.en: CodeBuddy (copilot.tencent.com) provider bundle for DeepSeek Harness: 18 models, web_search/web_fetch backends, image_generate, local streaming bridge with OAuth & multi-Key rotation, Web UI settings card. Unofficial.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 CodeBuddy 的 18 款模型，支持联网搜索、图片生成和本地流式桥接，可在 Web 界面管理密钥与设置。

description.en: A lightweight DeepSeek Harness vision delegation tool for text-only routes, with native OpenAI Responses, Chat Completions, and Anthropic Messages adapters.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek 文本模型借助多模态大模型看图，支持 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 接口，即插即用。

description.en: Keeps a local task-outcome ledger for DSH, verifies acceptance criteria from deterministic evidence, records user disposition and token usage, and supports digest-bound export.
description.zh: 为 DSH 保存本地任务结果账本，依据确定性证据验证验收标准，记录用户处置与 token 用量，并支持摘要绑定导出。

description.en: 只是一个 tps 插件
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面实时显示每秒生成的 token 数，方便你直观监控模型输出速度。

description.en: DeepSeek account balance, this session's billed spend, and today's total spend in the session-header badge; a turn-cost row in the message actions strip, a detail panel with per-model pricing and a today session-spend ranking. Official peak/off-peak pricing; balance from the real /user/balance API.
description.zh: 会话头部徽标显示 DeepSeek 账户余额、本轮对话花费与今日全部会话总花费；每轮消息操作行前置本轮花费，详情面板含按模型计价与今日会话消费排行。官方峰谷定价，余额取自 /user/balance API。

description.en: Full-pipeline Chinese translation for the dsh web GUI: live translation of the model reasoning as it streams, in-place Chinese below each English reply, and one-line Chinese summaries for tool outputs and tool-call glosses — a standalone provider request that never enters the session transcript.
description.zh: dsh 网页端全链路中文翻译：思考过程实时翻译、英文回复就地中文、工具输出中文摘要与工具调用注释；翻译为独立提供方请求，不进入会话上下文。

description.en: Use your ChatGPT/Codex subscriptions in DSH, with image generation and web search support.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中使用你的 ChatGPT/Codex 订阅，并支持图像生成和 Web 搜索。

description.en: Offline Cordis/DSH plugin standards, scaffolding, static checks, runtime debugging, and performance gates.
description.zh: 离线搞定 Cordis/DSH 插件开发，提供规范检查、脚手架和调试工具，让插件开发更省心。

description.en: ⏱️ DeepSeek 价格区间计时工具 | DeepSeek Harness 插件：侧边栏高峰/空闲定价徽标 + 距半价倒计时 + 点击详情面板 + /price 命令
description.zh: 在侧边栏显示 DeepSeek 高峰/空闲价格，倒计时半价时段，点击查看详情，支持 /price 命令。

description.en: Galgame Doctor for DeepSeek Harness: safe translation-memory migration, engine evidence, strict QA, and rollback.
description.zh: 为Galgame汉化提供证据规划、无损脚本适配、严格质检与回滚，让翻译更精准可靠。

description.en: Dependency-free dynamic wallpapers for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面换上动态壁纸和主题，无需额外依赖，开箱即用。

description.en: SSH Remote IDE for DeepSeek Harness: connect via SSH and the IDE goes remote — explorer browses the server, editor reads/writes over SFTP, terminal is a live SSH PTY. Dual-face DSH plugin.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中直接选择 SSH 云端工作区，让智能体的文件操作和命令执行透明地跑在远程 Linux 服务器上，无需本地环境。

description.en: 提供 Grok-compatible 网页搜索、保留来源分页、Context7 与 Exa 文档检索、有界网页提取、站点映射、离线研究计划和只读诊断。
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增强搜索能力，支持网页检索、文档查询与离线研究，提升信息获取效率。

description.en: Local development service console for DSH: lists every listening service on the machine and lets users inspect, safely stop, or restart services that were started during development.
description.zh: DSH 本地开发服务控制台：列出本机所有监听服务，并让用户查看、以安全方式停止或重启开发过程中启动的服务。

description.en: DSH skin plugin: Alphacoders popular wallpapers as the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI background — gallery, search, local image upload, light/dark mask
description.zh: 把 Alphacoders 热门壁纸设为 DeepSeek Harness 网页背景，支持图库浏览、搜索、本地上传和明暗遮罩，让界面更好看。

description.en: DSH STORE — third-party plugin marketplace and guarded lifecycle manager for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装插件的第三方市场，还能安全地安装、更新和卸载。

description.en: Docker-isolated real-host lifecycle tests for DSH plugins across install, boot, tool registration, update, uninstall, reinstall, and recovery, with structured evidence.
description.zh: 在 Docker 隔离的真实宿主中测试 DSH 插件的安装、启动、工具注册、更新、卸载、重装与恢复生命周期，并输出结构化证据。

description.en: Genuine Liquid Glass theme for DSH Web UI: SVG feDisplacementMap edge refraction on input card, send button, bubbles, view tabs, queue dock and sidebar. Built-in animated demo wallpaper, customizable background blur & brightness, redesigned model selector popup, glass-styled buttons throughout, and a unique water-drop settings icon.
description.zh: 真正的液态玻璃 DSH 主题：SVG 边缘折射效果覆盖输入框、发送按钮、消息气泡、视图标签、队列坞和侧边栏。自带动态色块壁纸，可自定义背景模糊与亮度，重新设计的模型选择弹窗，全界面玻璃质感按钮，以及水滴形状的专属设置图标。

description.en: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的思考状态被看见——零侵入地将 reasoning 等待转化为由蓝到金、持续升温的动态 ThinkBar。
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页编辑器中显示动态推理等待指示条，让思考过程一目了然。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin — tokensforce gateway integration: one-login onboarding, provider groups, and a usage dashboard tab
description.zh: 快速接入 TokensForce 网关，支持一键登录、模型分组与用量看板，帮你轻松管理 AI 服务。

description.en: WorkBuddy / DeepSeek Harness 可视化财务工作台：20 个模块、异常闭环、25 个 AI 工作流，支持 MCP App 一键安装
一个面向 Codex 的公开 skill：编排当前 Agent 已有的可信安装器，并为 skills、插件和市场能力维护一份有来源依据的中文说明目录
description.zh: 编排已有可信安装器，为技能、插件和市场能力维护一份有据可查的中文说明目录。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件:侧边栏「已归档」面板,可查看/打开/取消归档会话 A side panel that lists, opens, and unarchives archived sessions.
description.zh: 在侧边栏快速查看、打开或取消归档历史会话，方便找回和管理旧对话。

description.en: 火山方舟订阅套餐剩余额度 DSH 侧边栏小组件（宿主代理 GetCodingPlanUsage + 浏览器 widget + 免重启 cookie 刷新工具）
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏实时显示火山方舟订阅套餐剩余额度，支持浏览器小组件和免重启刷新 Cookie，方便随时掌握用量。

description.en: Bind your ChatGPT account via official OAuth and chat with ChatGPT models inside DSH, using your Plus/Pro subscription quota.
description.zh: 通过官方 OAuth 绑定你的 ChatGPT 账号，在 DSH 内直接使用 ChatGPT 模型对话，消耗 Plus/Pro 订阅额度。

description.en: Windows desktop launcher for DeepSeek Harness: a one-click whale icon plus a sidebar More menu with Settings / Restart-Refresh / graceful Full Exit, and a scrollable multi-DSH picker on the cold-start card.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 桌面启动器：一键鲸鱼图标 + 侧栏「更多」菜单（设置 / 重启/刷新 / 优雅完全退出），冷启动卡片支持可滚动的多 DSH 候选选择。

description.en: Mi Home (米家) control for DeepSeek Harness agents — list homes/devices, read props, control devices behind a human approval gate.

description.zh: 跨会话记忆管理插件，让智能体记住历史对话，实现自我进化与上下文延续。

description.en: auto sync opencode-go models in dsh
description.zh: 一键自动同步 opencode-go 模型列表至 DSH，有则刷新无则新建，随时获取最新可用模型。

description.en: Freshness gate for the agent's test, typecheck, lint and build claims: each verification run becomes a receipt on tools/post-execute, file edits are tracked, and on agent/turn-stopping a claim whose latest receipt is stale, failed or has no readable result steers one more step naming the receipt and the files edited since.
description.zh: 为智能体的测试、类型检查、lint 与构建结论提供新鲜度检查：每次验证运行在 tools/post-execute 上记录为凭据，文件修改被跟踪；在 agent/turn-stopping 时，若结论对应的最新凭据已过期、失败或没有可读结果，则引导再走一步，并指出凭据与其后被修改的文件。

description.en: Read-only repo bootstrap scanner (repo_setup_scan tool): detects stack/tests/docs/git/db and recommends plugins, MCP servers and hygiene files.
description.zh: 只读仓库体检引导工具（repo_setup_scan）：识别技术栈/测试/文档/git/数据库线索，给出插件、MCP 与卫生文件的安装建议。

description.en: Web page reader for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): fetch any URL as clean Markdown/plain text, inventory links, read RSS/Atom feeds, inspect HTTP headers without the body — zero runtime dependencies, built-in http proxy support
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上网页阅读器：输入网址，秒变干净 Markdown/纯文本，还能看链接清单、读 RSS、查 HTTP 头，零依赖只读不泄露凭证。

description.en: Zero-cost, zero-hassle toolkit for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): one-click free model setup (Zhipu GLM-4-Flash + OpenRouter Ox-Alpha) for complete beginners. 小白零门槛零费用套件。
description.zh: 小白零门槛套件，一键装好 DSH 并免费接入大模型，不用花钱不用折腾。

description.en: DSH Web annotation/quote plugin (fork enhanced)
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 中选中助手消息文字即可引用，可加备注或留空，本地增强版更顺手。

description.en: Switch between Chat and Agent without leaving your DeepSeek Harness session.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中一键切换聊天和智能体模式，不用打断当前会话。

description.en: Mochi 🐶 — natural-language CAE plugin for DeepSeek Harness: one sentence in, a full CAD → mesh → solve → post-process pipeline out (CalculiX FEA + OpenFOAM CFD). | 自然语言驱动的 CAE插件：一句话跑通 CAD → 网格 → 求解 → 后处理全链路（CalculiX 结构 + OpenFOAM CFD）。
Observe-only provenance ledger over public DeepSeek Harness runtime evidence
description.zh: Observe-only provenance ledger over public DeepSeek Harness runtime evidence

description.en: Manage archived DSH sessions on Windows with search, batch restore and deletion, AI-assisted file retention, and verified local or network-directory backups.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上管理 DSH 已归档会话，支持搜索、批量取消归档与删除、AI 辅助文件保留，以及经过校验的本地或网络目录备份。

description.en: Runtime-first Debug Mode plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 专为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的运行时调试插件，实时追踪执行状态与日志，帮你快速定位问题，排查报错更轻松。

description.en: Warm light, warm dark, and system-aware eye-care themes for DSH Web
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 换上暖色护眼主题，支持亮色、暗色和跟随系统，告别冷白刺眼。

description.en: Memory protocol enforcement plugin: bridges the opencode-memory MCP server, forces memory_weave before tool calls, auto-ingests turns, and injects memory context into agent steps.
description.zh: 记忆强制协议插件：桥接 opencode-memory MCP 服务器，工具调用前强制 memory_weave、每轮自动存档、自动注入记忆上下文。

description.en: More agent presets for DSH, derived from other coding agents such as Qwen Code and iFlow.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供更多智能体预设，衍生自其他编程智能体（例如 Qwen Code、iFlow）。

description.en: Windows system and custom desktop notifications for DeepSeek Harness events: task completed, failed, running, awaiting approval, and awaiting answer. Click-to-jump to the session.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness事件的Windows系统和自定义桌面通知：任务已完成、失败、正在运行、等待批准和等待答复。单击以跳转到会话。

description.en: Archive manager (browse / unarchive / auto-rules) plus a Codex-style fisheye conversation rail for dsh.·归档管理与对话刻度尺插件
description.zh: 归档文件管理与对话刻度尺插件，支持浏览、解压、自动规则，并带 Codex 风格对话导航栏。

description.en: Settings section for archived sessions: browse by workspace, search, batch unarchive with the sidebar updating live, and optional auto-archive rules (idle days, keep-last-N per workspace) with a dry-run preview — plus a left-edge turn rail for jumping between turns of long conversations and ↑/↓ input history in the composer.
description.zh: 设置页的归档会话分区：按工作区分组浏览、搜索、批量取消归档，侧边栏实时恢复；自动归档规则（不活跃天数、每工作区保留条数）可选，执行前可试运行预览。另含长会话的左缘轮次刻度尺（悬停预览、点击跳转、Alt+↑/↓ 逐轮移动）与输入框 ↑/↓ 历史翻找。

description.en: In-app DSH plugin marketplace panel with curated and full catalogs, keyword and semantic search, Chinese translation, favorites, installed-state tracking, and install/update/uninstall via the official CLI.
description.zh: DSH 内置插件市场面板：精选与全量目录、关键词与语义搜索、中文翻译、收藏、已安装状态，以及通过官方命令安装、更新和卸载。

description.en: Voice input plugin for DeepSeek Harness: a minimal mic control in the composer with continuous bilingual recognition, context-aware term correction, punctuation, and a live waveform
description.zh: 在输入框右下角加个麦克风，说话就能打字，支持中英混说、自动加标点，还能实时看波形。

description.en: 让 DeepSeek Harness 自动重试商汤 429/QUOTA 等瞬时网关故障直到任务完成——启动时给所有 llm-pi-ai provider 热注入加固版 retryPolicy。
description.zh: 自动重试商汤等网关的429限流和瞬时故障，任务不再中断，无需手动干预。

description.en: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 SillyTavern 角色卡、世界书与预设创作插件，集成 Preset Plus。
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 编写 SillyTavern 角色卡、世界书和预设，内置 Preset Plus，让创作更顺手。

description.en: Theme skin plugin for DeepSeek Harness — built-in themes / static image / dynamic 360°-follow video, one-click from the sidebar & Settings; imports persist, default skins protected.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 主题皮肤插件：内置主题 / 静态图片 / 动态视频（鼠标环绕跟随帧），侧边栏一键切换，设置页完整管理；导入持久化、默认皮肤不可删。

description.en: AI驱动的分波分析自动化。
Blaxel sandbox execution plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Blaxel 远程沙箱执行环境，让模型在隔离环境中安全运行代码。

description.en: Adds session, project, and global controls in the DSH WebUI for skills, MCP servers, tools, prompt injections, approval escalation, and safety guards; enforcement is scoped to the current agent.
description.zh: 在 DSH WebUI 中为技能、MCP 服务器、工具、提示词注入、审批升权和安全守卫提供会话、项目与全局三级控制，并在当前 agent 作用域内强制执行。

description.en: DeepSeek Companion Enterprise — DeepSeek Harness 企业级伴侣插件：安全审计与 DLP、团队协作与知识管理、任务编排与断点续跑、多模型竞技场、执行轨迹分析、Prompt 工程工作台。
description.zh: 面向企业团队的 AI 工程效率与安全平台，提供安全审计、任务编排、多模型竞技和 Prompt 工作台，助力团队协作与开发提效。

description.en: Draft polish for the DSH composer: one-click AI polish of the input draft (sparkles button next to send), with optional conversation context and a configurable model channel.
description.zh: DSH 输入框草稿润色：发送键左侧一键调用 LLM 润色草稿，可携带会话上下文，模型渠道可配置。

description.en: Stop pasting API keys into DeepSeek Harness — reuse the OAuth tokens your local Codex CLI and Claude Code already hold as model routes, with subscription usage built in.
description.zh: 复用本地 Codex CLI 和 Claude Code 的 OAuth 登录态，免去 API Key，直接作为模型路由调用 LLM。

description.en: oh-my-pi advisor subsystem ported to DeepSeek Harness — independent reviewer models watch your agent and advise it (nit injects, concern/blocker steer)
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 会话挂上独立审查模型，实时观察智能体行为并给出建议或拦截，帮你把任务跑得更稳。

description.en: Decision-and-goal memory with lineage: explicit commands and a model tool record decisions deterministically, a status card re-anchors them across compaction, a lossless event stream with BM25+jieba retrieval backs it, and a scenario-level fidelity regression suite gates releases.
description.zh: 带血缘的决策与目标记忆：显式命令与模型工具确定性记录决策，状态卡跨压缩重锚定，无损事件流 + BM25 分词检索兜底，场景级保真回归集作发布门禁。

description.en: Live balance & quota panel for all your LLM providers, right in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏实时同步各 AI 服务商的余额与调用额度，随时掌握用量，告别跨平台查账。

description.en: Relay agent approval requests and questions to iMessage / Email / WeChat channels and resolve them by replying with the request number (#N 批准 / 拒绝 / 回答).
description.zh: 把 agent 的审批与提问诉求推送到 iMessage / 邮件 / 微信通道，回复 `#编号 批准/拒绝/回答` 即可处理，无需打开网页。

description.en: Tauri 2 desktop application for Windows that detects (or installs) the global @deepseek-ai/dsh package, launches the DSH Web server and embeds it in its own window, with system tray management, login autostart, a global hotkey and desktop shortcuts.
description.zh: 面向 Windows 的 Tauri 2 桌面应用：检测或自动安装全局 @deepseek-ai/dsh 包，启动 DSH Web 并嵌入自身窗口，支持系统托盘管理、登录自启、全局快捷键与桌面快捷方式。

description.en: Remote-control DeepSeek Harness from Telegram: stream replies, one-tap keyboards, whitelist-secured, zero inbound ports.
description.zh: 通过 Telegram 远程遥控 DeepSeek Harness，随时查看回复、一键操作，安全白名单，无需开放端口。

description.en: DSH 供应商用量查询插件 — 实时查询 Kimi/智谱/DeepSeek/火山方舟等套餐与余额, 在输入框下方显示用量读数条。Install: dsh plugin --profile web add github:heekei/dsh-usage
description.zh: 实时查看各大 AI 平台的套餐与余额，输入框旁直接显示用量进度条，随时掌握额度不超支。

description.en: Tavily web-search provider for DeepSeek Harness (ctx.web). Keyless or API-key modes with a configurable UI card; provider framework designed to be extended to more search APIs.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 接上统一网页搜索，一个插件搞定十种搜索后端，默认官方零配置。

description.en: 微信 × DeepSeek Harness (DSH)：进程内插件，扫码即用，双向消息/文件，wechat_notify 主动推送
description.zh: 微信 × DSH 进程内插件，扫码即用，双向收发消息/文件，支持主动推送通知。

description.en: An independent approval subagent judges every sandbox escalation, with a configurable model and an audit log.
description.zh: 由独立审批子代理裁决每次沙箱提权，可配置审批模型并带审计记录。

description.en: Turn raw data (CSV / pasted table / SQL results / DuckDB) into a structured Markdown report with business conclusions, metrics and charts.
description.zh: 把原始数据（CSV / 粘贴表格 / SQL 结果 / DuckDB）转成带业务结论、指标与图表的结构化 Markdown 报告。

description.en: Discord-first adapter for DeepSeek Harness — sessions, streaming, approvals and controls from a Discord guild.
description.zh: 在 Discord 服务器里直接操控 DeepSeek Harness，支持会话、流式输出、审批和权限控制，让团队协作更顺手。

description.en: Experience Memory for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加长期个人记忆，让智能体记住你的偏好和历史对话。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: Git status pill in the session header — branch, dirty counts, ahead/behind, recent commits & changed files.
Native Graphify knowledge graph plugin providing 10 code intelligence tools, topological search, god nodes discovery, and PR blast radius triage.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生 Graphify 知识图谱支持，包含 10 个代码智能工具、拓扑搜索、核心节点发现与 PR 影响分析。

description.en: Codex-style message navigator for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a tick per user message along the conversation edge, hover or click to preview and smooth-jump to the message, with full history auto-loading.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供 Codex 风格的消息导航器：对话边缘为每条用户消息生成刻度，悬停或点击即可预览并平滑跳转到对应消息，自动加载完整历史记录。

description.en: Mnemosyne memory for DeepSeek Harness: remember / recall / forget / stats / sleep tools, embedded skill, auto-setup, optional auto-sync/prefetch, and a Settings panel. Data lives under ~/.dsh/mnemosyne.
description.zh: Mnemosyne 记忆插件 for DeepSeek Harness：提供 remember / recall / forget / stats / sleep 工具、内嵌技能、Settings 面板和可选的自动记忆功能。

description.en: Model catalog, portraits, Agent selection, and multimodal runtimes for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 接入多种模型，支持文本、图像、语音等多模态能力，灵活切换。

description.en: DSH community plugin: multi-host SSH tunnel + SSHManager (better-sidebar)
description.zh: 给 dsh-better-sidebar 加上多主机 SSH 隧道和 SSH 管理，远程连接、SFTP 传文件都更顺手。

description.en: dsh = 一台"所有零件都能换"的智能体机器。写插件 = 造一个零件装上去。本项目展示怎样开发一个天气插件：天气插件的设计：Node 端调 Open-Meteo 拿温度风力，浏览器端用这些数据画一张会动的天气卡片。
description.zh: 给智能体装上天气感知能力，自动获取实时温度风力，并在浏览器里渲染一张会动的天气卡片。

description.en: Kilo Gateway free models for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
agent工厂 让多个agent协同 deepseek harness插件
description.zh: 让多个智能体协同工作，像工厂流水线一样分工合作，提升复杂任务的完成效率。

description.en: 一个好看、简单、实用的余额监视器｜DeepSeek Harness 插件：官方余额快照 + ds_balance 工具 + 峰谷计价区间 + Matrix/原生双风格徽章
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：DeepSeek API 余额实时监测（官方 /user/balance 快照 + ds_balance 工具 + 峰谷计价状态 + Matrix/原生双风格侧边栏徽章）

description.en: Profile-aware keyboard shortcuts for DSH Web: supports Question and Approval cards, Standard/Vim/Custom profiles, and capability-gated Session and Workspace navigation.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供按 profile 管理的键盘快捷键：支持 Question 和 Approval 卡片、Standard/Vim/Custom 配置，并按能力提供 Session 与 Workspace 导航。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness（dsh web）额度插件：跟随当前模型显示官方余额或 OpenCode Go 订阅用量，支持本会话估算、跨会话累计消耗与可视化设置。
Dracula theme plugin for the DSH Web GUI: the classic dark palette and the Soft variant registered into the native theme runtime, one-click switching with a persisted choice.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的德古拉主题插件：经典暗色配色与 Soft 变体接入原生主题系统，一键切换并记住选择。

description.en: Safety-first five-agent orchestration plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), with leases, scopes, checkpoints, validation, and recovery.
description.zh: 把复杂工程任务变成一场有纪律的五智能体地牢探险，自带租约、检查点、验证与恢复机制，安全又省心。

description.en: Self-maintaining handoff memory per working directory and git branch: records turns, folds them into concise Markdown, and injects the result into future sessions from ~/.agent/agent-handoff, byte-compatible with pi-handoff.
description.zh: 每个工作目录与 git 分支自动维护 handoff.md：记录回合、折叠为简洁 Markdown 并注入后续会话，存储于 ~/.agent/agent-handoff，与 pi-handoff 字节级兼容。

description.en: Cron task scheduler for DSH: on schedule, automatically creates a new session and injects your prompt as its first message, with task history and manual run/stop controls. Its sidebar entry is provided by dsh-knj-menu; install together: dsh plugin add dsh-scheduler dsh-knj-menu.
description.zh: 定时任务调度器：按 Cron 表达式到点自动新建 DSH 会话并注入提示词执行，支持任务历史、手动运行与启停。侧边栏入口由 dsh-knj-menu 提供，一条命令安装：dsh plugin add dsh-scheduler dsh-knj-menu。

description.en: Paste non-image files or folders into the chat composer as native @path references, or drag them in as absolute paths, instead of the images-only error.
description.zh: 将非图片文件或文件夹以原生 @path 引用粘贴进聊天输入框，或拖放插入绝对路径，替代仅支持图片的报错。

description.en: Daily news digest from 46 curated RSS sources, edited by the model already configured in dsh, delivered to your IM via webhook, and broadcast in the chat like a regular model reply with zero context cost.
description.zh: 每日要闻日报：46 个精选 RSS 源，用 dsh 里已配好的模型做主编式编辑，经 webhook 送到微信/Telegram，并以模型回答的样式插播在对话里，零上下文消耗。

description.en: Rules execution engine for dsh: parses AGENTS.md, hard-blocks rule-violating tool calls, text-based B/D rule auditing, /guard command, version-guard for versioned files, and free-zone support (engine skips free-zone sections).
description.zh: dsh 规则执行引擎：解析 AGENTS.md、硬拦违反规则的工具调用、文本纠察与审计、/guard 命令、版本化文件守卫、自由区域支持（引擎跳过自由区内容）。

description.en: Right-click a folder in Windows File Explorer to open it as a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) workspace: register, launch DSH, and switch the page to it. 资源管理器右键「在此处打开 DSH 工作区」。
description.zh: 在Windows资源管理器中右键文件夹即可设为DSH工作区，并快速启动会话。

description.en: Import, validate, manage, and migrate Agent Skills for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), Claude Code, Codex, and other AI coding agents.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面里一站式导入、校验和管理各类 AI 编程助手的技能包，轻松迁移无缝复用。

description.en: Persistent token-usage ledger and Web Usage dashboard for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化 token 用量账本和 Web Usage 仪表盘。

description.en: dsh-usage-ledger（Token 费用统计）— 自动记下每笔对话花了多少 Token、多少钱（按对话、按天、累计都能查），价格自动跟着官方最新价走、支持多家国产厂商，低谷时段自动按便宜价算，预算超了自动提醒还能拦下调用，带可视化仪表盘。
description.zh: 自动记录每笔对话的Token和费用，支持按对话、按天、累计查询，价格自动更新，预算超限自动提醒并拦截调用，附可视化仪表盘。

description.en: [building……] DeepSeek Harness's web enhancement plugin—brings task dashboards, Git graphs, workspace file panels, balance displays, and graph recognition into the DSH web interface.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增强网页体验，提供任务看板、定时调度、Git 图谱及文件预览等实用面板。

description.en: Cloudflare Code Mode MCP global bundle for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — mcp__cloudflare__* tools + cfbridge skill + wrangler passthrough
description.zh: 把 Cloudflare 官方 MCP 工具、cfbridge 技能和 wrangler 命令打包成 DSH 全局桥接，让你在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接调用 Cloudflare 能力。

description.en: Full-screen lightbox for chat images with zoom, drag pan, download, and keyboard or touch navigation.
description.zh: 聊天图片全屏查看器：点击对话中的图片打开灯箱，支持缩放、拖拽平移、滚轮缩放、文件名显示、下载保存，以及键盘方向键与移动端滑动切换。

description.en: DSH 插件：回答前先预估 token 用量与 DeepSeek API 费用，回答后展示实际账单（Web 聊天内嵌行）

Raises Node's HTTP headers/body timeouts for the whole DSH process (default 30 min, proxy-aware) so Ollama and LM Studio models that stay silent while thinking or generating a large tool call are not cut off at 5 minutes; replaces the node_modules undici patch.
description.zh: 全局调高 Node 的 HTTP 超时时间，避免慢速本地模型（如 Ollama、LM Studio）因静默超 5 分钟被中断。

description.en: Automatic and user-customizable Fluent-style icons for DSH Settings and sidebar actions, with offline SVG packs and original-icon preservation.
description.zh: 为 DSH 设置和侧边栏自动分配并支持自定义的 Fluent 风格图标，离线内置 SVG，默认保留插件原图标。

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨会话长期记忆，分层管理事实与经验，自动蒸馏并支持回滚，让 AI 越用越懂你。

description.en: Transactional uninstall engine: every destructive action runs validate/preview/execute/undo with Saga rollback, WAL crash recovery, hash-chain audit, hardlink dedup, and a Bayesian oracle that predicts success probability before you commit.
description.zh: 事务化卸载引擎：每个破坏性动作走 validate/preview/execute/undo 四段式并带 Saga 回滚，WAL 崩溃恢复、hash chain 审计、硬链接去重，提交前先知推演成功率。

description.en: Offline mirror of the official DeepSeek Harness documentation as a dsh skill: 168 site pages (EN/zh) plus 52 repository-only reference docs, with topic navigation and a full-text search index for plugin development.
description.zh: 以 dsh-plugin-dev-kb 技能内置 DeepSeek Harness 官方文档离线镜像：站点中英 168 页 + 仓库补充文档 52 篇，带主题导航与全文检索，编写插件时随时查阅。

description.en: 🚀 为 DeepSeek Harness 而生的左右侧栏：左侧按工作区浏览会话（状态点/分组/搜索/移动到文件夹），右侧就地浏览文件 + Git 面板（状态/暂存/diff/提交/历史/分支）—— 会话管理像 IDE 一样顺手。
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供左右侧栏：左侧管理工作区会话，右侧浏览文件与 Git 操作，让会话管理像 IDE 一样顺手。

description.en: Sidebar session-search toggle between title and content: title filters by session title, content searches historical messages through DSH's built-in full-text index, grouped per session with the strongest snippet and message-type tags.
description.zh: 侧边栏会话搜索开关，标题 / 内容一键切换：标题按会话标题过滤，内容经 DSH 自带全文索引搜索历史消息关键词，结果按会话聚合，附最强命中片段与消息类型标签。

description.en: Declutter the DSH settings nav: fold third-party plugin entries under collapsible group rows, with bookmark-style custom groups, a fold toggle, and auto classification (market tags → name rules → your AI model).
description.zh: 设置面板导航整理：第三方插件入口折叠为可展开的分组行，支持书签式自定义分组、折叠开关与自动分类（市场标签 → 名称规则 → AI 模型三级兜底）。

description.en: Windows desktop companion for DeepSeek Harness: update checker, server start/stop, system tray, graphical console, and one-click installer.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 桌面伴侣：更新检查、服务器启停、系统托盘、图形控制台与一键安装。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的插件：灵动的小精灵【sprite（精灵）+ -ly（活泼地）】桌面精灵与背景设置
description.zh: 给 DSH 界面加个会动的小精灵，实时显示 AI 状态并跟着鼠标跑，让枯燥的等待变生动有趣。

description.en: Chinese writing de-AI plugin (AI-isms / AI writing / humanize): say "去掉AI味" to rewrite text, "写的不错" to auto-learn new AI words into the avoid list. Free from the Zhihu "去AI味写作技巧" community.
description.zh: 中文写作去 AI 味技能插件（AI-isms / AI writing / humanize）：说"去掉AI味"即重写，说"写的不错"自动把新 AI 词汇记入规避表。由知乎圈子"去AI味写作技巧"社区免费提供。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的中文学术论文检索 Bundle：复用 Academic Paper Search MCP，支持多源检索去重、引用核验、引文图谱、MeSH、试验检索与审计导出。
description.zh: 中文学术论文检索插件，支持多源去重、引用核验和引文图谱，帮您高效完成文献调研。

description.en: Archived-session manager for DeepSeek Harness: grouped archive panel with restore and delete.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话归档管理：分组归档面板，支持恢复与删除。

description.en: A `/backstory` command and tool that annotate each line with the git commit that last touched it and the agent turn + prompt that wrote it, from a persistent per-line ledger (drift-proof by content hash), DSH-* commit trailers, or the live session log.
description.zh: /backstory 命令与工具：为每一行标注最后改动它的 git 提交，以及写下它的 agent 轮次与提示词；数据取自按行持久化的账本（以内容哈希防漂移）、DSH-* 提交尾注或实时会话日志。

description.en: Inspect and simulate DSH context consumption with trajectory and inventory views, and create, inject, import, or safely repair session messages through the integrated Message Forge.
description.zh: 上下文控制台：通过轨迹墙与库存视图检查并模拟 DSH 上下文消费，并由内置消息锻造台创建、注入、导入或安全修复会话消息。

description.en: Discord-native remote controller for DeepSeek Harness: drive persisted coding-agent sessions from DMs, mention-gated guild channels, and threads, with slash commands, progress updates, approvals, structured questions, and image and text attachments.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Discord 原生远程控制器：通过私信、需提及机器人的服务器频道及 Thread 操作持久化的编程 Agent Session，并支持斜杠命令、进度更新、工具审批、结构化问题、图片和文本附件。

description.en: Opt-in detached watchdog for the DSH Web process with snapshot-checked repair and explicit patch restoration.
description.zh: Opt-in detached watchdog for the DSH Web process with snapshot-checked repair and explicit patch restoration.

description.en: Command Code Provider API chat for DSH with a Host-held API key, discovered model catalog, effort defaults, an optional zero-data-retention header, quota meters, and per-model OpenAI or Anthropic protocol selection.
description.zh: DSH 的 Command Code Provider API 聊天：Host 持有 API key，支持模型发现、effort 默认值、可选零数据保留请求头、额度仪表，以及按模型选择 OpenAI 或 Anthropic 协议。

description.en: Message recall (撤回) plugin for the DSH Web UI: one undo button on each user message that removes the turn and everything after it, durably, without reverting code changes.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 消息撤回插件。

description.en: Skill studio for DeepSeek Harness: visualize every agent skill (name, description, source, nested flag, model/user invocation), view and edit the full SKILL.md body, toggle model/user invocation, and mine DSH session logs to extract reusable personal skills that the agent auto-loads — from the web settings panel and via skillmgr_* / skillmgr_extract_* tools.
description.zh: DSH skill 可视化与管理插件：在设置面板列出全部 skill（含来源、嵌套标记与模型/用户调用状态），查看并编辑 SKILL.md 正文，一键启用/禁用模型与用户调用；并可从会话日志提取可复用内容，沉淀为 agent 可自动加载的个人 skill。提供 skillmgr_list/get/save/policy 及 skillmgr_extract_* 工具。

description.en: Switch the language of the agent's thinking/reasoning process (chain-of-thought): 简体中文, English, Русский, Français, Deutsch, Español, 日本語, 한국어 and more, or auto-follow the system locale. Adds a Settings → General row, a system-prompt instruction (per-prompt assembly, applies to new sessions), and the /thinking-language command.
description.zh: 切换智能体思考过程（推理/链式思考）的语言：支持简体中文、英文、俄语、法语、德语、西班牙语、日语、韩语等，或跟随系统界面语言（自动）。新增「设置 → 通用」中的思考语言选择行、系统提示词注入（每次组装提示词时求值，新会话生效）与 /thinking-language 命令。

description.en: Persistent local token usage sidebar and settings page for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), with automatic history discovery and a durable SQLite ledger.
description.zh: 在侧边栏持久显示今日、昨日及累计的 token 用量，方便随时掌握消耗情况。

description.en: A-share and US stock trading toolkit for DSH agents: realtime quotes, OHLCV klines, ADX three-state regime signals and simple backtest previews via EastMoney. Read-only, never places orders.
description.zh: DSH agent 的 A股/美股交易工具箱：实时行情、OHLCV K线、ADX 三状态市场分类信号与简易回测预览，数据源东方财富。只读设计，永不下单。

description.en: One-shot mcp-unity integration for DeepSeek Harness: bundled MCP server with zero manual config lets the agent drive the Unity editor through 34 tools - scenes, game objects, transforms, materials, prefabs, menu items, play mode, tests and console logs - with auto-reconnect.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 一键接入 mcp-unity：内置 MCP 服务端，零配置让 Agent 直接操控 Unity 编辑器——场景、GameObject、变换、材质、Prefab、菜单、播放模式、测试与控制台日志等 34 个工具，支持自动重连。完整中文文档。

description.en: A floating water-ball pet plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面加一只漂浮水球宠物，会随会话状态变色，还能拖动、调大小。

description.en: Composer-dock balance/usage readout for DeepSeek, Kimi Coding, OpenCode Go, Zhipu, MiniMax, OpenRouter and OpenAI Codex — provider-based, 2s polling, 5min cache.
description.zh: 输入框下方按 provider 展示 DeepSeek、Kimi Coding、OpenCode Go、智谱、MiniMax、OpenRouter、OpenAI Codex 的余额/用量，2 秒轮询、5 分钟缓存。

description.en: Selectable Codex model provider for DeepSeek Harness over the local Codex app-server
description.zh: 将 Codex 作为可选模型提供方接入 DSH，通过本地服务调用 Codex 智能体完成对话与任务。

description.en: Bounded local memory with CBDC authority gating: SQLite + FTS5 claims, scoped recall with explainable use/verify/ignore decisions and a full audit trail, /memory commands, ≤3-claim/1200-char injection per call, no extra model call.
description.zh: 有界本地记忆 + CBDC 权威门控：SQLite + FTS5 claims，作用域召回并给出可解释的采用/核验/忽略决策与完整审计轨迹，/memory 命令，每次注入 ≤3 条/1200 字符，不增加额外模型调用。

description.en: Session insights and one-click shareable HTML replay for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的会话洞察，并可一键导出为可分享的 HTML 回放。

description.en: Move, archive, restore, portable backup/export and import sessions across workspaces in the DeepSeek Harness web UI.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中跨工作区移动、归档、恢复、可携式备份/导出与导入会话。

description.en: Shut down Windows after DeepSeek Harness tasks complete — button-armed, cancellable countdown. 任务完成后自动关机（按钮开启，倒计时可取消）。Zero-dependency DSH plugin.
description.zh: 任务跑完自动关机，按钮开启可取消，过夜跑长任务省心又安全。

description.en: Token attention management panel for DeepSeek Harness: per-task/day/week/month token usage and cost tracking (input hit/miss, output, reasoning), DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing, task-type recognition, and advice on when to switch sessions, write a hand-off, or compact context.
description.zh: Token 注意力管理面板：按任务/日/周/月记录 token 消耗与费用（命中/未命中/输出/推理四桶），支持 DeepSeek 峰谷计价与任务类型识别，并给出换对话、写 hand-off、压缩上下文的建议。

description.en: Windows system-tray launcher for DeepSeek Harness Web: start, stop, restart, open the Web UI, tail logs, live status icon, and a launch-at-login toggle.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 的 Windows 托盘启动器：托盘图标一键启动、停止、重启服务，打开 Web UI、查看日志，实时状态图标，并支持开机自启开关。

description.en: Structured vision evidence (OCR/layout/semantics) plus a USB camera capture tool for a "shoot-look-adjust" debug loop; backends: Ollama, DeepSeek, Xiaomi.
description.zh: 结构化视觉证据（OCR/版面/语义）+ USB 摄像头拍摄工具，支持"拍-看-改"调试闭环；后端支持 Ollama、DeepSeek、小米。

description.en: 微信公众号 AI 写作插件，跑在 DeepSeek Harness 里：一条命令装上完整写作管线（选题→写作→质量门禁→排版→配图→草稿箱），定时默认只进草稿箱，群发永远人工。MIT 开源。
description.zh: 一条命令装好微信公众号AI写作全流程，自动选题、写作、排版配图，定时进草稿箱，群发永远人工。

description.en: 把 DeepSeek Harness 对话里的主语人称「我/你/I/me」渲染成 DeepSeek 蓝鲸图标（DSH 插件）
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 对话里的主语人称「我/你/I/me」渲染成 DeepSeek 蓝鲸图标（DSH 插件）

description.en: Move sessions across workspaces by drag-and-drop with true in-place migration; recover orphaned or unregistered sessions; re-point stale workspaces after folder renames. IDs and history stay intact, with per-step backup and rollback.
description.zh: 拖拽跨工作区真迁移会话，找回失联与未记账会话，文件夹改名后一键原地重定向工作区；ID 与历史原样保留，步步备份回滚。

description.en: Opens WSL Linux paths from DeepSeek Harness chat in the Windows default app or Explorer.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 聊天里的 WSL Linux 路径在 Windows 默认程序或资源管理器中打开。

description.en: Extracting and iterating skills from daily conversations with AI
description.zh: 从日常 AI 对话中自动提炼可复用的技能和项目记忆，让每次聊天都沉淀为长期资产。

description.en: Hand a DSH web session to the locally installed Claude Code CLI: a per-session engine selector (DSH | Claude Code), Claude models and reasoning effort in the model seat, Claude permission modes in place of the access-mode selector, and permission requests, AskUserQuestion and ExitPlanMode routed to the native DSH approval, question and plan-review cards. The stream is written as native DSH session events, so the built-in transcript, tool cards and nested subagents render it; Claude slash commands merge into the command palette; the CLI is held by a detached broker, so plugin updates and DSH restarts do not interrupt a running turn.
description.zh: 把一个 dsh web 会话交给本机 Claude Code CLI 驱动：输入框内的引擎选择器（DSH | Claude Code）按会话切换，模型座换成 Claude 的模型与 reasoning effort，访问模式换成 Claude 权限档；权限请求、AskUserQuestion、ExitPlanMode 分别接到 dsh 原生的审批卡、提问卡与计划审核卡。Claude 的流写成 dsh 原生会话事件，由内建转录、工具卡片与嵌套子 agent 渲染；斜杠命令并入命令面板；CLI 由独立 broker 持有，插件更新与 dsh 重启都不中断进行中的轮次。

description.en: Technical documentation agent preset for DeepSeek Harness: template-driven writing with a self-learning template library, AI-flavor removal for tech docs, and a quality-assurance toolkit (document audit, cross-document consistency, numbering resequencing, version sync, PDF and Word export, screenshot automation).
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的技术文档撰写 Agent 模式：模板驱动写作与自学习模板库、技术文档去 AI 味，以及文档质量保障工具集（量化体检、多文档口径一致性校验、图/表编号重排、版本同步检查、Word/PDF 导出与界面截图自动化）。

description.en: A DSH sidebar plugin that shows AnySearch references as cards, with the search query, source snippets and highlighted keywords in the right sidebar.一个 DSH 侧边栏插件，把 AnySearch 的搜索结果以卡片形式展示在右侧侧边栏中，包括搜索词、来源摘要和关键词高亮。
Codex-style /btw command: answer side questions in a conversation-seeded subagent (fork provider), rendered in the UI without entering the main session history.
description.zh: Codex 风格 /btw 指令：在继承主会话上下文的子代理中回答附带问题，答案展示在界面里、不写入主会话历史。

description.en: VSCode-style uncommitted-changes sidebar docked to the right of the DSH web conversation page: staged / unstaged / untracked file groups, status badges, per-file +/− line counts, click-to-expand diff, rename as old → new, untracked content preview, and open with the system default application.
description.zh: 停靠在 DSH Web 对话页右侧的 VSCode 风格未提交改动侧边栏：已暂存/更改/未跟踪三组文件、状态徽标与每文件 +/− 行数，点击展开单文件 diff，支持重命名显示、未跟踪文件内容预览及调用系统默认应用打开文件。

description.en: Labnana image generation for DeepSeek Harness: text-to-image / image-to-image / precise editing with credits estimation, subscription balance and web settings UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Labnana 图片生成：文生图 / 图生图 / 精准编辑，含积分预估、余额查询与网页设置界面。

description.en: My tasks, where to GO?????
description.zh: 基于 DSH 的多智能体编排调度系统，将主会话与专业子智能体组合，自动分配任务、协同处理复杂流程。

description.en: Bring OpenCode Zen's free models to DeepSeek Harness — zero config, no API key, catalog discovered live from upstream
description.zh: 把 OpenCode Zen 的免费模型一键接入 DeepSeek Harness，无需配置和 API 密钥，即插即用。

description.en: A content-aware PDF reading plugin for vision models: profiles each page for figures (vector and raster), tables, formula risk and double-column layout, then applies content-aware hybrid extraction, rendering figure/table/formula pages as high-DPI region crops. Provides a low-resolution preview to understand the page layout, and renders a specified region at high resolution. Packaged as multiple tools for agents.
description.zh: 面向视觉模型的内容感知 PDF 读取插件：逐页分析图（矢量与栅格）、表格、公式风险与双栏排版，基于内容识别进行混合提取，图表/公式页渲染成高 DPI 区域裁切。提供低清预览以理解页面概况并支持指定选区获取高清渲染。功能包装为多个工具供Agent使用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 状态灯插件：角色表情状态灯 + 聊天框气泡，完成任务/出错/提问时自动弹出（dsh-plugin）

Message-level full-text search across DSH sessions via an FTS5 trigram index (user / assistant / steering / tool with per-kind filters), deduplicated results across fork/continued sessions, read-only context preview with auto-scroll to the focused message, one-click jump to the real session, and incremental/full index rebuild with health check; zh/en i18n follows the Host locale service.
description.zh: DSH 会话消息级全文检索浏览器：FTS5 trigram 索引按消息检索（用户/助手/系统注入/工具四类，可按类型筛选），fork/续接会话结果自动去重，只读上下文预览自动滚动定位焦点消息，一键跳转真实会话；支持增量/全量重建索引与健康检查；界面中英双语跟随 Host locale 服务。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness all-in-one: no model switching — regular DeepSeek auto-routes to vision & image gen. Multi-backend: Gemini + any OpenAI-compatible (GPT-4o, Qwen-VL, GLM-4V, gpt-image, DALL-E, Flux, OpenRouter). gemini_vision/gemini_generate_image/gemini_optimize_image with vision self-check. Better than modlens.
description.zh: 自动路由多模型后端，无缝支持识图、绘图与OCR，不用手动切换就能搞定视觉任务。

description.en: Unified Godot asset and project-goal management for DSH: godot_* model tools, a /gap REST surface, and a better-sidebar UI with asset manager, scene-tree viewer, and Git panel.
description.zh: Godot 资产与项目目标统一管理：godot_* 模型工具 + /gap REST 路由 + better-sidebar 界面（资产管理器 / 场景树查看器 / Git 版本控制）。

description.en: State-oriented task graph kernel for the agentic era - a DeepSeek Harness bundle: 13 octie_* tools, octie Cordis service & events, realtime DAG task panel, bundled agent preset. State is derived, not set.
description.zh: 面向智能体时代的状态化任务图内核，提供13个octie工具、实时DAG任务面板和预设代理，让任务状态自动推导、可视化编排。
把 Claude Code 的对话、技能、记忆和插件资源一键迁移到 DeepSeek Harness，无缝衔接你的工作流。

description.en: DSH 原生 Cordis 插件：知识库(FTS5)、路由强制、会话记忆、沙箱执行(Think-in-Code)——context-window 减负
description.zh: 把大文件、网页和工具输出挡在上下文之外，只把答案带回来，给窗口减负。

description.en: DSH plugin for switching conversation language between Chinese and English
description.zh: 在中文和英文之间一键切换对话语言，AI 会跟着用对应语言思考和回复，设置即时生效。

description.en: Share any excerpt of a conversation.
description.zh: 分享任意段落的对话。

description.en: Turns session context into a deep-sea moyu (slack-off) game in a floating window — your hand sinks as context grows, touch a fish and server-rolled dice decide the mint of a holographic collectible card across five oceans, with a fish pond and a GitHub-linked leaderboard.
description.zh: 把会话 context 变成浮窗深海摸鱼：context 越长手沉得越深，摸到鱼后服务端掷骰定胜负，中卡铸造镭射收藏卡，五大洋摸鱼、鱼池养成、GitHub 绑定全球排行榜。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 飞书通知插件：在需要用户操作或对话结束时发送飞书机器人提醒，并支持持久化配置。
description.zh: 在需要用户确认或对话结束时，自动通过飞书机器人发送提醒，让你不错过重要节点。

description.en: Control a HarmonyOS phone from the DSH web UI with AI: live H.264 screen mirroring, mouse touch and system keys, hilog streaming, and agentic tools that let the model read the screen, locate UI controls, then tap, long-press, press keys, or type.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页中用 AI 操控鸿蒙手机：实时 H.264 投屏、触控与系统按键、hilog 日志，并让模型读屏、定位 UI 控件，再执行点击/长按/按键/输入。

description.en: DeepSeek API pricing reminder with a game HUD: Beijing-time countdowns to peak/off-peak windows, a draggable HP capsule with day/moonlight themes, and a nine-realm cultivation system with breakthrough animations.
description.zh: 按北京时间提醒 DeepSeek API 定价高峰/空闲时段的游戏化插件：可拖动血条胶囊、日夜主题、隐藏彩蛋与修仙突破动画。

description.en: Native Jupyter-style notebook for DeepSeek Harness: real ipykernel sidecar + VS Code-aligned cell UI, tqdm progress, inline figures, per-cell AI revision.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接跑 Jupyter 笔记本，支持实时内核、进度条和图表展示，还能让 AI 帮你改代码。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 峰谷计费插件：高峰时段发送前确认（可勾选本次高峰段内不再提示），支持将消息排队到空闲时段（半价）自动发送；可拖拽悬浮队列窗口、调整发送顺序与时间。
description.zh: 把高峰时段的请求自动排队到空闲时段发送，享受半价优惠，省钱又省心。

description.en: 原生UI界面。面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的虚拟机沙箱插件：它基于 OrbStack 为每个会话提供独立的 debian/alpine 沙箱虚拟机，在会话视图环中新增「虚拟机」页签，支持查看/启动/休眠/删除和详细配置展示，同时为模型提供 `vm_list`、`vm_create`、`vm_exec`、`vm_delete` 工具，并内置全局运行上限、闲置自动休眠、归档/删除自动清理等资源治理能力。
description.zh: 为每个会话配备独立虚拟机沙箱，让AI在隔离环境中安全跑代码，支持一键启停与闲置自动清理。

description.en: Prompt library above the DSH composer — a 📚 button expands a searchable panel to insert saved prompts into the draft with one click (appends, never overwrites), persisted in a host-side JSON file.
description.zh: 输入框上方的提示词库：📚 按钮展开可搜索面板，点条目一键填入草稿（追加不覆盖）；数据以 JSON 文件保存在 Host 侧。

description.en: DSH WebUI session query navigation with a faint conversation-edge rail, a hover list of real user queries, and click-to-jump back to the matching bubble.
description.zh: DSH WebUI 会话提问导航：对话区右缘淡色短横线，悬停列出真实用户提问，点击跳回对应气泡。

description.en: Local long-term schedule panel: top-bar "日程" text button, today/week/history month-calendar views with stats, completion checkmarks with per-day history, schedule↔conversation links with click-to-jump, recurring tasks (daily/weekly), optional auto carry-over for unfinished one-time tasks, and dailytask_* agent tools.
description.zh: 本地长期日程面板:顶栏「日程」文字按钮、今天/本周/历史月历统计视图、完成打勾(按天记录历史)、日程↔会话链接点击跳转、重复日程(每天/每周)、一次性日程可选未完成自动顺延,以及 dailytask_* agent 工具。

description.en: A-share technical analysis (ladder dynamics) plugin: chanlun structure via struct_calc, hang-slope D+/D/D- and strong-start E+/E/E- signals, with an in-app settings page and work prompts.
description.zh: A股技术面研判（架梯动力学）插件：基于缠论结构给出挂坡 D⁺/D/D⁻ 与强势起步 E⁺/E/E⁻ 信号，附设置页与工作提示词。

description.en: Canvas task board ported from CodexFF: hierarchical parent/child tasks with boundaries, snap-aligned draggable panels in a conversation view tab, plus `board_*` / `task_*` agent tools and a sync skill.
description.zh: 移植自 CodexFF 的画布任务看板：父子层级任务树与任务边界，会话「任务看板」tab 内磁吸对齐的可拖拽面板，配套 `board_*` / `task_*` 模型工具与同步技能。

description.en: DSH思考强度调节优化插件，模仿Codex中GPT5.6Terra等高级模型专属的档位吸附滑条，并解锁Low、Medium等档位。   |    DSH Thinking Intensity Adjustment Optimization Plugin, which mimics the exclusive snap-to-gear slider of advanced models like GPT5.6 Terra in Codex, and unlocks gears such as Low, Medium, etc.
description.zh: Thinking-strength slider: replaces the composer model seat's reasoning-effort button list with a snap-to-step slider for the DSH web UI.

description.en: 增强dsh左侧工作区区侧栏——每个工作区文件夹下提供 任务/文件/Git 子 Tab，含文件树与右侧预览、Git 的 Changes/Graph 双视图、搜索、视图切换与添加工作区，界面样式对齐默认插件。
description.zh: 给左侧工作区文件夹加上任务、文件、Git子页签，文件树带预览，Git双视图，还支持搜索和切换，用起来更顺手。

description.en: DSH Web 插件：右侧工作区侧边栏（文件树 / git 差异 / 提交历史 / @文件 引用）
description.zh: DSH Web 插件：右侧工作区侧边栏（文件树 / git 差异 / 提交历史 / @文件 引用）

description.en: Bridge your pi extension, codex plugin or claude code plugin to dsh (DeepSeek Harness)
description.zh: 将 Pi、Codex、Claude Code 插件桥接到 DeepSeek Harness，一站式安装管理各类智能体插件。

description.en: dsh-crosstalk — cross-session messaging for DSH, Claude Code-style, plus event-driven auto-collab coordination
description.zh: 让 DSH 各会话间直接互发消息，还能按事件自动触发协作，无需后台守护进程。

description.en: DeepSeek 账户控制台：实时余额监控 / 用量与成本统计 / 消费额度管理 / 全局悬浮 HUD（官方 API 直连，Key 仅存本机）
description.zh: DeepSeek 账户控制台，实时监控余额与用量，全局悬浮 HUD 显示费用，官方 API 直连，密钥仅存本机。

description.en: DeepSeek usage monitor as a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: balance / day-month-all-time token & cost panel in the chat UI with drag-reorder config, plus an optional local usage proxy
description.zh: 在聊天界面实时查看 DeepSeek 余额、Token 用量和花费，支持拖拽排序，还能开本地代理统计。

description.en: One-click Git commit plugin for DSH: the session model splits workspace changes into reviewed Conventional Commits batches, with built-in sensitive-file filtering.
Reads assistant replies aloud via Fish Audio API only (bring your own key): per-message read-aloud, auto-read toggle, and a settings page for model, voice reference_id, encrypted API key, and proxy.
description.zh: 朗读助手回复（仅支持 Fish Audio API，需自备 Key）：逐条朗读、自动朗读开关，设置页可配模型、音色 reference_id、加密 API Key 与代理。

description.en: Git and source-control plugin suite for DeepSeek Harness: local git operations plus GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps and Gitea adapters, with self-evolving memory.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Git 与源码管理插件套件：本地 git 操作，外加 GitHub、GitLab、Bitbucket、Azure DevOps 与 Gitea 适配器，并带自演进记忆。

description.en: Hebrew RTL rendering for the web GUI: per-block direction by dominant script, bidi-safe input fields, and RTL-aware Cmd+Left/Right line navigation.
description.zh: 为 Web 界面提供希伯来语 RTL 渲染：按主导文字判定每个块的方向，输入框的 bidi 处理，以及在 RTL 行上方向正确的 Cmd+左/右 行内跳转。

description.en: Huawei HarmonyOS assistant-today (负一屏) task-completion push for DeepSeek Harness: hiboard_push / hiboard_verify tools post Markdown task results to the phone card feed, wire-compatible with the OpenClaw today-task skill, with the authCode managed from the dsh settings panel.
description.zh: 华为鸿蒙负一屏（智慧助手·今天）任务完成推送：hiboard_push / hiboard_verify 工具把 Markdown 任务结果推送到手机卡片流，与 OpenClaw today-task 技能线级兼容，授权码可在 dsh 设置面板配置。

description.en: Push task-completion messages to the Huawei HarmonyOS assistant-today (负一屏) card feed from DeepSeek Harness — wire-compatible with the OpenClaw today-task skill.
Herdr control-plane plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): observe and drive Herdr — a terminal workspace manager for AI coding agents — from DSH sessions
Read-only Skills settings page plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web
description.zh: 在设置面板中新增只读的技能列表页面，方便你快速查看和管理当前会话的技能配置。
给 DeepSeek Harness 插件做热重载和注入，改完代码不用重启就能生效，开发调试更顺手。

description.en: WeCom AI Bot channel for DeepSeek Harness — every chat runs a persistent, preset-backed agent with real tools.
description.zh: dsh-wecom — DSH 插件（编排）

description.en: Enterprise workbench for DSH: manage AI employees, knowledge bases, skills, MCP servers and DSH plugins from a running session.
description.zh: 企业级工作台，在会话中直接管理AI员工、知识库、技能、MCP服务器和插件，一站式搞定。

description.en: ForeSight: a temporal-aspect long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh)
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上长期记忆，按时间维度记住对话和上下文，让智能体更懂你。

description.en: OLED burn-in care for the Web GUI with pure-black surfaces, gamma-aware text dimming on an idle/focus ladder, a true-black nap screensaver with live agent status, and slow accent-hue rotation.
description.zh: Web GUI 的 OLED 烧屏防护：纯黑底色、按空闲/聚焦档位做伽马感知的文字调暗、带实时 agent 状态的纯黑小憩屏保，以及缓慢轮转的强调色。

description.en: Plays a short chime when a conversation turn finishes, with three built-in tones or one custom upload, configured in Settings → Plugins.
description.zh: 会话回合结束时播放短提示音，内置三种音色或一条自定义上传，在设置 → 插件中配置。

description.en: OpenCode GO 套餐用量监控插件：账户三窗口额度 + DSH 按模型 Token/金额统计，为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 而生
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin: OpenCode GO 套餐用量（三窗口额度 + DSH 按模型 token/金额统计 + 输入框迷你条）

description.en: Visual goal lifecycle for the DSH web UI: a composer dock to create, multiline-edit, pause, resume, complete and clear session goals with live round progress, plus a phase-dot composer entry and a settings-page goal overview.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供可视化的会话目标生命周期：composer 上方的目标栏支持创建、多行编辑、暂停、恢复、完成与清除并实时显示轮次进度，工具行入口带阶段色点，设置页提供目标总览。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 联盟模式：自由组合 DSH、Claude Code、Codex 与全部已配置模型，保留原生 Agent 生命周期与实时执行过程。
Mobile device capability plugin for DeepSeek Harness: MobileService seam, mock/mobile-mcp providers, agent tools (observe/open_app/tap/type/back), tiered execution policy

A desktop pet in the DSH web GUI: floating, draggable sprite pet that animates with agent activity (thinking, idle, error, done, awaiting approval), with a settings page for size, switching, gallery search and one-click pet install. Ships 4 bundled Hunter x Hunter starter pets.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面里的桌面宠物：右下角悬浮、可拖拽，随智能体活动切换精灵动画；设置页可管理大小、启停切换、图库搜索与一键安装宠物。内置 4 个全职猎人主角宠物包。

description.en: Gives dsh the ability to generate images and videos through the grok2api API.
description.zh: 让 dsh 通过 grok2api 的 API 获得生成图片与视频能力。

description.en: A QR-code button above Settings that lets phones connect to the web UI through an auth-gated reverse proxy.
description.zh: 「设置」按钮上方的一键二维码，让手机通过带鉴权的反向代理连接 Web 界面。

description.en: TriComposer · DSH web 端 RP 结构化输入插件：台词/动作/心理分框填空、模板组装发送，从输入层消除 AI 对玩家言行的成分误识别。Structured tri-channel input composer for LLM roleplay on DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: RP对话输入增强插件，将台词、动作、心理分框填写，避免AI误读玩家言行，提升角色扮演体验。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: conversation rollback via Shadow Git snapshots + archive task management (restore/permanent delete/delete-all)
description.zh: 通过 Git 快照实现对话回滚，并管理归档任务，支持恢复、彻底删除和一键清空。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness web client plugin: group sidebar workspaces into a configurable three-level tree (分类→项目→会话). Sidecar YAML rules. dsh-plugin.
description.zh: 将侧边栏工作区按分类、项目、会话三级树形结构整理，让工作区管理更清晰高效。

description.en: DSH Desktop 原生插件：抓取 DeepSeek 完整对话，复用 DSH 模型整理为可执行需求，并一键发送到目标项目启动 Agent。
Self-update for the harness launcher; checks npm for a newer @deepseek-ai/dsh, stages the tarball, and applies it on harness exit or via update-and-restart from the web panel.
description.zh: Harness 启动器自更新插件；检查 npm 上的 @deepseek-ai/dsh 新版本，暂存 tarball，并在退出或通过面板「更新并重启」时应用。

description.en: Bayesian stock prediction plugin that fuses MACD, RSI, moving-average, volume and other technical signals into an up-move posterior probability with multi-horizon comparison, trend-state classification and position risk metrics for A-share and US stocks.
description.zh: 贝叶斯个股预测插件：多指标信号融合的上涨概率估计、趋势状态识别与持仓风险度量（A 股 + 美股）。
在聊天界面左侧添加导航栏，快速跳转到任意历史提问，长会话也能轻松回溯。

description.en: Crypto portfolio tracker for DSH: BTC / EVM (DeBank free+paid) / Solana / Hyperliquid L1 / CEX balances with multi-provider API failover, per-profile configs, scheduled daily refresh and trend charts (self-contained web dashboard).
description.zh: 加密货币组合追踪器：BTC / EVM（DeBank 免费+付费双源）/ Solana / Hyperliquid L1 / CEX 余额，多 API 源自动切换、多 Profile 配置、每日定时刷新与趋势图（自带 Web 仪表盘）。

description.en: Export and import DeepSeek Harness configuration across machines as same-OS .dshmig archives, with credential redaction, verification and rollback.
description.zh: 迁移 DSH 配置：跨机器导出/导入 .dshmig 归档（同 OS、新建 profile、凭据脱敏、校验与回滚）。

description.en: Image understanding for any DSH model: vision, OCR, grounding, and crop tools with domain presets for histopathology, cell biology, anatomy, clinical images and scientific figures.
description.zh: 让任意 DSH 模型都能识图：提供 vision/OCR/定位/裁剪四件套工具，内置病理、细胞、解剖、临床与科研统计图等专业预设。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件:JMComic 搜索下载、本地漫画库、窗内阅读器,内置源码离线可用。
description.zh: 在侧边栏一键搜索下载JMComic漫画，本地管理漫画库，窗口内直接阅读，离线也能用。

description.en: 轻量记忆系统插件：四个 Markdown 文件（USER/PROJECT/WORKLOG/CONVENTION）+ append/distill 两个动作，零外部部件，prefix-cache 友好
description.zh: 用四个 Markdown 文件当记忆，随手记、定期整理，让 AI 记住你的偏好和项目进度，纯文本好管理。

description.en: ZCode-style persistent project memory with a full settings manager, index-first injection and agent memory tools.
description.zh: ZCode 风格持久化项目记忆：设置内完整管理页、索引式注入与 agent 记忆工具。

description.en: Auxiliary inference usage, limits, and cancellation runtime for official DeepSeek Harness plugins
DSH Web GUI plugin: a browsable, searchable, stats-driven directory of GitHub DeepSeek Harness plugins (dsh-plugin topic), with CDN hot update, README-gated install, and live search.
description.zh: Browsable, searchable, stats-driven directory of GitHub DSH plugin repositories, rendered inside the DSH Web GUI settings.

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 个人微信 ClawBot 插件：OpenClaw 负责微信通道（扫码登录/收发消息），DSH 负责大脑，两者通过 OpenAI 兼容协议桥接。
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 变成个人微信机器人，扫码接入后自动回复，支持工具调用和记忆功能。

description.en: DSH的插件创意市场来啦!～～～欢迎使用&提供反馈！！DSH 插件创意市场 · DeepSeek Harness 插件发现与一键安装面板 全量嗅探官方 dsh-plugin topic（900+），过滤蹭标签噪音，保留人工精选标记； 支持总星数/最新发布/最近推送排序、即时搜索、语言过滤； 点安装先校验 dsh.bundle 声明，装不了的一律拒绝。零依赖零构建，装进 Web UI 的 Plugins 设置区。
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面里直接逛插件市场，自动过滤噪音、打上可信标，还能一键安装，省心省力。

description.en: Sidebar session-search toggle between title and content: title filters by session title, content searches historical messages through DSH's built-in full-text index, grouped per session with the strongest snippet and message-type tags.
description.zh: 侧边栏会话搜索开关，标题 / 内容一键切换：标题按会话标题过滤，内容经 DSH 自带全文索引搜索历史消息关键词，结果按会话聚合，附最强命中片段与消息类型标签。

description.en: Adds a docked-first vertical shorts wall to the DSH Web UI with YouTube Shorts and Bilibili sources, keyword rotation, four-corner resizing, and Alt+S/Alt+M shortcuts.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 中加入默认贴边的竖屏短视频墙：YouTube Shorts 与 B站双源、关键词轮换、四角缩放及 Alt+S/Alt+M 快捷键。

description.en: Skin switcher for the dsh web UI: one-click theme switching with auto-discovery of community skins.
description.zh: 皮肤切换器：右上角一键切换主题，自动发现社区皮肤。

description.en: Candy-pink acrylic DSH Web theme with light conservatory and dark stage art, gold-pink chat frame, Taffy character overlays, and an optional agent preset.
description.zh: 粉金亚克力 DSH Web 主题，含浅色花房与深色舞台背景、粉金对话框、塔菲立绘装饰与可选 Agent 预设。

description.en: A document preview / edit / management plugin for DeepSeek Harness. It provides a VSCode-style "Document Center" workbench inside the DSH Web GUI: a file tree on the left, click-to-preview, editable code & Markdown with Ctrl/Cmd+S save; and exposes three document tools (doc_read / doc_edit / doc_create) to agents, letting models read and write workspace documents through natural language.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的文档预览 / 编辑 / 管理插件。在 DSH Web GUI 中提供一个 VSCode 风格的「文档中心」工作台：左侧文件树，点击即预览，代码与 Markdown 支持编辑与 Ctrl/Cmd+S 保存；同时为 Agent 暴露 doc_read / doc_edit / doc_create 三个文档工具，让模型可以通过自然语言读写工作区文档。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 数据保险箱插件（dsh-vault）—— 自动备份、清空检测、一键恢复，保护聊天记录与工作区数据；可经桌面端一键安装或命令行 dsh plugin add 安装。
description.zh: 数据保险箱：为 DeepSeek Harness 提供备份、清空检测与一键恢复。备份触发时机：启动备份、意外关闭备份、手动备份（不再按会话落盘或定时全量备份，避免大量任务运行时卡死）。自动备份 ~/.dsh 的聊天记录(sessions)、工作区数据(storages)、设置(settings.yaml)、凭据与 profile 配置到用户主目录 ~/.dsh-backups（最多保留 10 份），检测数据被清空并支持按范围恢复与删除备份。设置页提供「备份管理」界面（Host+Client 双面插件）。

description.en: Floating, browser-local whale arcade with three score games and ocean-themed Gomoku for breaks while waiting on the agent.
description.zh: 浏览器本地运行的悬浮鲸鱼游戏中心，包含三款积分游戏和海洋主题五子棋，适合等待 Agent 时随手游玩。

description.en: Re-applies Chinese UI labels to the DSH client modules on every start, so translations survive upgrades.
description.zh: 每次启动自动将 DSH 界面英文工具与状态标签修补为中文，升级 DSH 后自动恢复，无需手动改文件。

description.en: 这是一个用来存放个人搭建的MCP服务的仓库
description.zh: 给 LLM Agent 用的分层长期记忆服务器，把对话沉淀成可语义检索的三层记忆，随时带出完整上下文。

description.en: Edge breathing border showing DeepSeek peak/valley hours, with flowing light and scheduled push reminders.
description.zh: DeepSeek 峰谷提醒：贴屏呼吸边框（高峰橙/低峰蓝）、流光效果与消息推送提醒。

description.en: Windows system-level notifications when the agent finishes a task or needs your input: task-done, question, approval and plan-review alerts via the browser Notification API, click-to-open the session, background-only mode, and a first-level settings page (Settings → 任务提示).
description.zh: 任务完成或需要你输入/批准时弹出 Windows 系统通知（浏览器 Notification API）：完成/提问/审批/计划审阅提醒，点击气泡直达会话，支持后台模式，设置页在官方设置 → 任务提示。

description.en: Automatically loads the full conversation history when a session opens, so older messages are ready without clicking "Load earlier".
description.zh: 打开会话时自动加载全部历史消息，免去反复点击「加载更早」。

description.en: Billing and usage inspection plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 查看 DeepSeek Harness 会话费用与额度，帮你掌握成本、优化资源使用。

description.en: Session-header button that cycles the conversation width (748-1600px), widening the chat column, composer, and user bubbles together.
description.zh: 会话标题栏按钮循环切换对话宽度（748–1600px），消息区、输入框、用户气泡同步加宽。

description.en: Bridges the Codebase Memory MCP code knowledge graph into DSH and keeps indexed repositories fresh with a debounced filesystem watcher. Windows-only MCP bridge (the watcher half is cross-platform); auto-installs its npm CLI via npx on first start.
description.zh: 把 Codebase Memory MCP 代码知识图谱接入 DSH，并用防抖文件监视器自动保持索引新鲜。MCP 桥接部分仅支持 Windows（监视器跨平台）；首次启动会经 npx 自动安装所需 npm CLI。

description.en: Splits the DeepSeek Harness sidebar into independently scrollable Pinned and Recents panes, and hides pinned sessions from Recents.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏分成可独立滚动的置顶栏和最近栏，置顶过的会话不再出现在最近列表里。

description.en: Codex-style pinned sessions for DeepSeek Harness — always visible above the sidebar list

A global task library plugin for DeepSeek Harness featuring cross-session persistence, a real-time generative-UI browser panel, and subagent job synchronization.DeepSeek Harness 全局任务插件：提供跨会话持久化任务库、生成式 UI (Generative-UI) 悬浮面板及子智能体 (Subagent) 状态自动同步。
description.zh: 全局任务库插件，跨会话保存任务，实时界面管理，并同步子代理任务状态，提升多任务协作效率。

description.en: QQ official bot (q.qq.com) integration for DeepSeek Harness: chat with the full agent from private chats, groups and channels — WS long connection (heartbeat / reconnect / RESUME), per-chat session isolation, standard agent preset, approval inline buttons with /revoke, slash commands, whitelist fail-closed, credentials via the credentials domain.
description.zh: 接入 QQ 官方机器人（q.qq.com）：私聊 / 群聊 / 频道 @ 与完整 agent 对话——WS 长连接（心跳 / 重连 / RESUME）、每会话隔离、标准 agent preset、审批内联按钮 + /revoke、斜杠命令、白名单 fail-closed、凭据走凭据域。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness web plugin that adds a LAN access
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加局域网访问开关，无需手动改配置，一键开启/关闭 Web GUI 的局域网访问。

description.en: AIEO (GEO/AEO) delivery method as one isolated skill provider: AI-visibility diagnosis on a 0-9 score, positioning, search-term mining restricted to whitelisted platform exports, periodic monitoring and an HTML monitoring dashboard, chained by one shared question library, plus a landing-page cloner.
description.zh: AIEO（GEO/AEO）交付方法论，挂载为一个独立的 skill provider：0-9 分制的 AI 可见性诊断、产品定位、仅限白名单平台导出数据的搜索热词挖掘、周期性效果监控与 HTML 监控面板，由同一份共享问题库串联，另附一个落地页复刻 skill。

description.en: MQTT protocol driver and agent worker gateway for DSH
DeepSeek Harness 像素皮肤（Agent Xi 风格）：四个主题一键切换——像素·木屋 / 像素·羊皮纸 / 像素·暖阳 / 像素·终端绿，随时可切回现代默认 UI。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换上复古像素皮肤，四种主题一键切换，还能随时回到现代界面。

description.en: Agent-managed procedural memory: a skill_manage tool that creates, patches, disables and deletes the agent's own skills in user or project scope, with delete guards (agent-created marker, pin, path confinement) and a trigger-discipline prompt.
description.zh: 代理自管的程序性记忆：skill_manage 工具可创建、修补、禁用、删除 agent 自己的技能（用户级/项目级双作用域），带删除守卫（agent 创建标记、pin、路径限制）与触发纪律提示。

description.en: DSH plugin: subagent_model tool — delegate to a subagent with a per-call selected model route (minimal fork of dsh-tool-subagent)
Token usage & cost statistics plugin for DeepSeek Harness — per model / date / session, cost estimation (USD/CNY), CSV/JSON export | DeepSeek Harness Token 用量统计插件：按模型/日期/会话统计用量与费用，支持 CSV/JSON 导出
description.zh: 统计 DeepSeek Harness 各模型、日期、会话的 Token 用量与费用，支持导出 CSV/JSON，帮你掌控成本。

description.en: Unit conversion toolbox for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): 17 categories — power (3 horsepower definitions), force, torque, typography (px/pt/em/rem), fuel economy (mpg ↔ L/100km), data sizes (MB vs MiB) — zero runtime dependencies
description.zh: 单位换算工具箱：覆盖 20 个类别——长度、质量、温度、面积、体积（含美制烹饪单位）、速度、时长、数据大小（十进制 MB 与二进制 MiB）、数据传输速率（Mbps 与 MB/s）、加速度（含 g-force）、照度（lux 与英尺烛光）、压强、能量、角度、频率、功率（含三种马力定义）、力、扭矩、排版（px/pt/em/rem）与油耗（mpg ↔ L/100km）。提供 convert_unit 与 list_units 两个工具；零运行时依赖，纯算术实现，结果附带所用公式。

description.en: DSH plugin: per-workspace .env injection for shell subprocesses
description.zh: 每次调用工具时自动注入当前工作区的 .env 环境变量，切项目自动切换配置，无需手动干预。

description.en: Daily cost card for your local LLM gateway: /usage reads gateway_usage.jsonl and itemizes spend per model and per hour, covering official direct, OpenRouter relay, and in-plan metered pools.
description.zh: 本地 LLM 网关当日花费价目卡：/usage 读取 gateway_usage.jsonl，按模型×分小时列出消费，覆盖官方直连、OpenRouter 中转与套餐内计费池。

description.en: Windows desktop UI context picker for Codex, DeepSeek Harness, and MCP clients: select windows, UI elements, or screen regions with hover highlighting, UI Automation, screenshots, and local OCR, then review and approve Markdown/JSON context before output.
description.zh: 面向 Codex、DeepSeek Harness 和 MCP 客户端的 Windows 桌面 UI 上下文取景器：选择窗口、UI 元素或屏幕区域，使用悬停高亮、UI Automation、截图和本机 OCR，并在输出前确认 Markdown/JSON 上下文。

description.en: Cat-themed DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin with three original themes and a calm interactive companion. Not an official DeepSeek product.

DSH plugin developer sandbox: spawn isolated DeepSeek Harness web mirror instances (own DSH_HOME/port/profile) that mount the plugin under development, with optional host API/model inheritance. GUI panel + sandbox_* agent tools.
description.zh: 为 DSH 插件开发者提供隔离的沙盒环境，可独立启动镜像实例并挂载待开发插件，方便调试和测试。

description.en: Diagnoses and fixes "duplicate loader entry id" boot crashes - finds duplicate loader rows across profile bundles and converts them into id-targeted patches via a zero-dependency CLI (detect / preview / fix / verify).
description.zh: 检测并修复 dsh 启动的 "duplicate loader entry id" 崩溃：扫描 profile 各 bundle 的重复 loader row，转换为 id-targeted patch，附带零依赖 CLI（检测/预览/修复/复检）。

description.en: Plugin-combination analysis for the DeepSeek Harness: dependency trees, conflict detection, risk scoring with prediction, visualization, and combination simulation.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件组合分析工具：依赖树、冲突检测、风险评估（含预测）、可视化与组合模拟。

description.en: GrayPrint — dsh web plugin for live reasoning-style fingerprints. Scores paragraph openers against grayscale/current references and independently tracks Let me ↔ We need. 94.2% holdout.
Source-aware prompt injection guard for DSH: tracks untrusted turn context, detects injection signals, scores sensitive sinks, and blocks high-risk tool calls with explainable audit logs.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的来源感知提示词注入防护：跟踪 Turn 中的不可信上下文，检测注入信号，评估敏感 Sink，并通过可解释审计日志阻断高风险工具调用。

description.en: Deepseek-Harness数学建模竞赛论文全自动撰写流水线插件。Deepseek-Harness fully automatic pipeline plugin for writing mathematical modeling competition papers.
description.zh: 粘贴赛题再发一条 /loopbegin，数学建模竞赛论文从分析到成稿全自动跑完。

description.en: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置页管理 MCP 服务器：运行时添加/编辑/启停/重连/删除，实时状态、自动重连，中英双语界面。MCP server manager for DeepSeek Harness — add, edit, enable/disable, reconnect & delete MCP servers from the web settings page, with live status and auto-reconnect.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置页直接管理 MCP 服务器，支持运行时增删改、启停、重连和实时状态监控，界面中英双语，操作简单直观。

description.en: Cross-session persistent memory for the DeepSeek Harness: a model-facing memory tool, an always-on index section, and a bundled maintenance skill.
Verifiable narrative state, continuity and character-knowledge ledger for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可验证的故事状态、连续性和角色知识账本，确保叙事逻辑严谨一致。

description.en: A pixel companion living in the chat area: hatches from an egg into one of three sprites or an LLM-drawn custom one from a text description, platform-jumps over message bubbles on its own, WASD controllable, chats in character through the models you already configured, and carries a nurture system (mood/power/health, levels, shop) driven by real token usage.
description.zh: 聊天区里的像素小宠物：从蛋孵化三选一，也可用一句话描述让 LLM 画出自定义形象，自动在消息气泡间平台跳跃，支持 WASD 操控与拖拽，用已配置的模型角色扮演陪聊，养成系统（心情/电量/健康、等级、商店）由真实 token 消耗驱动。

description.en: dsh Web UI 动态背景：WebGL2 流体 + 字符鲸鱼游动(循环接缝赛博朋克故障转场) + 发光鱼群 + 点线网格
description.zh: 给 dsh Web UI 加上赛博朋克动态背景，流体、发光鱼群和字符鲸鱼游动，让界面更炫酷。

description.en: Persistent five-layer memory system with relevance injection, LLM auto-extraction, profile rotation, and six agent tools.
description.zh: 五层持久记忆系统：相关性注入、LLM 自动提取、画像轮替与六个 agent 工具。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 网页端的 AI 与科技快讯看板：内置 RSS/JSON 源驱动的可拖拽浮窗，支持双语翻译、关键词过滤和设置页。
DeepSeek 峰谷定价时段徽章（DSH 双面插件，纯 UI、无状态、无网络请求）
description.zh: DeepSeek 峰谷定价时段徽章（DSH 双面插件，纯 UI、无状态、无网络请求）

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 工具箱插件：打开工作区目录并置顶会话。
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 增加工具箱：一键打开工作区目录、置顶会话，并支持独立置顶区，功能可自由开关。

description.en: 断线无限重新连接，适用于不稳定的API或者中转站
Fold everything since the last checkpoint mark into an auto-generated report, replacing it in context while keeping the full log.
description.zh: 把上次检查点之后的所有内容折叠成一份自动报告，替换进上下文，同时保留完整日志，帮你理清思路。

description.en: Quick temporary conversation and workspace manager for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 临时对话工作区自动化管理插件。

description.en: 还在为繁杂的log而苦恼吗？直接拓扑展示，清晰理顺所有，多智能体也不怕。
description.zh: 把杂乱的会话日志变成3D执行图，主线和子智能体分叉汇合一目了然，还能逐条追溯原始日志。

description.en: 站点地图（Yakit 风格）：DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏树形接口地图，搜索 / 接口详情 / 一键复制 curl，数据实时同步

Nightly self-improvement for your DeepSeek Harness agent: harvest past sessions offline, replay recurring tasks on your own API budget, and consolidate validated skills behind a held-out gate. Brings microsoft/SkillOpt's SkillOpt-Sleep engine to dsh as native tools plus a bundled skill - no weight training. Requires Python 3.10+ and the SkillOpt-Sleep engine (pip install skillopt).
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness agent 提供夜间自我进化：离线复盘过往会话，在你的 API 预算内重放高频任务，并把学到的技能凝练成经得起门禁验证的技能。把 microsoft/SkillOpt 的 SkillOpt-Sleep 引擎带进 dsh，作为原生工具加内置技能——无需模型训练。需 Python 3.10+ 并安装 SkillOpt-Sleep 引擎(pip install skillopt)。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 自定义皮肤工作室，支持全界面配色、组件图片/视频背景与皮肤包分享
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 皮肤工作室 — 内置精选皮肤 + 用户上传皮肤中心

description.en: A Deepseek Harness plugin that gives its UI color themes.
description.zh: Deepseek Harness 的一款插件，可为其用户界面添加颜色主题。

description.en: A full-screen terminal workbench for DeepSeek Harness with a durable assistant, workspace-grouped project sessions, transcript-only scrolling, and structured thinking, tool, diff, plan, and subagent views.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 全屏终端工作台，提供独立持久助手、按工作区分组的项目会话、仅聊天区滚动，以及结构化思考、工具、diff、计划和子代理视图。

description.en: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 **UI 皮肤插件**：在 UI 下方注入壁纸 / 视频背景，并把 DSH 整个界面（含侧栏）的表面背景烘焙为半透明（毛玻璃）让皮肤透出。支持拖动裁剪缩放、历史皮肤记录与可拖动悬浮窗；自定义皮肤支持网络地址或本地文件。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换皮肤，支持壁纸或视频背景，界面变半透明毛玻璃效果，还能自定义调整。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: turn UI screenshots into structured, implementation-grade web frontend specs. Deterministic geometry (sharp) + optional vision-model semantics, merged into one JSON + Markdown spec.
description.zh: dsh-ui-spec — DSH 插件（模型）

description.en: Low-footprint memory backend for AI agents — single binary, ~50MB RAM, verify-augmented accuracy
description.zh: Low-footprint memory backend for AI agents — single binary, ~50MB RAM, verify-augmented accuracy

description.en: meow-vision 是 DeepSeek Harness 的一款视觉插件，解决纯文本模型无视觉。另一方面vue页面开发视觉验证不闭环的问题。
description.zh: 给纯文本模型补上视觉能力，还能自动验证 Vue 页面渲染效果，开发调试更省心。

description.en: ARPM-derived local hybrid RAG plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 本地混合 RAG：ARPM 派生，检索增强全在本机完成。

description.en: Cross-surface action binding and replay parity evidence for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 验证 DeepSeek Harness 中同一业务操作在 CLI、MCP 和 GUI 三种界面下行为一致，确保跨界面操作无偏差。

description.en: Lets the DSH web UI attach files of any type as pathless @-mentions: pick a workspace file from the @ menu or drop one into the composer, and the agent reads it directly.
description.zh: 让 DSH 网页以无路径 @提及 附加任意类型文件：可从 @ 菜单挑选工作区文件，或拖入输入区，Agent 直接读取。

description.en: Content-addressed audit indexes across independent DeepSeek Harness evidence producers
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 各证据源生成内容寻址审计索引，方便独立校验与追溯。

description.en: A plugin for Deepseek Harness (well it may support other AI agent IDEs but I hadn't test it out yet) that checks for error when AI had finished writing the code.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 代码全面检查插件：三步流水线（编译运行检查 → 功能完整性核对 → 真实用户模拟测试），自动把问题反馈给 AI 修复，可选用 GUI，并附带适用于 Trae/Qoder 等平台的独立 CLI 与 MCP 服务

description.en: Command history for the Web UI composer: press Up/Down to cycle through previously sent instructions, then restore the draft at the end of the history.
description.zh: Web UI 输入框命令历史：按 ↑/↓ 浏览此前发送的指令，回到历史末尾时恢复原草稿。

description.en: CPA account-pool status panel: sidebar health light, quota bars, success-rate ticks, and gateway key endings.
description.zh: CPA 账号池状态面板：侧栏健康灯、配额进度、成功率刻度与网关密钥末四位一览。

description.en: Econometrics research assistant: 6 tools covering method selection, data preparation, model specification, empirical analysis with Python/R/Stata code templates, robustness checks, and result reporting.
description.zh: 计量经济学研究助手：6 个工具覆盖方法选择、数据预处理、模型设定、实证分析（含 Python/R/Stata 代码模板）、稳健性检验与结果报告。

description.en: A Codex-like effort switcher for Deepseek Harness.
description.zh: 为DSH添加一个类似于Codex的推理强度切换器。

description.en: dsh 插件：/gamemode 1 = 一键切换到内置创造模式（cordis）预设。dsh plugin: /gamemode 1 = switch to the built-in Creative Mode (cordis) agent preset.
OpenCode Go balance pill at the right end of the composer tool row: rolling/weekly/monthly quota remaining straight from the Zen usage endpoint, with hover detail and warn/danger coloring.
description.zh: 输入框工具行右侧的 OpenCode Go 余额胶囊：滚动/每周/每月配额剩余百分比（数据直接来自 Zen 用量接口），悬停查看明细，低余额自动变黄/变红。

description.en: Kubernetes ops for the agent: get resources with structured JSON output, describe, logs, exec, apply/delete (user-confirmed) and port-forward.
description.zh: Kubernetes 运维：JSON 结构化查资源、describe、日志、exec、apply/delete（需确认）与端口转发。

description.en: One-click launcher for DeepSeek Harness: detects whether the backend is running, starts dsh web if needed, waits until ready, then opens the main page in a new Chrome window. Ships a cross-platform CLI (dsh-launcher start / open / status / make-shortcut) and the harness_launch agent tool.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 一键启动器：检测后台是否在运行，未运行则启动 dsh web，等待就绪后在新 Chrome 窗口打开主页面。附带跨平台 CLI（dsh-launcher start / open / status / make-shortcut）与 harness_launch agent 工具。

description.en: Draggable floating cat-or-dog companion for the dsh web GUI that changes expression with the session and is configured on a Companion settings page.
description.zh: 可拖拽的猫狗悬浮伴侣，表情随当前会话变化，在 Companion 设置页里换皮肤。

description.en: Current-session message outline rail for the DSH web UI — your messages show as slim bars on the left edge; hover to expand the full outline (line number + text), click to jump instantly to that message. Pure frontend, zero external service dependencies, sessions-snapshot driven with zero polling.
description.zh: 当前会话消息大纲（左缘横杠）——你的消息在对话区左缘显示一列细横杠，hover 展开完整大纲（行号+文本），点击瞬间定位到对话里那条消息。纯前端、零外部服务依赖、sessions 快照驱动零轮询。
