description.en: DSH web sidebar session-search enhancement: one-click toggle between title search and content search; content results aggregated per session with title and hit snippets.
description.zh: DSH web 侧边栏会话搜索增强：标题搜索与内容搜索一键切换，内容搜索按会话聚合展示标题与命中片段

description.en: DSH Skills 管理器：设置页系统/用户技能分类，用户技能开关/编辑/删除/新建。Skills manager for DeepSeek Harness: system/user skill management (toggle/edit/delete/create) i…
description.zh: DSH Skills 管理器：设置页系统/用户技能分类，用户技能开关/编辑/删除/新建。Skills manager for DeepSeek Harness: system/user skill management (toggle/edit/delete/create) i…

description.en: DSH plugin: provider/model usage stats dashboard with response speed, call log, token totals, cache rate, cost estimates, CSV export
description.zh: Provider/模型用量看板：响应速度、调用日志、token 总量、缓存率、成本估算，支持 CSV 导出。

description.en: Community control-plane plugin for DeepSeek Harness live sessions
description.zh: dsh-supervisor — DSH 插件（会话）

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for installing and managing skills by global or workspace scope.

Unified plugin marketplace built for the DSH Desktop (EAC) shell, aggregating the curated catalog, the GitHub dsh-plugin ecosystem and the npm registry into one storefront, with source whitelisting, conflict pre-checks, trial-boot install verification, manual/batch/auto updates and .dshpack feature-pack management.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Desktop（EAC）桌面壳的统一插件市场：聚合精选目录、GitHub dsh-plugin 生态与 npm registry 三源，提供来源白名单、冲突预检、试装安装验证、手动/批量/自动三档更新与功能包（.dshpack）管理。

description.en: Renders image, video, and audio paths and URLs from DSH conversations inline, with workspace-confined local reads and an optional ComfyUI proxy.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话中内联显示图像、视频和音频路径及 URL，并提供工作区受限的本地读取与可选的 ComfyUI 代理。

description.en: Minimal prompt x Web PTC capabilities: one-line persona, run_code SDK, subagents, Ralph, web search/fetch, and Windows Git Bash; the general-purpose workflow tool stays hidden.
description.zh: 极简提示词 × Web PTC 能力：一句人格、run_code SDK、子代理、Ralph、网页搜索/抓取与 Windows Git Bash；通用 workflow 工具保持隐藏。

description.en: Desktop BigFish companion for DSH: real-time balance, out-of-browser desktop Q&A, 7 custom animations, 53 meme lines.
description.zh: 桌面大肥鱼增强版桌宠：点击实时显示 DeepSeek 余额，浏览器外桌面问答，7 套专属动作，53 条玩梗。

description.en: Design I/O for coding agents: controllable UI generation via declarations (spec/domain/craft/design/components/template) and contracts (skill/evaluator). Use for product UI—console, dashboard, agent-ops, CJK-first apps.

Provider plugin for dsh-skill-pack-security: registers the pack's skills/ (zh) or skills-en/ (en) edition on ctx.skills AND the plugin_vet supply-chain gate tool on ctx.tools (license/SBOM/commit-lock/malware scans + five-dimension risk card). Ships both

dsh web UI admin plugin: extension-plugin marketplace tab, MCP server & session-history settings pages, subagent management (named delegation-tool instances with persona/tool-filter/model config, plus external CLI backend mounting), slash-command & Claude
Boot-time watchdog for DSH web: detects broken plugins, disables them persistently so the UI opens, with quarantine audit, automatic probe recovery, and one-click restore.
description.zh: dsh web 启动看门狗：检测并持久化禁用问题插件，让界面正常打开，并提供隔离账本、探针自动恢复与一键恢复。

description.en: DIY your DSH UI fonts and colors: per-region styling, unified overrides, theme save and switch, random font and color.
description.zh: DIY 你的 DSH 界面：按区域自定义字体、字号与颜色，支持全局统一设置、主题保存切换与随机配色。

description.en: Read GeoServer WMS services and render map images in the dsh web GUI, with a settings card for server, username, and password.
description.zh: 在 dsh web GUI 中读取 GeoServer WMS 服务并渲染地图图像，带服务器地址、用户名和密码设置卡片。

description.en: Reports DeepSeek Harness session activity to a self-hosted cc-monitor server, which surfaces Claude Code and DSH sessions as color-coded state cards in one web dashboard and pings your browser and Android app when a session needs attention.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 会话活动上报到自托管的 cc-monitor 服务器：Claude Code 与 DSH 会话以彩色状态卡片出现在同一个 Web 仪表盘中，会话需要关注时通过浏览器与 Android 应用通知你。

description.en: MUV variable table editor for DeepSeek Harness: a tree view of the variables being tracked, a macro test panel for random, pick and roll, a dice shortcut bar and pick-cache management. Companion plugin for dsh-muv-engine.
description.zh: MUV 变量表格编辑器：树形变量面板、宏测试浮窗（random／pick／roll）、骰子快捷栏与 pick 缓存管理。dsh-muv-engine 的伴生插件。

description.en: DeepSeek balance & token-cost plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dual-face): query official balances of every DeepSeek provider (multi API key), compute costs (last question / session / today-project / today-all) from token usage with a user-editable price tabl
description.zh: 一键查询 DeepSeek 多账号余额与费用，实时统计 token 用量，界面直观，开箱即用。

description.en: Generates editable PPTX decks in DSH with a bundled authoring Skill, deterministic PPTD scene checks, native PowerPoint objects, and local PPTD source-project delivery.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中使用包内编排 Skill、确定性 PPTD 场景检查和原生 PowerPoint 对象生成可编辑 PPTX，并在本地交付 PPTD 源项目。

description.en: Natural-language data queries + BI reports: Text2SQL, charts, report saving, schema/data grid panel, and a sidebar workbench — all behind DSH's MySQL connection layer.
description.zh: 自然语言查询 + 商业智能报表：Text2SQL、图表、报表收藏、Schema/数据面板与侧栏工作台，基于 DSH 的 MySQL 连接层。

description.en: Adds an x_search tool for X/Twitter search to DeepSeek Harness, authenticated through a separate SuperGrok OAuth account so it does not consume the session provider quota.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加用于 X/Twitter 搜索的 x_search 工具，通过独立的 SuperGrok OAuth 账号鉴权，不占用会话所用提供方的配额。

description.en: Scheduled send: fire a drafted message into the bound conversation as a normal user bubble at a set time. Runs host-side, so the browser can stay closed; per-session isolation and restart-safe redelivery.
description.zh: 定时发送：到点将拟好的消息以正常用户气泡发送到绑定的会话。调度在服务端执行，关闭浏览器不影响发送；会话隔离、重启自动补发。

description.en: A Codex-style conversation navigator for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供 Codex 式对话导航与预览。

description.en: Whale girl desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: browser floating mascot plus Windows desktop pet sharing one data backend, with real-time balance board, task notices, head-pat interaction, 19 pre-synthesized voiced lines with per-line emotion, and presence-aware idle speech.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的鲸鱼娘桌宠：浏览器悬浮桌宠与 Windows 桌面桌宠共享一套数据，实时余额木牌、任务通知、摸头互动、19 句预合成带情感的台词朗读，空闲节奏随是否在场自适应。

description.en: Plays a short synthesized ding in the browser tab the moment an agent finishes a turn, built entirely with the Web Audio API; no backend audio and no OS notification.
description.zh: agent 回合结束时在浏览器标签页里播放一声合成的叮,纯前端 Web Audio 发音,不经过后端、不弹系统通知。

description.en: Metaso (秘塔AI搜索) search & reader providers for the web seam: web_search returns page summaries, web_fetch reads full-page markdown, multi-scope search (webpage/document/paper/image/video/podcast).
description.zh: 秘塔AI搜索 providers for ctx.web：web_search 返回网页摘要，web_fetch 读取网页全文 markdown，多范围搜索（网页/文库/论文/图片/视频/播客）。

description.en: An RTS-style orchestration dashboard where commands replace chats: a resident commander agent decomposes each order into task briefs with acceptance criteria, typed subagent troops (recon/engineer/medic/scribe) execute them across isolated workspaces, and every session is indexed by the order that started it.
description.zh: RTS 风格编排看板：用命令取代会话——常驻大副 agent 把舰长命令拆成带验收标准的任务书，侦察/工程/医疗/书记四类小队在隔离工作区执行，所有会话按发起命令索引归队。

description.en: Listen to Ximalaya podcasts and audiobooks inside the DSH web UI: search albums, browse paginated tracks, and play through a now-playing bar (prev/play/next, seek, volume, rate). After QR login the "Mine" page lists your liked tracks (click to play), subscribed albums with latest-episode hints, and followed anchors with their public albums; the host relays audio streams with Range support and registers an `ximalaya_play` tool so the agent can search and play on request.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面收听喜马拉雅播客/有声书：搜索专辑、分页浏览曲目，播放条支持上下集/进度/音量/倍速；扫码登录后「我的」页可看收藏的声音（点击即播）、我的订阅（带最新一集提示）与关注的主播（含其公开专辑）；Host 端音频流代理支持 Range 拖动，并注册 `ximalaya_play` 模型工具让 agent 按需搜索播放。

description.en: Whale Girl light theme for the DSH Web UI, ported from a DreamSkin skin package: registers one native runtime theme with a full --dsw-* token remap derived from the source palette, layers the artwork as an ambient fixed wallpaper behind a frosted UI, and pins the theme against appearance-preference resets.
description.zh: 移植自 DreamSkin 皮肤包的鲸鱼娘亮色主题：在原生主题运行时注册一套完整 --dsw-* 令牌重映射，鲸鱼娘插画作为环境壁纸衬于磨砂玻璃界面之后，并通过主题变更守卫保持主题固定。

description.en: Tavily Search API as a web search provider (settings toggle with DeepSeek fallback, keyless search) plus a Tavily MCP bridge: keyless search and extract tools, crawl and map with an API key.
description.zh: Tavily 网页搜索：设置页开关，关闭时回落到 DeepSeek 内置搜索；免密钥可用搜索与内容提取，配置 API Key 后解锁爬取与站点地图等 MCP 工具。

description.en: Exposes the DSH workspace as an HTTP API: browse, search and read files, and run natural-language agent tasks that answer with cited sources.
description.zh: 把 DSH 工作区暴露为 HTTP API：浏览/搜索/读取文件，并支持自然语言任务（agent 查阅文档后带出处回答）。

description.en: MCP server marketplace for DSH: browse a curated, npm-verified catalog and install MCP servers into the current profile with one click, live without restart.
description.zh: DSH 的 MCP 服务器商场：浏览经过 npm 校验的精选目录，一键安装 MCP 服务器到当前 profile，免重启立即生效。

description.en: Clinical documentation and reference bundle for healthcare professionals: SOAP/APSO progress notes, admission H&P, SBAR/I-PASS handover, discharge summaries, Safe Harbor de-identification, patient-instruction readability, completeness checks, and cited lookups against FDA labels, MedlinePlus, PubMed, and ClinicalTrials.gov. Draft-only with a PHI egress guard; not a medical device.
description.zh: 面向临床人员的文档与参考工具包：SOAP/APSO 病程录、入院 H&P、SBAR/I-PASS 交接班、 出院小结、Safe Harbor 脱敏、患者须知可读性评分、完整性检查，以及来自 FDA 说明书、 MedlinePlus、PubMed 和 ClinicalTrials.gov 的带出处检索。仅起草不决定， 内置 PHI 外发守卫；非医疗器械。

description.en: Turns the 13 δ-me13 (Amphoreus) role skill cards into seat workspaces: per-seat theme and wallpaper, first-turn skill injection, chat stickers, per-seat memory notes and presets, Alt+digit seat switching, and an overview canvas for dispatch and handoff; the skill suite itself is read from a configurable local directory and is not bundled.
description.zh: 把 δ-me13（翁法罗斯）的 13 张黄金裔角色技能卡变成席位工作区：逐席配色与壁纸、首轮自动注入技能卡、对话表情、每席记忆便签与预设、Alt+数字切席，以及用于派发与移交的总览画布；技能套件本身从可配置的本地目录读取，不随插件打包。

description.en: Qwen Token Plan CN Responses provider for DeepSeek Harness via the OpenAI Responses API, with Qwen server-side tools, DSH local function tools, text/reasoning/tool-call multi-turn history, persisted image attachments, and a per-release official model catalog snapshot.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的千问 Token Plan 个人版 Responses API 提供方，保留 Qwen 服务端内置工具与 DSH 本地函数工具，多轮文本/推理/工具调用历史与图片附件均被支持，官方模型目录按 npm 版本冻结快照发布。

description.en: Two-way sync of DSH sessions, workspace mappings, settings and patches between machines through your own private GitHub repo (API keys stay machine-local).
description.zh: 通过你自己的 GitHub 私有仓库,在多台电脑间双向同步 DSH 会话、工作区对应关系、设置与托管补丁(API 密钥留在本机)。

description.en: jit-viewer 的 dsh 插件适配：工具 preview_document + Web 预览浮层（client bundle）。第一版 PDF+Office/iframe 兜底。
Exits the dsh CLI process automatically when the Web UI closes, with a configurable grace period and dry-run mode.
description.zh: 关闭 DSH Web UI 后自动退出 CLI 进程（等效 Ctrl+C），支持可配置宽限期与试运行模式。

description.en: Zero-token online status indicator for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: an always-visible online/offline dot in the conversation header, auto-refreshed every 15 seconds with no LLM calls.
description.zh: 零 token 在线状态指示器：会话头部常驻显示 ● 在线 / ● 离线 状态点，每 15 秒自动检测一次，不调用任何 LLM。

description.en: DSH 手机/外网远程访问插件（frp 版）：frp 内网穿透公网隧道（frpc 一键下载）+ token 鉴权代理 + gzip 压缩 + 局域网 HTTP/HTTPS 直连 + 常驻手机图标面板 + 六大机器人通道（微信/QQ/Telegram/钉钉/飞书/企业微信）。
可安装的 DeepSeek Harness 插件市场，替换设置里的插件页

Read-only GitHub access for agents, wrapping several tools. Inside the tool it automatically probes and selects whichever GitHub access method works locally, and tries network proxies on its own. That cuts down the network and parsing problems an agent may hit when accessing GitHub, and the overhead of it repeatedly trying different approaches.
description.zh: 面向 agent 的只读 GitHub 访问，封装多个工具。在工具内部自动探测与选择本地可用的 GitHub 访问设施，并自动尝试网络代理。减少 Agent 在访问 GitHub 时可能遇到的网络问题或解析问题，减少 Agent 频繁尝试不同方案的开销。

description.en: Embedded MCP server letting external agents (Hermes, Claude Code, etc.) drive DeepSeek Harness over StreamableHTTP: sync/async task execution, a three-tier file sandbox, a Web-backed approval bridge, session management and search, and path-jailed file tools.
description.zh: 内嵌 MCP server，让外部 Agent（Hermes、Claude Code 等）通过 StreamableHTTP 驱动 DeepSeek Harness：同步/异步任务执行、三档文件沙箱、Web 审批桥、会话管理与搜索、路径隔离的文件工具。

description.en: Image generation workbench and agent tool for DSH: one tool (ark9_generate_image) paints text-to-image and image-to-image via any OpenAI-compatible API. Channels are entirely user-configured - no bundled endpoint, you bring your own baseURL, key and model name (manual input supported). Agent-initiated generations are approval-gated by default: requests queue in the floating panel and nothing bills until you approve; approval is non-blocking (the agent replies "awaiting your approval" immediately, and results, denials or timeouts are injected back so the agent reports them in the next turn). Floating glass workbench with five tabs (Generate / Approvals / Prompts / History / About), aspect-ratio grid with quality-budget + 16px-alignment sizing, transparent background, batch up to 10 images as aggregated sub-tasks, prompt library with custom JSON sources fetched through a host proxy, persistent generation logs with one-click retry, multi-channel aggregation with per-channel model fetching, bilingual UI (zh/en), stroke-SVG icon set, config import/export. Registers as a Better Sidebar tab when dsh-better-sidebar is installed; stacks above the dsh-cua FAB when both are present.
description.zh: DSH 生图工作台与 Agent 生图工具：一个工具（ark9_generate_image）走任意 OpenAI 兼容图片 API 文生图/图生图。渠道完全由用户自行添加——默认零预置，自带 baseURL、Key 与模型名即可（支持手动输入任意模型名）。Agent 发起的生图默认需用户审批：请求进入浮窗审批页，批准才开始生成并计费；审批非阻塞——Agent 立即回复"等你审批"，结果、拒绝或超时以通知注入后续轮次并自动汇报。玻璃拟态浮窗五页签（生成/审批/提示词/记录/说明）、比例网格（质量预算+16px 对齐）、透明背景、批量最多 10 张（子任务聚合，部分成功也返回）、提示词库（自定义 JSON 来源经宿主代理拉取）、生成记录持久化与一键重试、多渠道聚合与逐渠道拉模型、中英双语界面、线性 SVG 图标、配置导入导出。安装 dsh-better-sidebar 自动注册侧栏页签；与 dsh-cua 共存时自动堆叠其悬浮按钮上方。

description.en: Ship a project to Cloudflare and publish your plugin to npm — the first deploy needs no cloud account, and credentials never reach the model.
description.zh: 一句话把项目部署到 Cloudflare、把做好的插件发布到 npm：首次部署零账号，凭据模型看不到。

description.en: Layered file memory for DeepSeek Harness with workspace-scoped USER/MEMORY notes, background consolidation, and hybrid session recall.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 分层文件记忆，提供工作区隔离的 USER/MEMORY 笔记、后台沉淀与混合会话召回。

description.en: Wraps colbymchenry/codegraph into agent tools - status, search, callers/callees, impact, explore, and more.
description.zh: 将 colbymchenry/codegraph 封装到代理工具中 - status、search、callers/callees、impact、explore 等等。

description.en: LLM adapter plugin for locally deployed Qwen models behind a vLLM OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with per-model multimodal switch, fully configurable reasoning efforts, and a web settings page for editing the deployment from the frontend.
description.zh: 面向 vLLM OpenAI 兼容端点上本地部署的 Qwen 模型的 LLM 适配器插件,支持按模型多模态开关、完全可配置的推理档位,以及可在前端编辑部署配置的 Web 设置页。

description.en: Token usage statistics by model, session and date in a sidebar panel, plus OpenCode Go quota, DeepSeek balance and Z.ai quota monitoring.
description.zh: 在侧边栏按模型、会话与日期统计 token 用量，并监控 OpenCode Go 额度、DeepSeek 余额与 Z.ai 额度。

description.en: Waifu desktop companion and replaceable WebUI skins for DeepSeek Harness

Customer-machine access plugin for deepseek-harness-gateway: opens a single outbound WebSocket to the gateway and relays the machine local dsh web UI over that tunnel using pairing-code + HMAC auth, so no inbound port, port mapping, or public IP is needed.
description.zh: 客户机接入插件：以单条出站 WebSocket 连接网关，把本机 dsh web 界面经隧道转发给门户，配对接入码 + HMAC 认证；无需入站端口、端口映射或公网 IP。

description.en: Firecrawl-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool, with a settings card for the API key and result limits.
description.zh: 基于 Firecrawl 的网页搜索提供方：替换内置 web_search 的后端，并提供 API Key、结果数量等字段的设置卡片。

description.en: Modellix integration for DSH: schema-driven image, video and audio generation in a split Design workspace, a live LLM model catalog, and native web search and fetch providers through one API key.
description.zh: 将 Modellix 接入 DSH：使用一个 API Key 在分栏 Design 工作区中提供基于 Schema 的图片、视频与音频生成、实时 LLM 模型目录，以及原生网页搜索与抓取 Provider。

description.en: Import Cursor, Codex, and Claude Code sessions and skills into DeepSeek Harness
Context7 MCP bridge: gives the model up-to-date, version-specific library documentation and code examples through the Context7 MCP server, keyless by default.
description.zh: 接入 Context7 托管 MCP 服务，为 agent 提供随版本更新的库文档查询；默认免密钥可用。

description.en: Brings your existing Claude / ChatGPT history into DSH: instant zero-token import of the memories.json inside a Claude export, local Claude Code transcripts with no export needed, and conversations distilled through the model you already configured in DSH. Every memory carries verbatim evidence checked against the source by code — a paraphrase is dropped and counted, and evidence found only in the assistant turns is always routed to review rather than stored.
description.zh: 把你在 Claude / ChatGPT 里已有的历史搬进 DSH：Claude 导出包里的 memories.json 零 token 瞬时入库，本机 Claude Code 记录免导出直读，历史对话用你在 DSH 里已配好的模型提纯。每条记忆都带由代码回原文核对的逐字证据——转述会被丢弃并计数，只在 AI 回复里找到的证据一律转人工确认而非直接入库。

description.en: Doubao-style voice chat for DSH: press-and-hold mic in the composer converts speech to text and auto-sends, and AI replies are read aloud. Optional LLM condensing (long replies summarized into short spoken lines, following the current conversation model), TTS-friendly text cleaning, selectable Edge TTS voices, adjustable silence auto-stop, and settings embedded in DSH settings dialog.
description.zh: 豆包式语音对话插件：聊天框麦克风按钮（按住说话）语音转文字并自动发送，AI 回复自动朗读。可选 LLM 转述精简（长回复压缩成口语再播，跟随当前对话模型）、朗读前清洗 markdown/emoji/特殊符号、Edge TTS 多种音色、静音自动结束时长可调，设置嵌入 DSH 自带设置弹窗（voice chat 类目）。

description.en: Volcengine Ark Coding Plan LLM provider for DeepSeek Harness: provider-scoped PDF and image input, with Responses API streaming support.
description.zh: 火山方舟 Coding Plan 的 DeepSeek Harness LLM provider：provider 级 PDF 与图片输入，支持 Responses API 流式。

description.en: Delegates a self-contained coding task to the local Claude Code subscription through the official Claude Agent SDK, and adds a session tab with live output, cost and remaining quota.
description.zh: 把自包含的编码任务委派给本机 Claude Code 订阅执行（走官方 Claude Agent SDK），并在会话里新增一个标签页，实时显示输出、费用与剩余额度。

description.en: Cost panel for DeepSeek Harness: meters every request from session events, prices it against a built-in catalog of 136 models across 16 providers, and shows the current model, account balance, session, today and month spend plus a monthly budget bar next to the composer. Bilingual zh/en.
description.zh: DSH 费用统计面板：从 session 事件采集每次请求用量，按内置 16 家厂商 136 个模型的价格目录实时计费，在输入框旁展示当前模型、账户余额、本会话/今日/本月消费与月度预算横条。中英双语。

description.en: Tavily settings backend for DeepSeek Harness: usage endpoint, flat key-list manager, and the opt-in advanced tavily_search tool switch.

ChatGPT-style question nav rail with up/down arrow buttons — per-question tick marks on the chat edge, hover-triggered drawer listing every user question with real-time search filter, one-click smooth-scroll jump, and active-question highlight synced to scroll position.
description.zh: ChatGPT 风格问题导航胶囊，带 ⏫⏬ 上下箭头 — 对话区右侧逐条刻度尺，悬停展开抽屉列出全部用户问题，实时搜索过滤、一键平滑跳转、滚动同步高亮当前问题，会话切换自动重挂载。

description.en: Publish TXT, Markdown, HTML, PDF, Word, and PowerPoint files as ShareOne links with passwords, watermarks, text-page updates, and TXT/Markdown/HTML comments.
description.zh: 将 TXT、Markdown、HTML、PDF、Word 和 PowerPoint 文件发布为 ShareOne 分享链接，支持访问密码、水印、文本页面更新和 TXT/Markdown/HTML 评论。

description.en: A6API 多模型聚合站接入插件：原生 LLM 提供商注册、账户实时余额与价格波动监控、Token 白名单同步、商户线路探测与全景指标卡片
A Live2D waifu plugin for DSH.
description.zh: dsh 的 Live2D 看板娘插件。

description.en: Browse and manage the community plugin catalog from a first-level DeepSeek Harness Settings page, with verified installs and updates, removal, pause and resume, installed-package state, and sanitized README previews.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置一级页面中浏览和管理社区插件目录，支持验证后安装与更新、删除、暂停与恢复、已安装状态查看及安全 README 预览。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 一键全功能增强套件 (自动化调度 + WebStorm Git 提交对比 + 代码文档多标签预览 + 对话快捷栏)
Claude Code rules.md-style rule prompts: activate rule markdown files by glob-matching the files an agent reads or edits, with prompt injection and ordering support.
description.zh: 类 Claude Code rules.md 的规则提示词：按智能体读取或编辑文件的 glob 匹配自动激活规则文档，支持提示词注入与排序。

description.en: ZERONE agent preset for DeepSeek Harness: 16 OMZ SDD workflow skills (grill, PRD/issue-driven coding, review, evolution) registered globally with zero install footprint.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 ZERONE 模式：16 个 OMZ SDD 工作流技能（澄清/PRD/issue 驱动编码、审查、进化机制）全局注册，零落盘安装（技能内嵌，不写入用户目录）。

description.en: Firecrawl MCP bridge: hosted Firecrawl MCP server with keyless search, scrape and parse; an API key unlocks the full tool surface including crawl and map.
description.zh: 接入 Firecrawl 托管 MCP 服务：免密钥即可使用搜索、抓取与解析（有每日额度），配置 API Key 后解锁完整工具集，含爬取与站点地图。

description.en: A fully customizable theming framework for DSH UI, with Xiao from Genshin Impact as the default theme.
description.zh: 为 DSH UI 提供完全自定义的主题框架，默认主题为原神魈。

description.en: Use a local TraeX coding agent as a DeepSeek Harness model provider over ACP.

A desktop-native pet bubble driven by DeepSeek Harness session events: transparent always-on-top Electron window, status-aware animations, voice chat/wake, real DSH task execution, emotion, festival, balance, pomodoro, roast, and DSH settings card.

Type normally; about two seconds after you pause, it rewrites your draft into a version more likely to get a good answer, leaving pasted code, links and long text untouched and keeping multi-part questions numbered.
description.zh: 你只管正常打字，停下约两秒，它就把你刚写的话自动改写成更容易得到好答案的样子；贴进来的代码、网址、长文原样不动，一次问几件事也一件不漏、排好顺序。

description.en: Android client implementation for DeepSeek Harness: bridges local dsh web to the OneBox app with QR scan-to-pair and an end-to-end encrypted cloud relay tunnel.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Android 客户端实现:扫码配对 + 端到端加密云端中继,把本机 dsh web 桥接到万宝盒 App。

description.en: Browser Use cloud bridge for dsh: run real web tasks — open pages, click, type, fill forms, and extract data — through the Browser Use API.
description.zh: Browser Use 云端桥接：通过 Browser Use API 让 dsh agent 执行真实网页任务，包括打开页面、点击、输入、填表和提取数据。

description.en: Use locally authenticated coding subscriptions as DeepSeek Harness model providers.

Model-facing `generate_image` tool for text-only models: the model asks for a picture in natural language, Gemini draws it via the Antigravity CLI, the image is saved to a configurable output directory, and the tool returns the file paths for the model to use in its work.
description.zh: 给纯文本模型的 `generate_image` 工具：模型用自然语言要一张图，经 Antigravity CLI 让 Gemini 画出，保存到可配置输出目录并返回文件路径，供模型在任务中使用。

description.en: Attaches a stable per-conversation x-opencode-session header to OpenCode / OpenCode Go provider requests, fixing 400 MissingSessionID errors and keeping session affinity and prompt-cache routing intact.
description.zh: 为 OpenCode / OpenCode Go 提供商请求自动附加每个会话稳定的 x-opencode-session 请求头，修复 400 MissingSessionID 错误，同时保持会话亲和与提示缓存路由。

description.en: Adds 20 locales (Traditional Chinese HK/TW, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Ukrainian, Polish, Dutch, Turkish, Arabic, Hindi, Indonesian, Vietnamese, Thai, Swedish) to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with hand-polished translations, runtime fallbacks, and automatic translation of market and third-party text.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 界面新增 20 种语言（繁体中文香港/台湾、日语、韩语、法语、德语、西班牙语、葡萄牙语、意大利语、俄语、乌克兰语、波兰语、荷兰语、土耳其语、阿拉伯语、印地语、印尼语、越南语、泰语、瑞典语），逐条精译并带运行时兜底，另加自动翻译，把市场与第三方文本翻译成你的语言。

description.en: Per-session status labels (built-in active/done/paused plus custom) shown in the sidebar, conversation header, and hover card, with editable colors.
description.zh: 为每个会话设置项目状态标签（内置进行中/已结项/搁置中+自定义标签，颜色可调），在侧栏、对话头部与悬停卡片中显示。

description.en: A minimal installable DeepSeek Harness plugin bundle.

DSH Desktop enhancement plugin: task-execution discipline plus a real relationship, per session. Discipline: adaptive protocol tiers (short for chat / full for tasks / lean for reasoning models), intent routing across Q&A, lookup, discussion, diagnosis and execution (diagnosis never fixes unasked), evidence recency (verify timestamps and causality before citing logs or old errors), real tool-result verification (failed or unknown results are never reported as done), self-healing on repeated failures with a cross-session reflection loop, and compaction awareness that re-anchors state after the host condenses history. Persona: distill named characters from WeChat/QQ chat logs with tone, catchphrases and reply length anchored to real conversation statistics; long-term memory with automatic expiry for time-bound facts, corrections captured as style rules, approved replies pinned as corpus, two-way feedback that converges with use, memory star map, and persona card export/import.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 增强插件，给会话装上任务执行纪律与真实关系。纪律层：自适应协议分层（闲聊短版/任务完整版/推理模型精简版）、意图路由（问答/查找/讨论/诊断/执行五类分流，诊断不越权修复）、证据时效（引用日志与旧报错前先核对时间戳与因果）、真实工具结果验证（失败或结果未知不报完成）、连续失败自动纠偏与跨会话复盘回环、上下文压缩感知与状态重锚。人设层：从微信/QQ 聊天记录蒸馏具名角色（语气、口头禅、回复篇幅锚定真实对话统计）、长期记忆与临时记忆自动过期、纠偏自动转风格约定、认可回复摘录为语料、双向反馈随使用收敛、记忆星图可视化、角色卡导出导入。

description.en: Sidebar skill hub: scan Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini skill directories for one-click import, manage global/project skills (toggle, trash), and install from dropped folders, zip archives, or local paths of any size.
description.zh: 侧边栏技能站：扫描 Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini 技能目录一键导入，管理全局与项目技能（启停、回收站），支持拖拽文件夹、zip 包与本地路径（不限大小）安装。

description.en: Periodic prompt injection for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: every N model invocations (conversation turns and tool-call steps both count) the plugin injects a user-configured prompt as a model-visible user message; the first injection happens at conversat
During long agent thinking, posts a hot-news or reminder message directly into the conversation stream.
description.zh: agent 思考超时时，直接在对话流中推出一条今日头条热点或提醒消息。

description.en: HTTP/API debugging toolset: full-control HTTP requests (method/headers/body/auth), curl command parsing and one-step execution, in-session request history with side-by-side response comparison, pagination-aware Link headers, and DeepSeek-branded UI cards (optional dsh-http-tools-ui).
description.zh: HTTP/API 调试工具集：全参数 HTTP 请求（method/headers/body/auth）、curl 命令解析与一步执行、会话内请求历史与响应并排对比、分页 Link 头透出；配合可选 dsh-http-tools-ui 提供 DeepSeek 风格工具卡片。

description.en: Dual-model auto-routing plugin: low-cost direct / high-cost upgrade with an escape-learning closed loop (wrong direct answers auto-learn fingerprints, force-upgrading the same fingerprint next time), persisted and interoperable with the Python ModelRouter.
description.zh: 双模型 Auto 路由插件：低成本模型直返 / 高成本模型升级 + 逃逸学习闭环（直返答错自动学习指纹，同指纹下次强制升级），状态持久化并与 Python ModelRouter 互通。

description.en: 插件市场：搜 npm 上的 dsh 插件，一键装进当前 profile，管理已装插件与更新。Plugin market for DeepSeek Harness: search npm, one-click install, manage plugins and updates.
Activity overview pane for the DSH web UI: running, awaiting-response and recent sessions with child agents, progress, model and reasoning level in one sidebar pane.
description.zh: DSH Web 活动会话总览窗格：将运行中、等待响应与近期活跃的会话集中到一个侧边窗格，含子代理层级、进度、模型与推理级别。

description.en: DeepSeek account balance in the dsh web sidebar footer with live config hot reload and an editable Settings → Plugins card.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 侧边栏底部展示 DeepSeek 账户余额，支持配置热重载与可编辑的设置 → 插件卡片。

description.en: An Aether Gazer Verdandi-inspired DSH Web UI skin with light and dark backgrounds, wedding-themed chrome, responsive character art, and themed conversation and sidebar surfaces.
description.zh: 一款以《深空之眼》薇儿丹蒂为主题的 DSH Web UI 皮肤，包含昼夜背景、誓约婚礼装饰、响应式角色立绘，以及主题化的会话区与侧边栏。

description.en: Shows DeepSeek account balance and current-session token and cost usage in the sidebar footer and composer dock, including peak and off-peak billing and subagent consumption.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部和输入框上方显示你的 DeepSeek 账户余额与当前会话 token 及费用消耗，支持高峰/空闲峰谷计费与子代理消耗统计。

description.en: QQ Official Bot adapter for C2C single chat, interactive action boards, workspace session management, and real-time Web UI sync.
description.zh: QQ 官方单聊机器人适配器：支持交互操作板、工作区会话管理与 Web UI 实时双向同屏。

description.en: Third-party menu manager for the DSH Web UI: collects new menu entries added by other plugins into one place, with fold/collapse and pinned menu items.
description.zh: 第三方菜单管理器：统一收纳第三方插件的新增菜单入口，提供常规折叠与固定菜单项。

description.en: Web search provider for the ctx.web seam that routes the DeepSeek web_search tool through a LiteLLM proxy using the OpenAI Responses API, reusing LITELLM_API_KEY.
description.zh: ctx.web 搜索提供方：通过 LiteLLM 代理走 OpenAI Responses API 调用 DeepSeek 原生服务端 web_search，复用 LITELLM_API_KEY，无需新密钥。

description.en: 可自定义收录清单的 DSH 插件市场：收录、安装、卸载、升级一站完成，附 agent 工具与 dshm CLI。

Hosted tool server over MCP: invoice and bank-statement extraction with in-code arithmetic checks, ledger reconciliation in integer cents, PDF and table conversion, SQL dialect transpiling, and mainland-China reachability probes run from a China Mobile network vantage point.
description.zh: 托管工具服务器（MCP）：发票与银行流水提取并做代码内算术校验、按整数分对账、PDF 与表格转换、SQL 方言转写，以及从中国移动骨干网实测大陆可达性。

description.en:
Static HTML auditor for Chinese line-breaking: checks explicit-`
` orphan lines, keep-all CSS coverage, CJK line-start/line-end punctuation rules, and protected-phrase splits, then inserts at natural breakpoints; exposes a cn_linebreak_audit tool for agents.
description.zh:
中文网页文案断行静态审查与修复工具：检查显式
孤字行、keep-all 覆盖、标点禁则、保护词被拆等问题，并在自然停顿处自动插入 ；提供 cn_linebreak_audit 工具供代理调用。

description.en: DSH workspace hub: organize workspaces into color-coded folders in the sidebar (three-level drag reorder for folders/workspaces/sessions, inline edit, one-click expand/collapse, dual-channel search) with per-workspace and per-session token usage and cost stats from real session logs (official DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing for any deepseek model, three spend calibers, hover detail cards, overview panel) plus OpenCode Go plan usage; data persists to host disk and refreshes live every 30 s.
description.zh: DSH 工作区中枢：侧边栏将工作区按彩色分组管理（分组/工作区/会话三级拖拽排序、内联编辑、一键展开折叠、标题+消息双通道搜索），基于真实会话日志统计每工作区与每会话的 Token 与花费（任意 deepseek 模型自动按官方峰谷价计费、三种时段口径、悬停明细卡、总览面板），另含 OpenCode Go 额度；分组与结果持久化到本机磁盘，30 秒实时刷新。

description.en: Pixel-art reasoning-effort slider for DSH Web with continuous 0–100 dragging, 16ms throttled writes, snap-to-level commits, and a WebGL ember fire that ignites as the slider moves.
description.zh: 炭灰余烬风格的 DSH Web 像素推理强度滑块：以近黑木炭、暗红裂纹和橙红高温核心呈现 4px 像素化 WebGL 火焰，拖动时逐档点燃；支持 0–100 无极拖动、16ms 节流写入与松手吸附。

description.en: Minimal-compatible first turn for Web root sessions: starts with persistent bash and str_replace_editor, removes automatic workspace and skill context, then restores the selected preset after the first tool call or reply; includes a persistent composer toggle.
description.zh: Web 根会话的首轮精简：先使用持久 bash 与 str_replace_editor，移除自动工作区和技能上下文；首次工具调用或回复后恢复所选预设，带持久 composer 开关。

description.en: Data-loss-prevention plugin for DeepSeek Harness: a non-configurable tool guard floor, tool-result redaction, and fail-closed telemetry redaction
description.zh: Data-loss-prevention plugin for DeepSeek Harness: a non-configurable tool guard floor, tool-result redaction, and fail-closed telemetry redaction

description.en: GitHub MCP helper panel: shows copyable example prompts at Settings → Plugins → GitHub MCP (random 4 from a 30-example pool), visualizes a public user's repo star/fork/language, and adds the gh_repo_stats and gh_current_user model tools.
description.zh: GitHub MCP 辅助面板：在「设置 → 插件 → GitHub MCP」展示可复制的示例提示（30 条示例池随机 4 条）、可视化公开仓库的星/fork/语言，并提供 gh_repo_stats / gh_current_user 模型工具。

description.en: Cross-agent monitoring board for local AI agent sessions (cursor-ide, claude, codex, copilot, kimi and dsh itself) with session timelines, and message injection behind a default-off two-phase confirmation gate.
description.zh: 跨 agent 看板监控本机 AI agent 会话（cursor-ide、claude、codex、copilot、kimi 及 dsh 自身），提供会话时间线，并可经默认关闭的两阶段确认门注入消息。

description.en: Checkpoint / rewind / prune recovery toolkit over .dsh/memory/checkpoints.md. 基于检查点文件的恢复工具包（checkpoint / rewind / prune）

QQ official bot channel for DeepSeek Harness (feature-rich fork of tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot): group and private chat with the full agent, sticker library with auto-tagging and AI meme replies, group management (join approval and mute), botplay interactive card events with paginated catalogs, user extension registry (custom slash commands and QQ tools), scheduled wakeups, remote approvals over QQ, and a floating dock web UI.
description.zh: 接入 QQ 官方机器人的 DeepSeek Harness 通道(tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot 功能增强 fork): 群/私聊与完整 agent 对话、表情包图库(自动打标+AI 斗图)、群管理(入群审批/禁言)、botplay 互动事件卡与翻页目录、用户扩展注册表(自定义斜杠命令与 QQ 工具)、定时唤醒、QQ 远程审批、悬浮球 dock Web UI。

description.en: Built-in Obsidian-style knowledge base for DSH: agents distill conversations, documents and web sources into a structured .wiki graph, with retrieval, graph export, note editing, incremental builds and multi-vault management.
description.zh: DSH 内置版 Obsidian 知识库：agent 把对话、文档与网页蒸馏为结构化 .wiki 知识图，支持检索、图谱导出、笔记编辑、增量构建与多库管理。

description.en: Flyout sidebar with a file tree, uncommitted-changes list and multi-tab file/diff previews; pops out into a standalone browser tab.
description.zh: 可弹出侧边栏：文件树、Git 未提交变更列表与多标签文件/diff 预览，一键弹出为独立浏览器标签页。

description.en: Peak-Valley Meter (峰谷电表) — a tiny DeepSeek usage companion: a minimal two-part balance chip above the composer (currency symbol + number, nothing else), official balance refreshed every 5s; click the symbol to open the official top-up page in a new tab; hovering the chip fades in a circular backdrop under the symbol, its left arc flush with the chip's own left edge, and expands a 24h peak/valley timeline (orange=peak, blue=valley, glowing marker at the current local time) so off-peak hours are obvious; independent today-spend metering; a settings panel with 10 muted color presets plus custom valley/peak colors, detailed/minimal styles and readout toggles; all-Chinese UI.
description.zh: 峰谷电表——DeepSeek 用量小助手：输入框上方一枚极简余额徽章，框内只有「货币符号 + 余额数字」两组，官方余额每 5 秒实时刷新；点击符号即在新页签打开官方充值页；光标移入徽章时，符号身下浮现一枚圆形底色（左弧与徽章左端圆角完全重合），并展开 24 小时峰谷时间轴（橙=峰时、蓝=谷时、白色发光指针标当前本地时刻），谷时省钱时段一目了然；今日消耗独立计费；设置面板提供 10 套沉稳配色预置与谷/峰色自定义、详细/极简样式与各项读数开关；全中文界面。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that periodically detects added, modified, and deleted files in a workspace and reports the changes.
description.zh: 一个适配 DeepSeek Harness 的工作区监测插件，按周期检测并报告文件的新增、修改和删除。

description.en: Human-governed cross-session memory spaces with independent source and consumer relationships, provenance, versioning, and pre-send injection review.
description.zh: 用户治理的跨会话记忆空间，提供独立的来源与使用关系、来源追踪、版本管理和发送前注入检查。

description.en: Injects durable user-set must-do and must-not requirements into the model at conversation start.
description.zh: 在会话开始时向模型注入用户设定的“必须做 / 不能做”持久要求。

description.en: Host-side guard that lets the write tool only create new files: when the target already exists it denies the call before execution and tells the model to use edit instead, applied to all sessions.
description.zh: 纯 host 端守卫，让 write 工具只允许创建新文件：目标已存在时在执行前直接拒绝并提示改用 edit，全局所有会话生效。

description.en: DSH plugin for AST context compression, test log filtering, and token budget guard
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 AST 上下文压缩、测试日志过滤与 Token 预算守卫：剔除冗余语法、精简日志噪声，并强制执行 Token 上限以防止上下文窗口溢出。

description.en: Generates UI wireframes and high-fidelity mockups in DeepSeek Harness with selectable DashScope and Volcengine image providers.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用可切换的阿里云百炼与火山方舟图像服务生成 UI 线框图和高保真设计稿。

description.en: Programmatic token usage egress reading session cumulative usage buckets (uncached/cacheRead/cacheWrite/output). 会话累计 token 四桶可编程出口
Self-learning loop for dsh: record lessons, draft and promote skills, periodic curator review that corrects, consolidates, and retires skills.
description.zh: dsh 自我学习闭环：记录经验、生成并发布技能，定期审查修正、合并与退役技能。

description.en: Model authorization gate: subagent model/provider pulls must be in the user-controlled allowlist. 模型授权闸：子代理拉模型必须 ∈ 用户 allowlist
Standing system-prompt rule keywords that steer agent behavior mid-session via notice injection. 常驻系统提示规则关键词（notice 注入引导行为）
Adds a Codex-style message navigation rail for quickly locating earlier prompts in long DeepSeek Harness Web UI conversations.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 添加 Codex 风格的消息导航轨道，方便在长会话中快速定位历史提问。

description.en: Models+ settings page for the DSH web UI: per-model reasoning-effort tables, input modalities and compat flags saved through the official settings pipeline, with models.dev metadata prefill and API key management.
description.zh: 模型+ 设置页:按模型声明推理挡位、输入模态与兼容参数(走官方 settings 管线保存),支持 models.dev 元数据预填与 API 密钥管理。

description.en: Permission mode between workspace-write and full access: shell commands are checked by deterministic rules and a subagent review; irreversible or system-level actions require explicit approval.
description.zh: 介于 workspace-write 与 Full access 之间的权限模式：命令先经规则与子代理审查，不可逆或系统级操作需人工批准。

description.en: Project skill discovery: enumerate .dsh/skills entries with a SKILL.md present. 项目技能枚举（.dsh/skills 只读清单）
Controlled one-shot executor subagents with persona, tool allowlist, timeout and cancellation. 受控一次性执行层子代理（persona + 工具白名单 + 超时取消）

Read-only Sentry tools: project listing, issue search at organization or project scope, single issue detail, and the latest or a specific event with a trimmed stacktrace. Local variables, request headers and bodies, query strings, packages and secret-looking tags are removed before the event reaches the model, and oversized events degrade through source context, breadcrumbs and frames rather than failing.
description.zh: 面向 Sentry 的只读工具：项目列表、组织或项目范围的议题搜索、单个议题详情，以及最新或指定 event 的裁剪后堆栈。局部变量、请求头与请求体、查询字符串、依赖清单以及疑似机密的 tag 会在 event 交给模型前移除；超大 event 会依次降级源码上下文、面包屑与栈帧，而不是直接失败。

description.en: Multi-machine, multi-agent orchestration and control plane for DSH: discovers Agents and workspaces across devices, routes tasks by machine, repository, capability, and load to local or remote Agent runtimes, streams progress and results, forwards approvals, and recovers durable tasks after disconnections.
description.zh: DSH 的多机多 Agent 编排与控制平台：发现各设备上的 Agent 与工作区，按机器、仓库、能力和负载将任务路由到本地或远程 Agent Runtime，统一回传进度、审批与结果，并在断线后恢复持久任务。

description.en: Start and detach standalone chats without a mandatory workspace, keeping DSH's native workspace UI intact.
description.zh: 无需强制绑定工作区即可新建和分离独立会话，同时保留 DSH 原生的工作区界面。

description.en: Non-destructive DSH seam capability probe writing a two-evidence-level manifest (present vs invoked-ok). DSH seam 能力探测，输出现场/实调双证据能力清单
Conversation timeline dock bar for DeepSeek Harness: a turn-level timeline above the composer with user-prompt hover tooltips and click-to-jump back to the exact chat position.
description.zh: 对话时间线横条：输入框上方按轮次聚合的时间线，悬停显示该轮用户提示词，点击直接跳转到对话中的对应位置。

description.en: Read-only Odoo tools over JSON-RPC: server info, model field introspection, and a restricted search_read limited to an allow list of models whose domain field names may not contain dots, so related-record traversal is not possible. A draft-create tool is registered only when allowWrite is enabled, and is limited to sale.order and project.task with the draft state enforced by the plugin.
description.zh: 经 JSON-RPC 的 Odoo 只读工具：服务器信息、模型字段自省，以及受限的 search_read——仅限白名单模型，且 domain 字段名不允许包含点号，因此无法沿关联关系穿透。草稿创建工具需显式开启 allowWrite 才会注册，且仅限 sale.order 与 project.task，草稿状态由插件强制。

description.en: Token usage and cost metering for dsh: per-session and aggregate statistics with configurable pricing and reports.
description.zh: dsh 用量计量：会话级与汇总 token 统计、可配置计价与报告。

description.en: Visual Kanban board for DeepSeek Harness: Gitea-backed tasks, workflow columns, and a dedicated agent session per task.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可视化看板，支持 Gitea 任务、工作流列和每任务独立 Agent 会话。

description.en: Cherry Studio-style paste: multi-line/indented/fenced text or code pasted into the DSH Web composer collapses into a bordered, collapsible, language-tagged card and is restored as a fenced code block on send.
description.zh: Cherry Studio 式粘贴：把多行/缩进/围栏文本或代码粘进 DSH Web 输入框时收成带边框、可折叠、带语言标签的卡片，发送时还原为围栏代码块。

description.en: Native A2A (Agent-to-Agent) server for dsh: expose this dsh as a callable agent over HTTP with JSON-RPC tasks.
description.zh: dsh 原生 A2A 服务：通过 HTTP JSON-RPC 将本 dsh 暴露为可调用的代理。

description.en: Security and governance for dsh: rule-based tool denial, full tool-call audit trail, and governance reports.
description.zh: dsh 安全治理：规则化工具拦截、完整工具调用审计轨迹与治理报告。

description.en: WebDAV sync for DeepSeek Harness - sync settings, sessions, profiles, presets to JiaGuoYun (坚果云).

Read-only Grafana tools that query metrics through the data source proxy: instance health, data source listing, instant and range PromQL queries, current alert state, and provisioned alert rules. Range queries downsample to a point budget; an explicitly supplied step that would exceed it is rejected rather than silently changed, so the model never receives data at a resolution it did not ask for.
description.zh: 面向 Grafana 的只读工具，经数据源代理查询指标：实例健康、数据源列表、instant 与 range PromQL 查询、当前告警状态与已配置的告警规则。range 查询会按点数预算降采样；调用方显式指定的 step 若会超量则直接拒绝，而不是静默改写，避免模型拿到与预期不同分辨率的数据。

description.en: Adds a Graph tab that renders one session's execution as an interactive DAG of turns, LLM steps, tools, skills, subagents, code changes and tests, with live status, retry aggregation, critical path and trajectory linkage.
description.zh: 在会话区新增「图谱」Tab，把单个会话的执行过程渲染为可交互 DAG：轮次、LLM 步骤、工具、技能、子代理、代码改动与测试，支持实时状态、重试聚合、关键路径与轨迹双向联动。

description.en: Version-token-validated in-process result cache for the DSH read tool: repeated reads of unchanged files skip file I/O and line rendering, with a readcache tool for stats and clearing.
description.zh: 为 DSH read 工具提供版本令牌校验的进程内结果缓存：未变更文件的重复读取跳过文件 I/O 与行渲染，附带 readcache 工具查看统计与清空。

description.en: Authenticated LAN, Tailnet, and public HTTPS access for a DSH Host, with persistent host identity, pairing, and QR setup.
description.zh: 为 DSH Host 提供经认证的局域网、Tailnet 与公网 HTTPS 接入，支持持久主机身份、配对和二维码配置。

description.en: Zero-config lint feedback loop: lint_diagnostics / lint_workspace_errors / lint_fix tools driven by the eslint / biome / ruff already present in the repo (auto-detected from config files, repo-local node_modules/.bin resolved first, nothing bundled), plus an auto-injected post-edit findings delta wired to the harness fs/observed event — edit → lint → auto-repair with one lint_fix call for dsh agents.
description.zh: 零配置 lint 反馈闭环：由仓库已有的 eslint / biome / ruff 驱动（从配置文件自动探测、优先解析仓库本地 node_modules/.bin、不捆绑任何 linter）提供 lint_diagnostics / lint_workspace_errors / lint_fix 工具，并订阅 harness 的 fs/observed 事件自动注入「本次编辑引入的发现增量」——为 dsh Agent 带来编辑→lint→一键自动修复的闭环体验。

description.en: Trusted Iroh mesh networking for DSH hosts, with encrypted peer discovery, remote session delivery, and reachability status.
description.zh: 基于 Iroh 的可信 DSH 主机网状网络：提供加密的节点发现、远程会话投递与连通状态。

description.en: Per-profile settings overlay for DeepSeek Harness: global settings.yaml stays the baseline while each profile overrides any namespace through its own profiles/<name>/settings.patch.yml — object sections merge recursively, scalars and arrays replace wholesale, and !unset masks an inherited value. The overlay is transparent to existing plugins (they keep reading ctx.settings unchanged), writes land in the profile overlay only, and official schema validation, revision semantics, expectedRevision conflicts, watchers and events are untouched. Ships a settings command family (get/set/unset/mask/unmask/promote/demote/migrate/diff/layers) plus a Profile Settings section in the web Settings panel over a loopback RPC channel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按 profile 分层的设置覆盖：全局 settings.yaml 仍为基线，每个 profile 可用自己的 profiles/<name>/settings.patch.yml 覆盖任意设置命名空间——对象段递归合并，数组与标量整体替换，!unset 显式屏蔽继承值。覆盖层对现有插件透明（照常读 ctx.settings），写入只落在 profile 覆盖层；官方 schema 语义、revision、expectedRevision 冲突检测、watcher 与事件均不改动。附带 settings 命令族（get/set/unset/mask/unmask/promote/demote/migrate/diff/layers），并在 Web 设置面板经 loopback RPC 通道提供 Profile Settings 区块。

description.en: DeepSeek bills peak hours at 2x, and peak is 09-12 and 14-18 Beijing time. npx dsh-lean audit shows what your session paid and what it costs off-peak. DeepSeek 峰时按 2 倍计费，峰时正好是上班时间。
description.zh: Same answer, smaller bill. Cuts the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) prompt prefix by 53% and one-shot session cost by 41%, measured. 同样的结果，更小的账单。

description.en: Configurable web search for DeepSeek Harness using SearXNG, Wikipedia, Tavily, Brave, or Gemini, with per-client engine selection and bounded retries.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可配置联网搜索，支持 SearXNG、Wikipedia、Tavily、Brave 与 Gemini，并支持客户端引擎选择和受控重试。

description.en: ACP adapter to drive DeepSeek Harness from Obsidian Agent Client (and other ACP clients): list, resume and fork sessions, run the harness, and archive conversations.
description.zh: 通过 Obsidian Agent Client（及其他 ACP 客户端）驱动 DeepSeek Harness 的 ACP 适配器：可列出、续接、派生会话，运行 Harness 并归档对话。

description.en: Routes the DSH web_search tool through Ollama's web search API, reusing OLLAMA_API_KEY. No DeepSeek official key needed.
description.zh: 让 DSH 的 web_search 工具走 Ollama 联网搜索 API，复用 OLLAMA_API_KEY，无需 DeepSeek 官方 Key。

description.en: DSH web plugin: an official right-Sidebar tab type ('vscode') that embeds the VS Code web workbench opened at the current session workspace — same-origin by default through the plugin's built-in reverse proxy (/sidebar/vscode), or via a gateway subpath /
description.zh: 在侧边栏嵌入 VS Code 网页版，选中代码或文件可一键转为引用片段，提升开发效率。

description.en: Agentic answer reviewer for DeepSeek Harness: each final assistant turn is re-reviewed by a separate LLM graded 1-100; below-threshold scores steer the agent back with concrete feedback. Live config over a 127.0.0.1 HTTP server, plus a right-sidebar config tab via dsh-better-sidebar.
description.zh: 智能体回答审查器：每一轮 agent 的最终输出由独立 LLM 重新打分（1-100），低于阈值时携带具体反馈引导 agent 自我修正。配置经 127.0.0.1 本地 HTTP 服务实时修改，也支持 dsh-better-sidebar 侧栏配置页。

description.en: Add a theme-adjustment panel under Appearance to customize accent, background, foreground, contrast and gradient, applied live through theme token overrides.
description.zh: 在「外观」下增加一个主题调节面板，可自定义强调色/背景色/前景色/对比度/渐变度，并实时生效。

description.en: Track the origin of local development ports on Windows and safely manage verified DSH services.
description.zh: Windows 本地开发端口来源追踪与安全处理工具。

description.en: Lets a text-only DeepSeek agent read images in the same session by delegating to a vision-capable subagent, with send-time image-to-path conversion.
description.zh: 让纯文本 DeepSeek 代理在同一会话内读图：委派给视觉子代理，发送时自动把图片转为文件路径。

description.en: Registers the remove-pdf-background-gray skill for DSH: whitens gray/off-white scan backgrounds in image-based PDFs while preserving resolution, page geometry, and anti-aliased text edges (lossless Flate write-back), via a single Python script (pypdf + Pillow + numpy).
description.zh: 注册 remove-pdf-background-gray 技能：去除扫描 PDF 的灰色/米白底色，保持分辨率、页面几何与抗锯齿文字边缘（无损 Flate 写回），核心为单文件 Python 脚本（pypdf + Pillow + numpy）。

description.en: MiOpIIk plugin suite for DeepSeek Harness: one-command install of all seven plugins plus the miopiik four-layer workflow preset initializer. MiOpIIk 套件包：一条命令装齐 7 插件并初始化四层工作流 preset
In-place terminal popover for a dsh (DeepSeek Harness) web client, launched from the conversation dock. Built as a Feature-Sliced Design static Cordis plugin.
Settings panel for global and per-workspace AGENTS.md, with identity and persona injection, runtime-context toggle, and result notifications.
description.zh: 设置面板管理全局与各工作区 AGENTS.md，支持身份与人设注入、运行时上下文开关和结果通知。

description.en: Matrix-style CLI chat page for the DSH web UI: the agent's thinking streams down the screen as green code rain while replies print normally in the terminal.
description.zh: 矩阵风格 CLI 对话页：Agent 思考过程化作绿色代码雨倾泻而下，回复照常流式显示。

description.en: Adds /btw for one-off, context-aware side questions without tool execution, with independent answer bubbles that can be copied, collapsed, or closed without adding answers to the main conversation.
description.zh: 提供 /btw 一次性上下文旁问，不执行工具；回答显示在可复制、折叠或关闭的独立气泡中，不写入主对话。

description.en: Compaction fix for NInfer-hosted qwen3.8-27b gateways: disables thinking on dsh context-compaction and session-title calls so xhigh reasoning stops burning the whole output budget; the same idea applies to other launch methods, this package targets NInfer only.
description.zh: 针对 NInfer 托管的 qwen3.8-27b 网关的压缩修复：在 dsh 上下文压缩与会话标题调用中关闭思考，避免 xhigh 推理耗尽全部输出预算；同一思路适用于其他启动方式，本包仅面向 NInfer。

description.en: Live dot-matrix whale wallpaper for the DSH Web UI: ~1,750 breathing WebGL2 particles with pointer liquid vortices, light/dark themes, and a Canvas2D fallback.
description.zh: DSH Web 动态点阵鲸鱼壁纸：约 1,750 个呼吸的 WebGL2 粒子，指针液态涡流交互，明暗双主题，带 Canvas2D 回退。

description.en: Runs PowerShell scripts through base64 encoding, so quotes, $, backslashes and CJK survive as written. Same sandbox channel as the built-in pwsh tool.
description.zh: 把 PowerShell 脚本 base64 编码后执行，引号、$、反斜杠、中文全部原样传递，免去转义地狱。走与内置 pwsh 工具相同的沙箱通道。

description.en: Streams DeepSeek Harness sessions, messages, tool activity, and turn outcomes to a JARVIS Mission Control board with task status and human review.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的会话、消息、工具活动与每轮结果实时推送到 JARVIS Mission Control 看板，附任务状态与人工复核。

description.en: Shows the installed DeepSeek Harness version in the sidebar, checks npm and GitHub Releases for updates, and provides manual or confirmed update commands.
description.zh: 在侧边栏显示已安装的 DeepSeek Harness 版本，检查 npm 与 GitHub Releases 更新，并提供手动或确认后执行的更新命令。

description.en: Ranks OpenRouter providers for the current DSH model by quantization, speed, cache-heavy price, context, and uptime, with one-click switching to help reduce token costs.
description.zh: 按量化、速度、缓存重度价格、上下文和可用率为当前 DSH 模型推荐 OpenRouter 供应商，并支持一键切换以帮助降低 token 成本。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for Assistant Policy.

Real-time hot topics panel for the DSH web GUI: AI news and engineering news, each item with a distilled summary and the source link, shown from a sidebar entry with three views, keyword/source filters, read-state marking and hotkeys.
description.zh: DSH Web 时事热点面板：AI 大事与工科热点实时聚合，每条含要点提炼与来源链接；侧边栏入口、三视图、关键词与来源筛选、已读标记与快捷键。

description.en: Interactive terminal UI for deepseek-harness, installed as a dsh profile bundle
A safe, searchable, approval-gated Markdown knowledge vault for DeepSeek Harness.

Registers the Inspiration Deck Workshop skill for DSH: local static HTML presentation decks (6 deck templates, 25+ layouts, 23 themes & motion showroom) with a validate + PNG/PDF export CLI and smoke tests, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 注册灵感演示工坊技能：本地静态 HTML 演示文稿（6 套 deck 模板、25+ 布局、23 套主题与动效展示馆），带 validate 校验与 PNG/PDF 导出 CLI 和 smoke 测试，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Create a one-click Windows desktop shortcut from the Settings page: a .cmd launcher + desktop icon for DeepSeek Harness or any local server, auto-opens the browser, with taskbar pin hints.
description.zh: 在设置页一键创建 Windows 桌面快捷方式：为 DeepSeek Harness 或任意本地服务生成 .cmd 启动器与桌面图标，自动打开浏览器、可固定任务栏。

description.en: Open DSH workspace directories in installed file managers, terminals, and supported editors from the Web UI.
description.zh: 从 DSH Web UI 使用已安装的文件管理器、终端和受支持的编辑器打开工作区目录。

description.en: A durable, fenced cold-start scheduler and isolated Agent runner for DeepSeek Harness.
DeepSeek Harness 自动化任务与调度中心插件 (WorkBuddy 原生交互对齐版)
Protect declared workspace subpaths such as .git from writes, and optionally grant extra writable roots under workspace-write.
description.zh: 为工作区指定子路径提供只读保护 (例如 .git), 并支持在 workspace-write 下声明额外可写根。

description.en: Connects GitHub's official remote MCP server as a DSH plugin: stores the PAT in DSH's credential center (.credentials.yaml) via github_set_token, and exposes GitHub tools as mcp__github__*.
description.zh: 把 GitHub 官方远程 MCP server 封装为 DSH 插件：PAT 存入 DSH 凭据中心（.credentials.yaml），提供 github_set_token / github_token_status 模型工具，GitHub 工具以 mcp__github__* 形式可用。

description.en: Scoped, bounded, approval-gated long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness agents.
Community perk game plugin: play blackjack in dsh to win spendable model credit. 社区福利小游戏插件：在 dsh 里玩 21 点赢取可消费的模型额度。
description.zh: 在 dsh 里玩 21 点小游戏，赢取仅限本插件使用的模型额度，轻松娱乐还能薅点福利。

description.en: Skill marketplace with unified search across SkillHub and ClawHub, in-app README preview, one-click install and uninstall, an installed-skill list, and a chat-input skill picker.
description.zh: 技能市场插件，聚合 SkillHub 与 ClawHub 双源搜索，支持站内 README 预览、一键安装与卸载、已装技能列表，以及聊天栏技能选择器。

description.en: Plugin quality scorecard for DeepSeek Harness: 0-100 with grade, 6 components, fix suggestions per deduction, batch leaderboard - CLI plus an agent-callable quality_score tool.
description.zh: dsh 插件质量评分卡：0-100 分 + 等级 + 六项分项，逐项修复建议，支持批量榜单 - CLI + agent 可调用 quality_score 工具。

description.en: Self-tending living memory in one local SQLite file — a nightly patrol dedupes, merges, decays and cross-links entries on its own, with seven-signal RRF hybrid recall (FTS5 + jieba Chinese-first tokenization, optional vector KNN, graph PPR), a typed knowledge graph, conflict detection instead of silent overwrites, and web telemetry panels.
description.zh: 单文件本地 SQLite 的自整理活记忆——夜巡引擎自动去重、合并、衰减、建链，七信号 RRF 混合检索（FTS5+jieba 中文优先分词、可选向量 KNN、图谱 PPR），带类型知识图谱，冲突检测标记矛盾而非静默覆写，Web 遥测面板。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) settings panel: '规则、命令与技能' — visual rule editing, slash command list, user-defined custom command management (with {input} argument support, disable/enable), skill management (view/disable/enable/delete-to-trash), and backup restore
Claude Code CLI as an LLM provider for dsh: live model list, per-session resume, approval relay, images, a memory/rewind/changes panel, and workspaces on remote SSH boxes.
description.zh: Claude Code CLI as an LLM provider for dsh: live model list, per-session resume, approval relay, images, a memory/rewind/changes panel, and workspaces on remote SSH boxes.

description.en: Static and runtime security guard for dsh: rule-based scans for malicious code, prompt injection and token waste, runtime interception of dangerous tool calls, /scan command, plugin_scan tool, web panel, and allowlist.
description.zh: dsh 安全守卫插件：基于规则的静态扫描覆盖恶意代码、提示词注入与令牌浪费，运行时拦截危险工具调用，提供 /scan 命令、plugin_scan 工具、Web 面板与白名单。

description.en: Fold the DSH tool surface per request + ChainGuard firewall (high-risk block + exfil-chain detection + anti-obfuscation) + BM25/bge-m3 hybrid tools_search. Shrinks schema tokens 80-90% while keeping selection accuracy. v0.2.0 adds a semantic retrieval leg
description.zh: 装了大量 MCP 时折叠工具定义提示面：KV 缓存稳定的静态目录 + BM25/bge-m3 混合 tools_search + tools_schema 批量展开，几百个工具仍可检索，但不必每轮都付完整 schema 的 token。

description.en: DSH-native Matrix IM entry adapter for Agora governance — second IM implementation alongside cc-connect

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-matrix-connector
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-matrix-connector

notes: added the missing web platform to the client half

description.en: Session management enhancement plugin for DeepSeek Harness - workspace session count display, archived sessions panel with restore/delete, drag-and-drop session move across workspaces.
description.zh: DSH 会话管理增强插件 - 工作区会话数展示、归档会话面板（支持恢复/删除）、拖拽移动会话到其他工作区。

description.en: Durable bounded file, HTTP/JSON, and HMAC webhook triggers for DSH automations.
A core-only meta-bundle for the DSH personal assistant policy, memory, Wiki, and automations plugins.
DSH plugin for smart checkpoints, workspace safety guards, and instant rollback
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供智能检查点、工作区安全防护和即时回滚。

description.en: Maintainer and developer PR board for the DSH sidebar: a five-state review queue (waiting on me / waiting on author / ready to merge / merged / inbox), a three-column issue board, and a global view of the PRs you authored (my move / waiting on others / merged), with CI rollup badges, an inactivity filter, and one click per card to open or start the matching review conversation.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏的维护者 + 开发者 PR 看板：五状态评审队列（等我 / 等作者 / 可合并 / 已合并 / 待分诊）、三列 issue 看板、跨仓库跟踪自己 PR 的 mine 视图（我的回合 / 等别人 / 已合并），附 CI 汇总徽章与不活跃过滤，点卡片一键打开或新建对应的评审会话。

description.en: OpenHarness Reader — workspace file browser/editor with Markdown preview for DeepSeek Harness Web
description.zh: OpenHarness Reader - workspace file browser/editor with Markdown preview for DeepSeek Harness Web

description.en: dsh plugin: drive an existing dsh session from Feishu/Lark — round cards, interactive resume, ask-user cards, steer (outbound-only WebSocket bot)
description.zh: 在手机上通过飞书/Lark 远程操控已有的 dsh 会话，随时派活、看进度，还能一键恢复任务。

description.en: Policy-gated, content-free health and readiness aggregation for DSH assistant services.
A durable, policy-gated inbound/outbound message core for DeepSeek Harness.
Community plugin — NOT affiliated with DeepSeek AI. Extensible multi-provider web search for DSH — built-in DashScope and MiMo, easy to add more.
A thin Feishu/Lark WebSocket adapter for the durable DSH assistant-delivery core.

Ecosystem-wide plugin health audit: syncs the dsh-plugin topic into a local scored catalog (maintenance / docs / npm + weekly downloads / ecosystem, 0-100, A-D), static security scan with high-finding grade veto, star history snapshots, web leaderboard and agent tools.
description.zh: 插件生态体检：将 dsh-plugin 话题同步为本地评分目录（维护/文档/npm+周下载/生态四维，0-100 分 A-D 级），静态安全扫描高危一票否决，支持 star 历史快照、Web 榜单与 Agent 工具。

description.en: An audited OS-keychain credential-handle service for trusted DeepSeek Harness plugins.
Render Markdown + JSON into self-contained HTML documents, cards, dashboards, and galleries (CLI + artifact_render tool).
description.zh: 把 Markdown + JSON 渲染成自包含 HTML 文档/卡片/仪表盘/画廊（CLI + 内置 artifact_render 工具）。

description.en: Proposal-only, provenance-stable promotion between DSH personal Memory and Wiki.
A股 / 港股量化工作台：自选股、K线图、公司数据、策略配置与回测。 · A-share & Hong Kong stock quant workbench for DeepSeek Harness.
Adds a /simplify command that asks the agent to simplify code within a selected Git change scope, including staged changes, commits, and untracked files.
description.zh: 提供 /simplify 命令，让 Agent 在选定的 Git 变更范围内简化代码，支持暂存变更、提交及未跟踪文件。

description.en: Approval-gated behavioural self-evolution for the DSH personal assistant.
Pre-install supply-chain checks for DeepSeek Harness plugins: verify the tarball you are about to install matches the source you read, before any code runs.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件做安装前供应链校验：在代码运行前核对即将安装的包是否与你读到的源码一致。

description.en: DSH 凭据桥接插件：AI 代填登录表单/注入 env 运行 CLI，值不进模型上下文；附网页管理界面
description.zh: 让 AI 从凭据库取账号代填登录表单、注入环境变量跑 CLI，密码不进模型上下文。

description.en: API 用量余额插件 for DeepSeek Harness — webui 用量圆圈内提供「用量 / 余额」标签切换，展示账户余额与用量明细
description.zh: 在 webui 用量圆圈里加个「用量 / 余额」切换，随时看账户余额和用量明细。

description.en: DSH 设置面板新增「已归档会话」页：列出全部已归档会话并一键恢复。Settings page listing archived sessions with one-click restore.
description.zh: 在设置面板里集中查看所有已归档会话，点一下就能恢复，不用再翻来翻去。

description.en: Auto-discovery CLIProxyAPI provider for DeepSeek Harness, featuring dynamic model sync, native model switching, and vision-model selection.
description.zh: 自动发现并接入 CLIProxyAPI，模型动态同步、一键切换，还能挑视觉模型。
为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 DolphinDB 数据库接入，支持 WebSocket 执行查询与写入，让智能体直接操作时序数据。

description.en: 一个致力于让Agent在日常交流中更加拥有“活人感”的DSH插件。
description.zh: 让 Agent 按节律自己醒来，维护记忆、感知忙闲，再决定要不要开口，交流更有活人感。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: built-in HTTPS reverse proxy with configurable settings (设置→插件配置→Https Fix)
description.zh: 给 dsh 的 Web GUI 加个 HTTPS 反向代理，配上账密登录和证书，外网也能安全访问。

description.en: Peak/off-peak billing clock with live DeepSeek balance and per-turn cost above the dsh-tui prompt, plus an optional flashing peak-hour warning frame.
description.zh: 在 dsh-TUI 提示符上方实时显示峰谷计费时段、DeepSeek 余额和每轮花费，峰时还会闪框提醒。

description.en: 多文件夹 workspace：让 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的 Agent 不只能读写主目录，还能同时读写你添加的其他文件夹。Multi-folder workspace for DeepSeek Harness: let the agent read and write several folders at once, not just the primary one.
description.zh: 让 DSH 的 Agent 除了主目录，还能同时读写你添加的其他文件夹，多仓库项目一个会话搞定。

description.en: DSH PUA — 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 PUA 任务推进、角色风味、验收循环和运行状态卡片 · PUA task persistence, personas, verification loops, and live status cards for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 让 AI 助手别轻易放弃，换个思路再试，并在收工前自己检查一遍结果。

description.en: DSH 重启按钮插件：设置页一键重启 dsh web，复用桌面启动器机制（node + lib/bin.js、日志重定向、TCP 就绪轮询），修复非 ASCII 路径下计划任务静默失败的问题。
description.zh: 在设置页一键重启 dsh web，插件和配置改动立刻生效，不用再找桌面快捷方式。

description.en: DSH 客户端插件：实时会话花费（¥）· 官方峰谷计价 + 节省分解 DSH client plugin: live session cost readout (¥) with official DeepSeek peak/valley pricing and savings breakdown
description.zh: 在 DSH 客户端实时显示当前会话花了多少钱，按官方峰谷价算，还能看到省了多少。

description.en: Engineering workflow plugin for DeepSeek Harness: task stages, verification records, commit checks, and skill and rule management.
description.zh: 把开发流程拆成任务阶段，自动记录验证和提交检查，还能统一管理技能与规则。

description.en: DSH plugin porting thincoder self-discipline suite: advisor convergent review / engineering mode / escalate / consult
description.zh: 把 thincoder 的自律套件搬进 DSH：会诊式收敛评审、工程模式、升级与咨询，帮你把开发流程管得更稳。

description.en: DSH plugin: Vision bench — Keil debug and Modbus HMI in the session view
description.zh: 在会话视图里搞定 Keil 调试和 Modbus 上位机，日常开发台架，一键自检绑定环境。

description.en: Vision skill plugin for DeepSeek Harness (image analysis and OCR)
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上看图能力，能分析图片内容、识别图中文字，开箱即用。

description.en: dsh plugin to run DeepSeek Harness (dsh) agents in Zed’s Agent Panel.
description.zh: 为 dsh 补齐 ACP 能力，让 DeepSeek Harness 能接入 Zed 编辑器，实现交互式编程。

description.en: Removes the queued prompts a DSH fork child inherits from its parent, so the first turn in a new branch runs the prompt typed there instead of the parent's next one.
description.zh: 清除 DSH 分支会话从 fork 父会话继承来的排队提问，让分支的第一轮执行你在分支里输入的问题，而不是父会话的下一句。

description.en: Runs the WorkBuddy (CN) daily check-in on DSH startup — discovers every account logged in on this machine, claims the daily credits, and shows a status entry on the session title line with a details panel and failed-account retry.
description.zh: DSH 启动时自动完成 WorkBuddy 国内版账号的每日签到：自动发现本机登录过的全部账号并领取积分，会话标题行显示状态入口，面板可查明细并重试失败账号。

description.en: Full-screen terminal TUI for DeepSeek Harness with Web-GUI parity, live streaming, agent presets, and DeepSeek blue styling.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 全屏终端 TUI 界面，具备 Web GUI 级对齐能力，支持实时流式输出、智能体预设与经典蓝配色。

description.en: Configurable send and newline keys, a custom composer context menu with a native-menu switch, a quick-command panel with built-in prompts and a per-prompt "always append on send" toggle, a prompt optimizer that rewrites the draft with a separate model call, settings-panel size memory, and automatic x-opencode-session header injection for OpenCode routes.
description.zh: 可配置发送/换行键位、自定义输入框右键菜单（可切回系统原生）、快捷指令面板（内置提示词，每条可设「发送时自动附加」）、用另一次模型调用把草稿整理成清晰指令的提示词优化、设置面板尺寸记忆，并为 OpenCode 路由自动注入 x-opencode-session 请求头。

description.en: 为 DSH Web 的助手 Markdown、工具调用和 Think 内容提供可自定义的语义配色。Customizable semantic color accents for assistant Markdown, tool calls, and Think blocks in DSH Web.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 的助手回复、工具调用和 Think 内容加上可自定义的语义配色，让对话层次一眼看清。

description.en: dsh devin cli插件
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 直接调用本机 Devin CLI 的 210+ 款模型，实现零额外网络开销的流畅本地对话。

description.en: 蒸馏主管：把一本书蒸馏成可执行 Agent 技能（V4.6 · 三闸判态 + §21 强制门禁 + 避坑手册）
description.zh: 把一本书蒸馏成一组可执行的 Agent 技能，三道闸门把关，只判态不打分，零红灯才放行。

description.en: 公众号排版工作台，长在 DeepSeek Harness 的右侧栏里。 人在侧栏改字、加批注与占位；模型用块级 diff 看懂你改了什么、想要什么；成品仍由你复制粘贴进公众号编辑器。
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏里给公众号排版，你改字加批注，模型用块级 diff 看懂你的意图。

description.en: DSH 简化版记忆插件:SQLite 条目化记忆(标题/重要程度/来源/内容,增删改查)+ 日历与到点提醒(月视图+时间轴+待执行/已完成双tab),对话面板记忆 tab 与设置二级菜单,中英双语自动跟随。

让 DSH 跨会话记住上下文和偏好，新会话不用从零开始，直接延续之前的设定和踩坑经验。

description.en: Local media library management and playback powered by dsh Web: responsive on PC and mobile with touch swipe reels, instant seeking and on-the-fly transcoding.
description.zh: 基于 dsh 内置 Web 服务管理、浏览与播放本地媒体库，完美适配 PC 与移动端，支持手势上下滑动刷视频、即时拖拽秒播与实时转码。

description.en: Turn DeepSeek Harness sessions into daily, weekly, handoff and article reports, with a verifiable HTML export and a receipt that re-checks the saved file.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 会话整理成日报、周报、交接与文章稿件，支持可核验的 HTML 导出与复核收据。

description.en: 在 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 内等价重建 OpenAI codex-security 安全审计能力的原生插件
description.zh: 在 DSH 里做安全审计：自动发现漏洞、验证问题并生成报告，可选修复复验。

description.en: 守藏 Shoucang — DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 长期记忆插件：会话蒸馏自动沉淀 × 深度睡眠反思归纳 × 词法+向量混合召回 × 认知环引导 × 主动遗忘，配本地设置面板。一条命令装上，助理即拥有跨会话记忆——数据全在本机，零上传。
description.zh: 给 DSH 助理装上跨会话长期记忆，自动沉淀、反思、召回和遗忘，数据全在本机。

description.en: 基于 DSH 官方侧边栏的文件视图增强插件，提供源码视图、原位编辑、行号显示、搜索和字体缩放功能。  A file-view enhancement plugin that extends the official DSH sidebar, providing source view, in-place editing, line number display, search, and font zoom.

description.en: DeepSeekHarness任务完成时进行消息推送提醒（微信+Windows通知）
description.zh: 任务完成通知推送：代理转入空闲、出错或阻塞时，经 macOS 通知中心、Windows Toast 及 Bark、ntfy、Server酱、通用 Webhook 发送系统通知。

description.en: Browser automation bridge sub-plugin for dsh-tui.                    dsh-tui的浏览器自动化子插件
description.zh: 给 dsh-tui 的智能体装上浏览器自动化能力，让它能像人一样打开网页、点击操作、读取内容，帮你完成需要浏览器的任务。

description.en: Ultra-lightweight Moli (Rust headless browser) web-fetch provider for DeepSeek Harness: renders complex SPAs, micro-frontends, and dynamic pages with ~60MB memory.

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 全盘自进化升级插件：启动扫描全部插件、实时监控性能、基于信号生成进化提案、Sub-Agent 协同完成升级。MCP Server，13 个工具。v2.5.0 MoonBit native。
description.zh: 自动扫描并升级 Harness 插件生态，从识别问题到审批执行全流程闭环，让插件持续自我进化。

description.en: 自主覆盖与调整第三方模型的思考等级，修复工具内置预设缺失或不匹配的问题。
description.zh: 自主覆盖与调整第三方模型的思考等级，修复工具内置预设缺失或不匹配的问题。

description.en: Unofficial DeepSeek Harness settings panel for Command Code: credits, usage windows, and model-catalog sync.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置面板里直接查看 Command Code 的额度、用量周期，并同步模型目录。

description.en: DSH plugin: fold mis-rendered thinking/reasoning content into collapsible blocks and render mermaid diagrams inline.
description.zh: 把渲染错乱的思考内容折叠起来，并直接在对话中显示 Mermaid 图表，让输出更清爽。

description.en: DSH /fresh command: summarize conversation, start new session, archive old one
description.zh: DSH /fresh 命令：一键总结当前对话 → 开启新对话 → 归档老对话（缓解超大会话内存/卡顿，DeepSeek Harness / DSH）

description.en: Maestro harness sync — merge memories and sessions across machines (publishable)
description.zh: 跨设备同步 Maestro 的记忆和会话，轻松合并不同机器上的数据，即插即用。

description.en: dsh-research-kit 是一个 浏览器侧 DSH 插件：它维护科研资源目录、把工作流和用户参数组装成可编辑 Prompt，并由 DSH 当前会话负责实际发送与执行。
description.zh: 帮你整理科研资源目录，把工作流和参数拼成可编辑提示词，交给当前会话直接执行。

description.en: 跑团 / DM 工具插件（DeepSeek Harness）：中立随机裁决 + 本地 ComfyUI 配图 + 按会话隔离的战役配置（角色卡 / 世界 / 随机表）。TTRPG/DM tools for dsh: dice, local ComfyUI illustrations, per-session campaign state.
description.zh: 给跑团 DM 用的助手：随机裁决、本地 ComfyUI 配图，战役设定按会话隔离保存。

description.en: dsh (DeepSeek Harness) 更新中心与插件市场：自托管 plugins.json 注册表（GitHub dsh-plugin 主题自动聚合 + npm 包名映射秒级安装），一键安装/更新/卸载/禁用插件与更新 dsh 本体。Update center & plugin marketplace for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: dsh (DeepSeek Harness) 更新中心与插件市场：自托管 plugins.json 注册表（GitHub dsh-plugin 主题自动聚合 + npm 包名映射秒级安装），一键安装/更新/卸载/禁用插件与更新 dsh 本体。Update center & plugin marketplace for DeepSeek Harness.

description.en: 🐳 给 DSH Web 界面养一缸鲸鱼：官方鲸鱼标志在界面之上游动，鼠标靠近会躲开。非官方插件。
description.zh: 给 DSH 网页界面养一缸会躲鼠标的官方小鲸鱼，纯属好玩的彩蛋。

description.en: Agent-driven long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
description.zh: Agent-driven long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)

description.en: Agent 忙时自动分叉会话：你新发的指令立刻在新会话里得到响应，旧会话留在后台跑完并把结果回注（DeepSeek Harness 插件）

description.zh: 把线性聊天记录变成可看可点的对话地图，每轮问答是一个节点，提问就长出新分支。

description.en: Codex-style drag-and-drop files, folders, ZIP and Office attachments for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 拖拽就能把文件、文件夹、ZIP 和 Office 文档丢进 DeepSeek Harness 当附件，省去手动上传。

description.en: DSH Web UI 文件追踪插件：记录并查看模型读取/写入/编辑的文件，带行号内容与终端风逐行 diff(红删绿增蓝改)、hunk 上下文折叠、可拖拽高度。适配 DSH dsh-v0.1.2-alpha.1，纯客户端零核心改动。
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面里追踪模型读写过的每个文件，带行号查看内容，还能看红删绿增的逐行 diff，方便你审查 AI 改动了啥。

description.en: DSH 插件。解析机场订阅，在本机起一个串行反向代理，让 DSH 的模型请求走你的线路。并发固定为 1，不传工具调用。
description.zh: 把机场订阅解析成本地串行反向代理，让 DSH 的模型请求走你自己的线路。

description.en: 以角色扮演为主体、桌宠为附加功能的 DeepSeek Harness 插件
description.zh: 让AI角色有生活感，按时段作息、记住你的互动和重要日子，还能当桌宠陪你。

description.en: Voice call assistant for the DSH Web GUI: a draggable floating call ball, browser-side VAD that sends each utterance after a pause, FunASR HTTP or streaming speech recognition, MiniMax or OpenAI-compatible TTS replies, an optional wake-word mode with auto-sleep, and task dispatch to separate subagent sessions with progress, stop, and spoken completion reports.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的个人语音通话助手：可拖拽悬浮球通话面板、浏览器端 VAD（停顿自动发送）、FunASR HTTP 或流式语音识别、MiniMax / OpenAI 兼容 TTS 语音回复、可开关的唤醒词模式（沉默自动休眠），以及把任务分发给独立子代理会话并跟踪进度、停止与完成播报。

description.en: Turns the iterate skill into an autonomous closed-loop harness — plan, parallel review, atomic fixes, validate, loop, auto-stop — plus a dry-run review-only mode and a meta-review that audits the report and emits a final review report.
description.zh: 把 iterate 技能跑成自主闭环：规划、并行审查、原子修复、验证、循环、自动停止，并支持纯评审的 dry-run 模式与元评审最终报告。

description.en: claude-context-milvus like plugin for Deepseek Harness (DSH)
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Milvus 向量数据库上下文管理，增强会话记忆与检索能力。

description.en: dsh-DO (Detail Optimization): a Claude Code-style autonomous loop for DeepSeek Harness — auto-continue across turns until loop_done, the round budget, or cancellation, with durable checkpoints — plus a browser half (floating orb with install advice and GitHub dsh-plugin search, and a right-click add-workspace paste dialog).
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供自主循环优化，支持侧边栏发现并一键安装 GitHub 插件，还能右键快速添加工作区。

description.en: Turn DeepSeek Harness into your personal AI claw.将你的DeepSeek Harness变成飞书上的个人龙虾助手。
description.zh: 把你的 DeepSeek Harness 接到飞书上，随时在聊天里召唤你的个人 AI 助手。

description.en: Local OCR, color-statistics, pixel-scan, and metadata bridge for text-only DeepSeek Harness models; no external vision API.
description.zh: 给纯文本模型加装本地视觉能力，自动把图片转成文字、颜色和像素信息，无需外部API。

description.en: Right-side workspace panel for DSH Web (fork enhanced)
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 右侧加个增强版工作区面板，方便浏览文件、审查 Git 和开终端。

description.en: dsh-skill-sidebar 技能面板：DSH 右侧边栏技能面板（Skills panel）— 扫描本机技能目录列出全部技能，4-6 字功能短语 + 目录标签 + 一键复制调用 + 置顶 + 默认自动打开 + 每周刷新
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧边栏加一个技能面板，自动扫描本机技能目录，一键复制调用、置顶常用技能。

description.en: Transform DeepSeek Harness's web UI into customizable frosted glass with Mica or Compatibility modes, adjustable blur, and live wallpapers.
Alibaba Cloud Workbench CLI plugin — lets DeepSeek Harness's Agent directly control remote ECS instances.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 直接操控阿里云 ECS 实例，远程执行命令和管理服务器。

description.en: 知乎数据开放平台 DSH 静态双面插件:17工具+精美卡片+串行化限流。QQ群1017854502 https://qm.qq.com/q/RAHJuyhQQ
description.zh: 把知乎数据开放平台的 17 个工具接进 DSH，配精美卡片和限流保护，查数据、做内容都顺手。

description.en: KSG 纪代备份：DSH 内部备份插件，关闭自动保存快照、开机确认、单 zip 备份导出导入恢复、隔离自动恢复、多主流备份插件文件兼容
description.zh: DSH 内部备份管家，关门前自动保存快照，开机确认，一键导出导入恢复，兼容主流备份插件。

description.en: 知乎数据开放平台 DSH 静态双面插件:17工具+精美卡片+串行化限流。QQ群1017854502 https://qm.qq.com/q/RAHJuyhQQ
上下文治理一体化插件：/context 命令 + ctx.contextMeter 服务 + 剪枝工具（prune_candidates/apply/expand/guard/stats，合并自 dsh-agent-context-prun
description.zh: 一键查看和管理上下文用量，自动剪枝节省Token，让对话更高效不超限。

description.en: dsh-awake · 守夜人：在 agent 任务执行期间阻止操作系统休眠
description.zh: 任务执行期间自动阻止系统休眠，任务结束自动恢复，防止中断和数据损坏。

description.en: dsh侧边HUD面板，包含多个信息展示模块（可自定义是否展示），集成压缩上下文、查看git graph等功能。DSH side HUD panel, containing multiple information display modules (customizable whether to display), integrating features such as compressed context, viewing git graph, etc.
description.zh: 在侧边栏展示HUD面板，可自定义信息模块，支持压缩上下文和查看Git图谱，提升开发效率。

description.en: 人脑式上下文压缩逻辑，大幅减少长任务上下文占用以及token消耗
description.zh: 像人脑一样智能压缩上下文，长任务不爆内存，token 消耗大幅降低。

description.en: DSH conversation checkpoints: locate / rewind / edit user instructions with file snapshots and per-file undo. DSH conversation checkpoint plugin
description.zh: 把每条用户指令变成对话检查点，能定位、回退和改写，还带文件快照与单文件撤销。

description.en: Mobile pairing remote for DeepSeek Harness: E2EE companion over dual-plane allowlisted RPC (LAN, Tailscale, optional Cloudflare Quick Tunnel or self-hosted rendezvous).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 移动配对远程插件：双平面白名单 RPC 上的端到端加密 Companion（局域网、Tailscale，可选 Cloudflare Quick Tunnel 或自建 rendezvous）。

description.en: Read-only model request concurrency monitoring for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 实时查看模型请求并发量，掌握当前活动请求、峰值和供应商统计，不干预请求。

description.en: 在 DSH 对话底部统计行实时显示 DeepSeek 用量费用（人民币/美元双币，含缓存命中与峰谷定价）
description.zh: 在对话底部实时显示本次 DeepSeek 用量费用，人民币美元双币，含缓存命中与峰谷价

description.en: 每天首次启动 dsh 时用 git 检测上游提交并在 Web GUI 中询问是否更新（适配源码 checkout，不改 npm 依赖）
description.zh: 每天首次启动 dsh 时自动用 git 检查上游有没有新提交，并在界面里问你要不要更新。

description.en: Hold-to-talk voice input for the DeepSeek Harness web composer: hold the mouse on the input box, speak, release to insert the text into the draft. Local SenseVoice ASR via sherpa-onnx: no API key, offline, audio never leaves the machine. | DSH 长按说话语音输入插件:输入框上按住鼠标说话,浮层边说边出字,松手把文字写进输入框,上滑取消;识别在本机跑,免密钥、离线、音频不出本机。
description.zh: 按住输入框说话、松开就转成文字填进草稿，本地识别不用联网也不用密钥。

description.en: LLM provider adapter that routes model calls through any ACP (Agent Client Protocol) server — Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Devin and more — with a registry browser, per-server settings UI, lazy authentication, and dynamic model discovery.
description.zh: 通过 ACP（Agent Client Protocol）将任意外部 agent 作为 LLM 提供方接入——支持 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、Devin 等，内置注册表浏览与服务管理界面，支持惰性认证、模型动态发现与热切换。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的自定义 LLM API 请求注入 HTTP Headers（典型用途：改写 user-agent，例如网关要求 UA 带指定品牌字样）。
dsh全模态工作站插件，让模型支持视频、图片、语音的输入与输出，支持comfyui图像生成工具调用。Any-to-Any.
description.zh: 让模型能看视频、读图片、听语音，还能开口说话和画图，接上 ComfyUI 就能直接生成图像。

description.en: Adds a Quick Chat entry to the Web UI sidebar that opens a floating chat window with its own model and reasoning-effort picker, optionally seeded with the current session's transcript, and keeps every side conversation in a resumable, renamable, deletable history.
description.zh: 在侧边栏加入「快速会话」入口，打开一个小窗对话，可切换模型与思考强度、可选携带当前主会话全文，历史可继续、重命名、删除。

description.en: Manual provider connectivity and latency checks for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 手动检测模型供应商连通性与延迟，快速定位连接问题，方便又省钱。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) WebGIS Plugin: Map reading, map manipulation, and 3D world comprehension.
description.zh: 让 AI 真正看懂地图和三维世界，能加载、理解并操作 GIS 数据，在对话里直接完成地图分析。

description.en: Alternative WorkflowEngine provider for DSH 0.1.0-rc.7 that runs model-written orchestration in fresh QuickJS/WASM runtimes with a JSON-only host bridge and bounded memory, execution time, and child-agent fan-out.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供隔离沙箱工作流引擎，在 QuickJS/WASM 中安全运行模型编排，限制内存与执行时间。

description.en: JIT compiler plugin for deepseek-harness: compiles recurring agent workflows into hot skills and flow templates
description.zh: JIT compiler plugin for deepseek-harness: compiles recurring agent workflows into hot skills and flow templates

description.en: dsh 提醒插件：别错过需要你的时刻
description.zh: 提醒插件，帮你盯住重要时刻，不错过任何需要你关注的消息。
在 dsh 侧边栏底部实时显示当前渠道的余额和用量，方便随时掌握花费情况。

description.en: Overleaf tab for DSH better-sidebar: direct-CDP login, project mirrors under <workspace>/overleaf/, git/API sync, sidebar file preview
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏中直接管理 Overleaf 项目，支持自动登录、本地镜像同步和文件预览，让写作与代码协作更顺手。

description.en: 自动归档 DeepSeek Harness 对话记录
description.zh: 自动把 DeepSeek Harness 的对话记录归档保存，方便随时回溯和整理历史会话。

description.en: Check-digit mathematics toolbox for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): generate, validate and detect check digits for 13 schemes (Luhn, Verhoeff, Damm, ISBN, EAN, UPC, ISIN, CUSIP, IBAN, CAS, ABA) plus ISBN-10/13 conversion — zero runtime dependencies
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供校验码数学工具箱，支持生成、验证和检测 11 种校验码（如 Luhn、ISBN、IBAN 等），零依赖即插即用。

description.en: Color toolbox for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): parse/convert any CSS color (hex, rgb, hsl, hwb, named), WCAG contrast ratios with AA/AAA verdicts, named-color lookup, harmonious palettes (7 types), and color adjustments — zero runtime dependencies, pure math
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供颜色工具箱，可解析转换任意 CSS 颜色、计算 WCAG 对比度并生成和谐配色方案。

description.en: /skills command for DSH — list skills with auto-translated descriptions (zh↔en)
description.zh: 在聊天框输入斜杠命令，快速列出并选用本地技能，描述自动翻译成系统语言。

description.en: Compresses DSH time-context from ~280 chars to 46 chars by injecting a compact date line into the runtime-context snapshot; zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 将 DSH 时间上下文从约 280 字符压缩到 46 字符，向运行期快照注入紧凑日期行，无运行时依赖。

description.en: Map dsh (DeepSeek Harness) workspaces onto a Discord category — query session trajectories and live subagents, and drive an agent, from anywhere with no inbound port.
description.zh: 把 DSH 工作区搬到 Discord，随时查会话轨迹和子智能体，还能远程指挥 Agent 干活。

description.en: Money math toolbox for DeepSeek Harness: loans & amortization, compound growth, rate conversion, NPV/IRR/payback cash-flow analysis, retirement withdrawal planning — zero runtime dependencies
description.zh: 金融计算工具箱，帮你算贷款、复利、收益率和退休规划，零依赖即插即用。

description.en: Fork companion that auto-relinks subagent session records to the forked child: listens for the official session/created event and rewrites only the durable parentSession header frame of cold subagent children (with trash backups), so forked conversations keep their subagent panel, agent routing, and descriptors — the whole subtree follows, filtered by what the fork seed references.
description.zh: fork 伴随插件:官方 fork 发生后,自动把原会话的直接子 agent 记录头帧 parentSession 重链到新会话(仅重写头帧,其余帧字节原样,先备份到回收站),fork 出的对话完整保留子 agent 面板、代理路由与 descriptor 信息;按 fork 子会话 seed 的引用过滤,整棵子 agent 树统一跟随。零 UI、零路由、零依赖,与 AI 结对开发。

description.en: Geodesic math toolbox for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): great-circle distance, bearings, destination points, DMS parsing, rhumb lines, path intersections, spherical polygon areas — zero runtime dependencies
description.zh: 地理计算工具箱，提供球面距离、方位角、目标点、DMS解析等 geodesy 数学函数，零依赖即插即用。

description.en: IP & subnet math toolbox for DeepSeek Harness: IPv4 subnet layouts, CIDR summarization, IPv6 subnet math (128-bit exact) and IPv4/IPv6 parsing with RFC 5952 normalization and IANA classification — zero dependencies
description.zh: 纯计算 IP 与子网工具，支持 IPv4/IPv6 解析、CIDR 汇总和子网规划，零依赖离线可用。

description.en: DSH Cordis plugin: turn any source text into an AI knowledge graph (facts/inferences/concepts/definitions/examples/counter-examples/rules) with two-way linking between the graph and the original text.
description.zh: DSH Cordis plugin: turn arbitrary source text into an AI-generated knowledge graph (facts / inferences / concepts / definitions / examples / counter-examples / rules) with two-way linking between the graph and the original text, plus evidence-grounded verification, questioning, one-click fixes and an audit log.

description.en: dsh-plugin: OMP-style ingress shaping plus optional local /fast-compact for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在工具结果送达模型前进行压缩整形，并支持本地快速压缩，提升 DeepSeek Harness 处理效率。

description.en: Search, pin and hide models in DeepSeek Harness; refresh provider catalogues.
Music theory math toolbox for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): note parsing, frequency/MIDI conversion, correctly spelled chords (26 qualities) and scales (17 types) — zero runtime dependencies
description.zh: 音乐理论数学工具箱，帮你解析音名、转换频率与MIDI，生成正确的和弦与音阶，零依赖即插即用。
