description.en: Network diagnostics toolbox for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): DNS lookup (10 record types), ICMP ping, TCP port check, TLS cert check, traceroute, WHOIS lookup, public IP — seven read-only probes, zero runtime dependencies
description.zh: 网络诊断工具箱，提供DNS查询、Ping、端口检测、TLS证书检查、路由追踪、WHOIS和公网IP查询，纯只读操作，零依赖。

description.en: DSH Web 暂停插件：agent 完成一轮工具交互、正要发出下一次模型请求之前在 agent/pre-step 处拉门暂停，保持 composer 输入框可用，人类在主输入框按回车放行，空草稿为无感继续、带字作为插话一并放行；此暂停不打断任何在途 API 调用，模型上下文完整、无感知。纯插件自包含，不改 DSH 源码。
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek 下一轮请求前暂停，让你按回车插话或放行，不打断上下文。

description.en: Discord bridge for DeepSeek Harness: chat with your dsh web sessions from Discord
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的网页对话同步至 Discord，让你随时随地在聊天窗口继续 AI 交流。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 离线打包插件 — 在联网环境下将 DSH 插件打包为离线安装包（.tgz），传输到离线 DSH 环境中加载安装。

Semantic versioning toolbox for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): parse, compare, range-check, increment, diff and sort semver strings (npm semver.inc/diff/sort semantics) — zero runtime dependencies, pure logic
description.zh: 语义化版本号工具箱，支持解析、比较、范围检查、递增、差异对比和排序，零依赖纯逻辑实现。

description.en: A plugin for managing sessions generated by DeepSeek Harness, allowing users to freely delete legacy sessions and supporting session import from other third-party Agents (Claude Code, Codex).
description.zh: 管理 DeepSeek Harness 生成的会话，可删除遗留会话，并支持从 Claude Code 等第三方 Agent 导入会话。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 技能悬浮窗插件：侧边栏技能按钮，一键查看当前会话已加载的技能并打开本地目录。
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部一键查看当前会话已加载的技能，并快速打开本地技能目录，方便管理。

description.en: 一个 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）插件，把模糊的编程需求锻造成可执行规格，并在每次任务完成后沉淀为会自动复用的个人提示词模板库。
description.zh: 把模糊需求问清楚再动手，做完自动沉淀成可复用的提示词模板，下次同类任务直接套用。

description.en: 用于dsh界面美化，内置四种颜色主题，并且可上传自定义背景
description.zh: 给 DSH 界面换套顺眼外观，四种配色加自定义背景图，随时一键还原。

description.en: DSH Web UI 会话进度插件：输入框停靠区常驻会话进度条（todos 真实进度 / 实时 token 生成速率 / 中断橘红态 / 待办提醒），零核心改动
description.zh: 在输入框旁常驻显示会话进度条，实时查看任务进度、token 生成速率和中断提醒，无需改动核心代码。

description.en: 【求⭐】🐋DSH Web UI 全手绘像素鲸鱼伙伴插件：会话标题栏常驻，平时眨眼/偶尔摆尾/动胸鳍，思考运行时持续动起来，回合完成头顶喷水，点击还会冒爱心，不工作时还会偷懒睡觉，零核心改动。 【喜欢的话就点点star⭐吧~】
description.zh: 在会话标题栏养一只像素鲸鱼，会眨眼摆尾、思考时动起来、完成时喷水，点击冒爱心，零核心改动。

description.en: 让 DeepSeek Harness 拥有版本可见性：dsh_check_updates 模型工具 + Settings 更新检查页 + 周期复查，只报告不升级
description.zh: 让 DSH 随时看到有没有新版本，模型工具、设置页、定期复查三管齐下，只提醒不自动升级。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Network — public forwarding for a local dsh web UI over *.ds.hn: a dsh plugin + self-hosted WSS relay behind Cloudflare, with optional end-to-end encryption.
description.zh: 通过 Cloudflare 隧道将本地 dsh 网页界面安全公开到公网，支持端到端加密，随时随地远程访问。

description.en: Weiwen's Law (KISS-Law) — a domain-agnostic causal-constraint middleware for DeepSeek Harness. A faithful, white-box presentation of how causal law actually runs. White-box audit, never prediction. Hard-gate the boundary; inner H decides freely.
description.zh: 白盒展示因果律运行机制，提供领域无关的因果约束中间件，用于风险控制与审计。

description.en: only my DSH plugins — monorepo of DeepSeek Harness plugin bundles
description.zh: Unified DeepSeek Harness connector: edit MCP servers (cordis.patch.yml) and user skills (~/.dsh/skills) from one Web UI settings page. Repository-root package: installs either via the bare git URL (the root manifest re-exports the dsh-connector/ subdir) or via github:XJungit/omdp#path:dsh-connector.

description.en: 小白+AI开发，for小白的dsh小插件，解释AI吐出的“黑话”
description.zh: 专为新手设计的DSH小插件，能自动把AI输出的专业术语和“黑话”翻译成大白话，沟通零门槛。

description.en: 仿 Codex 的 DSH Web GUI 输入历史插件：会话输入框按 ↑/↓ 浏览历史 prompt，Esc清除当前对话框并进入历史，跨会话、跨重启持久保留，仅存纯文本，安全接管不误伤草稿。 A Codex-style input-history plugin for the DSH Web GUI: recall previous prompts with ↑/↓ in the composer, persisted across conversations and restarts, text-only storage with safe key routing.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页对话框中用 ↑/↓ 快速翻看历史输入，跨会话重启也不丢，纯文本存储，安全不误伤草稿。

description.en: Bridge Claude Code OAuth (Pro/Max/Team) into DeepSeek Harness — reuses ~/.claude/.credentials.json, auto-refreshes, no hardcoding
description.zh: 把 Claude Code 的 Pro/Max/Team 登录状态直接接入 DSH，自动读取并刷新凭证，无需手动配置。

description.en: Archived-session management (show/unarchive/permanently delete) for the DSH Web GUI, with zero changes to official packages.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面里管理已归档会话，支持查看、恢复和彻底删除，不改动官方包。

description.en: 接入智谱 BigModel / GLM Coding Plan 作为 DeepSeek Harness 模型清单插件，解锁 glm-5.3 等模型。 | Live Zhipu BigModel / GLM catalog plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 接入智谱 BigModel / GLM 编程套餐，让 DeepSeek Harness 直接调用 glm-5.3 等模型。

description.en: Chrome DevTools Protocol 插件 for DeepSeek Harness。通过 chromremote-interface 以 CDP 连接并操控 Chrome
description.zh: 通过 CDP 协议连接并操控 Chrome 浏览器，实现远程调试、自动化操作和实时监控。

description.en: Watch Claude Code and Codex work inside dsh: each gets a real terminal pane in your session's workspace that you can type into, plus five tools so the dsh agent seats them, hands them work, and reads their screens.
description.zh: 在 dsh 会话中并排运行 Claude Code 和 Codex 终端，可实时观察、接管操作并分配任务。

description.en: dsh web file-experience plugin: drag & drop any file into the composer (intakes it into the session workspace attachments/ folder) plus @file mentions that list workspace files and insert file references。也可以配合 WebDSH（darker2016/WebDSH）多用户服务器使用。
description.zh: 把文件拖进聊天框就能自动存到工作区，还能用@快速引用文件，右侧文件浏览器和标签页查看器让你边聊边改代码和文档。

description.en: Git Ship Done (opengsd-core) reimplemented as host-plane Cordis plugins: replaces the default agent loop with a spec/discuss/plan/execute/verify/ship phase loop.
description.zh: 把 GSD 阶段循环搬进 DeepSeek Harness，让智能体按 Git Ship Done 流程干活，替代默认循环。

description.en: The DeepSeek time-of-use meter for dsh: what this session cost, which tariff is running, when it flips, and the balance behind it — one line under the composer
description.zh: 实时显示 DeepSeek 会话费用、当前计费时段和余额，一行小字帮你省钱。

description.en: Provider-folded model selector for the DSH Web composer with catalog-driven reasoning effort choices.
description.zh: 把模型选择器改成按供应商折叠的样式，让切换模型更清爽高效。

description.en: dsh memory: Nocturne Memory client for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 给DeepSeek Harness装上长期记忆，自动沉淀对话上下文，让AI跨会话也能记住关键信息。
为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Command Code 大模型，让任务自动调用该模型执行。

description.en: DSH插件，以Observational Memory方式管理上下文
description.zh: 用 Observational Memory 方式管理上下文，让智能体记住关键信息，提升对话连贯性和效率。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin — /refine command + settings panel for the dsh-continual-harness self-refinement engine. npm: dsh-refine
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 /refine 命令和设置面板，让智能体持续自我优化，提升输出质量。

description.en: Let a local DeepSeek Harness Agent use BailingHub to query data, update records, and run permitted actions in an online store, SaaS, or other admin system.
description.zh: 让本地 DeepSeek Harness 智能体通过 BailingHub，直接操作商城、SaaS 或其他业务系统后台，在现有账号权限内查询数据、修改资料并执行已开放的操作。

description.en: Archived-session manager: an "Archived Sessions" settings page that lists archived sessions and lets you restore or permanently delete each one (two-step confirmation).
description.zh: 归档会话管理：在设置页新增“归档会话”，列出所有已归档会话，支持恢复与二次确认后的永久删除。

description.en: Reading archive for dsh: after reading open-source code, capture quick notes or write full deep notes that group into one card per repo / file / symbol, stored as an append-only log of Markdown notes you can open in Obsidian; query your history, browse recent reads, or search your own Obsidian vault and link related notes to a reading record. Nine tools, a /codevault command, and a code-reading skill.
description.zh: 读开源代码后记一笔的档案：快记或深读笔记按 仓库/文件/符号 归并成一张卡，追加式落盘为可放进 Obsidian 的 Markdown 笔记；可检索历史、回看最近阅读，也能搜你自己 Obsidian 里的笔记、把相关笔记挂到阅读记录上。共 9 个工具、/codevault 命令与 code-reading 技能。

description.en: DSH large-session performance plugin: zero-copy fork + projection warmup + chunked materialize
description.zh: DSH 大会话性能插件：零拷贝 fork + fast initFor + 投影分片预热 + fork 缓存回填 + 分片 materialize + 冷会话 LRU 裁剪 + heap 检测（DeepSeek Harness / DSH）

description.en: Live Spring Boot error HUD with opt-in AI diagnosis for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 实时监控 Spring Boot 报错并弹窗提示，可选开启 AI 智能诊断帮你快速定位问题。

description.en: dsh manger 远程工具对应使用的 dsh 插件，直接完成 dsh 远程访问
description.zh: 让 dsh 直接远程访问 dsh-manager 工具，远程操作一步到位。

description.en: Adds a settings page for declaring per-model reasoning efforts and vision support on pi-ai provider routes.
description.zh: 在设置里新增「模型能力」一页，为每个模型声明思考档位与视觉能力。
将 Claude Code、Codex、Pi 与 dsh 内置循环并排运行，方便对比不同 AI 助手的表现。

description.en: Source-grounded deep research, writing, and learning plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): steerable checkpoints, mid-run steering, and citations verified against retrieved sources.
description.zh: 深度研究写作插件，支持中途调整方向、检查点续写，并自动核实引用来源，让研究更可靠。

description.en: dsh web通用工具箱插件，纯AI制作（包括仓库），零人工含量，可能不会维护，请谨慎使用。
description.zh: 面向 dsh web profile 的个人工具箱，各功能可单独开关：任务完成桌面通知、一键重启、会话删除、插件启停、更新检查，以及若干界面小工具。

description.en: Request-level one-time prompt injection without further context pollution. SillyTavern-style UI and data compatibility, keyword/regex/constant triggers, and a lore_lookup tool for on-demand searching.
description.zh: 酒馆风格的通用世界书，为最新用户消息附加一次性的提示词注入，无上下文污染。兼容酒馆世界书，关键词/正则/常驻触发，以及不污染上下文的 lore_lookup 单轮查询工具。

description.en: DSH Web UI enhancement plugin: turn-by-turn conversation navigation & thinking-chain default-expand DSH Web UI 增强插件:逐轮对话导航、思维链默认展开
description.zh: DSH Web UI enhancement plugin: turn-by-turn conversation navigation & thinking-chain default-expand DSH Web UI 增强插件:逐轮对话导航、思维链默认展开

description.en: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的思考（reasoning）与最终回答默认使用简体中文的中文插件
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的思考过程和回答默认说简体中文，装上就能用，不用手动设置。

description.en: Canon integration plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把 Canon 消息服务接入 DeepSeek Harness，让它在 Web 界面之外多一个沟通渠道，方便随时交互。
配置可持久化的定时任务，每次自动启动智能体并调用指定模型，轻松实现自动化流程。

description.en: DSH Head up display panel
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 会话加上科幻风 HUD 面板，把运行数据变成游戏式等级条，一目了然。

description.en: Routes the first DSH prompt to Standard, PTC, Minimal, or Cordis with DeepSeek V4 Flash.
description.zh: 自动识别你的首条提问意图，智能切换至对应的预设模式，免去手动选择，对话更精准高效。

description.en: Cache-prefix stabilization and evidence-based cache metrics for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 稳定 DeepSeek Harness 的缓存前缀，并提供基于实测的缓存命中指标，帮你省 token 又提速。

description.en: DSH Web 客户端插件:模型选择按钮左侧显示 DeepSeek API 峰/谷价状态(绿=谷,橙=峰)
description.zh: 在模型选择按钮旁显示 DeepSeek API 峰谷价状态，绿色为谷、橙色为峰，帮您省钱。

description.en: Codex 主题外观插件 for DeepSeek Harness（DSH）：把 Codex 主题配置（codex-theme-v1，80 款浅/深色主题）做成可在 DSH 中直接切换、可自定义的外观插件。
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面换上 Codex 风格主题，内置 80 款浅深色配色，一键切换轻松自定义。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness（dsh web）额度插件：跟随当前模型显示官方余额或 OpenCode Go 订阅用量，支持本会话估算、跨会话累计消耗与可视化设置。
description.zh: 在输入框下实时显示官方余额或订阅用量，估算本会话消耗并累计跨会话总花费，帮你随时掌握成本。

description.en: Adds ChatGPT-style stop, edit-and-resend, native quote annotations, and an independent sidebar follow-up chat with model and image input for DeepSeek Harness Desktop.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 增加接近 ChatGPT 的停止、编辑重发、原生引用注释，以及支持模型和图片输入的独立侧边栏追问对话。

description.en: Warp-inspired image-to-theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness: upload a background, extract a palette, and apply a glass UI.
description.zh: 上传或拖入一张图片，自动提取主色调并生成 Warp 风格的毛玻璃主题，让界面随壁纸换肤。

description.en: Unofficial Cursor subscription chat: Host-owned CLI session login, a displayed model catalog, and subscription usage rails. Cursor staff treat this class of private-client usage as against ToS.
description.zh: 非官方 Cursor 订阅聊天：Host 持有 CLI 会话登录，可编辑展示用模型目录，并显示订阅额度。Cursor 员工认定此类私有客户端用法违反 ToS。

description.en: Windows computer-use for DeepSeek Harness. The computer tool uses ChatGPT Windows Computer Use action names, reusable window targets, UI Automation, occlusion-immune window screenshots, background-first verified input, and an isolated Chromium browser route.
description.zh: 适用于 DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 电脑操作插件。computer 工具采用 ChatGPT Windows Computer Use 动作名称，支持可复用窗口目标、UIA 无障碍定位、遮挡免疫窗口截图、后台优先的验证输入和隔离 Chromium 浏览器通道。

description.en: 3D printing & additive manufacturing plugin for DeepSeek Harness: parametric STL generation, calibration G-code, STL/G-code analysis, toolpath rendering and PrusaSlicer bridge, plus 5 skills and a concise persona optimized for local models.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 3D 打印与增材制造插件：参数化 STL 生成、校准 G-code、STL/G-code 分析、刀路可视化、PrusaSlicer 桥接，含 5 个技能与面向本地小模型的精简 persona。

description.en: Content-addressed proof that a DSH profile declaration, pnpm lock and installed bundles agree
description.zh: 自动比对DSH配置、pnpm锁文件与实际安装的包是否一致，生成防篡改凭证，让依赖环境更安全可靠。

description.en: Capability Manager for DeepSeek Harness: manage MCP servers and Skills from a Settings-page UI (dual-face dsh plugin)
description.zh: 在设置页里统一管理 MCP 服务器和技能，不用改配置文件，开箱即用。

description.en: Content-addressed conformance proof across recorded DSH ToolRuntime, MCP JSON-RPC and CLI JSON surfaces
description.zh: 验证 DSH 工具运行时、MCP 与 CLI 接口间的一致性，确保合约合规可追溯。

description.en: Persistent interactive terminal mode for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 进入持久交互终端模式，方便你连续执行命令和操作。

description.en: Model & reasoning-effort switcher plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): composer seat with Off/Max effort slider. DSH 插件：模型与思考力度切换器。
description.zh: 给 DSH 网页端换上 Claude 风格切换器，一键切换模型和思考强度，调推理力度更方便。

description.en: Content-addressed readiness proof for sanitized DeepSeek Harness observations on managed Windows hosts
description.zh: 为Windows主机上的DSH观测数据生成内容寻址的就绪证明，方便企业审计与合规验证。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: AI subscription quotas & balances (Codex, Kimi, DeepSeek, OpenCode Go) — model tool, Settings page, composer chip
description.zh: 一个插件，集中查看 Codex、Kimi、DeepSeek 等 AI 订阅的配额和余额，方便管理用量。

description.en: deepseek harness background-image plugin, built by DS and GPT
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 界面设置背景图片，支持网络图片、本地图片或纯色背景，让工作区更个性化。

description.en: enables /btw commands in deepseek-harness (similar to /btw in claude code)
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里用 /btw 快速问一句，答案不记入会话记忆，适合临时查资料或问个无关紧要的问题。

description.en: DSH 侧边栏实时显示 DeepSeek 官方服务状态（status.deepseek.com）| Live DeepSeek official service status in the DSH sidebar
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏实时显示 DeepSeek 官方服务状态，一眼掌握整体及各项服务是否正常。

description.en: dsh-gzip插件：压缩API响应，降低带宽占用，解决低速网络下历史加载失败问题
description.zh: 压缩API响应数据，减少带宽占用，让低速网络下历史记录也能快速加载。
把会话上下文打包成交接条，串成时间线，换班或切换任务时人和AI都能快速翻看，不丢上下文。

description.en: Explain failed DeepSeek Harness agent runs locally, then produce a redacted recovery plan. No model required.
description.zh: 把失败的 DeepSeek Harness 运行快速转成脱敏恢复计划，本地只读，无需模型也能用。

description.en: 一个 dsh-better-sidebar 的消费插件：在侧边栏新增一个「文件」tab，内置一棵固定在工作区（cwd）内的文件树，提供真正的文件管理能力——上传、移动、删除、重命名、新建文件夹。它补充了 better-sidebar 自带 Explorer 缺失的「写」操作（Explorer 只读）
description.zh: 在侧边栏新增文件管理页，支持上传、移动、删除、重命名和新建文件夹，补齐只读文件树的写操作。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: use your own Claude and ChatGPT/Codex subscriptions as model providers, over each vendor's OAuth sign-in
description.zh: 用你自己的 Claude 或 ChatGPT/Codex 订阅账号当模型源，OAuth 登录即可接入 DeepSeek Harness，省去额外 API 费用。

description.en: Invert selection in Deepseek Harness for when we are selecting models
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的模型选择对话框中一键反选，方便批量管理模型。

description.en: Local-first personal usage insights in Settings, with 1/7/30-day token heatmaps and a 30-day calendar, token composition, model mix, and skill-call status.
description.zh: 在设置页提供本机个人用量分析：1/7/30 天 Token 热力图与 30 天日历视图、Token 构成、模型分布和技能调用状态。

description.en: DeepSeek account balance chip for DeepSeek Harness Web: 3-min auto refresh with total/topped-up/granted breakdown
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页会话头部常驻显示 DeepSeek 和 OpenRouter 双账户余额，每 3 分钟自动刷新，悬停可查看充值赠送明细。

description.en: Isolated multi-model coding matches with deterministic verification, scoring, and reports
description.zh: Isolated multi-model coding matches with deterministic verification, scoring, and reports

description.en: Anime2.5DRig × DSH 桌宠：借助see-through，只凭一张干净背景的图像，即可获得带自动装配、发丝物理、表情动画和状态镜像的桌宠
description.zh: 上传一张干净背景的角色图，自动生成带物理发丝和表情动画的桌宠，还能镜像你的状态。

description.en: dsh 插件：在设置面板中查看、恢复与永久删除归档会话
description.zh: 在设置面板中查看、恢复或永久删除已归档会话，补齐宿主缺失的归档管理功能。

description.en: Semantic, configurable chat titles for DeepSeek Harness

Dual-engine screen capture for DSH: inside the SSiD desktop shell, a global hotkey or tray opens a fullscreen box-select overlay (all monitors, per-display pixel-perfect frames) with in-place red-box annotation and a WeChat-style toolbar; in plain DSH (browser), the composer camera button captures the display via getDisplayMedia and reuses the same single-phase box-select + annotation overlay in-page. The cropped image lands in the current conversation composer through the official attachment intake.
description.zh: DSH 双引擎截图：思灵桌面壳内，全局快捷键/托盘打开全屏框选浮层（多显示器、逐屏像素级抓帧），选区定格后工具条就地画红框，一次确认送进输入框；纯 DSH（浏览器）下由输入框相机按钮经 getDisplayMedia 捕获屏幕，复用同一套单阶段框选+标注遮罩。均走官方附件通道。

description.en: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 端插件,解决侧边栏底部(sidebar.footer.action 槽位)多个插件内容挤成一行的布局问题,并让你自由配置这些内容的上下排列顺序。
description.zh: 把侧边栏底部多个插件从挤一行变成自由上下排列，布局更清爽。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness integration plugin for Neo-MoFox
description.zh: 让 Neo-MoFox 直接调用和管理本机 DeepSeek Harness，无缝集成 AI 能力。

description.en: Backs up DSH profiles and mints a desktop "revival coin" that restores the harness after a failed boot or install: a boot guard runs a two-phase health check (HTTP 200 plus client render), marks good boots, isolates or rolls back bad ones, and keeps 3 rotating snapshots. Cross-platform.
description.zh: 备份 DSH 环境，启动或安装失败时通过桌面"复活币"一键恢复：内置启动守卫做两阶段健康检查（HTTP 200 + 客户端渲染），标记正常启动、隔离或回滚异常启动，并轮换保留 3 份快照。跨平台。

description.en: Composer GitHub picker: click the GitHub icon at the bottom-right of the input box to search the workspace repository's issues and pull requests via the gh CLI, and insert the reference as a URL or @owner/repo#number mention.
description.zh: 输入框右下角 GitHub 图标打开当前仓库的 issue/PR 搜索弹窗，数据来自本机 gh CLI，点选即以 URL 或 @owner/repo#number 形式插入引用。

description.en: DSH plugin for durable, cross-session memory & todos — five tracks (global/user/project/key/daily), confirmation-gated writes, Git-backed sync, in-place adoption of ~/.dsh/memories.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供跨会话的持久记忆与待办事项，支持多维度分类、确认写入和 Git 同步，无缝接管现有记忆文件。

description.en: Supervisor-style workflow orchestration over top-level sessions: confirmation-gated batch dispatch, team workstreams, steering running tasks, idle-wait collection and live model-route discovery across 11 task_* tools plus a /tasks slash command.
description.zh: 总控式工作流编排：确认闸门批量派发、团队编组、向运行中任务纠偏、等待收口与模型路线发现——11 个 task_* 工具加 /tasks 斜杠命令。

description.en: Verified current-source search workflow for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供带时效性验证的联网搜索，确保结果来自当前可靠来源。

description.en: Adds a subagent_routed tool that runs a one-shot subagent fully mounted on any agent preset from any session, with per-call model/provider override and a model-availability pre-check.
description.zh: 新增 subagent_routed 工具：从任意会话发起一次性子 Agent，并完整挂载到任意 agent preset 上运行，支持按次覆盖模型/提供方，并在调用前预检模型可用性。

description.en: In-app self-update for DeepSeek Harness git-source installs + optional native macOS shell
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 通过 git 安装的版本在应用内一键自更新，macOS 用户还能享受原生体验。

description.en: Session settings, MCP servers, and Skill management plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面里直接管理会话设置、MCP 服务器和技能，按需配置全局或单个会话。

description.en: Update copilot for DeepSeek Harness: one scan covers the DeepSeek Harness core and every profile plugin; explains what changed and how risky each update is, then updates only what you confirm.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的更新助手：一次扫描覆盖 DeepSeek Harness 本体和每个 profile 的插件，说清改了什么、风险多大，只更新你确认过的那些。

description.en: dsh主题维什戴尔风格
description.zh: 给 DSH 网页界面换上维什戴尔风格的暗黑主题，信息层级清晰，爆破涂写风拉满，看着带感又不影响操作。
AI 输入增强插件，帮你更高效地输入和优化文本内容，提升日常写作与对话体验。

description.en: Vision + smart model routing for DeepSeek Harness. Gemini sees. DeepSeek codes.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上视觉能力，自动分流图片任务给 Gemini，代码任务留给 DeepSeek，让模型各司其职。
把 ChatGPT Plus/Pro 订阅变成 DeepSeek Harness 的大模型供应商，用设备码登录即可接入。

description.en: Trusted office suite for government/enterprise work by Beijing Caizhi Technology (深知可信智能): three skills — trusted consulting (policy/regulation Q&A with citation markers + provenance HTML), trusted search (authoritative policy/standard retrieval with traceable HTML + clean Markdown), and official-document writing (draft/rewrite/Word/red-head delivery); all interfaces go through the dknowc trusted workbench MCP (Bearer auth), products land in the session workspace, one-time key setup persists for later sessions; ships on npm as dknowc-dsh.
description.zh: 彩智科技深知可信智能出品的可信办公全家桶 dsh 插件：包含深知可信咨询（政策/法规/办事问答，带真实来源角标 + 可点击溯源 HTML）、深知可信搜索（权威政策/标准检索与深度研究，溯源 HTML + 干净 Markdown）、深知公文写作（正式公文起草/改写/Word/红头交付）三个 Skill；接口统一经深知可信工作台 MCP 转接（Bearer 认证），产物写入会话工作区，API Key 一次配置长期免注册；已发布 npm 包 dknowc-dsh。

description.en: Adds an "About" settings page to the DeepSeek Harness web interface, showing the running DSH version and recent release notes.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 设置面板添加“关于”页，展示运行中的 DSH 版本与最近更新日志。

description.en: DSH plugin: password gate for remote (non-loopback) /api access (passwordless by default), unblock the loopback-pinned privileged endpoints, restore everything on uninstall, and give the local 127.0.0.1 user the native OS folder picker for workspace selec
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供远程访问认证门禁，保护你的服务不被未授权使用。
对话结束后自动把中间的工具调用和过程节点折叠成一行，让聊天记录更清爽，想看细节随时展开。

description.en: DSH Web 插件：悬浮显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，点击直达充值页 | DSH widget showing your DeepSeek balance with a top-up link
description.zh: 右下角悬浮球实时显示 DeepSeek 余额和模型费率，可拖动，点击直达充值页。

description.en: Adds a Reading tab to the DSH web client that shows process steps and live reasoning in source order, collapses successful turns to the final answer, and keeps the original tabs, composer, and tooling intact.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 客户端新增「阅读」页签：按源顺序呈现过程步骤与实时思考，成功轮次收起只留最终回答，原有页签、输入框与工具保持不变。

description.en: a lightweight plugin supports commandcode coding plan in dsh
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中快速启用 CommandCode 编码计划，让开发流程更顺畅。

description.en: Use your phone as a DSH peripheral remote: send messages (typed or dictated with the phone keyboard), answer yes/no and choice prompts, browse messages and switch sessions on a Game Boy-style screen, paired over LAN QR or a built-in Cloudflare tunnel.
description.zh: 把手机变成 DSH 的外设遥控台：发送消息（打字或用手机输入法语音转文字）、应答 yes/no 审批与选择题、浏览消息与切换会话，Game Boy 风格屏幕；局域网扫码或内置 Cloudflare 隧道连接。

description.en: Local knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: zero-dependency SQLite FTS5 index for markdown/text/code/web pages, source-cited retrieval, session experience library, interactive kbquery Web panel + knowledge galaxy.
description.zh: 本地知识库插件，自动检索文档并标注来源，还能沉淀会话经验、剪藏网页，让模型回答更靠谱。

description.en: dsh的记忆管理
description.zh: 跨会话记忆库，自动注入规约和上下文，让DSH对话更连贯、更懂你。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: one-page mobile access setup — Tailscale/LAN detection, scan-to-open QR (offline), insecure-origin polyfill
description.zh: 手机一键接入 DeepSeek Harness：自动检测 Tailscale/局域网，扫码即连，支持直连与 HTTP/2 切换，兼容旧版手机端。

description.en: dsh-plugin
description.zh: 粘贴大段文本时自动折叠成摘要，让聊天界面更清爽，阅读更高效。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: one local bridge for ChatGPT Codex / Claude / ZCode (GLM) / Qwen subscription plans — settings status card, one-click provisioning, zero core changes. npm: @taylorswitiger/dsh-plan-bridge
description.zh: 一个本地桥接插件，让你在DeepSeek Harness里直接管理ChatGPT、Claude等订阅计划，一键配置，无需改核心代码。

description.en: DSH 选择增强插件：「重新生成选项」/「更多选项」按钮。Choice refresh (regenerate / more options) for DeepSeek Harness (dsh).
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 选择操作添加“重新生成选项”和“更多选项”按钮，一键刷新可选内容。

description.en: Rich Markdown notebook for the composer region: a tool-row toggle plus a CodeMirror editor card with Codex-style list editing, submitted through the conversation service.
description.zh: 为输入区提供富 Markdown 笔记本：工具行开关加 CodeMirror 编辑卡片，支持 Codex 风格列表编辑，经会话服务提交。

description.en: Discover and verify portable RoleHub roles, pin each exact bundle, then launch its prompt and bundled skills in an isolated, continuable DSH Session with Host-approved tool bindings and optional Agent Team Room attachment.
description.zh: 发现并校验可移植的 RoleHub 角色，固定其精确 bundle，再将提示词和随角色打包的 Skills 加载到独立、可续聊的 DSH Session，以 Host 批准的工具绑定限制能力，并可选接入 Agent Team Room。

description.en: A better approach to editing files in DSH.

Nine consolidated tools that give agents full access to the stool ops CLI: server management, database query/redis, log search/tail, CI/CD deploy and history, MFA codes, git operations, notes, todos, and misc utilities (accounting, weekly reports, audit, project listing, nginx presets).
description.zh: 将 stool 运维 CLI 的全部能力整合为 9 个合并工具，Agent 可直接调用：服务器管理、数据库查询与 Redis、日志搜索与尾部查看、CI/CD 部署与历史、MFA 动态码、Git 仓库操作、笔记管理、待办任务，以及记账、周报、审计、项目列表、Nginx 预设等杂项工具。

description.en: Signature escook theme ported from VS Code: 4 classic aesthetic color schemes (Dark, Dark Soft, Light, Light Soft) with high-contrast syntax highlighting for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 移植自 VS Code 经典的彬哥主题：包含 4 款经典美学配色（经典暗黑、柔和暗黑、紫韵浅色、柔和浅色）与高对比度语法高亮。

description.en: agent memory plugin based on CLP
description.zh: 给AI智能体配上会进化的记忆，思考前自动调取历史，回答后自动总结沉淀。

description.en: DSH plugin bundle: live Wallpaper Engine backgrounds for the DSH web GUI - video/web wallpapers, static scene previews, rotation lists, search, resource monitor, bilingual UI
description.zh: 把 Wallpaper Engine 本地壁纸库变成 DSH 网页界面的动态背景，支持视频壁纸、轮播和资源监控。

description.en: Rotates images and videos from a media folder as the DSH UI background, with panel controls for the rotation interval and UI opacity.
description.zh: 把媒体目录中的图片与视频自动轮换为 DSH 界面背景，面板可调轮播间隔与界面透明度。

description.en: A plugin of Deepseek Harness(DSH),transform your recent chat history into beautifully designed knowledge cards, ready to download and share.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 网页里的任意对话一键变成干净有质感的知识卡片，支持概念、流程图、对比等样式。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for using ChatGPT Plus/Pro Codex models through OpenAI Codex OAuth.
description.zh: 用 ChatGPT Plus/Pro 的 Codex 模型跑任务，通过 OpenAI OAuth 登录，即插即用。

description.en: Windows desktop automation for DeepSeek Harness: accessibility-first observe/act loop with 30 standard tools (element/coordinate targets, auto/a11y/event strategy routing), superseded-observations and no-replay safety semantics, persistent kill switch, RuntimeId/rect-drift stale protection, chat cards and a floating panel (live ops, frame wall, env auto-detect settings), tiled vision describe for low-res models, JSONL audit trail and a pid allowlist. Requires Windows 10+ and Python 3.9+ with uiautomation and pillow (installable from the settings page).
description.zh: Windows 桌面自动化插件：无障碍优先的观察-动作回路（30 个标准工具，元素/坐标双目标与 auto/a11y/event 策略路由），写后作废与禁重放安全语义，持久急停开关，RuntimeId/矩形漂移防错位，对话卡片与悬浮面板（实况/画面/环境自检设置），面向低分辨率模型的分块识图，JSONL 审计与 pid 白名单。需 Windows 10+ 与 Python 3.9+，并安装 uiautomation 与 pillow（设置页可一键安装）。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: GitLab and GitHub API tokens stay out of the model context — encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM), tools on demand, web settings panel.
description.zh: 帮你安全保管 Git 平台密钥，按需自动注入工具调用，数据全程加密且不进大模型上下文。

description.en: Manages multiple Jenkins servers and triggers jobs from a Settings page, model tools, or a per-workspace "Run Jenkins Job" entry, with a bilingual host + browser UI.
description.zh: 管理多台 Jenkins 服务器，支持从设置页、模型工具或工作区级「执行 Jenkins Job」入口触发构建，宿主 + 浏览器双端、界面中英双语。

description.en: Prompt Presets to manage your library
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中管理常用提示词库，一键注入到输入框，快速复用你的提示词模板。

description.en: use a GitHub Copilot subscription as a DSH LLM provider
description.zh: 把 GitHub Copilot 订阅变成 DeepSeek Harness 的模型后端，直接当普通 LLM 提供商来用，支持流式对话和模型列表。

description.en: A QQ NT messenger skin for DeepSeek Harness: light and dark share one QQ NT language — clean restrained light mode (brand blue #12B7F5, light-blue bubbles) and a calm blue-gray dark mode (#101822) — applied as reversible token and layout layers that never touch your Light/Dark preference.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 QQ NT 皮肤：浅色与深色共用一套 QQ NT 语言——浅色干净克制（品牌蓝 #12B7F5、浅蓝气泡），深色为沉稳蓝灰（#101822）——以可逆的 token 与布局两层实现，不改变你的浅色/深色偏好。

description.en: Audit citation sources in AI responses – extract URLs from the reply, score and rank them by threat level, and output a detailed report. Domains on your blocklist will be genuinely blocked – web tools such as web_search and web_fetch will directly refuse to access them. The blocklist is fully maintained by you.
description.zh: 自动审查AI回复中的引用链接，按威胁度打分排序并生成报告，还能真正拦截黑名单域名。

description.en: Restore archived sessions to their original workspace from the Web GUI sidebar.
description.zh: 从 Web GUI 侧栏查看已归档会话，并一键恢复到原工作区。

description.en: Watches agent execution traces and fires an LLM review at every successful turn end when signals trip, crystallizing reusable workflows into registered skills that improve progressively with later runs.
description.zh: 观察 agent 执行轨迹，在每个成功回合结束时按信号触发 LLM 评审，把值得复用的工作流结晶为已注册技能，并随后续运行持续改进。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 会话管理工具插件，为模型提供会话创建/重命名/归档/切换/列表/查询工具，支持沙箱提权审批与 UI 会话切换。
description.zh: 为模型提供会话管理工具，支持创建、切换、归档和查询会话，并带沙箱审批和UI切换功能。

description.en: Adds a sentient floating eye to DeepSeek Harness — injects a taming kernel that makes the AI truly understand you, with 11 dynamic eye skins, ghost mode, and zero token cost when AI mode is off.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上会开智的智子：注入驯兽内核让 AI 真正懂你，11 款动态皮肤、幽灵模式，关闭 AI 模式即零 token 消耗。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness usage analytics dock on the composer: Beijing-time peak/valley pricing with all-day weekend valley rate, live balance, cross-session history, by-date drill-down and charts.
description.zh: DSH 用量分析坞：输入框峰谷计费坞（周末全天谷时）、实时余额、跨会话历史、按日期下钻与图表。

description.en: DSH Web GUI 壁纸背景插件：从本机 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸库加载背景，wasm 渲染 scene 壁纸
description.zh: 把 Wallpaper Engine 动态壁纸搬进 DSH 网页界面，浏览器里直接实时渲染，不用装 Wallpaper Engine。

description.en: Routes chat images to a fixed OpenAI-compatible vision model, returns factual observations to the selected main model, and reuses session-scoped observations across replay, compaction, and restarts.
description.zh: 将聊天图片交给固定的 OpenAI 兼容视觉模型，把事实性观察交给当前主模型，并在事件回放、上下文压缩和重启时复用会话内观察。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Codex Web Search 能力。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Codex 网页搜索，直接调用兼容接口，让模型联网查资料更顺手。

description.en: Explicit cross-session work state for DeepSeek Harness: goals, decisions and next steps captured automatically from host events or via a model-visible work_state tool, inspectable with /checkpoint.
description.zh: 跨会话工作状态显式持久化：目标、决策与下一步从宿主事件自动捕获，或由模型经 work_state 工具主动记录，/checkpoint 随时可查。

description.en: Structured machine-readable CI output for DeepSeek Harness: JSON/NDJSON session reports, JUnit XML, semantic exit codes, artifact collection and privacy redaction - a dsh profile bundle plus a standalone CLI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供结构化、机器可读的 CI 输出：JSON/NDJSON 会话报告、JUnit XML、语义化退出码、工件收集与隐私脱敏——一个 dsh profile bundle 外加独立 CLI。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的 APEX 实验插件：Minimal 锚定启动、按需 Standard 工具、持久任务状态与 V4 Flash 定向研究。
description.zh: APEX preset for DeepSeek Harness with a Minimal anchor, lean guidance, and on-demand Standard tools

description.en: 把 DSH Web GUI 变成"桌面应用":以独立应用窗口打开,关闭窗口即优雅退出整个 DSH 进程
Guardian preset for DeepSeek Harness with independent persistent Codex auditing
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加独立审计模式，代码展示与人工复核结合，确保关键操作安全可控。

description.en: Ringtone notifications for DeepSeek Harness: alerts are triggered when the conversation ends and when authorization is required (either with a built-in tone, TTS voice, or custom audio).  **DeepSeek Harness 网页端铃声提醒插件：回答完成或需要授权时响铃提醒，支持内置铃声 / 文字转语音 / 自定义音频。
description.zh: 对话结束或需要授权时自动响铃提醒，还能弹卡片，支持内置铃声、语音播报和自定义音频。

description.en: DSH plugin: visible cost/balance stats pill below the composer, with settings page and one-click reset. Fixed fork-level issues of dsh-cost-balance (slot id collision, missing ctx, invisible 5px bar).
description.zh: 在输入框下方直接显示会话余额和花费，点开还能看Token明细，设置里可自定义样式并一键还原。

description.en: Guardian preset for DeepSeek Harness with independent persistent Codex auditing
Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness agents: automatic recall each turn, a retain/recall/reflect tool, standing rules, and visibility you scope to the whole bank, a preset, or a session.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 智能体装上长期记忆，每轮自动回忆，还能手动保留、召回和反思，让对话不中断。

description.en: Off-peak task queue plugin for DeepSeek Harness — queue at peak price, drain at night, read the savings report
description.zh: 把耗时任务留到夜间低价时段运行，帮你省下Token费用，早上直接看省钱报告。

description.en: Optical compression memory using DeepSeek-OCR (OCR1)
description.zh: 把文本记忆渲染成带编号的图像，按年龄降清晰度，检索时靠光学定位找回原文，省上下文又记得牢。

description.en: iPhone-style agent phone: dual-panel calls & SMS, RCS group chat with trust gates, cross-device agent messaging via the registry inbox bridge, L0–L4 trust badges and evidence audit. Experimental: trust summaries are not a security guarantee, and SMS/signalling is relayed through the operator's inbox (visible to them); E2E encryption is planned.
description.zh: 苹果风格智能体手机：双面板电话/短信、RCS 群聊（信任门禁）、跨设备智能体消息（registry 收件箱桥）、L0–L4 信任徽章与证据审计。实验性：信任摘要非安全保证，短信/信令经运营方收件箱中继（运营方可见）；E2E 加密为演进方向。

description.en: DSH 动态 Cordis 插件安装安全审查守卫 (DeepSeek Harness plugin install security review gate, security-first)
description.zh: DSH 动态 Cordis 插件安装安全审查守卫 (DeepSeek Harness plugin install security review gate, security-first)

description.en: Plugins for DeepSeek Harness: a source library that reads 72 feeds and publishes podcasts, digests and reports, plus web search over Serper, Tavily and Brave
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供丰富插件，支持订阅 72 个信息源生成播客摘要，并集成多种搜索服务。

description.en: 把 pubmed-mcp-server 的核心能力 移植成 DSH 原生模型工具：搜索、文章元数据、全文、引用格式化、MeSH、ID 转换等 11 个工具， 直接对接 NCBI E-utilities 与 Europe PMC REST，无需额外的 MCP 客户端配置。

See how you have been using AI: `/session-insights` reviews your DSH sessions over time, shows what worked, which problems kept coming back, and what results were actually produced, then creates a retrospective report on your machine.
description.zh: 回头看看你是怎么使用 AI 的：`/session-insights` 会整理一段时间内的 DSH 会话，找出哪些做法有效、哪些问题总在重复、最终真正留下了哪些成果，并生成一份保存在本机的复盘报告。

description.en: 简单的dsh定时任务插件 支持定时列表任务、ui显示，对于长期任务有益
description.zh: 给 DSH 智能体加个定时闹钟，支持任务列表和 UI 展示，适合跑长期任务时自动唤醒提醒。

description.en: Readline-based interactive terminal profile bundle for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: dsh 交互式终端聊天应用：流式对话、工具卡片、任务面板、全文搜索、轨迹回放、多会话标签与 A2A 派发（Ink 实现）。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness vision plugin: 8 analysis modes (describe, OCR, chart data, UI review, object detection, compare, code-gen, debug), any OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible vision API, with a built-in free vision model and automatic rate-limit failover.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 图像理解插件：8 种分析模式（描述、OCR、图表取数、UI 评审、目标检测、对比、代码生成、诊断），支持任意 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容视觉 API，内置免费视觉模型与限流自动切换。

description.en: Manual browser speech-to-text input for DeepSeek Harness Web
description.zh: 在 Composer 里用浏览器语音输入，边说边转文字，还能结合当前会话润色，发送由你决定。

description.en: Six-stage WeChat Official Account content-publishing workflow with quality-gate tools and a bundled skill.
description.zh: 六阶段公众号内容发布工作流，带质检门工具与配套 skill。

description.en: a ticket tool for agent
description.zh: 给智能体用的工单小助手，帮你在对话里快速创建、查看和管理工单，提升处理效率。

description.en: Persistent provider-reported token usage totals with per-session, per-model, and daily activity statistics.
description.zh: 持久化 provider 上报的 Token 用量统计，支持按会话、按模型和按日活跃度查看。

description.en: Agnes AI image and video generation plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: Agnes AI 生图生视频插件。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness hashline - 哈希锚点编辑
description.zh: 在编辑器中快速插入和管理哈希锚点，方便文档内跳转与引用，提升编辑效率。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that displays real-time account balances for DeepSeek, Kimi (Moonshot), and Qwen providers.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框下方实时显示 DeepSeek、Kimi 和 Qwen 账户余额，方便你随时掌握费用消耗。

description.en: Whole-report verification for scientific reports: per-claim checks against Crossref, PubMed (retraction scan), ClinicalTrials.gov, UniProtKB, GEO/SRA and PatentsView, URL accessibility and title agreement, claim-vs-source meaning at temperature 0, and a durable restartable audit ledger with an annotated report.
description.zh: 面向科研报告的整篇校验工作流：逐条核对 Crossref、PubMed（含撤稿扫描）、ClinicalTrials.gov、UniProtKB、GEO/SRA 和 PatentsView，核验 URL 可访问性与标题一致性，以温度 0 判定声明与原文含义一致，输出可恢复的审计账本与标注版校验报告。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bundle: a Chrome browser for agents (browser_goto / browser_evaluate / browser_screenshot tools) with a live two-way pane inside the DSH Web GUI. The browser engine is a fork of zenbu-labs/terminal-browser with the React Ink terminal UI replaced by a DSH tool surface and web pane.
description.zh: 给智能体装上真实Chrome浏览器，能跳转网页、执行脚本、截图，还能在DSH界面实时看到浏览器操作。

description.en: Mobile access gateway for the Web GUI: isolated child-process reverse proxy with a first-visit PC approval gate (admin-token auth, DNS-rebinding defense), LAN/VPN/WAN auto-detection with network-mode switching, QR-code entry, WebSocket forwarding, and narrow-screen UI adaptations (composer reflow, third-party plugin overlays, crypto.randomUUID polyfill).
description.zh: 移动端访问网关：独立子进程反向代理 + 首次访问 PC 审批（管理 token 认证、DNS rebinding 防护）+ 局域网/VPN/公网自动识别与网络模式切换 + 扫码访问 + WebSocket 实时转发 + 窄屏 UI 适配（输入区重排、第三方插件弹窗适配、crypto.randomUUID polyfill）。

description.en: Phone-first drawer shell for DSH Web. Collapses the session list into a tap-to-open drawer, keeps header plugin actions, and turns Settings into a full-width sheet.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 做成真正的手机壳：会话列表收成抽屉，点会话自动收起且不弹键盘，设置页改为全宽 sheet。

description.en: dsh-okf-memory: 会话记忆 → OKF 知识沉淀插件(神经自我学习驱动)。Session-to-OKF memory plugin: predictive recall, uncertainty-driven capture, reinforcement feedback, consolidation & forgetting.
Ctrl+click file paths and links in chat: paths open their folder in the OS file manager (with the file selected), links open in a new browser tab.
description.zh: 在对话中 Ctrl+点击文件路径与链接：路径在文件管理器中定位所在文件夹，链接在新标签页打开。

description.en: DSH web plugin: a sidebar-footer QR-code button that lets a phone scan and re-issue the current browser's authenticated launch URL.
description.zh: 在网页侧边栏加一个二维码按钮，手机扫码就能复用当前浏览器的登录链接，快速打开同一会话。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 动态 Skill 运行时管理器，自动发现、路由、挂载和卸载 Agent Skills
Three Departments and Six Ministries governance mode plugin for DeepSeek Harness | dsh 三省六部模式插件
dsh-think-autoexpand：让 DeepSeek Harness 里的 Think 思考行始终可见，并在流式输出时自动展开，实时查看 Agent 完整推理过程；保留工具卡折叠体验。
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 中的思考过程始终可见并自动展开，实时查看 Agent 完整推理，同时保留工具卡折叠体验。

description.en: 给每次 AI 对话装一根 Token 保险丝：为每条用户消息设置独立总预算，统一约束输入、缓存、思考与回答。A per-conversation total-token safety fuse for DeepSeek Harness, with a whale slider and automatic reset on the next user message.
description.zh: 给每次 AI 对话装一根 Token 保险丝，按消息设定总预算，自动控制输入、思考与回答，防止超支。

description.en: Aqua glassmorphism theme for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: mica and compatibility modes with adjustable blur and frost, fluid or wallpaper backdrop, background brightness, particle-whale accent, and a master switch that restores the stock UI.
description.zh: Aqua 玻璃质感主题：云母/兼容双模式、可调模糊与磨砂、流体/壁纸背景、背景亮度、粒子鲸鱼点缀，一键关闭即还原原生界面。

description.en: DSH 插件：在对话框下方监控 DeepSeek API 用量与余额（本月/日均/昨日/今日消费 + 账户余额），点击账单行配置 userToken
description.zh: 在对话框下方实时显示 DeepSeek API 用量与余额，点击账单行即可配置 token，方便掌控消费。

description.en: ADB device & bench operations for DSH: device discovery, structured logcat (background streaming), apk install, file pull/push, and dumpsys performance snapshots.
description.zh: ADB 设备·台架运维工具集：设备发现、结构化 logcat（后台采集）、apk 安装、文件 pull/push、性能快照。

description.en: Document → Markdown + vision image description plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh). Converts Word/PPT/Excel/ODT/RTF/EPUB/CSV/PDF via firecrawl-anydoc and describes embedded images with a VLM.
Bridges images into text for non-vision DeepSeek Harness models — your message stays untouched, zero manual setup.
Feishu (Lark) private-chat frontend for DeepSeek Harness: drive, monitor, and approve local agents from Feishu, sharing sessions with the Web GUI
description.zh: Feishu (Lark) private-chat frontend for DeepSeek Harness: drive, monitor, and approve local agents from Feishu, sharing sessions with the Web GUI

description.en: Feishu/Lark channel that drives DeepSeek Harness agents from chats: streaming rich cards with live thinking and tool steps, per-turn cost metering at DeepSeek peak/off-peak rates, one-tap approval cards, model-gated image intake, and QR onboarding without a public endpoint.
description.zh: 在飞书聊天里驱动 DeepSeek Harness agent：流式富卡片实时展示思考与工具步骤，按 DeepSeek 峰谷牌价计量每轮费用，一键审批、按模型能力透传图片，扫码即用、无需公网。

description.en: 在dsh中接入智谱 GLM 视觉模型，让 DeepSeek 等文本模型通过 glm_vision 工具看图。
Registers the MathWorks MATLAB/Simulink MCP server into a dsh profile, so agent sessions get mcp__matlab__* tools for running MATLAB code and reading, editing and testing Simulink models.
description.zh: 把 MathWorks MATLAB/Simulink MCP 服务器注册进 dsh profile，让会话获得 mcp__matlab__* 工具，用于运行 MATLAB 代码以及读取、编辑与测试 Simulink 模型。

description.en: Scopes MCP tool injection per workspace directory in the DeepSeek Harness: a session opened in a project sees only the MCP servers that project needs — removed from the model's tool list and refused at call time. Plus per-session switches in the composer to narrow or widen the session you are in, temporarily.
description.zh: 按项目目录自动隔离 MCP 工具，每个工作区只暴露自己需要的工具，避免模型看到无关工具。

description.en: Bridges the MemOS memory service over MCP: the agent gets add/search/update/delete memory, multi-cube sharing, and a memory scheduler as mcp__memos__* tools.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 桥接 MemOS 记忆服务：agent 获得 mcp__memos__* 记忆写入/检索/更新/删除、多 Cube 共享与记忆调度工具。

description.en: Bark push notifications to iPhone: turn completion, waiting-for-input, and approval events sent from the DSH Host.
description.zh: Bark 推送通知到 iPhone：回合完成、等待回答、等待授权等事件由 Host 端发送。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for third-party OpenAI Responses and native Gemini APIs, with custom providers, model discovery, and hosted web search.
Route OpenRouter requests through a configured provider list and quantization cap, injected as provider.only/order with allow_fallbacks, plus provider.quantizations.
description.zh: 配置 OpenRouter 请求使用的提供商列表与量化位数上限，注入 provider.only/order（allow_fallbacks）与 provider.quantizations 路由参数。

description.en: Claude Code-style permission rules engine: hard/deny/ask/allow tiers with a hard tier above full access, workspace-scoped rules, wildcard path protection, and a visual staged editor; rules persist in settings.yaml.
description.zh: Claude Code 风格权限规则引擎：hard/deny/ask/allow 四级规则（hard 高于全访问、不可豁免）、workspace 作用域、通配符路径保护、可视化草稿式编辑器，规则持久化于 settings.yaml。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns your photos into Web GUI skins — auto-extracted accent colors, all files stay local.
description.zh: 把照片变成 DSH 网页界面的皮肤，自动提取主色调，所有文件本地保存，即插即用。

description.en: 为手工 OpenAI 兼容模型补上推理档位声明的 DSH 插件 / DSH plugin to declare reasoning efforts on hand-added OpenAI-compatible models.
description.zh: 为手工添加的OpenAI兼容模型自动补上推理档位声明，让模型按预期强度思考。

description.en: Plugin development toolkit for DeepSeek Harness with scaffolding, contract checks, plugin vetting, impact analysis, and upstream compatibility tracking.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的插件开发工具集，提供骨架生成、契约检查、插件体检、影响面分析与上游兼容性追踪。

description.en: Qoder CN adapter plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 帮 DeepSeek Harness 直连 Qoder 国内服务，自动搞定签名和加密传输，让你轻松调模型。

description.en: Session-scoped full-duplex voice assistant for DeepSeek Harness with safe drafting, explicit Agent submission, and optional knowledge curation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话级全双工语音助手，支持安全草稿、显式提交 Agent 及可选知识整理，提升语音交互效率。

description.en: Sidebar system monitor for the DSH Web UI: live host overview (CPU/memory/network/disk), process list, and Docker container status, all read-only.
description.zh: 侧边栏系统监控：实时查看宿主机概览（CPU/内存/网络/磁盘）、进程列表与 Docker 容器状态，全程只读。

description.en: Fail-closed three-mode approval plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: Fail-closed LLM-assisted approval reviewer for DeepSeek Harness

description.en: Stability audit for installed dsh plugins: static risk grading (hook surface, startup work, inject, entry, dep ranges) plus optional isolated install verification.
description.zh: 已安装 dsh 插件的稳定性审计：静态风险分级（钩子面/启动任务/inject/入口/依赖区间）加可选隔离安装验证。

description.en: Native memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness — auditable facts with evidence chains, powered by StateCore

Pins every request to native `max` reasoning effort instead of the `ultra` option, with isolated Flash / Pro / Vision depth presets. Distributed as a build-only artifact: the core is closed and its license forbids reverse-engineering, deobfuscation and repackaging.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 加一层深度推理控制，让每次请求都保持最高思考强度，还能单独调节不同模型模式的深度。

description.en: Modular search tool for DeepSeek Harness: attach SearXNG, RAG and your own sections to the native web_search.
description.zh: 增强版网页搜索工具，支持话题筛选和SearXNG双结果区，搜索更精准灵活。

description.en: Drag-and-drop file upload into the conversation composer, token usage pill with quota tracking, and session archive management — a three-in-one daily-driver addon.
description.zh: 会话输入区拖拽上传文件、Token 用量胶囊与额度跟踪、会话归档管理，三合一日常插件。

description.en: DIY你的小蓝鲸吧
description.zh: 不用改代码就能给 DSH 换背景、字体和配色，保存后下次打开还在。

description.en: A native DSH desktop whale with growth, achievements, skins, and privacy-safe progress tracking
description.zh: A native DSH desktop whale with growth, achievements, skins, and privacy-safe progress tracking

description.en: DeepSeek Harness workspace & session enhancement plugin: recycle bin, cross-workspace drag, ungrouped sessions, multi-folder roots, session merge
description.zh: 增强 DSH 工作区与会话管理：回收站防误删、跨工作区拖拽、未分组会话整理、多根目录支持，还能合并会话。

description.en: DSH Web Client 的 VSCode 风格文件树侧栏插件：虚拟化懒加载文件树，支持文本 / Markdown / 图片预览。
description.zh: 给 DSH 网页客户端加上 VSCode 风格的文件树侧栏，支持懒加载和文件预览，浏览项目文件更顺手。

description.en: 虾说教材写作 · dsh-course-writer — AI course-authoring workspace plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). 三栏式工作台 · 九阶段门禁 · 课程/章节/资料库/知识图谱 · 导出 TXT/Word · 分享协作。Three-pane workspace, nine-phase gated workflow, lorebook, export & share.
description.zh: 虾说是一款 AI 教材写作工作台，提供三栏式编辑、九阶段流程管理和知识图谱，帮你高效完成课程创作与导出。

description.en: Русский язык для DeepSeek Harness web UI — one-command install, 1061 строка, 100% покрытие
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面一键安装俄语语言包，覆盖全部界面文本，让俄语用户使用更顺手。

description.en: Capability Manager for DeepSeek Harness: manage MCP servers and Skills from a Settings-page UI (dual-face dsh plugin)

Agent discipline guard for DeepSeek Harness: four gates enforced at the harness boundary — loop circuit-breaker, token-cost fuse, route-switch warning, plan approval — where prompt-level reminders can't reach, so an agent can no longer burn a weekly quota in minutes; one-click 🛡 chip, hot-reloadable thresholds, and presets from invisible-but-armored to warn-only.
description.zh: DSH Agent 纪律卫士：在 harness 边界强制四道闸门（循环熔断、Token 成本熔断、路由切换警示、计划审批卡），模型无法用文字绕过；🛡 芯片一键解除，daily 档对有缓存路由零打扰，把无缓存失控从每回合数百万 token 封顶到约 50 万。

description.en: 基于抖音官方资料的 DeepSeek Harness 自媒体插件：帮你做选题、审脚本、诊断流量、制定周计划，已用于《商道人物志》近 6 万粉丝实战。
description.zh: 基于抖音官方资料的创作助手，帮你做选题、审脚本、诊断流量、制定周计划，已实战验证。

description.en: Light-weight explorer plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中浏览工作区文件，并用内置 Monaco 编辑器直接查看和编辑代码。

description.en: deeepseek-harness kiro provider
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Kiro 模型服务，即插即用，轻松切换 LLM 提供商。

description.en: Scans skills and MCP configs for prompt injection, homoglyphs, hidden Unicode, dangerous shell, and credential leaks.
description.zh: 扫描 skill 与 MCP 配置中的提示注入、同形字、Unicode 隐形字符、危险 shell 与凭据泄露。

description.en: dsh-message 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的统一消息接入插件，仅包含微信、飞书、QQ、企业微信和钉钉。项目采用一套 Host/Client 插件、统一设置页和统一 HTTP Harness 会话链路，并在五个渠道上共享提示词、长期记忆和会话策略。并且可以定制鲸鱼娘的soul哦~
DeepSeek Harness 飞书接入插件（薄架构）：Web 面板扫码授权 lark-cli + 监听器管理
description.zh: 飞书接入插件（薄架构）：Web 面板扫码授权 lark-cli + 管理飞书网关监听器，业务收发仍在独立 lark-bridge 进程

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 社区插件管理器:来源分类、热停用/启用、事务化卸载 | Community plugin manager for DeepSeek Harness: origin classification, safe hot disable/enable, transactional uninstall
description.zh: 管理 DeepSeek Harness 社区插件，支持来源分类、安全热停用/启用和事务化卸载，随时掌握加载内容并安全恢复。

description.en: 为会话增加管理菜单、归档会话管理、轮次级删除、重新生成，以及右侧话题快捷导航。Add a management menu for conversations, archive conversation management, delete by round, regenerate, and a quick topic navigation on the right.
description.zh: 给会话页加上管理菜单、归档、按轮次删除和重新生成，右侧还有话题快捷导航，日常管理更顺手。

description.en: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) usage statistics dashboard plugin: token / cost / duration / session aggregation with trend, heatmap and calendar views.
description.zh: 本地用量数据看板，帮你直观掌握Token、费用和时长的消耗趋势，数据不出本机。

description.en: deepseek harness 背景主题插件
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换个背景主题，让界面更顺眼，用起来更舒服。

description.en: Three-pane workspace layout with file-tree browsing, file editing, a non-linear conversation mindmap view, and mobile mode support.
description.zh: 三栏工作区布局，提供文件树浏览、编辑文件、非线性会话导图视图，并且支持手机模式。

description.en: Windows desktop shortcut and system-tray launcher for DSH running in WSL, with fully hidden startup, tray open/restart/exit menu, and a plugin-configuration card to manage the shortcut.
description.zh: 为运行在 WSL 的 DSH 提供 Windows 桌面快捷方式和系统托盘启动器：完全隐藏启动，托盘菜单支持打开/重启/退出，插件配置页可管理快捷方式。

description.en: vibeweaver 的 deepseek harness 专属发行版，帮你的 dsh 交付可信任，经过验证的代码。
description.zh: 把 vibeweaver 编码规范搬进 dsh，帮你交付经过验证、值得信任的代码。

description.en: Desktop (native) control for dsh as a stdio JSON-RPC bridge over a Python core: capture the screen, inject pointer/keyboard input, drive accessibility-tree actions, and gate high-risk operations behind required confirmations.
description.zh: 桌面(native)控制:dsh 经 stdio JSON-RPC 桥接 Python 核心;支持截屏、指针/键盘注入、无障碍树语义操作,并以强制确认为高风险操作把关。

description.en: DSH 设置新增「归档」页：按工作区分组查看已归档会话，支持筛选/排序、取消归档、二次确认彻底删除。Add an Archive page to DSH Settings: view archived sessions grouped by workspace, filter/sort, unarchive, and permanently delete one or all with confirmation.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中新增「归档」页，按工作区分组管理已归档会话，支持筛选、排序、取消归档及彻底删除。

description.en: Per-model capability profiling for DSH: turns local session history into per-model dashboards of session counts, tool usage, error rates, and top error signatures, with time-range filters and multi-model comparison.
description.zh: DSH 按模型的能力画像:把本地会话历史变成逐模型的会话数、工具使用、错误率与 Top 错误签名看板,支持时间范围过滤与多模型对比。

description.en: a demo plugin for a preset with builtin musescore wasm editor/preview engine for agent composing
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页里直接打开、编辑和试听 MuseScore 乐谱，让 AI 帮你协作写谱，无需安装桌面软件。

description.en: Give coding Agents runtime evidence for debugging and verifying DSH / Cordis plugins. 让 Coding Agent 获得用于调试和验证 DSH / Cordis 插件的运行时证据。
description.zh: 让编码智能体实时查看 Cordis 运行时状态，调试和验证 DSH 插件更轻松。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的用量、费用、Token、缓存、余额与模型价格分析插件。
DSH 斗地主插件：在 DeepSeek Harness 里等回复时来一把（PVP → DSH Agent）
DeepSeek Harness Web 的本地文件输入插件。在输入框原有的 + 菜单顶部增加 attach，并用分隔线与 Harness 原生命令区分；不会再增加一个单独按钮。Private local file attachments for DeepSeek Harness with native images and bounded document reading.
description.zh: 在输入框的+菜单里直接附加本地文件，支持图片预览和文档解析，不额外占按钮位置。

description.en: One-step GitHub uploader: initializes git, auto-creates or improves README, sets repository topics, and pushes a local project to GitHub.
description.zh: 一键上传项目到 GitHub：自动初始化 git、生成或完善 README、设置仓库 topics，并推送本地项目。

description.en: Fully local vector memory for DSH: local embeddings, SQLite storage, automatic recall injection, dedup with conflict detection, soft-delete recycle bin, online backup, and optional LLM extraction.
description.zh: DSH 全本地向量记忆:本地 embedding、SQLite 存储、自动召回注入、去重与冲突检测、软删除回收站、在线备份,可选 LLM 提取。

description.en: Local IndexTTS 2.5 and GPT-SoVITS speech synthesis and playback for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 本地调用 IndexTTS 2.5 或 GPT-SoVITS 语音合成，让 DeepSeek Harness 用中文语音朗读回复，支持播放。

description.en: Convert Office documents and PDFs (including scanned ones) to structurally formatted Markdown via a CPU-first routing OCR pipeline (RapidOCR/SLANet/FormulaNet).
description.zh: 将 Office 文档与 PDF（含扫描件）转换为保留结构的 Markdown，采用 CPU 优先的路由 OCR 流水线（RapidOCR/SLANet/FormulaNet）。

description.en: Codex-like persistent memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness: auto-injected memory summary, memory tools, per-session rollout summaries, and a localized Web settings card.
description.zh: Codex-like persistent memory for DeepSeek Harness: auto-injected memory summary, raw memory tools, and per-session rollout summaries distilled into a bounded global memory file.

description.en: Plug-in vision for text-only models on DSH, with native interaction for image understanding and generation, and GUI automation, through layered evidence memory and cache.
description.zh: 给纯文本模型装上“眼睛”，原生支持识图与画图，内置记忆缓存与智能路由，多模态交互更顺畅。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: provider sign-in, model catalog, and selection routing over a loopback-only /model-hub channel
description.zh: 统一管理多个模型提供商的登录、模型列表与选择路由，让 DeepSeek Harness 切换模型更省心。

description.en: Multi-workspace sandbox: grants file-write access to every registered workspace automatically — add a workspace, write to it immediately, no config or escalation needed.
description.zh: 多工作区沙箱：自动赋予所有已注册工作区的文件写入权限——添加工作区后即可直接写入，无需配置或提权。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 原生全功能终端交互界面 · Claude Code-styled Terminal TUI & CLI for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的原生终端界面，让你在命令行里像用 Claude Code 一样流畅地写代码、跑 Agent。

description.en: Financial quantitative workbench and stock ticker: floating ball and drawer panel, real-time A/HK/US/global market quotes, multi-period K-lines and 5-day intraday charts, depth order book, capital flow, sector heat map, and AI investment research.
description.zh: 全景金融量化工作台与股票盯盘：悬浮球与抽屉面板、A/港/美/全球指数实时行情、多周期K线与5日分时、五档盘口、资金流向、板块热点榜与AI投研诊断。

description.en: Quick prompt templates for DeepSeek Harness: global and per-session templates, a right-side panel, and Python-backed SQLite persistence
Skill and MCP management center for DeepSeek Harness: browse and toggle user/project skills, add/edit/remove MCP servers hot without restart, with live per-session status in the sidebar.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 技能与 MCP 管理中心：浏览并启停用户/项目技能，热增删改 MCP 服务器（免重启），侧边栏实时展示各服务器状态。

description.en: A turn-based conversation timeline for DeepSeek Harness with bookmarks, history loading, keyboard controls, and mobile support.
description.zh: A discoverable, accessible conversation timeline for DeepSeek Harness with search, bookmarks, history loading, and mobile support.

description.en: Read-only trajectory review in a resizable conversation sidebar, with rule analysis, optional model explanations, evidence navigation, and same-range run comparison.
description.zh: 在可调宽的会话右侧栏中提供只读轨迹复盘、规则分析、可选模型解读、证据定位和同区间运行对比。

description.en: Open-source local driver for trusted agents to control your existing signed-in Chromium browser without browser-wide remote-debugging approval.
description.zh: 让可信AI代理直接操控你已登录的Chromium浏览器，无需全局调试权限，自动化测试和操作更安全便捷。

description.en: Adds a colored status line under the DSH conversation stats showing live DeepSeek API cost, usage and account balance, with on/off-peak pricing indicators.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话统计行下方新增彩色状态行，实时显示 DeepSeek API 费用、用量与账户余额，并带高峰/错峰计费指示。

description.en: DSH 带队模式插件：主 Agent 只规划派活监工，改动交给 subagent，每次派活弹窗选子模型
dsh 提醒插件：别错过需要你的时刻
DeepSeek Harness automatically opens browser plugins and includes a built-in WebView2 program to achieve a lightweight desktop experience.
description.zh: deepseek harness自动打开浏览器插件，内置WebView2程序实现轻量级桌面化。

description.en: 简陋deepseekharness计费插件,可查询显示余额.设置预算,累计汇总。
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供计费与预算管理，实时查询余额、统计调用费用，帮你控制成本。

description.en: Typed, guarded container control: ps/logs/inspect/exec/start/stop and compose up/down with JSON output, project-aware targeting, and approval-gated destructive ops.
description.zh: 类型安全、带护栏的容器控制：ps/logs/inspect/exec/start/stop 与 compose up/down，JSON 输出、项目感知定位、破坏性操作需审批。

description.en: Feishu/Lark bot bridge for DeepSeek Harness — control DSH agents remotely from Feishu.
description.zh: 通过飞书/Lark 远程操控 DSH 智能体，随时随地管理任务和状态。

description.en: Import MCP servers & Skills from Claude Code / Cursor / Codex / cc-switch into DeepSeek Harness (Settings → General → 导入智能体设置)

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供开发工具包，方便开发者快速构建和调试智能体插件。

description.en: Local knowledge base manager for DSH agents: multi-format import, CJK-aware chunking, sqlite-vec vector + BM25 hybrid search with bge-reranker-base rerank, snapshots, kbpack export/import and cross-KB search — 22 agent tools plus a Web panel.
description.zh: 本地知识库管理：多格式导入、CJK 感知分块、sqlite-vec 向量 + BM25 混合检索与 bge-reranker-base 重排序、快照恢复、kbpack 导入导出与跨库检索，提供 22 个 agent 工具与 Web 面板。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness long-run mission suite: mission control, Long-Run Captain preset, patched LLM-as-a-Verifier, self-wake timer
description.zh: 让 AI 自主跑长期任务：任务管控、定时自唤醒、严格验证，交付更靠谱。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: automatic session handoff when a session keeps hitting 429 TPM rate limits — cancel old, summarize handover, continue in a fresh session. True handoff, never parallel.
description.zh: 会话频繁触发 429 限流时，自动总结并迁移到新会话继续任务，避免中断，实现无缝交接。

description.en: DSH 插件：任务结束 / 需要用户决策时弹窗提醒（web toast + 桌面通知），类似 Codex / Claude Code 体验
description.zh: 任务结束或需要你决策时，自动弹窗提醒，让你不错过关键节点，体验更流畅。

description.en: dsh web-UI plugin: open the current session's workspace folder with an installed app (Finder, Terminal, VS Code, Ghostty, Zed, ...) — icons included
description.zh: 在聊天窗口一键用已装应用（如终端、VS Code）打开当前工作区文件夹，提升开发效率。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: multi-key pool with automatic quota failover and a usage dashboard for the OpenCode Go plan
description.zh: OpenCode Go 套餐多 Key 池，额度用完自动切换下一个 Key，还能在设置页看余额和重置时间。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin providing HTTP Basic Authentication, remote IP access, and Web Cryptography UUID polyfill for self-hosted server deployments.
description.zh: 为自托管服务器提供HTTP基础认证、远程IP访问控制和安全UUID生成，保护你的DeepSeek Harness服务。

description.en: Context manager for DeepSeek Harness: auto-summarizes every turn into priority-sorted records, injects them plus pinned cross-session notes and custom text into each model request, and folds any-size real conversation ranges into summaries to save tokens. Persistent and restart-safe. NOTE: manual multi-step install — copy the three package folders into profiles/node_modules and add the provided cordis.patch.yml rows, then restart DSH; not a standard one-command install.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 上下文管理：每轮对话自动总结为记录并按优先级排序注入，⭐ 置顶记录跨会话继承，自定义文本每轮注入；真实对话任意范围折叠成摘要真省 token，全状态持久化重启不丢。注意：非标准一键安装——需手动将三个包目录复制到 profiles/node_modules、粘贴 cordis.patch.yml 接线并重启 DSH。

description.en: Browse, search, star-sort, favorite and one-click download community plugins from inside DeepSeek Harness settings.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置页内浏览、搜索、星标排序、收藏并一键下载社区插件。

description.en: Rate-limits LLM requests per provider and per model using a reservation-based token bucket, with queue or reject modes, plus gateway identity rules that rewrite user-agent and inject custom headers.
description.zh: 按供应商与模型粒度限速 LLM 请求，预约式令牌桶支持排队或拒绝两种模式，附带网关身份规则（改写 User-Agent、注入自定义请求头）。

description.en: Zero-dependency MCP stdio server template + ready-to-use A-share data tools for DeepSeek Harness (dsh). No API key, all env-var paths, standard NDJSON protocol.
description.zh: 零依赖的MCP服务器模板，开箱即用获取A股公开数据，无需API密钥，直接接入DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: In-browser novel reader for the dsh web GUI: online book-source search, chapter-by-chapter reading in a chat-style view, and whole-book TXT download.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 在线小说阅读器：书源搜索、聊天式阅读界面、整本下载 TXT 到本地。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness novel writing and reading workspace plugin (modified fork of dsh-workspace-explorer, MIT): character-accurate pagination, auto-saved progress, pinned progress bookmark, return-to-progress chip, chapter TOC, ruled-line writing mode
Shiki, syntax highlighting, and code rendering services for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 插件的转义与主题响应 HTML 代码块渲染服务，基于结构化语法高亮 token，并保留源码换行符。

description.en: omdsh-dev/dsh-sandbox-micro 声明为 DeepSeek Harness 生态插件。
description.zh: 把模型命令隔离在Linux微虚拟机里执行，提升沙箱安全性和隔离度。

description.en: Universal skill adapter that registers any GitHub repo containing a SKILL.md as a DSH skill by cloning and symlinking into the official skills root.
description.zh: 通用 skill 适配器，将含 SKILL.md 的 GitHub 仓库克隆并 symlink 到官方 skills 根目录，注册为 DSH skill。

description.en: Shows per-turn and session token costs in DSH web conversations.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页对话中实时显示每轮和整个会话的 token 用量及费用，帮你随时掌握成本。

description.en: 基于 DSH 的有道风格划词翻译：划选即现「译」按钮，harness 自带大模型，零 API key / Youdao-style word-selection translation for DSH: select text, click 「译」, powered by the harness's own LLM, no API keys
description.zh: 划选任意文本即现「译」按钮，用 harness 自带大模型翻译，无需 API key。

description.en: 用 Vditor 3.11.3（IR 即时渲染模式）接管 DSH Web 的聊天输入卡片，并把用户消息渲染为完整 Markdown。
description.zh: 用 Vditor 即时渲染接管 DSH Web 聊天输入框，让消息以完整 Markdown 呈现。

description.en: Live llmtrim savings dashboard in the DSH web UI: Settings page with paid, would-have-cost, saved-today and saved-this-week cards plus per-model breakdown, and a configurable rotating or static stats strip under the composer.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内实时展示 llmtrim 节省统计：设置页金额卡片（已支付、未压缩应付、今日与本周节省）与按模型明细，输入区可配置轮播或静态统计条。

description.en: Five casual mini-games (sliding-number puzzle, Sudoku, snake, Schulte grid, number memory) that pop up when a turn starts, with auto-saved progress across sessions.
description.zh: 任务开始时自动弹出的 5 个休闲小游戏（数字华容道、数独、贪吃蛇、舒尔特方格、数字记忆），支持跨会话自动保存进度。

description.en: Local semantic code search for DeepSeek Harness: fragment-level symbol-aware indexing, offline lexical embeddings or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, and hybrid vector + BM25 retrieval fused with RRF - three dsh tools plus a sema CLI.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地语义代码搜索：片段级符号感知索引、离线词法 embedding（或 OpenAI 兼容端点）、向量+BM25 混合检索并以 RRF 融合——三个 dsh 工具外加 sema CLI。

description.en: DSH的外观插件
Bidirectional RPC between DSH Host and Client through the native Connection and Typert Gateway, with targeted peer calls, cancellation, and connection lifecycle handling.
description.zh: 通过原生 Connection 与 Typert Gateway 在 DSH Host 和 Client 之间提供双向 RPC，支持目标 Peer 调用、取消与连接生命周期处理。

description.en: A Taffy mood mascot for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: the corner GIF reacts live to agent state — approval pending / approved / rejected / begging, thinking, tool runs, interrupts, ask_user_question waiting, compaction, long-task fatigue, idle-ignored approval, idle / sleeping — with SSE-pushed state, drag positioning, middle-click console, tool-card mirror console, per-mood locking, persisted appearance settings and per-day bucket statistics.
description.zh: Taffy 表情包状态机：右下角表情实时联动 agent 状态——待审批 / 已批准 / 被拒 / 求饶、思考、工具执行、插话、等你回答、压缩记忆、长任务疲惫、审批没人理、空闲 / 休眠；SSE 推流同步、拖拽定位、中键控制台、工具卡片镜像控制台、表情锁定、外观设置持久化与今日时长统计。

description.en: an AI role play plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness量身打造的AI角色扮演插件，帮你轻松开启沉浸式角色互动体验。

description.en: Invoke user-accessible Skills with @name tokens and show matching Skill suggestions in the conversation composer.
description.zh: 通过 @名称 标记调用用户可用的 Skill，并在对话输入框中显示匹配的 Skill 候选项。

description.en: 让 DeepSeek 的每一分钱都花在刀刃上 —— 前缀缓存命中率、费用与健康度，一眼看穿。（已按规范要求严格配置文件，不会出现异常阻止启动） DeepSeek Harness 插件，the monster of cache-cost，用于监控前缀缓存命中率、统计 Token 消耗与估算 API 运行成本。 DSH plugin for DeepSeek API prefix cache hit-rate monitoring, token usage statistics and cost estimation.
description.zh: 实时监控前缀缓存命中率与Token消耗，估算API成本，让DeepSeek每一分钱都花得明明白白。

description.en: 让对话的 AI 不再是冰冷的工具——它拥有长期记忆、真实性格和随时间变化的好感度。你可以为它设定完整人设（高冷御姐、阳光学妹...），它会在对话中自然成长，并记住与你相处的点滴。  这是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 的开源插件，纯本地存储，子代理不受影响。
description.zh: 让AI角色记住你，通过长期互动逐渐形成对你的了解，关系越处越深。

description.en: IMAP email reader for DeepSeek Harness: list, read, and search mail via imapflow (email_list / email_read / email_search).
description.zh: 面向密码认证被禁用邮箱的 OAuth2 IMAP 读取插件：微软 2024 年起停用个人 Outlook 的 IMAP 基本认证，本插件改用 refresh-token OAuth2（XOAUTH2）自动续期，Gmail 走应用密码并可选本地 HTTP/SOCKS 代理；工具注册为 ol_email_*，可与市场版 dsh-email 共存不撞名。

description.en: One plugin, every upgrade DeepSeek Harness lacks out of the box: multi-engine web search, skills & MCP managers, per-profile plugin toggles, session cleanup with hover-delete, one-click restart/shutdown, themes. Single tool surface, no telemetry.

Experience validation layer for DSH: zero-token collection of tool-failure/retry/search signals, AI refinement into verified skill books (three-layer verification), looked up at task start. Ships 10 trial skills and benchmark data (complex-task success 100% vs 60% bare).
description.zh: DSH 经验验证固化层：零 token 采集工具失败/重试/搜索信号，加工轮提炼成经三层检验的技能书，任务开局翻书复用。内置 10 本试验经验 + benchmark 数据（复杂任务成功率 100% vs 裸环境 60%）。

description.en: Four dependency-free local git tools (status, diff, log, commit) for DeepSeek Harness operating on the session workspace.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供四个零依赖本地 git 工具（status、diff、log、commit），作用于会话工作区。

description.en: openai models for login by chatgpt
String-matches tool-call input arguments, blocks dangerous tool calls (deny) or allows them with an injected warning (warn), and ships a full rules-management panel.
description.zh: 对 agent 工具调用输入参数做字符串匹配，命中危险行为则拦截（deny）或放行但注入警告（warn），附规则管理面板。

description.en: deepseek-harness 的插件，可以使用kiro的模型（claude系列）和账号
description.zh: deepseek-harness 的插件，可以使用kiro的模型（claude系列）和账号

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI plugin — replaces the "Deep diving..." running status with rotating witty phrases and practical tips.
description.zh: 将Web界面中的“Deep diving...”加载状态替换为诙谐短语和实用提示，保留原位置和闪烁效果，让等待更有趣。

description.en: macOS desk pet forked from anneheartrecord/dsh-desk-pet, in a real always-on-top window that covers fullscreen Spaces: the pose follows whatever the local DSH is doing across six states, the right-click menu is a real AppKit one carrying quiet mode and a session list, and seven skins ship with it. Two of the seven are drawn from geometry by a script in the repo rather than generated, so making a skin needs no image model and no API credits; the bundled skill still expands one photo into all eighteen poses on your own image tool and credentials. There is no Electron and nothing to install alongside it: the window is driven through ctypes on the Python that ships with macOS.
description.zh: 分叉自 anneheartrecord/dsh-desk-pet 的 macOS 桌宠，一个真的置顶窗口，全屏 Space 也盖得住：姿势跟着本地 DSH 在六种状态之间走，右键菜单是真的 AppKit 菜单，里面有免打扰和会话清单，随包带七套皮肤。七套里有两套是仓库中的脚本用几何画出来的，不是生成的，所以做一套皮肤不需要图像模型、也不烧 API 额度；自带的 skill 仍用你自己的画图工具和额度，把一张照片扩写成十八个姿势。没有 Electron，也不用另装任何东西：窗口是用 macOS 自带的那个 Python 经 ctypes 驱动的。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness client plugin: mic dictation button next to the Full access control
/fuck — migrates your Claude Code & Codex habits into DeepSeek Harness. One command, parallel scan, boot-time recall.
description.zh: /fuck 命令：把 Claude Code 和 Codex 的使用习惯迁移进 DSH。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件雷达：定时扫描 GitHub topic:dsh-plugin 新插件，Web 界面左下角卡片推送，支持 README 关键词搜索与一键安装
description.zh: 定时扫描 GitHub 上的 DSH 新插件，左下角卡片推送，支持关键词搜索、AI 摘要和一键安装。

description.en: Peak-hour auto session gate: weekend mode + global peak auto-pause + session-level freeze/resume + backend auto-retry, auto-resume on off-peak.
description.zh: 高峰自动会话门：周末模式 + 高峰自动暂停（全局）+ 会话级冻结/恢复 + 后端自动重试；错峰自动续跑。

description.en: Shows a local image or short video in the current conversation card, with click-to-preview.
description.zh: 在当前对话卡片里展示本地图片或短视频，点击可预览。

description.en: SMS forwarding webhook for DeepSeek Harness: receive pushes from phone SMS Forwarder apps, store them, expose sms_recent / sms_search tools.
description.zh: DSH 短信转发 webhook：手机端转发 App（短信转发器/Tasker 等）把短信 POST 到本地 HTTP 端点，插件落盘 JSONL 并暴露 sms_recent / sms_search 工具，让 agent 在任务中直接读取短信验证码；自动提取 4–8 位 OTP，支持关键词过滤，可走局域网或 Tailscale。

description.en: LLM debug console for DeepSeek Harness: captures the full content of every model call at the llm/stream waterfall (options, stream chunks, usage, wire protocol) and shows it in a DevTools-style docked panel, with shared-prefix context diffing, wire-JSON reconstruction, JSON export and a runtime-tunable capture policy.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 里的 LLM 调试台：在 llm/stream 层完整捕获每次模型调用（请求参数、流式块、用量、真实 wire 协议），以 DevTools 风格停靠面板展示，支持上下文共享前缀折叠对比、wire JSON 重建、JSON 导出与运行时可调的抓取策略。
把 Trae 的积分变成本地 OpenAI/Anthropic 接口，让 Claude Code、Cursor 等工具直接调用 GLM、DeepSeek 等模型。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness自定义主题插件
DSH Web GUI 界面状态持久化插件：侧边栏开合/宽度/详情面板/对话滚动位置恢复
description.zh: 自动记忆侧边栏开关、拖拽宽度、详情面板和对话滚动位置，重启页面后一键恢复上次布局，操作不折腾。

description.en: Subtitle-first video transcription with SRT export, cancellable job controls, and a faster-whisper large-v3 fallback when subtitles are unavailable.
description.zh: 字幕优先的视频转录，支持 SRT 导出与可取消任务控制；字幕不可用时回退到 faster-whisper `large-v3`。

description.en: Reusable skill to browse, search and download Wallpaper Engine (Steam 431960) workshop wallpapers and wire them into the DSH skin center, including bypassing the Steam HTTP block and the region-mismatch sign-in block via a matching SOCKS proxy.
description.zh: 可复用技能：批量浏览、搜索、下载 Wallpaper Engine（小红车，Steam 431960）创意工坊壁纸并接入 DSH 皮肤中心；含绕过 Steam HTTP 封锁与异地登录拦截（经出口 IP 与账号一致的 SOCKS 代理）。

description.en: Let your AI agent see and operate a real Android phone: phone_look (vision + UI-tree fusion), tap/swipe/type, screenshot — over adb, for any MCP client.
description.zh: 让 AI 助手看见并操作真实安卓手机：phone_look（视觉+UI 树融合判读）、点击/滑动/输入、截图——经 adb，适用于任何 MCP 客户端。

description.en: Per-session Web Search toggle that directs the agent to search the web before answering.
description.zh: 在聊天输入框加个「联网搜索」开关，打开后助手会先搜网页再回答。

description.en: Connects DSH to local Beav for Xiaohongshu (RED/RedNote) and social-media AI operations: topic research, knowledge, copywriting, image, audio, and short-video workflows with approval and artifact tracking.
description.zh: 将 DSH 连接到本机 Beav，面向小红书（RED/RedNote）、社交媒体运营和自媒体 AI 创作，覆盖选题研究、知识库、文案、图片、音频与短视频工作流，并保留审批和产物追踪。

description.en: dsh --profile tui：DeepSeek Harness 的终端交互客户端（out-of-tree profile bundle）
description.zh: 在终端里直接和 DeepSeek Harness 交互，不用切窗口，聊着天就能完成各种任务。

description.en: Evidence-driven system architecture reconnaissance for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 自动扫描多仓库项目的底层架构，基于真实证据帮你快速摸清代码脉络，接手或重构项目更轻松。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：产物浏览器
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 对话侧边栏中浏览产物并添加书签，方便快速回溯和管理。

description.en: Fast `@` file/session reference caching for the DSH Web GUI: preloaded indexes, browser-local keystroke filtering and native mention serialization.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框 `@` 文件/会话引用加速：预加载索引、浏览器本地按键过滤、保留原生 mention 序列化。

description.en: Blue Archive-inspired DSH theme with a Shiroko desktop companion, Codex-style reply bubbles, petting effects, and completion chime.
description.zh: 给 DSH 换上蔚蓝档案学院风皮肤，还带一只可拖动、可抚摸的白子桌宠，能同步回复并查 API 余额。

description.en: Side-ask drawer opened from a completed answer's action row: follow-up questions run in an independent, auto-archived session seeded with the prior conversation text (read-only, capped at 48,000 characters), leaving the main session untouched. The side session inherits the main session's model, switchable inside the drawer, with a context-usage ring.
description.zh: 每条已完成回答操作行上的侧问抽屉：追问在独立且自动归档的会话中进行，携带此前的已完成对话文本（只读，上限 48000 字符）作为参考，主会话零写入；模型默认继承主会话并可在抽屉内切换，附上下文占用圈。

description.en: All-in-one UI enhancement layer for DeepSeek Harness web: prompt library with quick-insert and management, two-step AI polish, predicted-reply dock with click-to-send, MCP tool management, scheduled automation, smart session titles, adjustable chat width, full-width AI messages without gray background, auto-collapse for long user messages with smooth expand/collapse animations, and scene-specific entrance animations across all plugin surfaces.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 一站式界面增强：提示词库（快选+管理）、两步 AI 润色、预测回复栏（点击直接发送）、MCP 工具管理、定时自动化、智能会话标题、对话宽度可调、AI 回复占满无灰底、超长用户消息自动折叠（带平滑展开/收起动效），以及各面板的场景化入场动效。

description.en: Connects a Feishu self-built app over WebSocket, routes each chat to an independent DSH agent session, and streams replies through a Card JSON 2.0 card with plain-text fallback.
description.zh: 接入飞书自建应用，把每个飞书会话映射到独立的 DSH Agent，经卡片 JSON 2.0 流式回复，不可用时回退纯文本。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Feishu gateway plugin: chat with your DSH agent from Feishu (persistent sessions, /new, Markdown replies, proactive push)
description.zh: 在飞书里直接和你的 DSH 智能体聊天，支持持久会话、Markdown 回复和主动消息推送。

description.en: Leaderless flat agent teams for DeepSeek Harness: cross-window structured task dispatch, recorder service, and web dashboard
description.zh: 让多个独立Agent窗口组成无队长扁平团队，跨窗口互派任务，内置记录员实时汇报进展。

description.en: GitHub account management plus a local Git workflow for the web GUI with clone, fast-forward pull, status, commit, push, and host-side push guards.
description.zh: Web GUI 的 GitHub 账号与本地 Git 工作流插件，支持 clone、快进 pull、status、commit、push，推送默认关闭并有宿主侧开关保护。

description.en: A github reviewer based on the Deepseek Harness

Three-layer local memory for DeepSeek Harness: L1 snapshot memory (MEMORY.md/USER.md) read on demand through the memory_* tools + L2 searchable knowledge base (facts + SQLite FTS5, Chinese search via sliding-window tokenization) + L3 import from Hermes/Claude Code/Codex/WorkBuddy and from approved Agent Hub documents (memory/global, memory/projects, accepted decisions) with content-hash dedup. v0.2.0 removed every automatic injection: memory enters the context only when the model calls one of the 12 memory_* tools, and data stays on the local drive.
description.zh: DSH 本地混合记忆插件：L1 快照（MEMORY.md/USER.md，由 memory_* 工具按需读取）+ L2 可检索知识库（facts + SQLite FTS5，滑窗分词支持中文检索）+ L3 从 Hermes/Claude Code/Codex/WorkBuddy 以及 Agent Hub 已批准文档（memory/global、memory/projects、accepted decisions）导入，内容哈希去重。v0.2.0 已移除全部自动注入：记忆只在模型调用 12 个 memory_* 工具之一时才进入上下文，数据全部留在本地。

description.en: 菲奖得主强推的百合新闻订阅DSH插件
description.zh: 输入番名，AI 帮你搜遍动画漫画同人，一键提炼头条资讯，还能在会话里直接调用。

description.en: Local LLM integration plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中直接管理本地 GGUF 模型，通过 llama-server 提供服务，无需安装 Ollama。

description.en: A local-first full-text memory search plugin for DeepSeek Harness, enabling fast cross-conversation search, message-level navigation, and intelligent retrieval of your AI coding history.
description.zh: 本地优先的全文记忆搜索插件，帮你快速跨会话查找历史AI对话，精准定位消息并智能检索编码记录。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 极简模式增加自动上下文压缩、/compact、/context 和模型主动压缩，解决极简模式长任务无法持续工作的问题。
description.zh: 为极简模式增加自动上下文压缩和手动/模型主动压缩，让长任务不再因上下文溢出而中断。

description.en: Codex Pets–style desktop pet + live task panel plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面里养一只桌面宠物，边陪你写代码边实时展示任务进度，让开发更有趣。

description.en: Floating power dock for the DSH web GUI: one-click restart or graceful shutdown of the dsh host, loopback-guarded and dependency-free.
description.zh: DSH Web 悬浮电源坞:一键重启或优雅关机,仅限环回访问,零依赖。

description.en: Projectless sessions for DeepSeek Harness with isolated date-organized working directories
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加个「无工作区」会话选项，每次自动建独立日期目录，随手开聊不脏项目。

description.en: Hard-stop consecutive identical tool calls after a configurable streak so the agent cannot spin in place.
description.zh: 在可配置次数后硬拦截连续相同的工具调用，避免 Agent 原地空转。

description.en: Scans MCP servers configured in Claude Code, Codex and CodeBuddy and probes real connectivity via stdio and streamable-http initialize handshakes, with enable/disable toggles and a /mcp control panel.
description.zh: 扫描 Claude Code / Codex / CodeBuddy 配置中的 MCP，通过 stdio 与 streamable-http initialize 握手检测真实连通性，支持启停开关与 /mcp 控制面板。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 每个会话页右侧加一个类似deepseek网页端的常驻、可折叠的目录栏：每条用户提问对应一个条目，点击即可滚动定位到对应消息并高亮当前条目。
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页聊天界面右侧添加可折叠目录栏，点击即可快速跳转到对应提问，方便回顾长对话。

description.en: Injects WSL distro, Linux path mapping, /mnt/c CRLF and git caveats, and NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY into the system prompt.
description.zh: 向 system prompt 注入 WSL 发行版、Linux 路径映射、/mnt/c 的 CRLF 与 git 注意点，以及 NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY。

description.en: Adds a net_doctor tool that reports proxy environment, NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY, and reachability of the DeepSeek API and the npm registry, and sets NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY on bash and npm child processes.
description.zh: 提供 net_doctor 工具，报告代理环境、NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY，以及 DeepSeek API 与 npm registry 的连通性，并为 bash 和 npm 子进程设置 NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY。
通过 OAuth 2.0 安全绑定 X 账号，让 DeepSeek Harness 直接读取和发布 X 内容，实现社交媒体数据接入。

description.en: dsh主题维什戴尔风格
description.zh: Wishadel demolition-terminal skin + task board, git graph, project panel and settings center for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI

description.en: DeepSeek API 余额显示插件 / DeepSeek API balance display for DeepSeek Harness
Automatic context compaction for DeepSeek Harness: token-pressure-driven summarization checkpoints with a LATE-by-default trigger and a settings card
description.zh: 自动监测对话长度，上下文快满时智能摘要压缩，防溢出且更省Token。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Dream Skin，DSH theme plugin: Dream Skin color presets with a settings-page switcher.

Composer stats strip for the DSH Web UI: official CNY pricing with auto-synced peak/off-peak tiers, per-model accounting, live timers, subagent-tree merging, DeepSeek account balance, budget alerts, and streaming cost estimation.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框下方的增强统计条：官方人民币计价（峰谷分时、价目自动同步）、多模型分账、实时计时、子代理树合并、余额直连、预算预警与流式成本估算。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 用量看板插件：余额 / 消费 / token / 7 日趋势 / 一键充值
description.zh: DSH 常驻用量看板：实时显示余额、消费和 token 用量，7 日趋势一目了然，低余额提醒，还能一键跳转充值。

description.en: dsh对话导航
DSH 更新检查插件：首次打开自动检查新版本，取 npm 实际最高版本；左下方更新弹窗 +【更新到】按钮自动执行已校验升级（含安装后对盘校验）；UI 全部使用 DSH 语义化主题 token。
