description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 引入 Work Charter 策略，规范多智能体协作流程，提升团队工作效率。

description.en: Real-browser automation for dsh via an MCP server (Playwright core): navigate, click, fill, type, screenshot, and act on accessibility snapshots with numbered references - all 22 web_* tools re-exposed to the harness over stdio.
description.zh: dsh 的真实浏览器自动化:基于 Playwright 的 MCP 服务,提供导航、点击、填写、输入、截图与带编号引用的无障碍快照操作,22 个 web_* 工具经 stdio 接入 Agent。

description.en: Cadence SKILL (Virtuoso Lisp) assistant for EDA engineers: official-doc-anchored API lookup (3557 entries across 5 IC6.1.8 manuals, signature confidence levels, never invents APIs) plus zero-execution static analysis driven by a lexical depth coordinate system — iterator-safe deletion with position-sensitive copy() protection, printf placeholder/argument reconciliation, in-loop nth O(N^2) detection, deprecated APIs with page refs, dangerous-intent interception and CIW error-log triage. Host half has zero third-party dependencies.

description.zh: 让会话主模型跑在本机 Claude Code 订阅上：经官方 Claude Agent SDK 接管 claude-code provider 的 llm/stream 路由，支持 token 级流式、会话 resume 续接，并把 DSH 工具经 MCP 桥接进去以保留 DSH 的沙箱与审批。

description.en: Reasonix-style cache-aware compaction backend for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Modular compact plugin with auto-sync from esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix.
description.zh: Reasonix-style cache-aware compaction backend for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Replaces/enhances compaction-basic with compact_ratio, one structured summary checkpoint, and a stable recent tail.

description.en: DeepSeek 分时段计费小组件 · DSH client 插件（platform=web）：按北京时间自动判定高峰/空闲时段，10 款风格侧边栏小组件 + 设置页
description.zh: 按北京时间自动识别高峰/空闲时段，用10款侧边栏小组件直观展示DeepSeek分时计费价格，帮你省钱。

description.en: A generic web-app docking system for DeepSeek Harness: dock any local web service (marimo, Pluto.jl, gradio, streamlit...) via *.localhost routing + iframe.
An exec extension for headless dsh runner allowing more flags etc.
DSH plugin: per-model reasoning levels for custom API models, with family presets and an official-settings-page editor.
description.zh: 自动为自定义模型注入思考等级，内置主流家族预设，设置页一键切换，让深度思考更顺手。

description.en: Security-focused Feishu (Lark) channel for DeepSeek Harness: allowlisted remote-agent access with workspace-scoped paths, symlink checks, risk-based approvals, session isolation, redacted logs, and bounded message queues.
description.zh: 面向安全的 DeepSeek Harness 飞书通道：提供白名单远程 Agent 访问、工作区路径与符号链接边界校验、风险分级审批、会话隔离、日志脱敏和有界消息队列。

description.en: Floating minimal-mode DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: a transparent terminal TUI over dsh web in a borderless Electron window.
Foveated repository intelligence for DeepSeek Harness: token-budgeted code graphs, focus, impact, and continuous sync.
Free-tier model aggregation plugin for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh): transparent failover, multi-key rotation, settings panel
description.zh: 免费模型聚合插件，自动切换可用模型和密钥，让 DeepSeek Harness 更稳定省钱。

description.en: One-time Full access switch for DeepSeek Harness: new sessions (workspaces and conversations) start with danger-full-access and skip the per-session Full access confirmation; installable as a dsh bundle or via patch scripts.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加 Full access 一次性开关：新工作区与新对话默认 danger-full-access 并跳过逐个确认；可作为 dsh bundle 安装，也可用脚本打补丁。

description.en: Live remaining balance for the current API key from Sub2API, New API, or official DeepSeek, plus actual spend when the site publishes it, not a local token estimate.
description.zh: 读取当前 API key 在 Sub2API、New API 或 DeepSeek 官方账本上的剩余额度；站点公布实扣时才显示实扣，不是本地 token 估算。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: Cursor-style Git commit-chain graph with SVG lanes, commit details, diff, filtering, and guarded branch switching.
Literal Hermes Agent → DeepSeek Harness bridge: shared memory, skills, live tools, MCP, and full-agent delegation.
description.zh: 将 Hermes 智能体无缝接入 DeepSeek Harness，共享记忆、技能与实时工具，支持 MCP 和全代理委派，让多智能体协作更高效。

description.en: Configurable VS Code style keyboard shortcuts for the DSH web GUI, with a settings-page keybinding editor, conflict detection and JSON import/export.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供可配置的 VS Code 风格键盘快捷键，内置设置页改键、冲突检测与 JSON 导入导出。

description.en: Uses an isolated LLM review to approve or reject DSH sandbox permission requests.
description.zh: 使用隔离的 LLM 审查来批准或拒绝 DSH 沙箱权限请求。

description.en: Nous Portal LLM plugin bundle for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 直接接入 Nous Portal 模型库，无需改动核心代码，即插即用。

description.en: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）本地跨会话记忆插件：捕获每轮对话摘要、注入最近几天记忆，并提供 memory_search 工具按需检索全部历史记忆。
description.zh: 本地跨会话记忆插件，自动摘要每轮对话并注入近期记忆，还能用 memory_search 随时检索全部历史。

description.en: Black-first Matrix hacker skin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web — live session-powered code rain and readable provider reasoning.
Matrix rain for expanded thinking in DeepSeek Harness Web
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 网页里的思考过程变成数字雨特效，让推理内容可视化，边看边想更带感。

description.en: DSH plugin: sync MCP configs from Claude Code, Codex CLI, and Cursor Agent
description.zh: 一键同步 Claude Code、Codex CLI 和 Cursor 的 MCP 配置，省去手动迁移的麻烦。

description.en: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) skill: read/write Notion workspaces via the official REST API
DSH plugin: auto-upload conversation progress to Tencent IMA (daily note + Work knowledge base)
description.zh: 自动把对话记录同步到腾讯IMA，自动生成每日笔记和工作知识库，方便随时查阅和知识沉淀。

description.en: Web UI plugin that folds each staged response's think and tool calls into per-segment bounded, scrollable slide windows with a configurable height, keeping every intermediate response visible.
description.zh: Web UI 插件：以阶段性文字回复为界分段，把每段的 think 与工具调用收进限高可滚动、高度可配置的 slide 窗口，中间过程始终可见。

description.en: Send QQ private-message notifications via a local NapCat bot: qq_send / qq_status / qq_napcat / qq_deploy native tools plus one-click deployment scripts.
description.zh: 通过本机 NapCat 机器人向主号 QQ 发送私聊通知：qq_send/qq_status/qq_napcat/qq_deploy 原生工具与一键部署脚本。

description.en: 对DSH里的OpenCode的Go套餐，以及DeepSeek官方API的额度监控
description.zh: 在DSH界面左下角实时监控OpenCode Go套餐、DeepSeek API余额和MiniMax Token Plan额度，并显示当前任务的token消耗与预估费用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web 浏览器后台最终响应完成通知
description.zh: 当 DeepSeek Harness 在浏览器后台完成响应时，发送桌面通知提醒你，不错过任务结果。

description.en: Branching surveys in the web GUI: the ask_survey tool with per-option routing, hover insights, Mermaid diagrams, quick one-click answer templates, and resumable banked progress.
description.zh: 网页端分支问卷：ask_survey 工具，按选项路由后续问题，悬停洞察、Mermaid 流程图、一键快速模板，答案可暂存续答。

description.en: Adds a Branch Chat tab to dsh-better-sidebar that opens independent archived sessions with a head/middle/tail context digest and the same tools as the main agent.
description.zh: 在 dsh-better-sidebar 新增分支对话页签：开出独立封存 session，注入头／中／尾脉络摘要，并使用与主对话相同的工具。

description.en: See the same repo through every agent's eyes — compare the effective instruction surfaces of DeepSeek Harness, Codex, and Claude Code. 查看同一仓库在 DeepSeek Harness、Codex 与 Claude Code 眼中的不同指令面。
Manage installed DeepSeek Harness skills from Settings: disable/enable without uninstalling, restorable trash. Desktop + web. (dsh-plugin)
Read and search bounded log output from allowlisted SSH servers and log roots without exposing arbitrary remote commands.
description.zh: 从白名单 SSH 服务器和日志根目录读取或搜索有界日志内容，不开放任意远程命令。

description.en: 灵感便签 (Sticky Notes) plugin for the dsh web GUI: jot ideas while the agent thinks — without interrupting it. Queue-channel sends/forwards, auto-persist (localStorage + host file), export TXT/JSON/MD, bilingual zh/en. DeepSeek Harness plugin · @lastplayer82/dsh-sticky-notes
description.zh: 在智能体思考时随手记灵感，不打断对话，还能一键把便签内容发进聊天里。

description.en: Resolves a company name or ticker to a verified stock symbol via SEC EDGAR, then fetches a live quote with price, P/E, EPS, market cap, 52-week range, and dividend yield from yahoo-finance2.
description.zh: 通过 SEC EDGAR 将公司名称或股票代码解析为已验证的股票代号，再从 yahoo-finance2 获取实时行情，包括价格、市盈率、每股收益、市值、52周区间和股息率。

description.en: A paper-and-ink client-side theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: Balanced preserves semantic status colors, and Immersive maps supported surfaces to monochrome.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 纸墨风客户端主题，提供保留语义状态色的平衡模式和黑白沉浸模式。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: top-right widget counting let me / we / let's / I'll in reasoning chains
description.zh: 在右上角实时统计思维链中“let me”等短语的出现次数，帮你快速洞察推理过程。

description.en: Readable thinking display for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把模型思考过程分段整理成清晰摘要，让推理内容一目了然，方便阅读和复盘。

description.en: A phone shell for the web GUI - the sidebar becomes an overlay drawer that closes when a session is tapped, the settings sheet goes full-screen single column, and the transcript is retuned for phone reading.
description.zh: 网页版界面的手机外壳：侧栏改为覆盖式抽屉、点会话自动收起，设置面板改全屏单列，正文排版按手机阅读距离重调。

description.en: Check which DeepSeek Harness plugins actually loaded, and look up public evaluation boards on trapstreet.run
description.zh: 查看 DeepSeek Harness 插件是否真正加载，并浏览 trapstreet.run 上的公开评测榜单。

description.en: Agent Trace — visualize an agent's reasoning, parallel tool calls, and results as an interactive DAG inside DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 把智能体的推理过程、并行工具调用和结果，以交互式流程图的形式实时展示在聊天流中，让执行逻辑一目了然。

description.en: Ask a sidebar assistant about selected assistant text: an ephemeral right-side panel answers from a snapshot of the main conversation's LLM history with streaming Markdown, collapsible thinking and multi-turn follow-ups, without touching the main conversation.
description.zh: 选中助手回答中的文本，在临时右侧面板向侧边栏助手提问：基于主对话 LLM 历史快照回答，支持流式 Markdown、可折叠思考与多轮追问，不打扰主对话。

description.en: S3 storage backend for the DeepSeek Harness attachment seam: content-addressed, idempotent uploads with verified reads, installable with one dsh plugin command.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 S3 附件存储，支持内容寻址与幂等上传，读取可校验，一条命令即可安装。

description.en: 一款DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 插件：类似 Claude Code 中 Auto Mode 的一种命令通过机制，给 dsh中的full access 加一层 LLM 安全网的自动审批插件。
DeepSeek Harness bundle providing Brave Search API access and a unified brave_search tool
description.zh: 一键接入 Brave 搜索，在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接搜网页、新闻、图片和视频，还能拿 LLM 上下文。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for provider/model-aware adaptive rate-limit pacing, visible retries, and free-model recovery.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 免费模型自动限速与重试，避免因频率限制导致任务中断。

description.en: Community DeepSeek Harness bundle for Codex account-pool integration
description.zh: 把多个 Codex 订阅账号集中管理，并让团队成员共享闲置额度，省钱又高效。

description.en: 面向 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 的社交评论研究插件
DeepSeek Harness plugin for fail-closed network recovery, recommended answers, decision learning, and unattended continuation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可配置的自动续跑策略，断网或临时故障后自动恢复任务，无需人工盯守。

description.en: Verifier-gated multi-agent mathematical proof-search orchestration, native to DeepSeek Harness: content-addressed fact graph, role-gated tools, cold-start verifier, worker swarm, paper/report rendering. TypeScript, cross-platform. Based on Danus (frenzymath).
Adds a system tray icon to DSH Desktop, with settings to hide the main window to the tray on minimize or close and self-healing after app updates.
description.zh: 为 DSH Desktop 增加系统托盘图标，可在设置中选择最小化或关闭时隐藏到托盘，应用更新后自动恢复。

description.en: Feishu/Lark bridge for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — long-connection, card streaming, slash commands
description.zh: 手机飞书直连你的 Harness，长连接实时推送消息，支持斜杠命令和卡片流式回复。

description.en: Bidirectional Feishu/Lark integration for DeepSeek Harness: summaries, reply routing, binding UI, and QR provisioning.
DSH web 插件：VSCode 风格左侧文件面板（文件树 / 编辑器 / 预览 / @引用，按会话隔离）VSCode-style left file panel for DSH web: explorer, editor, preview and @-references, isolated per session
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页里加一个 VSCode 风格的左侧文件面板，能浏览、编辑、预览文件，还支持 @引用，每个会话独立互不干扰。

description.en: DSH bundle: 当前 Git 分支徽标。在会话 header 与新会话欢迎页显示当前分支，支持切换、新建、更新、拉取、推送、删除（仅本地分支，IDEA 风格目录树）。
Session loop-health diagnostics for DeepSeek Harness: oscillation/stall/near-repeat/per-tool/token/compaction profiles + auditable 0-100 score. CLI + live watch bundle.
化口水为乐趣，把大肥鱼流的口水变成游戏连击！
description.zh: 把模型思考时的“犹豫词”变成弹幕动画，让推理过程更有趣，还能自定义样式和开关。

description.en: Ink-and-paper Apple-inspired theme for the DSH web client with a handwritten jimmy sidebar brand.
description.zh: 墨水纸质感的苹果风 DSH 网页主题，侧栏使用手写 jimmy 字标与小狗头像。

description.en: MCP marketplace and management panel in the Web sidebar: one-click official templates (Apifox public/private, Apipost, MasterGo, Pixso), paste raw mcpServers JSON, and enable, edit or delete your services with hot reload.
description.zh: Web 侧边栏的 MCP 市场与管理面板：官方模板一键配置（Apifox 公有云/私有化、Apipost、MasterGo、Pixso）、粘贴完整 mcpServers JSON、我的服务增删改启停，热加载生效。

description.en: A unified memory management layer
description.zh: 为 AI Agent 提供统一记忆管理，支持短长程记忆、语义检索、智能摘要与可视化界面，让对话更连贯。

description.en: 为原版 DeepSeek Harness 提供长期记忆：用键值对保存身份、偏好、方法论和约束，并在后续对话中按提问召回。可手动增删改查；也可选「记忆迁移」，从 ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini / DeepSeek 官方导出包提取少量核心记忆。独立插件，不修改 DSH 源码。

description.en: Intelligent memory system for DSH - Track user preferences, tool usage, and project context to provide personalized recommendations
description.zh: 为 DSH 记住用户偏好、工具使用和项目上下文，提供个性化推荐，让开发更顺手。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness mobile: CSS-only UI plugin, password-protected Cloudflare tunnel and a tiny Android WebView app - use DSH on your phone.
description.zh: 用手机也能玩 DSH：纯 CSS 移动端界面，配密码保护的 Cloudflare 隧道和安卓 WebView 小应用。

description.en: Legacy code modernization workflow (preflight -> assess -> map -> transform) with a Cordis mount plugin, offline Python scripts and smoke tests.
description.zh: 遗留代码现代化工作流（preflight → assess → map → transform），含 Cordis 挂载插件、离线 Python 脚本与冒烟测试。

description.en: DSH休闲阅读文本插件
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 界面里摸鱼看小说的插件，支持悬浮窗分页阅读和透明隐形模式。

description.en: Antigravity-style run_command for DSH: short commands return inline within a configurable wait window (default 10s) while longer ones auto-promote into ctx.jobs for later collection and completion notices — executed via ctx.shell under the session sandbox and approval pipeline.
description.zh: Antigravity 式 run_command：短命令在可配置窗口（默认 10 秒）内同步返回结果，长命令自动晋升为 ctx.jobs 后台任务并推送完成通知——命令经 ctx.shell 执行，受会话沙箱与审批管线约束。

description.en: DeepSeek API balance + per-call cost tracker: durable per-call cost ledger from real usage chunks with official Beijing peak/off-peak (x2) pricing, 60 s balance polling, and a sidebar footer action showing balance and today's spend.
description.zh: DeepSeek 余额与逐次调用成本追踪：基于真实 usage 的持久化成本账本，支持官方高峰/低谷定价（北京时间 ×2），60 秒余额轮询，侧栏底部显示余额与今日消耗。

description.en: Writable plugin management tab for DeepSeek Harness - toggle, enable/disable, and uninstall user-installed Cordis plugins from Settings
description.zh: 在设置里直接管理已安装的 Cordis 插件，随时启用、禁用或卸载，不用再折腾命令行。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness proxy config plugin: injects HTTP/SOCKS proxy into process.env so plugin installs (pnpm/git) use it
description.zh: 配置代理后自动生效，让 Harness 及子进程走 HTTP/SOCKS 代理，访问外网更顺畅，本机内网直连不绕路。

description.en: Host-side dsh plugin that adds seven reasoning-effort levels to third-party llm-pi-ai models in the web composer.
description.zh: 给第三方模型手动调节思考等级和视觉能力，在 Composer 里像调滑块一样控制推理强度。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）提供 SSH 远程工作区能力：已核验的服务器身份、失败关闭的 Agent 执行路由、远端文件与命令操作；提供 Windows 离线一键安装包，无需 Node.js 或构建工具。
DSH plugin: expose rtk (Rust Token Killer) as wide-category Tools — save 60-90% tokens on shell output with softRewriteBash routing
description.zh: 把 Rust Token Killer 的 60+ 个 token 优化命令变成模型可调用的工具，处理 shell 输出能省 60-90% token。

description.en: 为deepseek harness创建自动化任务
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness启用内置持久化调度器，让根Agent拥有创建和管理自动化任务的能力。

description.en: Memory consolidation tuning for dsh-mneme (autoDream enabled, schema-max output budget, deepseek-chat route) plus the llm-deepseek reasoning-effort fix, an MCP bridge to the auditable seed-society agent runtime, and six yogacara seed skills.
description.zh: 面向 dsh-mneme 的记忆巩固调优（开启 autoDream、放大输出预算、deepseek-chat 路由）与 llm-deepseek 推理力度修复，附带可审计智能体运行时 seed-society 的 MCP 工具桥与六个唯识种子技能。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 提供会话管理：列表（含标题）/ 点击预览 / 真删除（二次确认）/ 归档分组与恢复。
description.zh: 管理 DeepSeek Harness 会话，支持列表预览、二次确认删除、归档分组与恢复，让会话整理更高效。

description.en: A skill management plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) desktop: list / enable / disable / delete / add skills, filling the gap in dsh's official skill toggle control.
description.zh: 管理 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端的技能，支持查看、启用、禁用、删除和添加，补全官方缺失的技能开关控制。

description.en: 一个插件把 DeepSeek Harness 主窗口变成多个分屏，同时查看多个会话的状态。再也不用在会话列表里切来切去了。
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 主窗口分成多个分屏，同时查看多个会话状态，不用再切换列表。

description.en: DSH SSH Forge：为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）提供 SSH 远程工作区能力：已核验的服务器身份、失败关闭的 Agent 执行路由、远端文件与命令操作；提供 Windows 离线一键安装包，无需 Node.js 或构建工具。
Multi-channel coding-agent subagents for DeepSeek Harness: Codex, Claude Code, Grok Build and configurable ACP agents, with strict roles and durable runs.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Codex、Claude Code、Grok 及任意 ACP 编码代理，支持严格角色分工与持久化任务运行。

description.en: DSH plugin bundle for obra/superpowers skills and development workflows
DSH Web task panel for queued sub-agent execution, scheduled runs, auto review, acceptance, rework, and historical session context.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话变成任务看板，排队、定时、自动复核、验收返工一屏搞定。

description.en: A useful or useless plugin for Deepseek Harness that visualize your token usage as-you-go. It's just delightful watching colorful bubbles popping up while your agent is emptying your wallet, isn't it?
description.zh: 把 token 消耗变成实时冒出的彩色气泡，让你边烧钱边看得开心。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件工具包——一条命令安装两个常用插件：mcp管理 与 Skill管理。装完即用，设置页自动出现 mcp管理 与 Skill管理 两个分区。
Personal usage analytics & activity dashboard for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web GUI: token totals, contribution heatmap, model share, insights. Local-only, metadata only.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供个人使用统计与活动仪表盘，展示 token 消耗、贡献热力图和模型占比，帮助了解使用情况。

description.en: Personal usage analytics & activity dashboard for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web GUI: token totals, contribution heatmap, model share, insights. Local-only, metadata only.
description.zh: 在 dsh 网页界面里查看个人用量统计和活动仪表盘，包括 Token 总数、贡献热力图、模型占比和洞察，数据仅存本地。
给 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面加上语音输入和朗读功能，动动嘴就能和 AI 对话，也能让 AI 把回答念给你听。

description.en: Un-clamps the composer stats footer: long turn and token stats lines span the full composer width instead of truncating with an ellipsis.
description.zh: 解除输入框统计行的宽度限制：较长的轮次与 token 统计行横跨输入框全宽居中显示，不再以省略号截断。

description.en: A living memory workbench for DeepSeek Harness: watch the Hindsight bank grow (7-day curve, recall heat, timeline) and manage knowledge pages and background tasks, with the local daemon auto-started by the plugin.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 长记忆工作台：7 日增长曲线、召回热度与时间线一目了然，支持知识页面与后台任务管理；本地 Hindsight daemon 由插件自动拉起。

description.en: 指哪打哪：在任意网页标记元素并评论，截图+结构化文本直达 dsh 会话（dsh 插件 + 浏览器扩展）
description.zh: 在任意网页上直接标记元素并写评论，截图和结构化内容一键发送到 dsh 会话，告别繁琐描述。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：逐页判断搜索结果的语义相关度，智能过滤无关噪音，量化信息覆盖度，让每一次AI检索都透明可信。
description.zh: 逐页判断搜索结果的相关度，自动过滤无关噪音，量化信息覆盖度，让AI检索更透明可信。
把 DSH 所有组件装进一个指挥室，统一管理插件、技能、预设和规范，一目了然。

description.en: Visual conversation canvas for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 把对话变成可视化画布，让你像看地图一样浏览和管理整个会话。

description.en: DSH 余额与消耗面板（dsh-balance-stats）
description.zh: 实时查看 DeepSeek Harness 的余额和消耗情况，帮你随时掌握成本，避免超额。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: Bilibili video search, metadata, and subtitle transcripts (bilibili_search / bilibili_video / bilibili_subtitles) · DeepSeek Harness 插件:B 站视频检索、元数据与字幕文稿,匿名可用,可选 SESSDATA 解锁登录字幕
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里搜 B 站视频、看元数据和字幕文稿，匿名可用，登录后还能解锁更多内容。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness timeline with hover Q&A preview and panel pin
description.zh: 给聊天消息加一条时间轴侧栏，悬停就能预览问答摘要，还能钉住面板、按天分隔和加书签。

description.en: DSH 声音提醒插件:九类 Agent 事件(完成/子任务/后台任务/审批/提问/评审/受阻/打断/失败)独立铃声、音量与开关,浏览器合成音 + Windows 系统蜂鸣,工作区快捷静音
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加九类 Agent 事件的声音提醒，支持独立设置铃声开关，不用死盯屏幕也能随时掌握任务进度。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Cordis plugin: observer/feedforward/feedback control loop, stability valve, controllability check
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 加入控制论内核，实现观察-前馈-反馈闭环，自动调节稳定性并检查可控性，让 AI 运行更稳更可控。

description.en: Drag documents into the dsh web chat for direct local-file processing; a right sidebar lists outputs and file paths. 拖拽文档进 Web 对话框快速处理，右侧侧栏展示产出。
Extends the DSH web chat drag-and-drop to accept every file type: non-image files are saved into the active session workspace so the agent can read and use them.
description.zh: 让 DSH 网页聊天支持拖拽任意类型文件：非图片文件保存到当前会话工作区，供 Agent 读取使用。

description.en: DSH Web browser lifecycle: ask/close/keep service on browser close, one-click restart with auto refresh
description.zh: 双击桌面图标就能启动 DSH Web，不用开终端；在设置页还能一键重启或关闭服务，省心省力。

description.en: Email reminders from your DSH agent when you are away, with stable SMTP (no 535 retry loop), connect and idle timeouts, and a --check self-test.
description.zh: 你不在电脑前时由 agent 邮件提醒你：稳定 SMTP（不重试 535）、连接与空闲超时，并带 --check 自检。

description.en: Per-session Engram memory for DeepSeek Harness: spawns an engram MCP child per agent session rooted at the session workspace, registers mem_* tools per agent scope, and injects the Memory Protocol as a system-prompt section.
description.zh: 为每个智能体会话创建独立的 Engram 记忆空间，让记忆按会话隔离，互不干扰。

description.en: Fourth permission preset for dsh: unconfined, GPU-capable sessions (danger-full-access) with per-operation user approval for writes outside the workspace or to protected paths (.git/**, .env*); implemented purely as a bundle over the official tools/pre-execute ask hook, no core edits.
description.zh: dsh 第四个权限预设：进程全权限（GPU 可用），同时工作区外与受保护文件（.git/**、.env*）的写入逐次向用户审批；纯插件实现，零核心改动。

description.en: dsh 中可以使用插件来调用gpt-image2生成图片
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话中按需生成图片，一句话描述需求即可快速出图，提升创作效率。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: GitHub repository & issue search, repo/issue details, and file reading tools (github_search / github_get) · DeepSeek Harness 插件:GitHub 仓库与 issue 检索、详情与文件读取,匿名可用,可选只读 token 解锁代码搜索
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接搜 GitHub 仓库、查 issue 详情、读文件，匿名可用，也能配 token 解锁更多功能。

description.en: Claude Code / Codex CLI update detection, prompting, and one-click channel updates for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 自动检测 Claude Code 和 Codex CLI 版本，一键更新 DeepSeek Harness 插件，省心省力。

description.en: Automatically retrieves time-of-use pricing data (with Beijing Time) and notifies users during peak periods to reduce costs.
description.zh: 自动获取分时电价数据（按北京时间），在高峰时段提醒用户，以降低用电成本。

description.en: Codex-style session archiving: hovering a sidebar conversation row reveals an Archive icon at the far right; one click archives the session via the official workspace archive API.
description.zh: Codex 风格会话归档：鼠标悬浮侧边栏会话行时，最右侧浮现 Archive 图标，一键归档会话。

description.en: DSH plugin: bookmark every question you asked — index, search, and jump back to any conversation point in one click.
description.zh: 给对话加个书签索引，一键回看所有问过的问题，长对话翻找不再头疼。

description.en: User message jump bar for the DSH web GUI: a minimap-style dash strip on the right edge of the conversation, with hover preview, click-to-jump, drag-to-scrub and a viewport marker.
description.zh: DSH Web 用户消息跳转条：对话区右缘 minimap 式横杠条带，悬停预览消息内容、点击跳转置顶、拖拽快速浏览，并带当前视口标记。

description.en: A LAN password gate for the Web UI: phones and tablets on the same network log in with a shared key and see the same sessions in real time, with a built-in randomUUID polyfill for plain-HTTP origins.
description.zh: Web UI 局域网密码门禁：同网手机/平板输共享密钥登录，会话与电脑实时同步，内置 randomUUID polyfill。

description.en: Codex-style left message navigation rail for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 对话侧边栏添加 Codex 风格的左侧消息导航栏，快速跳转历史消息。

description.en: Planner/executor delegation with named roles: a strong planner steers, disposable executor sub-agents (per-role routes and prompts) implement. Default role plus per-delegation override, a global reasoning-effort knob in the composer chip, and a settings page for role management.
description.zh: 规划者/执行者委派调度：高阶模型（Planner）定方向，一次性低阶执行子代理（按角色的路由与提示词）干具体活；默认角色 + 单次委派覆盖，输入框芯片快速切换角色与全局思考等级，设置页管理执行角色。

description.en: DSH memory plugin: RRF multi-lane recall / confirm-based writes / Fernet vault / session harvest
description.zh: 给 DSH 智能体装上分层长期记忆，五路召回更准，写入需确认，数据加密更安全，还能自动转录会话。

description.en: Forgetting engine for AI agents — memory TTL, decay, eviction, audit. The opposite of memory programming. DSH plugin + local skill + CLI.
DSH 模型中心插件：免费模型目录 / 真免费实测 / 价格余额 / 一键切换 / 用量统计 — Model center plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把免费模型、真实可用性、价格余额和用量统计聚合到一张卡片，一键切换模型，省心省钱。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Pet
description.zh: 把 Agent 状态变成一只悬浮在 macOS 桌面的心情球，随时瞄一眼就知道它在忙什么。
把常用提示词、模板和代码片段集中存好，聊天时在输入框旁一键取用，省去反复敲打的麻烦。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin (not MCP): a falsification-driven correction loop — explicit claims, deterministic gates, mutually exclusive hypotheses — that turns agent retry loops into auditable evidence for better development quality.
description.zh: Popper: a falsification-driven correction loop for agent sessions — claim commitment, gate falsification, and mutually exclusive hypothesis revision, with an append-only evidence ledger

description.en: deepseek项目组功能
description.zh: deepseek项目组功能

description.en: DSH插件，手机远程控制
description.zh: 手机扫码就能远程控制电脑上的 DSH WebUI，局域网内随时访问，未授权设备自动拦截。

description.en: Turns each produced-file chip into a per-file menu: open the file, copy its path, reveal it in the native file browser, or open a terminal cd-ed into its directory.
description.zh: 把每个产物文件卡片变成按文件操作的下拉菜单：打开文件、拷贝路径、在系统文件浏览器中定位，或打开终端并进入其目录。

description.en: Session manager panel under Settings → Plugins: list all sessions with title, cwd, agent preset, updated time, turns and steps, expand a row to view message history, delete non-running sessions, and export a session as JSON or Markdown via a browser Blob URL.
description.zh: 设置 → 插件 下的会话管理面板：列出全部会话的标题、工作目录、agent 预设、更新时间、轮次与步数，展开可查看消息历史，删除非运行中的会话，并经浏览器 Blob URL 导出为 JSON 或 Markdown。

description.en: 山海系列 DeepSeek Harness 用量统计插件：总量徽章、每日走势、GitHub 风格热力图、按模型/提供商分组明细
description.zh: 山海系列用量统计插件，在 DSH 中展示总量徽章、每日走势、热力图和模型分组明细，帮你掌握 Token 消耗。

description.en: Remote-control your dsh agent from Telegram: chat, skills, workspace browsing, and file transfer.
description.zh: 通过 Telegram 遥控 dsh Agent：对话、技能调用、工作目录浏览与文件传输。

description.en: ⚡ ThunderForge — 宇宙无敌雷霆霹雳炫光 DSH 插件锻造炉：一站式插件开发套件（单一 Bundle）
description.zh: 一站式 DSH 插件开发套件，内置 LLM 载荷捕获、三层编写技能和对话式脚手架，帮你快速生成并验证插件。

description.en: DSH web plugin: interaction timeline rail for long conversations (fork-independent successor of dsh-history)
Settings-page usage dashboard: per-provider/model token summary across all sessions, with today/7-day/30-day CSS-bar trends and a cache-hit rate.
description.zh: 设置页用量仪表盘：按服务商/模型汇总全部会话 token 用量，含今日/近 7 天/近 30 天趋势柱状图与缓存命中率。

description.en: DSH-native uv environment manager: create, sync and run Python virtualenvs from the settings tab, with pip fallback, read-only conda visibility and a dry-run project sync preview.
description.zh: DSH 原生 uv 环境管理器：在设置面板创建、同步、运行 Python 虚拟环境，pip 回退、conda 只读可见，项目依赖同步带 dry-run 差异预览。

description.en: A floating, draggable, resizable **video player** for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里悬浮一个可拖拽、可缩放的小视频播放器，方便你边看视频边干活。

description.en: lhenlihai-hub/dsh-voice-input 声明为 DeepSeek Harness 生态插件。
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加语音输入，直接说话转文字，解放双手，让交互更自然。

description.en: DSH-Wallpaper background wallpaper and system font picker plugin for DSH Desktop. Plugin source only, no DSH core.
description.zh: 给 DSH Desktop 换壁纸、调系统字体，让桌面更顺眼的小插件。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web GUI 加一道账号密码门：每次打开 DSH Web 都必须先登录；登录令牌有效期 12 小时；令牌过期被登出时，后台正在运行的任务完全不受影响，重新登录后一切还在。
面向 Claude、Codex、Cursor 和 DeepSeek Harness 的足球数据 MCP Server，支持 18 个欧洲联赛、8 个杯赛，以及比赛、积分榜、交锋、赔率和近期状态查询。
Multi-language subtitle translation workflow for dsh: SRT/VTT parsing, sentence-level LLM translation, bilingual merge, batched with resumable checkpoints.
description.zh: 多语言字幕翻译工作流：SRT/VTT 解析、逐句 LLM 翻译、双语合并；批量处理支持断点续跑。

description.en: A desktop pet that lives in a floating overlay; click it to interact and switch between idle, sleeping, happy, and eating states.
description.zh: 桌面宠物插件，常驻悬浮层养一只龙猫，点击互动并可在待机、睡觉、开心、进食等状态间切换。

description.en: CalDAV + iCalendar + RRULE calendar integration bundle for dsh with Chinese-bias support (lunar calendar / holidays), conflict detection and reminder tools.
description.zh: dsh 的日历集成 bundle：CalDAV + iCalendar + RRULE 日程管理，内置农历/节假日等中文场景支持、冲突检测与提醒工具。

description.en: Auto-retries failed API requests to keep DSH conversations running, with configurable HTTP status and error-code rules.
description.zh: 自动重试失败的API请求，解决限流和临时错误，让对话不中断。

description.en: Native WCAG accessibility scanner: runs axe-core over local HTML files / build output / URLs and reports violations (rule id, impact, WCAG 2.1 mapping, element targeting, fix suggestions) as Markdown/HTML/JSON. Read-only, CI-able.
description.zh: 原生 WCAG 无障碍扫描工具：对本地 HTML / 构建产物 / URL 运行 axe-core，输出规则 id、impact、WCAG 2.1 映射、元素定位与修复建议（Markdown/HTML/JSON），只读可进 CI。

description.en: Session access-mode plugin (Default / No Edit / Auto) for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). dsh-plugin
description.zh: 为DSH会话提供Default/No Edit/Auto三种访问模式，控制AI可自动执行的操作、审批流程及沙箱选择。

description.en: MCP stdio gateway for exposing local AGY, Codex, and OpenCode CLI agents to DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
description.zh: 把本地 AI 命令行工具接入 DeepSeek Harness，让智能体通过 MCP 直接调用，省去手动切换的麻烦。

description.en: Record terminal/tool output as asciinema v2 (.cast), replay with an offline embedded player, and export HTML.
description.zh: 把终端/工具输出录制为 asciinema v2（.cast）文件，离线内嵌播放器回放并导出 HTML。

description.en: adds an auto-review permission preset to DeepSeek Harness. Same Codex auto review
Type @ in the composer to reference another conversation: pick a historical session and inject its compacted context into the current prompt.
description.zh: 输入 @ 引用另一个对话：选择历史会话，将其压缩总结注入当前提示词。

description.en: OpenAI Codex (ChatGPT Plus/Pro OAuth) provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). dsh-plugin
description.zh: OpenAI Codex (ChatGPT Plus/Pro OAuth) provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). dsh-plugin

description.en: Tracks DeepSeek Harness LLM token usage and cost (CNY, peak/off-peak pricing) with a settings dashboard, agent tools, HTTP API and persistent storage.
description.zh: 统计 DeepSeek Harness 的 LLM Token 用量与花费（人民币、峰谷计价），提供设置面板、Agent 工具、HTTP 接口与持久化存储。

description.en: DSH web plugin: replace branding (favicon + sidebar logo) with your own images via an in-app upload panel
description.zh: 上传两张图就能把 DSH 的 favicon 和侧边栏 Logo 换成你自己的品牌标识。

description.en: Auto-switch DeepSeek models: routes every request to the vision model when images are present, to the pro model for complex tasks, and to the fast model otherwise; includes a switch_model tool for manual overrides.
description.zh: 自动切换 DeepSeek 模型：含图片时走视觉模型，复杂任务走 pro，常规任务走 fast；提供 switch_model 工具手动固定。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 对话产物列表增加主动展开与收起功能的 Web UI 插件。
description.zh: 让对话结束后的产物列表支持主动展开和收起，查看文件更顺手。

description.en: Scan project lockfiles (npm/pnpm/yarn/pip/go/cargo/maven/gradle/...) against the free OSV API and report confirmed dependency vulnerabilities with fix versions and remediation commands.
description.zh: 扫描项目锁文件（npm/pnpm/yarn/pip/go/cargo/maven/gradle…）并对免费 OSV API 批量查询漏洞，输出「包 / 当前版本 / 漏洞 ID / 摘要 / CVSS / 修复版本」表格与修复命令。

description.en: HarmonyOS NEXT / ArkTS development skills plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供鸿蒙 NEXT 的 ArkTS/ArkUI 开发与代码审查技能，助你高效构建鸿蒙应用。

description.en: Immersive Hiyuki dual-form skin for DeepSeek Harness Web, with frost/sakura transitions, themed controls, and native DSH layout.
Parse Chinese e-invoice PDFs (XML attachment first, text-layer regex fallback) into structured JSON with amount cross-check, and generate expense reports (Markdown / xlsx).
description.zh: 解析增值税电子发票 PDF（XML 附件优先、文本层正则兜底）为结构化 JSON + 金额勾稽校验，多张汇总生成报销单（Markdown / xlsx）。

description.en: K12 capability substrate for DeepSeek Harness — 143 objectively-decidable capability anchors and 6,091 list items from China's MOE 2022 curriculum standards, with local-only learner profiles
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 K12 能力底座，内置教育部课标锚点，支持本地化学习者画像。

description.en: a dsh plugin that helps you to automatically generate, evolve and manage your dsh plugins
description.zh: 自动帮你生成、迭代和管理 DSH 插件，把一次成功的任务变成下次能直接用的能力。

description.en: Expose a local MCP server to remote agents through an outbound-only tunnel stack (mcp-proxy + cloudflared Quick Tunnel), then register the public URL into dsh-mcp-client streamable-http config.
description.zh: 把本机 MCP Server 通过出站-only 隧道栈（mcp-proxy + cloudflared Quick Tunnel）暴露给远程 Agent，并把公网 URL 注册进 dsh-mcp-client 的 streamable-http 配置。

description.en: OpenRouter image, video, and speech generation as deepseek-harness tools — an out-of-tree profile bundle, no fork required
description.zh: 把 OpenRouter 的图片、视频和语音生成能力接入 deepseek-harness，无需改代码即插即用。

description.en: DSH插件，消息功能增强
description.zh: 在聊天输入框上方加一条索引标尺，帮你快速定位用户消息和最终计划，一眼看清执行结果。
把 MiniMax 的搜索和识图能力接进 DSH，自动回退搜索、贴图即识图，装好 CLI 就能用。

description.en: 📡 手机远程遥控 DeepSeek Harness：实时进度 / 审批 / 对话（PWA + PIN 配对 + Tailscale 外网支持）
description.zh: 手机远程遥控 DeepSeek Harness，随时查看进度、审批请求和对话，支持 Tailscale 外网访问。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于关键词和语义分类的动态模型路由插件，可按任务自动选择模型与推理强度。
description.zh: 按关键词和语义自动选模型，动态调整推理强度，省心又高效。
把会话过程、产出和token消耗一键生成可独立打开的办公室动画仪表盘，方便复盘汇报。

description.en: A live peak/off-peak pricing readout for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: one status pill under the composer, with the effective prices on hover. · DeepSeek Harness 错峰计价浮标

description.en: Safe delete plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): move files to trash / staging area instead of permanent removal, with restore and purge supp…
description.zh: dsh-safe-delete — DSH 插件（工具）

description.en: Adds a "Delete" item to the sidebar session menu with a confirmation dialog, then hard-deletes the session.
description.zh: 在侧边栏会话菜单添加「删除」项，经二次确认后硬删除该会话。

description.en: Customizable hierarchical DSH settings navigation organizer
Intelligent project detection and capability recommendations for DeepSeek Harness.  Visibility: Public
Short Web Audio cues when a session needs your attention (approval, question, or plan review) and when a task finishes. No popups or OS notifications.
description.zh: 会话需要你操作（审批、提问或计划确认）以及任务完成时播放不同的短提示音。Web Audio 现场合成，无弹窗、无系统通知。

description.en: 用于DSH的对话框任务音效，以及个性化聊天背景||Dialog box sound effects for DSH, as well as personalized chat backgrounds.
description.zh: 任务提问、审批或完成时播放提示音，还能自定义聊天背景和遮罩，让 DSH 更好看更好用。

description.en: 30 classic open-source theme palettes (Catppuccin, Nord, Tokyo Night, Gruvbox, Solarized, etc.) mapped to official ThemeService tokens for DeepSeek Harness, with a Style Settings panel for live color/font/radius tweaks and JSON export/import for sharing config packs.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 30 套经典开源主题配色（Catppuccin、Nord、Tokyo Night、Gruvbox、Solarized 等），映射官方 ThemeService token；带 Style Settings 面板，可实时调整颜色/字体/圆角，并支持 JSON 导出/导入分享配置。

description.en: Project/task dual-mode workspaces for DSH: a task skips the workspace picker and gets a fresh scratch directory (D:\dsh_working\<name>-<timestamp>) per conversation, Codex-style; no-workspace sessions are grouped under a persistent Tasks section in the sidebar with empty states, and the new-session workspace picker gains a "no workspace (task)" option.
description.zh: DSH 项目/任务双模式工作区：任务不绑定工作区，每次新对话在 D:\dsh_working\<名称>-<时间戳> 自动创建独立临时目录（类 Codex）；侧边栏"任务"分组常驻显示所有无工作区会话并带空状态提示，新建会话的工作区选择器增加"无工作区（任务）"选项。

description.en: Turn-based time tracking from dsh session logs: totals, per-day/project/provider/source rollups, tool-call counts, failure rates, and time-to-first-token — CLI plus an agent-callable timesheet tool, dsh-timesheet/v1 reports, zero runtime deps.
description.zh: 从 dsh 会话日志做基于 turn 的时间跟踪：总计、按天/项目/供应商/来源汇总、工具调用数、失败率与首 token 延迟——CLI + agent 可调用 timesheet 工具，dsh-timesheet/v1 报告，零运行时依赖。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 插件：把 todo 面板停靠到右上角并跨轮常驻（CSS 注入 + 机制级重放），可热调样式，零依赖。原名 dsh-ui-todo-fix。
Token usage dashboard for DeepSeek Harness 用量仪表盘：查看缓存、上下文、请求效率、逐步骤和跨会话统计。
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 中直观查看 Token 用量、缓存效率与请求性能，帮你优化资源、提升效率。

description.en: OpenAI-compatible image generation in DSH Desktop chat: generate inline, edit reference images or chain-edit previous results directly (image-to-image) without re-uploading, with storage cleanup.
description.zh: 对话内联生图插件：模型在对话框直接出图，可基于参考图或上次生成结果连续图生图修改，附存储清理。

description.en: Connect Trilium notes to the DSH agent via ETAPI with 20 agent tools: durable memory (remember/recall + auto-injected index), note management (CRUD/clone/attributes/revisions), full-text search, weekly-report workflow, attachments, calendar notes, backup/import, and a settings card.
description.zh: 通过 ETAPI 把 Trilium 笔记库接入 agent，提供 20 个工具：记忆读写（remember/recall + 自动注入索引）、笔记管理（CRUD/克隆/属性/修订）、全文搜索、周报工作流、附件、日历笔记、备份导入，独立设置卡片，配置 0600 落盘。

description.en: DSH 免费公网隧道插件：一次性安全密钥二维码自动登录，支持定时刷新与 macOS、Linux、Windows。

DSH usage and balance panel with official live balance, per-event official peak/off-peak pricing, all-channel spend estimates from daily balance snapshots, and a Codex-style 12-month token activity timeline. Fork of Ychris12138/dsh-usage-stats.
description.zh: DSH 用量与余额面板：官方余额实时拉取、逐事件官方峰谷计价、基于余额快照的全渠道消耗估算、Codex 风格 12 个月 Token 活动时间轴。Fork 自 Ychris12138/dsh-usage-stats。

description.en: Wallpaper backgrounds for the DSH web GUI. Windows: reads your Wallpaper Engine (Steam) library and plays video/web wallpapers behind the chat. macOS: scans the WaifuX download folder and loose media folders automatically — anything saved in WaifuX becomes a DSH background with zero setup. Liquid-glass blur, dim and border sliders.
description.zh: DSH Web 聊天背景壁纸。Windows：直接读取你的 Wallpaper Engine（Steam）库，把视频/网页壁纸渲染到聊天界面背后。macOS：自动扫描 WaifuX 下载目录和媒体文件夹——在 WaifuX 里保存的壁纸零配置即可成为 DSH 背景，支持视频与图片。带毛玻璃模糊、压暗、边框调节滑块。

description.en: DSH插件，用于将dsh连接至微信、qq等软件，通过微claw插件、qq机器人等方式实现
A context engine for DeepSeek Harness — reversible, token-budgeted compression of the live context window.

Model-agnostic visual-inspection pipeline for text-only agents: page-by-page HTML screenshots plus a ready-made vision-subagent briefing contract (gewu_prep), then source-code truth verification of every finding (gewu_locate); validated on mimo-v2.5 & qwen3.7-plus.
description.zh: 面向纯文本 DSH 主脑的模型无关视觉审阅流水线：HTML 逐页截图 + 视觉子代理简报契约（gewu_prep），再把每条审阅发现定位回源码核验真值（gewu_locate）；已在 mimo-v2.5 与 qwen3.7-plus 上实测。

description.en: DSH bundle porting Matt Pocock's 25 promoted engineering and productivity agent skills (grilling, TDD, code review, domain modeling, etc.).
description.zh: 将 Matt Pocock 的 25 个精选工程与效率 Agent 技能（grilling、TDD、代码审查、领域建模等）移植为 DeepSeek Harness 插件包。

description.en: OctoOps: Unified SSH/Telnet & JumpServer Bastion Orchestrator for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
Adversarial multi-lens code review: parallel correctness/security/maintainability lenses attack a diff, with deterministic severity grading, suppression rules and incremental review history.
description.zh: 对抗式多视角代码审查：正确性/安全性/可维护性透镜并行攻击 diff，确定性严重度定级、抑制规则与增量审查历史。

description.en: A project-agnostic multi-agent collaboration protocol for the DeepSeek Harness: loop guards that stop runaway agent loops, a six-field handoff format, risk-tiered review routing, and a fixed verify→commit→push→review→close sequence. One skill instead of the same rules copy-pasted into every agent's instructions.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness、与具体项目无关的多智能体协作协议：阻止失控循环的循环守卫、六字段交接格式、按风险分级的评审路由，以及固定的验证→提交→推送→评审→关闭流程。用一个 skill 取代复制粘贴进每个 agent 指令里的相同规则。

description.en: dsh backpack plugin
description.zh: dsh backpack plugin

description.en: Codex bridge for dispatching tasks to DeepSeek Harness sessions, with Harness settings integration.
DeepSeek Harness Workspace Plugin
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多智能体协作编排，让规划、编码、研究等角色分工协作，高效完成复杂任务。

description.en: Audits your agent harness stability using deepseek harness.
description.zh: 用 DeepSeek Harness 审计智能体框架稳定性，专查导致循环中断的故障模式，只认代码实锤。

description.en: A DSH Web plugin for managing archived and active local sessions, with batch archive/restore/delete, session details, disk usage, produced files, and record-folder access.
description.zh: 在侧栏集中管理本地会话，批量归档、恢复、删除，还能看详情和占用空间。

description.en: Real-time DeepSeek account balance readout in the session header: host /api/balance route resolves the API key through the credentials seam (never sent to the browser), 60-second auto-poll plus manual refresh.
description.zh: 会话标题栏实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额：host 端 /api/balance 路由经凭据 seam 解析 API key（密钥绝不下发浏览器），60 秒自动轮询并支持手动刷新。

description.en: Adaptive wallpaper and appearance studio for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
Track human decisions for related DSH session branches: keep, discard, or follow up with reasons, labels, and external links.
description.zh: 为相关 DSH 会话分支记录人工决策：保留、淘汰或待跟进，并保存理由、标签与外部链接。

description.en: Tencent CodeBuddy provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness: OAuth login, token refresh, and model sync via native dsh seams
Right-side file-tree sidebar that opens workspace files, plus a DeepSeek account balance meter in the composer stats line.
description.zh: 右侧文件树侧栏，可打开工作区文件；并在输入框状态行显示 DeepSeek 账户余额。

description.en: Multi-agent isolated debate for DeepSeek Harness: debaters of different temperaments research independently (no herding), then cross-examine, then judges converge to a conclusion. Runs as a background job with per-agent progress, token accounting, wave-parallel execution, and session-referenced resume.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 多 agent 隔离辩论：不同底色的辩手各自独立联网取证（互不可见防人云亦云）、交叉辩论互相反驳、评审收敛出结论。后台 job 运行，逐 agent 进度可见、token 统计、波次并行、断点续传。

description.en: dsh插件：对角巷角色面具插件 v1.0.0
Verifies that Cordis-managed runtime resources return to baseline after isolated plugin teardown, with deterministic cleanup receipts.
description.zh: 隔离插件卸载后验证 Cordis 管理的运行时资源是否回到基线，并生成确定性清理回执。

description.en: Evidence-backed Skill self-evolution for DeepSeek Harness: redacted trajectory learning, quarantined proposals, arena validation, canary monitoring, automatic rollback.
description.zh: 带证据的 Skill 自进化：脱敏轨迹学习、隔离提案、竞技场验证、金丝雀监控与自动回滚。

description.en: On-demand vision for text-only DeepSeek models: upload images, and the model calls a view_image tool backed by any OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint (Qwen/DashScope by default).
description.zh: 为纯文本 DeepSeek 模型提供按需视觉：上传图片后，模型通过 view_image 工具调用任意 OpenAI 兼容视觉端点（默认 Qwen/DashScope）。

description.en: Two-way Feishu (Lark) chat bridge for DeepSeek Harness over the official WebSocket long connection: messages route to the bound workspace's latest session and replies return automatically; bot credentials and workspace routing are configurable from the settings page.
description.zh: 基于飞书官方 WebSocket 长连接的 DSH 双向聊天桥：消息路由到所选工作区的最新会话并自动回复，可在设置页切换机器人凭证与工作区。

description.en: A VS Code-style Git source control panel plugin for DeepSeek Harness.为 DeepSeek Harness 开发的一个类似 VS Code 的 Git 源代码管理面板插件。
description.zh: Git source-control sidebar for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: repo init, staging, commit/push/pull, branch & remote management, AI-generated Conventional Commits messages, and a commit-history graph.

description.en: dsh-git lets you manage conversations with an agent the way you use Git.
Visual git commit/branch graph panel for the DSH Web UI (DSH plugin)

OpenCode GO subscription usage widget for DeepSeek Harness: rolling / weekly / monthly usage with reset countdowns, collapsible to a right-edge tab.—— DeepSeek Harness 的 OpenCode GO 套餐用量角标插件：右下角卡片显示滚动 / 每周 / 每月用量与重置倒计时，可收起为右边缘竖条。

Agent governance suite: policy-based tool gating (allow/deny/ask with wildcards and priorities), a structured JSONL audit trail, and per-agent token quotas against the host token meter, with state under $DSH_HOME/gov.
description.zh: Agent 治理套件：基于策略的工具门禁（allow/deny/ask，支持通配符与优先级）、结构化 JSONL 审计日志、基于宿主 token 计量的按 agent 配额，状态存于 $DSH_HOME/gov。

description.en: Chinese localization for tool results: intercepts tool execution output and translates English markers (`[exit code]`, `[timed out]`, `[sandbox: ...]`, etc.) into Chinese, with a settings toggle.
description.zh: 把工具执行结果里的英文标记自动换成中文，带设置开关，看输出不再费劲。

description.en: DSH plugin: 让 AI 通过 Kimi WebBridge 驱动你的真实浏览器（webbridge_* 工具）。官方 bundle 插件，install via dsh plugin --profile web add github:LunarCache/dsh-kimi-webbridge#main
description.zh: 让 AI 通过 Kimi WebBridge 直接操控你的真实浏览器，实现网页自动化操作。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin for local-first automatic Wiki memory and native Skill generation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造本地优先的自动 Wiki 记忆与技能生成插件，让 AI 持续积累知识并复用。

description.en: 澜·记忆与人格系统 — DeepSeek Harness memory & persona plugin (三层记忆 + SOUL/MOOD + 一键整理)
Minimal Lark/Feishu gateway plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — chat with your agent from Feishu, one topic = one session. 极简 DeepSeek Harness 飞书网关插件
Live token estimates and true streaming TPS for DeepSeek Harness Web
description.zh: dsh-live-stats — DSH 插件（模型）

description.en: Multi-provider LLM API balances under the chat input, with presets for DeepSeek, OpenRouter and SiliconFlow.
description.zh: 聊天输入框下方显示多个 LLM API 账户余额，内置 DeepSeek、OpenRouter、SiliconFlow 预设。

description.en: DSH plugin: local SKILL browser with a Notion-style web UI (live watch, Use-button guide, bundled starter skills)
description.zh: 在网页里浏览和管理本地技能，带 Notion 风格界面，实时监控目录变化，一键查看使用指南。
让 dsh 智能体在回复里用 ::文件名:: 发内置女仆表情包，零配置即装即用，还能加自定义表情。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的手机响应式适配与 WireGuard 远程增强插件（文件管理 + PTY 终端 + 设置远程可用）
App-free mobile voice calls with existing DeepSeek Harness sessions.
Moonrise dark theme for the DSH Web UI, with deep indigo surfaces and warm amber accents.
description.zh: 月升暗色主题——深蓝夜色打底、琥珀月光点缀。

description.en: dsh包管理器中间件，对原有的add的模式进行的封装，支持预设和插件  （内容还在迭代!!!!）
🧠 Local-first code intelligence graph for DeepSeek Harness. Structural search, blast radius, temporal memory, and 27 agent skills.
DSH (DeepSeek Harness) ↔️ Telegram bridge: message, approve, ask, switch sessions/models/modes, manage permissions from Telegram. Cordis profile plugin, bilingual.

Verification toolkit for DSH agents: evidence-based claim checking against workspace files with line citations, config validation (JSON/YAML), and read-only URL/npm/GitHub submission-readiness probes.
description.zh: DSH 核验工具箱：在工作区文件中核查声明并返回带行号引用的证据，校验配置文件（JSON/YAML），以及只读的 URL / npm / GitHub 提交就绪度探测。

description.en: Headless-browser verification tools so the agent opens the page it just built, reads the rendered DOM and computed styles, checks the console, and screenshots the result; ships a frontend-verify skill.
description.zh: 无头浏览器验证工具：让 agent 打开自己刚写的页面，读取渲染后的 DOM 与计算样式、检查控制台、截图留档；内置 frontend-verify 技能。

description.en: 中文 DSH 知识复习插件：有证据才回答、资料缺失提醒补充学习视频。
description.zh: 中文 DSH 知识复习插件：默认零配置本地资料检索，可选连接项目 RAG 增强。

description.en: Native DSH provider hub with official account OAuth, API channels, model discovery, failover, and logs
description.zh: Native DSH provider hub with model discovery, secure API channels, official account OAuth, failover, and logs

description.en: 一个基于和风天气的DSH天气预报接口，提供侧边栏widget、对话skill，让你的LLM更快的给出天气预报
Scenario bundles of dsh plugins (插件界的 dotfiles): a recipe tool that lists, searches, applies and composes ready-made plugin environments with ordered install sequences.
description.zh: 把 dsh 插件打包成场景配方（"插件界的 dotfiles"）：recipe 工具可列出、搜索、应用并组合现成插件环境，带有序安装序列。

description.en: Adversarial code review — parallel finders inspect a diff through separate lenses (correctness, lifecycle, contract, security), then each finding goes to independent verifiers tasked with refuting it, and one refutation drops it.
description.zh: 对抗式代码审查：多个 finder 并行地从不同视角（正确性、生命周期、契约、安全）审查改动，随后每条发现都交给独立验证者去推翻它，只要有一票推翻就丢弃。

description.en: Automatic model routing for DeepSeek Harness: three difficulty tiers (hard/normal/easy) plus vision routing, picking models you already configured under Settings ? Models. ???? + ?????????
Sound notification plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web: plays a chime when user confirmation is needed and a success sound when tasks complete
Token usage statistics for DeepSeek Harness. Per-channel usage with balances and plan quotas for mainstream providers, CNY cost estimates, and daily charts — a settings-sidebar section.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Token 用量统计。按渠道区分统计，官方渠道自动显示余额，套餐渠道显示 5 小时/7 天/30 天用量余量，人民币计费估算，含每日图表与模型分布，集成在设置页侧边菜单。

description.en: Trending-topics collector aggregating Baidu / Toutiao / Douyin / Weibo hot lists in one call (Weibo optional cookie), returning titles with heat values for content creators — tool: `sxs_news_hot`.
description.zh: 时事热点采集：一次调用聚合百度热搜 / 头条热榜 / 抖音热点 / 微博热搜（微博可选 cookie），返回标题+热度值，供内容创作借势——工具：`sxs_news_hot`。

description.en: Collapsible in-conversation interactive terminal with multi-tab live shells, auto-reconnect, one-click quick commands, and a bilingual UI that follows the theme.
description.zh: 在对话里直接开一个可折叠的多标签终端，随时跑命令、看结果，还能自动重连和快速执行常用指令。

description.en: A Person-of-Interest surveillance-terminal theme for deepseek-harness — the machine is watching.
一个deepseek-harness插件，用来做agent轨迹回放。欢迎试用给出反馈
description.zh: 把 agent 轨迹回放到具体某条消息或工具调用，还能对比新旧执行、单步门控，方便排查问题。

description.en: Ecosystem trend dashboard (行情面板): snapshot the dsh-plugin topic and the awesome list into local history, then report weekly trends — new plugins, star gainers, category heat, awesome coverage — plus a keyword radar for new plugins and star surges.
description.zh: 生态行情面板：把 dsh-plugin topic 与 awesome 收录列表快照成本地历史，产出周报（新增插件、star 增速、类别热度、收录覆盖率），并支持关键词雷达监控新品与 star 突增。

description.en: DSH界面定制插件，暂时支持背景图片的自定义操作和主题定制操作，可以随便添加背景图片，并支持保存10个历史图片，主题可以保存无限个
description.zh: UI customizer for the dsh web GUI: a sidebar menu above Settings that sets a full-page background image with adjustable opacity

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏用量仪表盘插件：跨会话 token / 模型 / 活动统计、按会话明细与可选时间尺度的用量趋势图。 Usage dashboard plugin for DeepSeek Harness web: cross-session token, model, and activity stats with a per-session table and a windowed trend chart.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness dynamic Cordis plugin: durable cross-session usage ledger with a sidebar dashboard (per-day trend, per-model usage incl. subagents, backup export/import)

description.en: dsh的本地用量面板，统计 Token、请求、Agent 活动、工具调用和性能
description.zh: 本地用量面板，统计 Token、请求、Agent 活动和工具调用，帮你核对工作数据。

description.en: Give your text-only model eyes - chat image attachments are auto-described via a vision model (default prompt), with iterative re-parsing through model-generated prompts when details are missing; system/custom model modes + GUI config panel, key-safe secret handling, and a small host patch for DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 (see repo README).
description.zh: 让纯文本模型也能看图：发图自动用视觉模型描述（默认提示词），描述不足时对话模型自动生成更具体的提示词重新解析；系统模型/自定义双模式 + GUI 可视化配置、Key 脱敏安全、针对 DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 的宿主小补丁（见仓库 README）。

description.en: Give DSH text-only models vision: an image/OCR/document recognition skill (race pool → custom channels → local) plus an idempotent host patch so image messages reach the model.
description.zh: 为 DSH 纯文本模型补充视觉能力：识图技能（图片理解/OCR/文档解析，竞速池→自定义通道→本地）+ 幂等宿主补丁，让图片消息能送达模型侧。

description.en: Approval attention plugin for the DSH Web GUI: pending approval/plan-review/question alerts (chime, tab-title & favicon badge, PWA badge, approval-hub dock, OS notify) plus completion, job-failure, disconnect and 429 runtime-error alerts.
description.zh: Approval attention plugin for the DSH Web GUI — audible + visual alerts (chime, tab badge, OS notification, dock) for pending approvals, session completions, job failures, and connection loss.

description.en: Secure S3, Xiaomi FDS, and FTP/FTPS file tools for DeepSeek Harness, with approval-gated mutations and cancellable transfers.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 S3 和 FTP 文件管理工具，支持列目录、上传下载等 8 种操作，带审批和进度控制。

description.en: 鲸鱼插件市场 / Whale Market — browse, search, one-click install & update DSH plugins from the GitHub dsh-plugin topic (Web settings UI + Agent tools)
Open DeepSeek Harness workspaces from the existing sidebar three-dot menu
Manage Git worktrees inside DSH: scan workspace repositories, create worktrees, add them as DSH workspaces, open folders, remove worktrees, and prune stale records.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里集中管理 Git worktree，扫描仓库、创建/删除 worktree，还能直接作为工作区打开，多分支并行开发更顺手。

description.en: Two-step inline archive on workspace sidebar rows — one click arms a red confirm, the second click archives; the archive entry is removed from the ⋮ menu.
description.zh: 工作区侧边栏行内两击归档：点一次变红确认，再点即归档，归档项不再出现在 ⋮ 菜单里。

description.en: Disk-persisted execution planning for DSH: milestone/step state machines, dependency gating, an audit event stream, and a deterministic completion gate via dsh tools, CLI, or skill.

description.en: GitHub workbench MCP server (dsh bundle): 23 MCP tools for repos, issues, PRs, code review, and search, with zero runtime dependencies and PAT/OAuth auth.
description.zh: GitHub 开发者工作台 MCP server（dsh bundle）：23 个 MCP 工具覆盖仓库、issue、PR、代码审查与搜索，零运行时依赖，支持 PAT 与 OAuth 双认证。

description.en: A structured multi-panelist review workflow for the DeepSeek Harness: N panelists score in isolated subagents, blind to each other; a chair reconciles disagreement by anchor match then Δ-level adjudication; an independent critic audits the process. Works for design, code, paper or project review.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的结构化多评审人评审工作流：N 个评审人在相互隔离、彼此不可见的 subagent 中独立打分；一名 chair 先按锚点匹配、再按 Δ 级别裁决来调和分歧；一名独立的 critic 负责审计整个评审过程。适用于设计、代码、论文或项目评审。

description.en: Two-phase session captioning: instant keyword titles while the conversation is busy, then cheapest-budget-model refinement plus a one-line summary once it goes idle.
description.zh: 两阶段会话题词：会话进行中即时关键词题名，空闲后再调用最经济的预算模型精修，并附带一句话摘要。

description.en: Task-to-skill pairing for DeepSeek Harness — pours the minimal set (usually one; zero when plain tools suffice), prefers workflow skills over hand-composed atomics. Laziness ladder, quarantine → SkillSpector scan → explicit human approval, never auto-installs. 任务配技能 · 懒惰阶梯 · 安全酒窖 · 绝不自动安装
Bridge a DSH agent to a persistent, self-evolving KiroCrew development workspace over ACP (JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio) via a single `kiro_send` tool.
description.zh: 让 DSH 智能体通过一个 kiro_send 工具接入可持久、自进化的 KiroCrew 开发工作区。

description.en: Official-style composer model trigger with a floating reasoning-effort slider popup.
description.zh: 官方风格输入框 + 浮动推理能力滑块弹窗，节点与滑块对齐，弹窗跟随 Harness 主题自适应。

description.en: Scans a project's declared build commands — Makefile targets, package.json scripts, just recipes, deno tasks — and exposes them as ready-to-run agent tools.
description.zh: 扫描项目已声明的构建命令——Makefile 目标、package.json 脚本、just 配方、deno 任务——并作为可直接调用的 agent 工具暴露给智能体。

description.en: Session context triage for long DeepSeek Harness sessions: deterministic screeners trim stale, duplicate, failed, and oversized content through the official ctx.compaction seam.

description.zh: 把 Windows 桌面会话接到 DSH 上，本地起个 HTTP 服务就能远程管理会话。

description.en: Document workshop skill pack: four pure-prompt Agent Skills that turn a codebase into READMEs, PR descriptions, changelogs and code reviews, installed into dsh via a dsh.bundle plugin row.

description.en: Generates strong random passwords and diceware passphrases via crypto.
description.zh: 用加密级随机数生成强密码和 Diceware 口令，注册成工具随时调用。

description.en: DSH-PDF插件，让 AI 助手读取任意大小的 PDF 文件： 通过 pdfjs-dist 提取完整 Unicode 文本层（中文、英文及其它文字系统），并对扫描件/图片页自动 OCR， 手写笔记也能变成可读文本。DSH-PDF plugin — read any-size PDFs in DeepSeek Harness: full Unicode text (Chinese/English) via pdfjs-dist + automatic OCR (Windows WinRT / tesseract.js) for scanned pages. MIT.
Free-interval session reports with AI-narrated daily/weekly digests over any date range, plus every-N-days scheduled reminders with system notifications (macOS / Linux).
description.zh: 自由周期会话报告：任意日期区间的 AI 叙事日报/周报/月报，支持每隔 N 天定时提醒并弹系统通知（macOS / Linux）。

description.en: Queries npm/PyPI package metadata (version, license, dependencies).
description.zh: 查询 npm 和 PyPI 包的版本、依赖、发布时间等元数据，返回结构化 JSON，方便模型和程序调用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns silent tool failures into loud ones: a tools/post-execute policy that matches warning signatures in successful tool output and blocks the result or attaches a notice
DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin market tab: deepseek-harness GitHub catalog with Chinese-translated descriptions
Upload files and folders straight into the conversation — images attach as real message blocks, text content is written into the composer draft, folders land by directory structure.
description.zh: 把文件与文件夹直接传进对话——图片以真实图片块加入消息，文本内容写入输入框草稿，文件夹按目录结构落盘。

description.en: 8 curated color schemes plus custom palette import (name + scheme + seed colors derive a full token map), a Palette row in General settings, hot-plug install.
description.zh: 为 dsh 网页端提供 8 套精选配色，支持导入自定义色板，一键热插拔切换主题，无需改动核心。

description.en: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）QQ 通知插件：对话回合结束时经腾讯官方 QQ Bot API 推送私聊提醒，内置扫码绑定、5 个预设与占位变量，零外部依赖。| DSH QQ notification plugin: turn-end QQ alerts via official QQ Bot API, QR binding, presets & placeholders, zero deps.
description.zh: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）QQ 通知插件：对话回合结束时通过腾讯官方 QQ Bot API 推送私聊提醒，内置扫码绑定、5 个可编辑预设与占位变量，零外部依赖。

description.en: Two-tier image reading for text-only models: fast local OCR (RapidOCR, offline) first, vision-model fallback (modlens).
description.zh: 纯文本模型双层识图：优先本地快速 OCR（RapidOCR，离线），不足时回落视觉模型（modlens）。

description.en: DSH推理强度安装工具 | DSH Reasoning Effort installer - 让官方模型选择器支持推理等级选择，一键安装，支持任何模型供应商 | Enables reasoning effort selection in the official DSH model selector, one-click install, works with any provider
DeepSeek Harness Artifact/Deliverable plugin: publish workspace files as chat artifacts with inline image previews and download cards.
Pre-execution guardrail: vetoes dangerous shell commands and blocks secret/credential leaks before they run.
description.zh: 在命令执行前拦截危险 shell 命令和密钥泄漏，防止工具误操作造成损失。

description.en: Restart & shutdown buttons in the session header utilities: graceful appExit shutdown, auto-restart of `dsh web` via scheduled task → launcher `-ControlledRestart`.
description.zh: 在会话头部直接重启或关闭 dsh web 服务，不用切回终端，重启后页面自动重连。

description.en: Aborts startup when another live dsh instance holds the same DSH_HOME data directory, preventing the concurrent session-log writes that corrupt transcripts.
description.zh: 检测到其他存活的 dsh 实例占用同一 DSH_HOME 数据目录时中止启动，防止并发写会话日志导致的历史损坏。

description.en: Frosted-glass skin for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: pick any image as background, theme colors extracted from it, glassmorphism surfaces.

Speech plugin for DeepSeek Harness: per-message voice playback, auto-announce, and dictation via mic — cloud TTS/ASR on Alibaba DashScope or Volcengine (freely combinable), with Web Speech API fallback.
description.zh: Speech plugin for DeepSeek Harness: per-message speak button, composer voice input, and auto-announce toggle, over cloud TTS/ASR with Web Speech API fallback

description.en: S3-compatible backend for the spill seam: oversized tool output goes to object storage (S3, MinIO, R2) with hashed session prefixes and unguessable keys, instead of the agent's local disk.
description.zh: spill seam 的 S3 兼容后端：超长工具输出写入对象存储（S3、MinIO、R2），会话前缀经哈希、键不可猜测，而不是落在 agent 的本地磁盘上。

description.en: Local SSH bridge plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — password via browser page, agent exec via localhost API, OpenWrt router management
description.zh: Local SSH bridge for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH): user types the router password in a browser page, agent runs commands via a localhost API — the password never enters the chat.

description.en: A GUI subagent-model selector beside the main model seat: pick a model and reasoning effort per session, applied to every in-process subagent.
description.zh: 主模型选择器旁的子代理模型选择器：按会话选择模型与思考程度，应用到所有进程内子代理。

description.en: Turn any SVG logo into a motion video inside DSH: an `animate_svg` tool renders a transparent 30fps assembly animation (parts fly in, or the whole mark settles) and synthesizes an MP4 with ffmpeg.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里把任意 SVG logo 变成动效视频：`animate_svg` 工具渲染透明背景 30fps 组装动画（零件飞入或整体落位），并用 ffmpeg 合成 MP4。

description.en: Personal bookkeeping for DeepSeek Harness: record expenses/income (single or batch), list, monthly/annual stats with trends, budgets with progress/over-limit alerts, soft-delete restore, CSV & self-contained HTML report. Zero deps, local JSON. 个人记账插件
description.zh: 本地记账小工具，随手记支出收入，自动汇总月度年度账单，还能管预算、导出 CSV。

description.en: 把 Harness 的执行过程收敛成一个始终可见、几乎不打扰的任务状态指示器
DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: live task completion time, token & per-model cost estimator in the session header, with LLM-powered PERT estimates. / DSH 插件：会话标题栏实时任务耗时、token 与花费估算。
description.zh: 在会话标题栏实时显示任务耗时、token 消耗和各模型花费，还能用 AI 预估完成时间。

description.en: Two-way TickTick/Dida365 (滴答清单) task sync via the official OAuth Open API: pull tasks across lists, create/update/complete/delete tasks, and one-shot title-deduped sync, with a web settings panel.
description.zh: 基于官方 OAuth Open API 双向同步滴答清单（TickTick/Dida365）任务：拉取各清单任务、创建/更新/完成/删除、按标题去重的一键同步，带 Web 设置面板。

description.en: Per-process tool-call statistics: a `tool_stats` tool reporting per-tool call counts, error counts, and average durations.
description.zh: 进程内工具调用统计：提供 `tool_stats` 工具，按工具汇报调用次数、失败次数与平均耗时。

description.en: GitHub REST API tools + browser sidebar panel: repos, search, issues, PRs, comments, account binding (credential-store), and one-click clone-as-workspace.
description.zh: GitHub REST API 工具 + 浏览器侧边栏面板：仓库/搜索/Issue/PR/评论、账号绑定（凭据库）与一键克隆为工作区。

description.en: DSH 字体插件：界面字体/代码字体/显示比例/行高/字体浏览器 | DSH font plugin: UI/code fonts, display scale, line-height, font browser with CJK glyph marking
description.zh: DSH 字体插件：修改整个界面的文字显示效果（正文字体 / 代码字体 / 显示比例 / 行高 / 字体平滑 / 代码连字 / 字体浏览器 / 中文字形标记），设置 → 字体。

description.en: URL parsing, tracking-parameter removal, encode/decode, and redirect expansion.
description.zh: URL 解析、清理跟踪参数、编解码和重定向展开，零依赖开箱即用。

description.en: Give text-only DeepSeek models vision by describing images through an OpenAI-compatible vision model (DSH plugin)

Turns markdown into a WeChat Official Account (微信公众号) draft: inlines every CSS rule onto its element because the editor discards `<style>` blocks and class names, uploads each local image through WeChat's own endpoint so it is not filtered out, and creates the draft; it never broadcasts.
description.zh: 把 markdown 变成排好版的微信公众号草稿：样式逐条内联到元素上（编辑器会丢弃 `<style>` 块和 class 名），每张本地图片走微信自己的上传接口以免被过滤，然后创建草稿；不做群发。

description.en: 微信风格皮肤 for DeepSeek Harness — WeChat-style light theme for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 微信风格皮肤 for DeepSeek Harness — WeChat-style light theme for DeepSeek Harness: green bubbles, WeChat green accents, conversation-list sidebar, a far-left function rail, message avatars, and a resizable composer. Light mode only; dark mode falls back to the official look.

description.en: Parses natural-language relative time (e.g. "in 2 hours") into ISO timestamps, fail-fast.
description.zh: 把「两小时后」这类中文相对时间直接转成 ISO 时间戳，让插件和脚本能准确算时间。

description.en: Windows-grade notifications for DeepSeek Harness: system toasts, custom sounds, and a taskbar tray badge — a native DSH profile plugin (zero patching).
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上 Windows 原生提醒：系统弹窗、自定义提示音和任务栏角标，待办决策不再错过。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 插件：Workspace Only 开关 —— 任何模式下越界文件访问都请求用户确认 (approval prompt in every mode)
description.zh: Workspace Only switch for DeepSeek Harness: confine file access of every sandbox mode to the session workspace

description.en: 工作空间文件浏览器：树形目录浏览、搜索、在线编辑，可放入布局左/右区域，文件在对话/轨迹同级标签页打开
基于deepseek harness插件功能捏的狼人杀小游戏
description.zh: 9人局狼人杀多Agent游戏引擎（DeepSeek Harness 插件）：自动主持、角色技能、警长竞选、投票、复盘、人类席位、跨局知识库、素材管线

description.en: Conversational DSH plugin finder: four-source unified index, BM25 pre-filter plus LLM semantic ranking, candidates carry evidence grades and local static security audit, safe install flow with post-install verification.
description.zh: 对话式查找 DSH 插件的增强版 skill：四源聚合统一索引，BM25 粗筛 + LLM 语义精排，候选表带证据分级与本地静态安全审计，安装走安全确认流程并自动验证。

description.en: Cordis-native, evidence-driven full-stack engineering workflow: inspect-first planning, explicit verification evidence, and approval-aware gating for sensitive operations.
description.zh: 以证据驱动的全栈工程工作流：先勘察后规划、要求显式验证证据、敏感操作走审批门控。

description.en: DSH 插件管理器：设置→插件管理。插件安装/卸载/禁用/更新，插件包导入导出，Agent 预设清理。
description.zh: 插件管理：设置 → 插件管理（管理插件 / 下载插件 / 开发插件 / 插件包）。M1 持久管理 loader 树插件：原生插件禁用/启用，用户插件禁用/启用/卸载，操作写 profile 配置、重启后生效。

description.en: DSH Flow and plugin hub for DeepSeek Harness Agent Stacks
A local table data management plugin developed for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接管理表格数据，无需数据库和服务器，数据全存在本地，简单好用。

description.en: Auto-supplement QMD semantic search when the model greps/globs a knowledge-base directory: zero-dependency DSH plugin, async injection via next-step, no manual invocation.
description.zh: 模型在知识库目录执行 grep/glob 搜索时自动补充 QMD 语义检索：零依赖 DSH 插件，异步注入下一步上下文，无需手动调用。

description.en: Blocks agents from reading or writing sensitive files (.env, credentials, key material), masks leaked secret-shaped values in tool results, keeps an audit journal, and exposes safe sg_* inspection tools that never print raw values.
description.zh: 拦截 agent 对敏感文件（.env、凭据、密钥材料）的读写，对工具结果中泄露的机密形状内容做掩码兜底，记录审计日志，并提供永不输出原始值的 sg_* 安全检查工具。

description.en: Expands #tag shorthand into snippet-library text before messages are sent; multi-library, aliases, variables and recursion guards.
description.zh: 发送前把消息中的 #tag 展开为片段库配置的正文；支持多片段库、别名、变量占位符与递归防护。

description.en: Cross-app project memory for DeepSeek Harness with role-separated writeback, a visual knowledge workspace, confirmed corrections, session controls, local Writer and organizer settings, and an account-free Windows local installation preview.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的跨应用项目记忆，支持角色分离写回、可视化知识工作台、确认后纠错、会话控制、本地 Writer 与整理模型设置，以及免账号 Windows 本地安装预览。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 桌面宠物「宇昊」
DeepSeek Harness 图片插件：贴图不会让对话报错，模型自动判断是否需要看图（支持智谱/魔搭免费视觉模型，图片在聊天窗口正常显示）
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 图片插件：贴图不会让对话报错，模型自动判断是否需要看图（支持智谱/魔搭免费视觉模型，图片在聊天窗口正常显示）

description.en: Declarative task-DAG orchestration for DSH: validates dependency graphs, runs topological task layers in parallel through workflow-backed subagents, and propagates failures deterministically.
description.zh: DSH 声明式任务 DAG 编排：校验依赖图，通过工作流子智能体并行执行拓扑任务层，并确定性传播失败。

description.en: dsh 主题管理插件
description.zh: dsh 主题管理插件

description.en: Kimi-Code-style agent swarm for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): parallel worker agents + coordinator synthesis — agent_swarm tool and /swarm command
One-command bundle of the three AgentFrame plugins: memory-director, compaction, and aura-scheduler together.
description.zh: AgentFrame 三件套整合包：一条命令装齐记忆、压缩与主动调度。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to AsimovBox for creating, updating, rendering, and finishing videos through API-key-authenticated tools.
description.zh: 通过 API 密钥认证的工具将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 AsimovBox，用于创建、更新、渲染和完成视频。

description.en: DSH Web UI 的认证门禁插件，提供 SVG 图形验证码与防暴力破解保护
description.zh: 给 DSH Web UI 加一道登录门，用 SVG 图形验证码拦住暴力破解，保护你的管理界面。

description.en: Client-only right-edge chat input index rail: one bar per user message, two-stage hover preview (15 chars, expandable to 40), click-to-jump, and scroll-follow highlight; static npm bundle with no host half.
description.zh: 纯客户端对话输入目录条：每条用户消息一根横条，两级悬停预览（15 字，移入气泡展开 40 字）、点击跳转、滚动跟随高亮；静态 npm 包，无宿主半。

description.en: Task-completion notification chime for the DSH web GUI: beeps when an agent turn finishes, even in background tabs. 10 preset sounds + custom import + volume.
Injects allowlisted GitHub Actions and GitLab CI run metadata into agent context without reading logs, credentials, or provider APIs.
description.zh: 将白名单内的 GitHub Actions 与 GitLab CI 运行元数据注入 Agent 上下文，不读取日志、凭据或服务商 API。

description.en: Claude → DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 配置迁移插件：自动识别用户主目录与项目根的 .claude/skills、.claude/rules、.mcp.json、CLAUDE.md，skill 按工作区隔离唤醒，MCP 动态注册真实连接，内置可折叠配置中心看板

Project memory for coding agents on DeepSeek Harness: similar past edits surface as precedents, out-of-scope edits are blocked, and cognition persists across sessions (47 upstream-verified fixes, gold-free 20-task run).
description.zh: 给 DSH agent 的项目记忆:历史相似编辑作为先例出现、越界修改被 scope 锁拦下、认知跨会话持续积累(47 次上游验收修复、去 gold 化 20/20)。

description.en: Compaction backend replacing LLM summarization with a deterministic semantic extractor (keeps code/paths/commands, drops chatter) plus 28.4x KV-compression accounting.
description.zh: 压缩后端：用确定性语义提取器替换 LLM 摘要（保留代码/路径/命令，剔除闲聊），附带 28.4x KV 压缩记账。

description.en: dsh-compat 是 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的旧插件兼容层。它让原本面向 Claude Code、Codex 的插件尽量保持原目录与语义运行，而不是把每个插件重新迁移成 DSH 原生插件。
description.zh: dsh-compat 是 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的旧插件兼容层。它让原本面向 Claude Code、Codex 的插件尽量保持原目录与语义运行，而不是把每个插件重新迁移成 DSH 原生插件。

description.en: DSH plugin: cross-session messaging with reliable delivery and role addressing (coding/review loop)
Conversation-local credential handoff for DSH that writes through the credential service without exposing the secret.
description.zh: 会话级凭证交接：通过 credential 服务安全传递。

description.en: Transparent image preprocessing route for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 透明图片预处理路由：给纯文本模型加视觉通道。

description.en: DSH 对话报告化分享插件：生成带封面、摘要统计与章节排版的精美报告，导出为 PNG 图片 / 单 HTML 文件 / PDF。
DOOM in Deepseek Harness web ui
MCP client hub (stdio / Streamable HTTP / SSE) with a web console for DeepSeek Harness — manage MCP servers, agent skills, slash commands, project & global memory, and prompt sections.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 MCP 客户端中枢，支持多种连接方式，并带网页控制台管理服务器、技能、命令和记忆。

description.en: Runtime security gate on the tool pipeline: denies calls naming hosts outside an egress allowlist, redacts credentials from results at the canonical value rather than only the rendered content, and appends every decision to a JSONL audit log; ships in monitor-only mode.
description.zh: 工具管线上的运行时安全网关：拦截出站白名单之外的主机调用，在 canonical value（而非仅渲染内容）层面脱敏结果中的凭据，每个决策写入 JSONL 审计日志；默认仅监控不拦截。

description.en: Font system plugin: OFL webfont presets served offline from the plugin, user-imported custom woff2 fonts, and a ctx.fonts registry other plugins can extend.
description.zh: 字体系统插件：随插件离线分发的 OFL 开源字体预设、自定义 woff2 字体导入，以及供其他插件扩展的 ctx.fonts 注册表。

description.en: A development safety kit: rolling config snapshots, automatic rollback on plugin failures, boot-failure rescue, and an in-settings management panel.
description.zh: 开发配套守护：滚动快照、插件失败自动回退、启动失败救援、设置页管理面板。

description.en: 图解教学：DeepSeek Harness 插件——把任何知识点自动渲染成精美图解画廊（8 套小红书科普风模板，专为本科学习设计）
A DeepSeek Harness web plugin: set a background image and adapt the UI's text, background, brand and border colors to the image palette automatically.Built with DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页换上背景图，界面文字、配色和边框会自动跟着图片色调走，颜值瞬间提升。

description.en: Hands repetitive text and vision labor (OCR, image analysis, comparison) to a local KoboldCpp (llama.cpp) server through koboldcpp_run and koboldcpp_vision tools, with on-demand server lifecycle management.
description.zh: 给在线模型装上本地双手：koboldcpp_run 与 koboldcpp_vision 工具把重复的文本与视觉（OCR、图像分析、对比）劳动交给本地 KoboldCpp（llama.cpp）服务器，并按需拉起与管理服务器生命周期。

description.en: 浮游主题（Krill）——深海世界 + 浅海世界 双模式主题插件（DSH Web）：深色=深海（亮度编码信息层级），亮色=浅海（清澈度编码）；浮游生物动画背景、深潜工作态增强、水母参数入口。dsh-plugin
Fix the DeepSeek Harness web UI on phones: injects a crypto.randomUUID polyfill so it works over plain HTTP on your LAN - no certs, no proxy. dsh plugin + CLI, zero dependencies.
DeepSeek Harness Codex OAuth provider with native compaction and image support
Automatic provider failover on rate limits or quota exhaustion: switch between providers with configurable per-provider models, a cooldown, and a permanent last-entry fallback.
description.zh: 限流或配额耗尽时自动切换模型提供方：可按提供方配置模型，带冷却机制与永久最终兜底。

description.en: Local Markdown wiki as long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness — RRF-fused retrieval (keyword + wikilink graph + temporal), token-budget injection, auto-capture. Ported from llmwiki.
description.zh: 把本地 Markdown 笔记变成 DeepSeek Harness 的长期记忆，自动检索并注入上下文，让对话更连贯。

description.en: dsh-mcp-xcode
description.zh: 让 DSH agent 直接调用 Xcode 的无头能力，建工程、构建测试、跑模拟器、渲染预览全搞定。

description.en: LLM-driven remember/forget memory: after each turn a model decides what to keep (MemoryDirector), injects relevant memories before each step, dedups, and persists cross-session.
description.zh: LLM 驱动的记忆记/忘插件：每轮对话后由模型决定记住什么/忘记什么（MemoryDirector），请求前注入相关记忆，自动去重，跨会话持久化。

description.en: Window-like controls for every Web UI modal: drag by title bar, eight-way resize, pin against outside clicks, maximize to the full viewport, removable backdrop blur, and per-dialog persistent state.

description.en: DSH Web GUI 新闻聚合插件：侧边栏入口 + 弹窗聚合国际/AI/科普/历史 RSS 新闻，站内阅读、中英互译、自定义源。A news aggregator plugin for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI: RSS feeds, in-app reading, bilingual translation, custom sources.

Email reminders from your DSH agent when you're away: fires at goal completion, blockage, before asking the user a decision, and at long-task milestones via a bundled zero-dependency Node SMTP sender.
description.zh: 你不在电脑前时由 agent 邮件提醒你：goal 完成、阻塞、向你提问决策前、长任务节点时触发，自带零依赖 Node SMTP 发送器。

description.en: The pet that grows with your agent: 5 evolution stages earned from real signals (verified rules, completed sessions, tool calls, compactions), agent-state mirroring, and one-click growth share cards. Zero dependencies, 100% local.
description.zh: 会随 agent 成长的宠物：真实信号（已验证规则/会话/工具调用/压缩）驱动 5 阶段进化、镜像 agent 状态、一键导出成长分享卡。零依赖、全本地。

description.en: DSH使用体验优化包-UI has been i18n (zh/en)。自动审核(auto-review)、提示音(systematic notification)，为你把关系统权限，持续推进；需要你审批、回答或后台任务跑完时，提示音 + 系统通知一个不落。一行命令装完，解放被持续召唤的碎片时间。

Workflow tools for the local aflare binary: generate, validate and run local-first deterministic YAML workflow DAGs (WAL crash recovery, Saga compensation) through the local aflare binary, with 300+ templates built in.
